sprout.title: -SPROUT-
sprout.descHtml: -SPROUT- is a mini precision-platformer built for speed-running. Run, jump and dash your way through 100 levels across five unique lands, and restore your world to its former glory.
sprout.instHtml: Purchase the game from Steam. Download the game and place the game files in sprout/assets.

100liljumps.title: 100 Lil Jumps
100liljumps.descHtml: Nara the frog has been cursed and can only make 100 jumps. Complete the challenge and break the curse.

2048plus.title: 2048 Plus
2048plus.descHtml: A feature-packed implementation of the classic puzzle game 2048, built using the LÖVE framework.
2048plus.instHtml: Ready to run. Use the D-Pad to move tiles, L1/R1 for power-ups, B to undo, and Y to switch themes.

6feetunder.title: 6 Feet Under
6feetunder.descHtml: Our zombie friend has risen from her grave. Help her find her way back home so she can rest easy. Game is focused on the speedrun community but if you're a casual player, this game is also good for you.
6feetunder.instHtml: Ready to Run! Thanks to Stoff for making this game and generously allowing us to host it on our site.

8bitbuccaneer.title: 8-BIT BUCCANEER
8bitbuccaneer.descHtml: A pirate-themed roguelike game, in which you sail around, buy treasure maps, dig up treasure, and fight enemy ships and monsters.

akeyspath.title: A Key(s) Path
akeyspath.descHtml: Build your way with your own keys. Your three movement keys (Left, Right, Jump) are available at the bottom of the screen; you can drag them in the world to use as platforms. But don't use too many, or you could run out of movement options!
akeyspath.instHtml: Game files are included and ready to run. Thanks, Geegaz!

ametadatagame.title: A Meta Data Game
ametadatagame.descHtml: Embark on a short yet captivating journey of self-discovery. Solve intricate puzzles and uncover the hidden truths that await you.
ametadatagame.instHtml: All files included and ready to run. Thanks to Ansimuz for releasing this fantastic game to the Public Domain.

apondbeyond.title: A Pond Beyond
apondbeyond.descHtml: A short puzzle platformer where you play as a tiny frog who must make their way to a pond beyond and avoid many dangers along the way. There are many flies to eat during your adventure, pause the game at any time to view how many you've got.
apondbeyond.instHtml: Download A Pond Beyond.zip (August 16, 2024) from https://npjarcade.itch.io/a-pond-beyond. Copy the data.win from the zip over to apondbeyond/assets.

astoryaboutbirds.title: A Story About Birds
astoryaboutbirds.descHtml: The birds are coming back! So, gather some wood, some bird food, and build some amazing shelters. Explore Plumage Farm on a relaxing day, collect branches and seeds in form of a minigame that requires skill and get to know its inhabitants and regulars. How will you use the day?
astoryaboutbirds.instHtml: Install port files. Buy game in Itch. Download "asab-linux-v1.0.5.zip" then extract file "a-story-about-birds.arm64" into "ports\astoryaboutbirds" folder

thanksgiving.title: A Thanksgiving Game
thanksgiving.descHtml: A mini farming sim that lasts just 5 days, much like the game jam it was made for. You are tasked with preparing a small town's Thanksgiving feast by Thursday.
thanksgiving.instHtml: Download A_Thanksgiving_Game_v1.4.zip at itch.io and copy data.win and options.ini into assets folder.

atowerintheforest.title: A Tower in the Forest
atowerintheforest.descHtml: "Today is the day"- to finally climb the tower in the forest. Turn windmills to activate platforms, open doors or create shortcuts and make your way to the top in this short, atmospheric platformer about reaching your goals.

a7xpg.title: A7Xpg
a7xpg.descHtml: The goal of the game is to collect all the gold bullions found in each level and avoid crashing into any of the enemies. As you progress through the levels you will encounter harder enemies, and you can gain a short period of invincibility if you gather gold at high speeds.

abes_adventure.title: Abe's Amazing Adventure
abes_adventure.descHtml: A scrolling, platform-jumping, key-collecting, ancient pyramid exploring game, vaguely in the style of similar games for the Commodore+4. Abe's Adventure files are already included and ready to go.

abombniball.title: Abombniball
abombniball.descHtml: The objective of Abombniball is to defuse all the explosives on each level. As a ball, this would normally be a simple task, however each level is filled with traps and devious puzzles.
abombniball.instHtml: You defuse bombs by landing on the bombs square, however you can only defuse the bomb thats currently counting down. Trying to defuse any other bomb will cause it to explode.

absolutereflex.title: Absolute Reflex
absolutereflex.descHtml: Absolute Reflex is a Classic Bullet Hell showdown, but you can STOP TIME at any point and TELEPORT to safety! Though if you want to try for the score, refrain yourself.
absolutereflex.instHtml: Download the game from https://jukio.itch.io/absolute-reflex and copy the exe file into the port folder.

profadeluxe.title: Abu Simbel Profanation Deluxe
profadeluxe.descHtml: An open-source, freeware remake of the Spanish platform game from 1985 replaces the graphics and sounds with new enhanced assets, while maintaining the same unforgiving gameplay of the original.

abuse.title: Abuse
abuse.descHtml: A fork of the original Abuse SDL port from http://abuse.zoy.org/. An intense 2D shooter. Plays best on dual analog stick devices. Just download and play.

asc.title: Advanced Strategic Command
asc.descHtml: A free, open-source turn-based hex wargame in the tradition of Battle Isle 2/3. Command land, sea, and air units to eliminate your opponent across dozens of bundled maps and campaigns.
asc.instHtml: Ready to run, all game data is bundled, no additional files needed.

adventurerush.title: Adventure Rush
adventurerush.descHtml: Get ready for another incredible adventure, face spiders, monsters and goblins in a side scrolling system with Shoot 'Em Up elements and try out numerous equipment with your hero. But beware of the fearsome Dragon!!
adventurerush.instHtml: Purchase the game on Steam or download the free demo from Itch.io and copy all game files into the assets folder.

aerofoil.title: Aerofoil
aerofoil.descHtml: Aerofoil is a port of John Calhoun's Glider PRO, the classic paper airplane game for Apple Macintosh computers released in 1994.

aestheta.title: Aestheta
aestheta.descHtml: A roguelike royalelike about warriors from across space and time, fighting to claim a wish from the Star of Aestheta. Strategize your tactics, enhance your troops, and outwit your opponents to rise to the top!
aestheta.instHtml: Install port. Download game on Steam or Itch. Copy all game files into the ports/aestheta/assets folder.

afternoonstalker.title: Afternoon Stalker
afternoonstalker.descHtml: Afternoon Stalker, a robot-killing video game. It is a clone of the 1982 Night Stalker video game for the Intellivision, from Mattel Electronics.

air.title: Air
air.descHtml: 'AIR' follows Yukito Kunisaki, a traveling puppeteer searching for a winged girl from a childhood legend, who arrives in a small seaside town. There, he meets various girls, each with their own unique stories and supernatural abilities. As Yukito unravels their pasts and the town's mysteries, he discovers connections that transcend time and space, leading to poignant revelations about love, loss, and the human spirit.

alchemyquest.title: Alchemy Quest
alchemyquest.descHtml: Alchemy Quest is a simple puzzle game where players combine alchemic elements to create exotic combinations and score points. A launcher for Open Alchemist is included.
alchemyquest.instHtml: All files are included and game is ready to play.

alephone-marathon.title: Aleph-One Marathon 1
alephone-marathon.descHtml: An open source version of Bungie's Marathon 1 first person shooter.

alephone-marathon2.title: Aleph-One Marathon 2
alephone-marathon2.descHtml: An open source version of Bungie's Marathon 2 first person shooter.

alephone-marathoninfinity.title: Aleph-One Marathon Infinity
alephone-marathoninfinity.descHtml: An open source version of Bungie's Marathon Infinity first person shooter.

alex1.title: Alex the Allegator 1
alex1.descHtml: A very short platform game by Johan Peitz, made for the 1999 "Allegro Speedhack" jam. Jump around the level as Alex and try to find your dreamgirl Lola. Unfinished by the author's own admission, but playable start to finish.

alex2.title: Alex the Allegator 2
alex2.descHtml: A mouse-driven puzzle game by Johan Peitz, made for the 2001 "Allegro Speedhack" jam. Place your tokens on the board or slide a row/column in turn, trying to wipe the board of your own color while keeping the higher score. Watch out for the gray stone tokens, and use the yellow multi-tokens wisely.
alex2.instHtml: Ready to run. Entirely mouse-driven - the left stick moves a cursor and A clicks. Two-player works fine on one controller since both players share the same cursor in turn.

alex3.title: Alex the Allegator 3: Radioactive Racers
alex3.descHtml: A top-down racing game by Johan Peitz, made for the 2002 "Allegro Speedhack" jam. Race against AI opponents (and a second local player) around a single track, throttling, braking and steering to place first across 5 laps. Unfinished by the author's own admission (only one track), but playable start to finish.

alex4.title: Alex the Allegator 4
alex4.descHtml: A GameBoy-style platform game by Johan Peitz / Free Lunch Design. Guide Alex the Allegator through 10 levels, spitting cherries and jumping on enemies to rescue his captured family. This port also bundles 23 fan-made custom level packs sourced from the game's own community map page, selectable from a startup menu alongside the original campaign.
alex4.instHtml: Ready to run. On startup, pick the main campaign or browse a curated set of bonus community level packs.

alexvsbus.title: Alex vs Bus: The Race
alexvsbus.descHtml: A free and open source platform runner game. Alex depends on public transportation and needs to run to catch the bus, or wait an eternity for the next one.
alexvsbus.instHtml: Ready to run. D-pad to move, A/B/X to jump, Start to pause.

alicecliche.title: Alice In Clicheland
alicecliche.descHtml: Alice in Clicheland is a game developed for Digital Games Development course, taken during their Computer Science grad school at UFMG. It is an action RPG game, where the action takes place in real time. With its 2D graphics and aerial view, Alice in Clicheland recalls SNES RPG games, like Final Fantasy and Zelda.

alienblaster.title: Alien Blaster
alienblaster.descHtml: Alien Blaster is a classic 2D shoot 'em up featuring lots of different weapons, special items, aliens to blast and a big bad boss. Your mission is simple: Stop the invasion of the aliens and blast them!

aliendeathmob.title: Alien Death Mob
aliendeathmob.descHtml: Aliens have invaded Earth! Towns, cities, deserts, they're everywhere! Take on the role of Earth's last super soldier and confront the alien menace in this intense twin stick shooter!
aliendeathmob.instHtml: Purchase the game from Steam. Download the latest version of the game and place the game files in ports/alientdeathmob/assets

alienpogs.title: Alien Pogs From Outer Space
alienpogs.descHtml: This Bullet Heaven Survival game was made for GBJam11 from Sept 15-25 2023 .
alienpogs.instHtml: Download any version of the game from Itch.io , extract the zip file and copy the .rpg file into the alienpogs port folder

aliensquatter.title: Alien Squatter
aliensquatter.descHtml: You are a homeless extraterrestrial living in a futuristic version of Japan. Humans are nearly extinct and Earth is a cesspool of pollution, urban decay, and economic inequality. Struggle to survive in this new style of RPG.
aliensquatter.instHtml: Download any version of the game from Steam or itch.io, extract the zip file and copy the asquatter.rpg file into the the aliensquatter port folder.

avp.title: Aliens versus Predator
avp.descHtml: The three most ferocious species in the universe in a bloodthirsty battle for the ultimate prize: survival. Take your pick: be a Colonial Marine, a Predator or an Alien. Fight through suspense-filled environments: from starships and space stations to colonial bases and eerie planetscapes. One wrong move turns you from hunter to prey.
avp.instHtml: You will need the original files of the 1999 PC release copied to the ports/avp folder.

alllcall.title: AlllCALL
alllcall.descHtml: This is a mini shmup. The boss appears when 8 large numbered enemies are defeated. The stage is cleared when the boss is defeated.
alllcall.instHtml: Download free at itch.io and copy the data.win file into the assets folder.

alphaman.title: Alphaman
alphaman.descHtml: Alphaman is an action platformer with classic, run, jump, dash, and shoot combat about an android taking down some bots gone bad. The group of hackers known as the Red Bombers have unleashed a virus infecting every day robots. Even more dangerous are the bots who were formerly modified by their previous owners to enter into android fighting tournaments. It's up to Alpha to stop the bad bots and take down the Red Bombers!
alphaman.instHtml: Buy the game from here "https://yomic.itch.io/alphaman" and download the Alphaman Steamless Windows 'PortMaster' version. Unzip the file once downloaded and place 'Alphaman.pck' into ports/alphaman/gamedata

alruna.title: Alruna and the Necro-Industrialists
alruna.descHtml: Welcome to a compact, tightly packed Metroidvania, where the Square Aspect Ratio and Single Screen Level Design allows every one of the 200+ rooms to slot into the larger puzzle-box of the world; where secrets, exploits and sequence-breaking are built into the very foundation of the game; and where the overarching story doesn’t care too much which path you happen to take through the game.
alruna.instHtml: Purchase the game on Steam and copy game files into the assets folder.

alwayssurrender.title: Always Surrender
alwayssurrender.descHtml: Always Surrender is a vertically scrolling shoot 'em up score attack, with an emphasis on pushing your luck as far as you can. Last as long as possible against an endless horde of enemies and then surrender in order to bank the bonus. Giving up has never been so rewarding. Battle a never ending swarm of enemies, but be sure to surrender before you die...
alwayssurrender.instHtml: Purchase the game on Steam and copy all game files into the assets folder.

ambidextro.title: Ambidextro
ambidextro.descHtml: Ambidextro is a multiplayer for a single player. Learn to control two characters at the same time, one with each hand. Develop your ambidexterity and rescue both the prince and the princess simultaneously.
ambidextro.instHtml: Copy the file Ambidextro.pck into the folder: /roms/ports/ambidextro/

amoebax.title: Amoebax
amoebax.descHtml: Amoebax is a cute and addictive action-puzzle game. Due an awful mutation, some amoeba's species have started to multiply until they take the world if you can't stop them. Fortunately the mutation made then too unstable and lining up four or more will make them disappear.

amphetamine.title: Amphetamine
amphetamine.descHtml: Jump'n run platformer with colored lighting, fogging and corona effects. Fight eleven evil monsters with your magic weapons.

amuletsarmor.title: Amulets & Armor
amuletsarmor.descHtml: 1997 first-person dungeon-crawler RPG, released as open source by ExiguusEntertainment.

anarch.title: Anarch
anarch.descHtml: Anarch is extremely small, completely public domain, no-dependency, no-file, portable suckless anarcho-pacifist from-scratch 90s-style Doom clone that runs everywhere, made for the benefit of all living beings

angband.title: Angband
angband.descHtml: Angband is a free, single-player dungeon exploration game. You play an adventurer seeking riches, fighting monsters, and preparing for a final battle with Morgoth, the Lord of Darkness.
angband.instHtml: Game files are already included. Controls are rather complex, make sure to read the control sheet on our website carefully.

angrydd.title: Angry Drunken Dwarves
angrydd.descHtml: A falling-block puzzle game in the style of Puzzle Fighter. Build large gems by matching colors, then break them to drop garbage gems on your opponent. Seven playable characters, six AI difficulty levels, and secret unlockable modes.

annalynn.title: Annalynn
annalynn.descHtml:
Annalynn is a 2D platformer made in the style of arcade games from the early '80s. Play as Annalynn, the eponymous heroine who has to run, jump, and climb to outwit the four snakes: Randy, Handy, Candy, and Mike. Collect the coins, grab the bonus foods, and turn the tables with blinding rubies! Think you've got what it takes to go for the high score?

Note: This is version 1.3 of the steam version. Other versions are not compatible with this portmaster package!
annalynn.instHtml: Purchase the game from steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1508460/Annalynn/ Run steam console via Windows+R: Type: steam://open/console, download the 1.3 version by typing: download_depot 1508460 1508461 5365853075598347936 in the console. When the download is complete, it will tell you the location of the folder, copy all files to /ports/annalynn/assets

annulus.title: Annulus
annulus.descHtml:
Afraid of the dark? Turning the lights on just might be more dangerous...

You have arrived on the the Annulus, a space station here to reap all of your home world's power. You can channel this power freely through you, but strange and twisted machines are here to take it. Navigate the dark corridors and Fight against the darkness in this epic descent into the Annulus and control the vessel from within. Reroute power to light the way and solve puzzles. Pick up abilities along the way and become strong enough to traverse the deepest parts of the ship. Can you uncover the true purpose of the Annulus?
annulus.instHtml: Download Annulus 2.31.exe from here - https://toq-games.itch.io/annulus - rename exe to zip and extract contents to ports/annulus/assets folder. Launch the game and Enjoy!

anodyne.title: Anodyne
anodyne.descHtml: In this unique Zelda-lite game, explore and fight your way through surreal and creepy, nature, urban and abstract themed areas in the human Young's subconscious, evoked by a 16-bit-era visual style and a moody, dream-like soundtrack.
anodyne.instHtml: Copy all the files contained in the game's Remake folder to anodyne/gamedata.

antecrypt.title: Antecrypt
antecrypt.descHtml: Shoot corrupting monsters and save mankind's last hard-drive with your rechargeable laser-beam! ... But your aiming has a mind of its own, so you'll have to make do!
antecrypt.instHtml: Purchase the game on Steam or itch.io. For Itch.io, download the MacOS version and copy the antecrypt.app into gamedata. For Steam, download the MacOS version using the following Steam console command: download_depot 1659920 1659922 959787945917647264, and then copy the files into gamedata.

antonballclassic.title: Antonball Classic
antonballclassic.descHtml:
After a long night on the town, Anton's struggling to find his way back home. You'll have to help Anton out by using your balls to break the bricks!

You'll also run into pesky Ballbusters during your adventure together. Get rid of them by smacking them with your balls, or hitting them from behind!
antonballclassic.instHtml: Download the game on itch.io https://summitsphere.itch.io/antonball and unzip all game data to antonballclassic/assets.

antonballdeluxe.title: Antonball Deluxe
antonballdeluxe.descHtml: The breakout title from Summitsphere, Antonball Deluxe is a retro, high-octane smorgasbord of ballbusting arcade action! Antonball Deluxe quite literally turns the breakout genre on its head, blending traditional brick-breaking gameplay with tight, intense platforming.
antonballdeluxe.instHtml: Purchase the game from Steam and use Steam Console to get the correct version of the game. Enter this command- "download_depot 1382320 1382321 918226394225802310" Once this is done, It will tell you the location of these downloaded files. Copy them into the assets folder.

apocrunner.title: Apoc Runner
apocrunner.descHtml: As the world burns, as the streets crumble, you cling to one thing: Survival. An unstoppable alien blight has taken hold of the earth, and there's no fighting it. Escape is the only option. Run, jump, and slide your way through urban destruction in this intense runner!
apocrunner.instHtml: Thanks to Omnitron Studios, there is no need to download the game from itch.io to obtain the game files. This port is now Ready to Run as soon as it's been installed on your device.

apotris.title: Apotris
apotris.descHtml: Apotris is a block stacking game in the style of Tetris! It features satisfying graphics, responsive controls and a large amount of customization so that you can tailor the game to your preferences! There are 11 game-modes to explore, with various options to keep yourself entertained (or challenged).

applerabbledazzle.title: Apple Rabble Dazzle
applerabbledazzle.descHtml: The fruit of the Great Tree grows all year long. To claim it, one must follow the Mazana Tribe's ritual.
applerabbledazzle.instHtml: Download the 1.1.2 VM compile from itch.io and copy all of the files into ports/applerabbledazzle/assets/.

apricots.title: Apricots
apricots.descHtml:
Apricots has nothing to do with apricots. It's a game where you fly a little plane around the screen and shoot things and drop bombs on enemy targets, and it's meant to be quick and fun.

Big thanks to Moggers87 for producing this game.

The source
apricots.instHtml:
At present there is no option screen. Options can be changed by editing the configuration file apricots.cfg. This is first searched for in ~/.config/apricots/, then the system configuration directory (usually /usr/local/etc or /etc) and finally the default configuration in the data directory.

The number and type of planes can be varied, along with the airbases, as can 1/2 player game be chosen. The number of anti aircraft guns and scenery can be selected. Draks can be turned on or off, and a different condition for winning the game can be chosen.

aprildabbledazzle.title: April Dabble Dazzle
aprildabbledazzle.descHtml: The fruit of the Great Tree grows all year long. To claim it, one must follow the Mazana Tribe's ritual.
aprildabbledazzle.instHtml: Download the VM compile from itch.io, extract, and copy all of the files into ports/aprildabbledazzle/assets/.

aquaria.title: Aquaria
aquaria.descHtml: A massive ocean world, teeming with life and filled with ancient secrets. Join Naija, a lone underwater dweller in search of her family, as she explores the depths of Aquaria. She'll travel from hidden caves, shrouded in darkness, to beautiful, sunlit oases, all lovingly handcrafted by its two creators.
aquaria.instHtml: Install the port. Buy the game on Steam or GoG and copy the game files (data/ and surrounding files) into your ports/aquaria folder.

arcadespirits.title: Arcade Spirits
arcadespirits.descHtml: Arcade Spirits is a Visual novel that takes place in an alternative future where the Video Game Crash of 1983 did not happen. You will be working at an Arcade, and who knows, maybe romance would bloom?
arcadespirits.instHtml:
Notes: If you want to name your player character something other than Ari Cader, connect a Keyboard to your device

Also Please note that at the current time, the best way to leave the game is to rely on the in-game quit menu

Thanks to: Fiction Factory Games for creating this lovely game

The testers for helping getting this port to it's current state

arcanumce.title: Arcanum Community Edition
arcanumce.descHtml: A steampunk isometric RPG from Troika Games where you can freely mix magic and technology. Ported via Arcanum Community Edition, a clean-room reimplementation of the original engine.
arcanumce.instHtml: You must own Arcanum (GOG or Steam) and copy its data files into arcanumce/gamedata/ on the device before launching: tig.dat, arcanum1.dat through arcanum4.dat, and the modules/ folder.

arco.title: Arco
arco.descHtml:
A Mesoamerican fantasy RPG that blends turn-based and real-time combat. Explore the world through three handcrafted stories forged in bloodshed, laced with magic, and united by revenge. This port does not work with the demo files!.

Note: If the L2 toggle patch is applied, use L1/R1 to select combat actions.
arco.instHtml: Purchase the game on Steam. Copy arco.exe to ports/arco. On first startup, you can apply a D-pad/L-stick L2 toggle patch (Recommended for D-pad only devices).

area2048.title: AREA2048
area2048.instHtml: Clear a scene by destroying all the enemies that are in the scene. If you touch an enemy body or enemy bullet, you loose a life. When you clear 10 scenes, you proceed to the next area. The game is complete when five areas are cleared. If all areas can't be cleared in the time limit, it's game over.

arengius.title: Arengius
arengius.descHtml: The whole galactic federation is under attack by the gigantic organism known only as Arengius! With the federation army under attack on all fronts, only you have a chance to stop Arengius and save the galaxy! The game offers 13 stages full of unique hazards and powerful bosses.
arengius.instHtml: Download the game (both Lite and Full version works) from Itch.io and place the zip file into the assets folder.

arkovstower.title: Arkovs Tower
arkovstower.descHtml: This roguelike puts you in the shoes of an unnamed adventurer who just woke up on the top level of Arkov's Tower. Try to fight your way down and escape it - or die trying. Move your player trough numerous procedural generated levels. Fight numerous enemies including some unique bosses. The turn based combat system allows you to take your time and plan every move carefully. Upgrade your character with all sorts of items found in chests or dropped by enemies. This game is highly customizable for people with pixel art and/or programming experience.
arkovstower.instHtml: Includes the Arkovs Tower Prologue version. If you enjoy the game, please consider adding the full version to your steam wishlist

armagetronad.title: Armagetron Advanced
armagetronad.instHtml: Ready to run! Control Player 1 via DPAD and Player 2 via ABY

armorstride.title: Armor Stride
armorstride.descHtml: Sir Stepsalot is trapped in the Cursed Forest! Armed with his sword and bomb pouch, he must fight monsters, dodge traps, and seek treasure to sell. But he can't linger -- something dark is chasing him through the woods.
armorstride.instHtml: Purchase from itch.io, and download the Armor Stride Stand-Alone version. Then, extract and copy the game files to the armorstride/assets folder

arx.title: Arx
arx.descHtml:
The world of Arx is wrought with turmoil, brought to the brink of destruction by a violent war. It is set on a world whose sun has failed, forcing the above-ground creatures to take refuge in caverns. Arx Fatalis is an innovative first-person role-playing game featuring crafting, combat and spell-casting using mouse gestures.

Arx Libertatis is an improved, cross-platform and open source engine for Arx Fatalis.
arx.instHtml: Purchase the game and copy the GoG offline installer (2 files, setup_arx...exe and setup_arx...bin) to arx/gamedata. They will be extracted on first run. Alternatively, copy Steam or Windows CD-ROM files so that copy them so that data.pak and surrounding files and folders are in arx/gamedata.

ascentdx.title: Ascent DX
ascentdx.descHtml: Crashed on a desolate but mysterious planet you find yourself eye to eye with an ancient civilisation. Explore the planet, find powerful upgrades, and fulfill your destiny.
ascentdx.instHtml: This game is ready to run! Special thanks to Johan Peitz for allowing PortMaster to distribute the game!

assaultshell.title: ASSAULT SHELL
assaultshell.descHtml: Engage in an action packed shoot em' up adventure! Choose from 4 powerful fighters and fight through 5 intense stages!
assaultshell.instHtml: Purchase from itch.io or Steam and place data.win, each audiogroup.dat file, and each .csv file into gamedata folder.

asteroludi.title: asteroludi
asteroludi.descHtml: Drifting through space, blasting rocks, enjoying the silence — it begins like a calm round of Asteroids. But you’re not out here just for fun. You’re mining. And soon, you realize... you’re not alone.
asteroludi.instHtml: Use the left stick or D-Pad to navigate your ship. Use the right stick or face buttons to aim and shoot your weapons. Extract minerals from asteroids by firing your mining laser and fly close to collect them. But be careful not to get too close to large asteroids or enemy ships, as collisions can easily damage or destroy your ship. Sometimes, collisions can be avoided by activating your shields (right shoulder button), but they consume energy quickly.

astronautilus.title: Astronautilus
astronautilus.descHtml: Your ship has crash-landed on a stray rogue planet, and you're out of fuel ... It's up to you to delve beneath the frozen surface and find a way to get your ship back into space. Fight strange sea creatures and uncover the mysteries of the world beneath the ice!
astronautilus.instHtml: Purchase the game from Steam. Enter the Steam Console and use the following command to download a compatible version: download_depot 1724120 1724121 6233168631671934006. Copy those downloaded files to the astronautilus/assets directory.

asylum.title: Asylum
asylum.descHtml: Young Sigmund has a few problems. To help him resolve his mental instability you must enter the surreal world of his inner mind and shut down the malfunctioning brain cells. Guide Sigmund through the Ego, Psyche and Id zones - each one 300 times the size of the screen - to locate the eight renegade neurons, entering them one by one to find and trigger their self-destruct system.

atomic_automaton.title: Atomic Automaton
atomic_automaton.descHtml: The player must face endless waves of enemies, as long as possible in a challenging, action-packed environment.

petsciirobotsmsx.title: Attack of the PETSCII Robots (OpenMSX)
petsciirobotsmsx.descHtml: Attack of the Petscii Robots is a top-down action-puzzle game. This free version was developed by Robosoft for the MSX1. It is inspired by oblique top-down projection games like Ultima, but takes much of the gameplay concepts from first-person shooters. The object is to destroy all of the robots. To do this, you have to search objects in the game for weapons and other items to help you along the way. Many scenarios require complex thinking and problem solving, rather than just action shooting.
petsciirobotsmsx.instHtml:
Place the following BIOS files in the 'petsciirobotsmsx/share/systemroms' directory: fs-a1gt_firmware.rom, fs-a1gt_kanjifont.rom, yrw801.rom

The game is already included and was acquired from MSXdev.org

attrition.title: Attrition
attrition.descHtml: Welcome to a world trapped in perpetual fighting. Attrition is a turn-based strategy game where three countries, Lutem, Bertas, and Cualitas, are constantly at war with one-another. Command their armies in a story of opposite opinions, sacrifices for one’s beliefs, and the quest for a greater goal. Here no one’s completely in the wrong, but no one’s completely in the right.
attrition.instHtml: Purchase the game on Itch.io, download the zip with game and extract all files into assets folder. You can also use the free demo.

augustus.title: Augustus
augustus.instHtml: You will need the original files of the PC release copied to the ports/augustus/data folder.

axecop.title: Axe Cop
axecop.descHtml: Fight all of the bad guys! Axe Cop and his team of colorful characters must go on an epic adventure, that covers his ten-year comic book history, to rid the world of all bad guys once and for all in this epic turn-based RPG!
axecop.instHtml: Purchase the game from itch.io or Steam and download the Windows version (Linux should work fine, too). Copy the file named axecop.rpg to the port directory. Alternatively, you could play the DEMO version (also on the itch page).

axiom.verge.title: Axiom Verge
axiom.verge.descHtml: A port of Axiom Verge, an awesome metroidvania 2D platformer.
axiom.verge.instHtml: You will need to add your own files to the ports/axiom-verge/gamedata folder. YOU HAVE TO USE THE DRM FREE EPIC GAMES VERSION. file in your Portmaster/libs folder. All intructions are in the ports/axiom-verge/gamedata folder

azimuth.title: Azimuth
azimuth.descHtml: Azimuth is a metroidvania game, and something of an homage to the previous greats of the genre (Super Metroid in particular).
azimuth.instHtml: Ready to run! For detailed instructions visit https://mdsteele.games/azimuth/manual.html

babbeu.title: Bab Be U
babbeu.descHtml: A fan game of Baba Is You: a puzzle game where the rules you follow are represented as physical blocks you can push around and recombine.
babbeu.instHtml: Ready to run out of the box, no additional files needed.

badendtheater.title: BAD END THEATER
badendtheater.descHtml: Bad End Theater is a charmingly cruel little story game where everything goes wrong and that’s exactly the point. You guide a cast of cute-but-doomed characters through branching paths, knowing full well that every choice leads to another terrible ending. The fun comes from experimenting: change one role, replay the story, and watch how fate twists in new, often darkly funny ways.
badendtheater.instHtml: Either buy the game on Steam or GOG. For Steam version, open the Steam console and enter the following command to get a compatible version: download_depot 1764390 1764391 5823322159234091361, then copy the "game" folder into the ports "badendtheater" folder. From GOG installation, just copy the "game" folder into the ports "badendtheater" folder

balatro.title: Balatro
balatro.descHtml: Balatro is a poker-inspired roguelike deck builder all about creating powerful synergies and winning big.
balatro.instHtml: Purchase the game from Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2379780/Balatro/. On macOS, copy Balatro.love from Balatro.app/Contents/Resources into the balatro folder. On Windows, copy Balatro.exe into the balatro folder.

banana.duck.title: Banana Duck
banana.duck.descHtml: Experience the sweet taste of pursuing bananas and avoiding all the evil vegetables and saw blades that are there for absolutely no reason. Also, you're a duck that can't swim and dies when it touches the water.
banana.duck.instHtml: Game files are already included and ready to go.

bananaguy2.title: Bananaguy 2
bananaguy2.descHtml: Bananaguy 2 is about exploring strange and playful worlds collecting "Power Coins" along the way which are used to travel to the next world. Each coin features its own wacky little adventure.

bananaguyclassic.title: Bananaguy Classic
bananaguyclassic.descHtml: Bananaguy wakes up and sees his banana is missing! Make your way through a colorful world filled with hard but fun challenges. Unlock new power ups to make Bananaguys moveset grow! Retrieve your lost banana and consume it in the comfort of your home :D

barhop.title: Bar Hop
barhop.descHtml: A rhythm game inspired by Frogger. Hop to the bar and back for 7 days straight without getting hit or falling in. Each day gets harder. Earn points for every hop, coin, and safe return.

barbarian.title: Barbarian
barbarian.descHtml: Barbarian is a fighting game that gives players control over sword-wielding barbarians.
barbarian.instHtml: Go to Barbarian Website, download the linux version and extract the files to the barbarian gamedata folder.

barrelroll.title: barrel roll
barrelroll.descHtml:
Barrel roll is a puzzle game that makes you think outside the barrel to find solutions to each level.

You're a cute little guy named Bruno who just woke up in this abandoned castle, your mission is to go around sorting all kinds of button puzzles with your trusty barrel!
barrelroll.instHtml: Download the game directly from the itch.io website. Extract the files and place them in the ports/barrelroll/assets directory.

battalion.title: Battalion
battalion.descHtml: Your lands have been invaded by General Mustache and his infamous armored division! Nothing seems to stop him, except perhaps for Commander Joe and his old companion "G-080 Justice" tank destroyer. Engage in 8 exciting battles through the liberation campaign. Fight in cities, forests, riverbanks, military bases and more... Collect the powerup to experience ultimate defense and crush obstacles on the way.

wesnoth.title: Battle for Wesnoth
wesnoth.descHtml:
Explore the world of Wesnoth and take part in its many adventures! Embark on a desperate quest to reclaim your rightful throne... Flee the Lich Lords to a new home across the sea... Delve into the darkest depths of the earth to craft a jewel of fire itself... Defend your kingdom against the ravaging hordes of a foul necromancer... Or lead a straggly band of survivors across the blazing sands to confront an unseen evil.

The Battle for Wesnoth is an open source, turn-based strategy game with a high fantasy theme. It features both singleplayer and online/hotseat multiplayer combat.
wesnoth.instHtml: Ready to run! Note that the port is about 670MB in size, but will consume over 1.5GB of space on non-ext4 volumes.

beardblade.title: Beard Blade
beardblade.descHtml: Run and jump through tropical 16-bit locales as you fend off foes with the power of Branson's shapeshifting beard. Visit the barber to toughen your scruff with new abilities and confront the thieving Smuglins.
beardblade.instHtml: Purchase and install Beard Blade on Steam (https://store.steampowered.com/app/1546940/Beard_Blade/) and copy the data.win file (and possibly the options.ini file) into ports/beardblade/gamedata.

pixelheat.title: Beat of The PixelHeat
pixelheat.descHtml: Beat of The Pixel Heat is a rhythm game in which you must control HEAT, an artificial intelligence responsible for defending cyberspace from a wave of viral elements that have invaded your home!

beat2x.title: Beat2x
beat2x.descHtml: Beat2x is DDR-style rythm game where the goal is to time the button presses to line up with the music beat.
beat2x.instHtml: All files are included and game is ready to play

beatblock.title: Beatblock
beatblock.descHtml: SPIN TO WIN: Move your paddle around to hit blocks to the beat! Taps and different block types- like mines and sides- keep things fresh.
beatblock.instHtml: Download the Linux version of the game from https://bubbletabby.itch.io/beatblock and place Beatblock-linux.zip into the beatblock/gamedata/ directory on your device

beemisthecurseofgod.title: Beemis: The Curse of God
beemisthecurseofgod.descHtml: Become a real-life bee and also fight God himself. Take on many bosses and wacky levels as a young bee whose life has been drastically changed by a curse maniacally concocted by God.
beemisthecurseofgod.instHtml: Download the game (for free) here: https://blebgo.itch.io/beemis-the-curse-of-god -- extract and copy the data.win file to the port gamedata folder.

bellablood.title: Bella Wants Blood
bellablood.descHtml: Entertain the god-like Bella’s thirst for blood in this absurd bite-sized roguelike terror defense game.
bellablood.instHtml: Purchase the game on Steam, download the Windows version and copy the BellaWantsBlood.pck into the gamedata folder.

belleboomerang.title: Belle Boomerang
belleboomerang.descHtml: A fast-action platformer packed with beautiful pixel art and exciting variation in every level!
belleboomerang.instHtml:
Purchase and download the game from: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1632170/Belle_Boomerang/

Locate your gamefolder and copy all the files from the folder to /ports/belleboomerang/gamedata.

benwas.title: Ben Was Assimilated
benwas.descHtml: Ben Was Assimilated is a hack n slash style roguelike game where things only move when you do.

beowulfclassic.title: BEOWULF CLASSIC
beowulfclassic.descHtml: Made for the Historically Accurate Game Jam 4.Embark on an adaption that mixes retro platforming and combat while you explore the old Beowulf Poem.

bermuda_syndrome.title: Bermuda Syndrome
bermuda_syndrome.descHtml: A reimplemntation of the Berumuda Syndrome engine.
bermuda_syndrome.instHtml: You will need the original files of the PC release or PC demo copied to the ports/bermuda/DATA folder.

beyondtotalloss.title: Beyond a Total Loss
beyondtotalloss.descHtml: A Dark and Comedic adventure that combines gameplay elements from Lisa and Resident Evil. You play as John Harry after he drives his car off the edge of a cliff. He's now stranded in an old podunk town filled with weirdos. Help John escape the town and best a series of strange ordeals. Thank You Pseudobug for creating this amazing adventure!
beyondtotalloss.instHtml: 1) Open the Steam Console 2) Open Download.txt 3) Copy the text from Download.txt into the Steam Console and press ENTER 4) Patiently wait for the game to Download 5) Open Game Location (You can Copy and Paste the file location from the Steam Console after the game is successfully downloaded) 6) Copy and Paste files into the gamedata folder 7) Enjoy the Game!

billyfrontier.title: Billy Frontier
billyfrontier.descHtml: This is Pangea Software's Billy Frontier updated to run on modern operating systems. Use the touchscreen to navigate the UI and gameplay.

binarystarinfinity.title: Binarystar Infinity
binarystarinfinity.descHtml: Binarystar Infinity is a 1-Bit Shoot ‘Em Up with a challenging experience reminding of the traditional Arcade Shmup classics, that can be experienced alone or with a friend, and with the particularity of being playable in vertical or horizontal scrolling mode.
binarystarinfinity.instHtml: Purchase the game from Steam Download the game and copy over the game files into ports/binarystarinfinity/gamedata/

binkystrashservice.title: Binky's Trash Service
binkystrashservice.descHtml: Storm evil lairs ... and take out the trash! Play as BINKY in a perilous, precision platformer where you run a garbage collection service for EVIL LAIRS! Optimise your speedrun strats and empty all the trash in 15 unique and colourful mini-Metroidvania maps!
binkystrashservice.instHtml: Purchase the game from itch.io or Steam. For Steam, open the console and enter download_depot 1498940 1498941 7126354185184625380. Download, extract, and copy the game files to the binkystrashservice/assets directory.

biolab.title: Biolab Disaster
biolab.descHtml: A jump'n'gun platformer, displaying many of high_impacts capabilities.

biomassgrowth.title: Biomass: Growth
biomassgrowth.descHtml: BIOMASS: Growth is a scifi horror metroidvania platformer developed by BRAINOS. You wake in a deserted lab with no idea who, what, where or why you are. You have only your senses and the logbooks of deceased crew members to guide you. As you search for ways to expand your arsenal and access to the station, the titular BIOMASS will spread throughout, growing stronger, more aggressive, in a desperate arms race against you. Find out who, what, where and why you are, and uncover the fate of the crew in this doomed lab. Find a way to destroy the BIOMASS and save humanity from certain death.

biplanesrevival.title: Biplanes Revival
biplanesrevival.descHtml: An old cellphone arcade BlueTooth BiPlanes recreated for PC

bittriprunner2.title: BIT.TRIP Presents... Runner2: Future Legend of Rhythm Alien
bittriprunner2.descHtml: 'Bit.Trip Runner2', also known as 'Runner2: Future Legend of Rhythm Alien', is a rhythm-based platformer video game developed by Gaijin Games. Released in 2013, it is the sequel to the original Bit.Trip Runner. The game features CommanderVideo, the main character, navigating through various levels filled with obstacles and challenges, all synchronized to an engaging electronic soundtrack. Players must execute precise jumps, slides, and kicks to the beat of the music, creating a dynamic and rhythmic gameplay experience. With its vibrant visuals, catchy music, and addictive gameplay, Bit.Trip Runner2 offers a unique and entertaining take on the platformer genre.
bittriprunner2.instHtml: Copy your Linux Game files (runner2, Runner2.png, package.toc and the other 9 folders) to the runner2 folder.

bitriot.title: BitRiot
bitriot.descHtml: A clone/reimplementation of the Amiga game Bug Bomber, in the style of Bomberman, with the added twist of spawning helper robots.

bitsybox.title: Bitsybox
bitsybox.descHtml: ~ a little engine for little games, worlds, and stories ~ It comes with two demos: a night train to the forest zone and mossland If you like this game please support the author https://ledoux.itch.io/bitsybox
bitsybox.instHtml: Ready to play ! Add your bitsy game files in bitsybox/games

blackout.title: Blackout
blackout.descHtml: A witch on the roof of a scary old house. Black cats, cobwebs, and a crescent moon -- all too creepy! In this point-and-click adventure, your task is to guide the main character, Marilyn, as she ventures deeper and deeper into a mysterious house in the middle of the night.
blackout.instHtml: Download the Blackout-1.0.2-win.zip version for free at itch.io. Extract the .zip, and copy the .exe file to the port's gamedata folder.

bstone-aog.title: Blake Stone - Aliens of Gold
bstone-aog.descHtml: The unofficial source port for Blake Stone Aliens of Gold.
bstone-aog.instHtml: Includes the shareware files. You can also add your own full version Blake Stone - Aliens of Gold (*.BS6) files to the 'ports/bstone-aog/gamedata/aliens_of_gold' folder. The Steam version of these files can be found by browsing local files and entering the 'Blake Stone - Aliens of Gold' directory.

bstone-ps.title: Blake Stone - Planet Strike
bstone-ps.descHtml: The unofficial source port for Blake Stone Planet Strike.
bstone-ps.instHtml: You'll need to add your own full version Blake Stone Planet Strike (*.VSI) files to the 'ports/bstone-ps/gamedata/planet_strike' folder. The Steam version of these files can be found by browsing local files and entering the 'Blake Stone - Planet Strike' directory.

blarglike.title: Blarglike
blarglike.descHtml: Blarglike is a small dungeon-crawling roguelike where you play as a tiny robot on a mission to restore life to a dying ecosystem. Venture deep into procedurally generated dungeons, plant flowers, and guide nutrients to help the environment thrive. Each day offers a fresh challenge with new dungeon layouts!.

blastius.title: Blastius
blastius.descHtml: Blastius is a simple old-school space shooter with a twist: your ship's piloting system has been heavily damaged during a battle and now you can only move by boosting and drifting around. The result of this is a dash that can be both an offensive and a defensive manoeuvre.
blastius.instHtml: Download game from https://stedl89.itch.io/blastius-gamejam2020, rename exe to zip, extract. Copy data.win and all .mp3 files to /ports/blastius/gamedata

blazeofstorm.title: Blaze of Storm
blazeofstorm.descHtml: Blaze of Storm is an arcade-style vertical scrolling shmup featuring cyber-inspired pixel art, exhilarating fast-scrolling and a variety of sub-weapons.
blazeofstorm.instHtml: Purchase the game on Steam and copy all game files into assets folder. You can also use the free demo.

blazingbeaks.title: Blazing Beaks
blazingbeaks.descHtml: Roguelite - where too much greediness can be fatal. A colorful world with armed birds blazing their way through piles of mutants, monsters and creepy creatures. Lots of mysteries to unravel, secrets to discover and levels to explore. Requires Twin sticks!
blazingbeaks.instHtml: Purchase the game from GOG. Download Version 1.2.0.3. Do this by going to More > Manage Installation > Configure > Uncheck auto-updates > Show more versions > Select Version 1.2.0.3. Copy over all the game file to ports/blazingbeaks/assets

bleed.title: Bleed
bleed.descHtml: Wryn is a girl with a big arsenal and big dreams -- she wants to be the ultimate videogame hero! Help her take down the Greatest Heroes of All Time in an action-packed bid to claim the title for herself and show the world what a true hero looks like!

bleed2.title: Bleed 2
bleed2.descHtml: Bleed 2 is a relentless arcade action game featuring air-dodging, bullet-reflecting, and tons of bosses. Now with randomly-generated levels and daily challenges, too!

bleubayou.title: Bleu Bayou
bleubayou.descHtml: Embody a crawdad plagued by debt in this roguelite boss-rush shoot 'em up.
bleubayou.instHtml: Includes demo build with lots of content. Copy over data.win from the Steam build of the full game when released if you want to play the full game on your device.

blobwars.title: Blob Wars: Metal Blob Solid
blobwars.descHtml: Metal Blob Solid is the first game in the Blob Wars series made by Parallel Realities. It is a 2D platform game, where you control Bob in an effort to save his world from an invasion of alien Blobs.
blobwars.instHtml: Blobwars files are already included and ready to go.

bloboats.title: Bloboats
bloboats.descHtml: Bloboats is an arcade-like boat racing game in the hybrid spirit of Mario-like platform jumpers and elasto mania / xmoto.
bloboats.instHtml: Ready to run! To Start Text-Input mode press Start + Down!

blockamokremix.title: Blockamok Remix
blockamokremix.descHtml: Fly through a 3D world of never-ending blocks and survive for as long as you can! Includes customization options for both gameplay and visuals, along with five music tracks.

blockdude_playdate.title: Blockdude Playdate
blockdude_playdate.descHtml: Blokdude is a remake of the well known TI Caluculator game from Brandon Sterner as well as the blockman game from Soleau Software. This version of the game is based on the Playdate which in itself was based on the GP2X port of blockdude.

blockout2.title: BlockOut II
blockout2.descHtml: BlockOut II is a free adaptation of the original BlockOut DOS game. BlockOut II has the same features than the original game with few graphic improvements.
blockout2.instHtml: BlockOut II files are already included and ready to go.

blood.title: Blood
blood.instHtml: You'll need to add your own full version Blood 1.21 files to the ports/Blood folder.

bloodxthirsty.title: Blood X Thirsty
bloodxthirsty.descHtml: Serve drinks, enhance your brew, and fight off unruly customers in this fast-paced bartending sim!

bloonstdx.title: Bloons TD X
bloonstdx.descHtml: Bloons TD X is a bloons tower defense fan game made by Ramaf Party.

blossomtales2.title: Blossom Tales II
blossomtales2.descHtml:
The Minotaur King has returned...and it's all your fault! Lily's back for a new "classic" action-adventure set hundreds of years after The Sleeping King!

Grandpa's latest tale takes you on a journey through haunted forests, pirate shores, and other mysterious lands across a vast open-world! Charming towns, terrible enemies, tricky puzzles, and powerful weapons await you.

Will you help Lily defeat the Minotaur King and save her brother?
blossomtales2.instHtml: Drop all the assets from the game inside of the gamedata folder. Windows and Linux versions both work!

blowfly2.title: BLOWFLY2:OVERLIMIT
blowfly2.descHtml: "BLOWFLY2:OVERLIMIT" is a superhero-style platform action game. Use the protagonist's unique abilities to explore and collect pink POOBABYs in the map. This time, you will go deep into the enemy's lair and challenge more powerful levels and enemies! Blowfly! Flight! Dash!
blowfly2.instHtml: Download the game from Steam https://store.steampowered.com/app/2831590/BLOWFLY2OVERLIMIT/ and copy all game files to the 'assets' folder. Patching will take place on first run.

bluerevolver.title: BLUE REVOLVER
bluerevolver.descHtml: BLUE REVOLVER is a fresh new shoot-em-up built for newcomers and psychos alike. An adaptive difficulty system tailors the game to your skill level as you fight and flourish to evade the maniac environmental force, Blue Revolver!
bluerevolver.instHtml: Download the game from https://store.steampowered.com/app/439490/BLUE_REVOLVER/ and copy the .exe or .love file into the port (bluerevolver) folder. Switch to the [1.12 - Old pre-DA version] in steam betas, as that is the only version supported for now. First run will take a few minutes to patch the game. Also you will need to have around 1.5 gb of free space for patching (additional space is needed only for patching on first run).

blues.brothers.title: Blues Brothers
blues.brothers.descHtml: A rewrite of the Blues Brothers game engine developed by Titus Interactive.
blues.brothers.instHtml: Includes the demo files. You can add your own full game Amiga or Dos files to the ports/bluesbrothers/gamedata folder.

bbja.title: Blues Brothers: Jukebox Adventure
bbja.descHtml: A rewrite of the Blues Brothers game engine developed by Titus Interactive.
bbja.instHtml: Includes the demo files. You can add your own full game Dos files to the ports/bbda/gamedata folder.

blupimania.title: Blupimania
blupimania.descHtml: A puzzle game where you guide Blupi through more than 120 riddles across four difficulty levels, rearranging the environment to help him find his lost balloon.

bombastic.title: Bombastic
bombastic.descHtml: Play as Splodey, a bomb with an explosive spring in his step! Use his exploding jump to traverse rooms and solve puzzles. Destroy all of the orange blocks and TNT to progress through the levels!
bombastic.instHtml: Download the game free at itch.io. Download, extract, and copy the game files to the bombastic/gamedata folder.

bomberpibe.title: BomberPibe
bomberpibe.descHtml: A 2D platformer with a unique double jump mechanic using your own exploding head.

boneraiserminions.title: Boneraiser Minions
boneraiserminions.descHtml: Amass an army of undead to fight endless waves of heroes intent to end your boneraising ways! In this gothic auto-battler rogue-lite Survivor-like, use the bones of slain heroes to raise your minions, collect relics and spells, and unlock meta upgrades, all to survive King Gigald's crusade! This works with v37.9
boneraiserminions.instHtml: Purchase the game from Steam. Open steam console via Windows+R: Type: steam://open/console, download version 37.9 by typing: download_depot 1944570 1944571 1079624835738126360 in the console. When the download is complete, it will tell you the location of the folder. Transfer all the game files to ports/boneraiserminions/assets.

bonesintheboneyard.title: Bones in the Boneyard
bonesintheboneyard.descHtml: There are many bones in the boneyard. As they fall from the screen, arrange skulls in lines of three to clear them, and line up complete skeletons to set them free.
bonesintheboneyard.instHtml: Purchase the game at itch.io. Extract the .zip, and copy the game files to this port's gamedata folder.

boni.title: Boni+
boni.descHtml: Boni the skeleton is traveling across the Mexican 'Dia de Muertos', however, he needs to cross the spooky Iztepetl Cemetery. Help him get his skeletal body to the other side!
boni.instHtml:
You can download Boni+ for free at: https://pistachoduck.itch.io/boniboni

Download the Boni_Linux64.zip version and extract it, and place the Boni_Linux.pck file in the gamedata directory.

bootlegbox.title: Bootleg Box
bootlegbox.descHtml:
BOOTLEG BOX is a retro pastiche of bootleg NES/Famicom multicarts and unlicensed games - featuring:

ULTRA PADDLES CYBER ATTACK CHOMP'S PUZZLE NUCLEAR CODES EGGSELENT

These small games are designed to feel retro-yet-smooth, with streamlined controls, and colourful, sometimes toy-like art. Difficulty ramps up over time. Best suited to killing time during lunch breaks or something, idk.

Everything should be pretty well optimised, and each game responds to the same control scheme as outlined in the main menu.

boswars.title: Bos Wars
boswars.descHtml: Bos Wars is a futuristic real time strategy game (RTS). In a RTS game, the player has to combat his enemies while developing his war economy. Everything runs in real-time, as opposed to turn-based games where the player always has to wait for his turn. The trick is to balance the effort put into building his economy and building an army to defend and attack the enemies.

botvice.title: Bot Vice
botvice.descHtml: Show off your skills and reflexes in this frantic gallery shooter arcade action title - Filled with bullets, bots, and explosions! You play as Erin Saver, who carries out a personal vendetta against the criminal gang the Wildbots while bringing them to justice
botvice.instHtml:
Purchase the game either from itch.io OR steam

For itch: Download Bot Vice (Linux Ubuntu 14.04 LTS) version, copy all files from /assets to /ports/botvice/assets

For steam: Run steam console via Windows+R: Type: steam://open/console, download the linux version by typing: download_depot 491040 491042 in the console, when the download is complete, it will tell you the location of the folder, copy all files from /assets to /ports/botvice/assets

botbreak.title: Botbreak
botbreak.descHtml: BOT-BREAK! is a Paddle Pinball arcade-y experience, made for MechJam III, and designed to somewhat resemble a physical electromechanical game - complete with a cute little dot matrix display. Destroy the enemy Giant Robot one part at a time, dodge Missiles, get a Shield, launch your MechBall from the Railgun, and activate Hyper Mode to button-mash to victory!

bouncinghero.title: Bouncing Hero
bouncinghero.descHtml: Bouncing Hero is an extreme auto-jump platformer. Use your skills to control the knight on his pogo stick and avoid the sophisticated traps to conquer the castle!
bouncinghero.instHtml: Purchase the game on Steam and place all game files into the assets folder.

bowlingcross.title: Bowling Cross
bowlingcross.descHtml: BOWLING CROSS: DARK LEGACY OF THE DEVIL BOWLER (FINAL FRAME) is the complete version of BOWLING CROSS, a weird GBC-style Battle-Bowling Action RPG - play as a roaming adventurer, using Custom Battle-Bowling Balls to knock down your enemies!
bowlingcross.instHtml: All game files are included. Thanks to Harley Wilson at https://hwilson.itch.io/bowling-cross-final-frame for creating the game and allowing us to distribute.

boxspace.title: BOX: Space Station
boxspace.descHtml: BOX: Space Station is a challenging puzzle game where your objective is to escape, but the more than one hundred levels will make your objective more difficult. Developed and published by plaYnice!
boxspace.instHtml: Purchase the game on Steam https://store.steampowered.com/app/1613150/BOX_Space_Station/ and copy data.win, audiogroup1.dat and _223235__dambient__8_bit_loop.ogg into the port folder.

bradhasapain.title: Brad Has A Pain
bradhasapain.descHtml: Brad's sole goal is to stop Lisa from spreading her evil across Olathe at any and all costs. The only problem is... Brad has a pain.
bradhasapain.instHtml: Download the game on Itch 'https://scary-lemon.itch.io/brad-has-a-pain' download BraHasPain.rar and extract contents of BradHasPain folder to the portfolder

braid.title: Braid
braid.descHtml: Braid is a puzzle-platformer, drawn in a painterly style, where you can manipulate the flow of time in strange and unusual ways. From a house in the city, journey to a series of worlds and solve puzzles to rescue an abducted princess. In each world, you have a different power to affect the way time behaves, and it is time's strangeness that creates the puzzles.
braid.instHtml: Purchase the original linux version of the game from GoG or Humble Bundle. Note that this port does not work with the newer Anniversary Edition. Put the installer file (ending in .sh) in ports/braid/gamedata.

bravedogsroad.title: Brave Dogs Road
bravedogsroad.descHtml: Brave Dog's Road is a short platformer about a dog who dreams of adventure.

breaker.title: Breaker
breaker.descHtml: a blend of BREAKOUT, SPACE INVADERS and IKARUGA
breaker.instHtml: Download BREAKER.exe from https://managore.itch.io/breaker and place it in the /ports/breaker/gamedata

breakhack.title: BreakHack
breakhack.descHtml: A simple roguelike dungeon crawler. Randomly generated maps/rooms, a leveling system, permadeath, and multiple classes. Casual and fun for a 10-20 minute break.

brittleblade.title: Brittle Blade
brittleblade.descHtml: In this game, you've lost your sword, and have to make do with the stalactites that fall from the ceiling. Each stalactite is brittle, so it has only one use. After that, it breaks, and you are missing a weapon until another one falls. Developed by FartFish for the Godot Wild Jam 31.

brogue.title: Brogue
brogue.descHtml: Brogue is a single-player strategy game set in the halls of a mysterious and randomly-generated dungeon. The objective is simple enough -- retrieve the fabled Amulet of Yendor from the 26th level -- but the dungeon is riddled with danger.
brogue.instHtml: Game files are already included. Controls are rather complex, make sure to read the control sheet carefully.

brokenpipes.title: Broken Pipes
brokenpipes.descHtml: Broken Pipes is a game created by cocawsugar during and for the GMTK Game Jam 2020. The jam's theme is out-of-control, so this game is a platformer where the flow of water is out-of-control and the water level increases and decreases constantly.
brokenpipes.instHtml: Download the game from https://cocawsugar-gj2020.itch.io/broken-pipes and extract the data.win file into the game folder.

brotato.title: Brotato
brotato.descHtml: Brotato is a top-down arena shooter roguelite where you play as a potato wielding up to six weapons to fend off alien hordes. Customize traits and items to survive until help arrives.
brotato.instHtml: Buy and download the game of Epic https://store.epicgames.com/en-US/p/brotato-ed4097 Copy the brotato.pck to brotato/gamedata folder

brotherbrother.title: Brother Brother
brotherbrother.descHtml: You awake in a small world, in the small house that you share with your brother. His bed is cold and empty, and there’s no sign of his whereabouts. Something doesn’t feel right. Explore the land and gear up, finding your brother is going to be no walk in the park.
brotherbrother.instHtml: Download the game from steam for FREE here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1147850/Brother_Brother/ Once Dowloaded and Installed, In your Library, Right click on it and choose "Manage-Browse Local Files". Copy everything to assets folder.

bugdom.title: Bugdom
bugdom.descHtml: This is Pangea Software's Bugdom updated to run on modern operating systems. Use the touchscreen to navigate the UI.

bugscraper.title: Bugscraper
bugscraper.descHtml: Rise to the top of a bug-infested tower by fighting on an elevator. On each floor, waves of enemies will come for your skin (or rather, exoskeleton). With your trusty pea gun, eliminate them and prepare for the next floor!

bulletbeat.title: Bullet Beat
bulletbeat.descHtml: Bullet Beat is a shoot'em up, where everything at the levels is in tune with the music, even shooting. You can also upload your track and enjoy the experimental generated levels! Keep the combo to get stronger!
bulletbeat.instHtml: Purchase the game from Itch.io. Download Bullet Beat.exe and place it in ports/bulletbeat/assets. You can add your own music files in the .ogg format to ports/bulletbeat/saves.

bullethell.title: Bullethell
bullethell.descHtml: A fast-paced bullet-hell shooter with weapon power-ups, a chargeable shield, and boss fights across three levels.

bumpersbroadswords.title: Bumpers & Broadswords
bumpersbroadswords.descHtml: BUMPERS & BROADSWORDS GAIDEN is a Strategy RPG in a world of discs - with every disc (Bumper) possessing HP, ATK, SPD, and a special Ability! In other words, it's a bit Fire Emblem, a bit Lunar Pool, and a bit Yu-Gi-Oh!

bnbmax.title: Bumpers & Broadswords Maximum
bnbmax.descHtml:
BUMPERS & BROADSWORDS: MAXIMUM is a tower-scaling, BUMPER-collecting RPG, set in a universe where Yu-Gi-Oh! and Beyblade had a wonderful baby and everyone is obsessed with it.

Ascend BUMPERCORP's TRIAL TOWER, crushing your foes to win their BUMPERS, and win the TOURNAMENT to discover what waits for you at the very top...

bnbtourn.title: Bumpers & Broadswords Tournament
bnbtourn.descHtml:
BUMPERS & BROADSWORDS: TOURNAMENT is a Yu-Gi-Oh!-style tournament-based RPG - explore the open-world-ish city, collect roughly 60 different types of Warriors/Magicians/Beasts/Machines/Etc... to slam against each other and win the Championship!

Each Bumper has its own special effect, so choosing 4 that have a powerful synergy is vital.

bunnysflowers.title: Bunny's Flowers
bunnysflowers.descHtml: Bunny’s Flowers is a cute, wholesome puzzle game about taking a trip to your grandma's house. Overcome box-pushing challenges using your mysterious magical power.
bunnysflowers.instHtml: Copy data.win, audiogroup1.dat and audiogroup2.dat into /ports/bunnysflowers/gamedata from the Steam version of Bunny's Flowers: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1375480

burgerspace.title: Burger Space
burgerspace.descHtml: Burgertime is an arcade game where the player is a cook trying to make his 4 hamburgers by stomping on their ingredients (buns, lettuce, ground meat) to knock them down, while avoiding his pursuers - the condiments (eggs, sausage, peppers), who are trying to catch him, but whom he can nonetheless temporarily immobilize with his pepperpot or eliminate by crushing them with one of the ingredients.

burst.title: Burst
burst.descHtml: Your aura switches between red and blue every few seconds; hit balls the same color as your aura to gain points. The more balls there are on the screen, the more points you get.

bushidopanda.title: Bushido Panda
bushidopanda.descHtml: The Kingdom of Japanda is in great danger! The pig army from the Land Of Darkness has seized control over the five elemental crystals, plunging the world into chaos! Take up your katana and fight back in this grand 8-bit adventure! Will you be able to save Japanda from ruin?
bushidopanda.instHtml: Download the BushidoPanda_v1_1b.zip from Itch.io and place it into assets folder.

butterflysoup.title: Butterfly Soup
butterflysoup.descHtml: A visual novel about gay asian girls playing baseball and falling in love.
butterflysoup.instHtml: Get the game from Brianna Lei's itch.io. Place the contents of the game/ directory into the port/butterflysoup/gamefiles/ directory.

bytepath.title: BYTEPATH
bytepath.descHtml: BYTEPATH is a retro-inspired arcade game that combines fast-paced action with strategic skill-building. Players navigate through procedurally generated levels, battling waves of enemies while upgrading their ship and unlocking powerful abilities. With its pixel art aesthetics and challenging gameplay, BYTEPATH offers a nostalgic yet fresh experience for fans of classic arcade shooters.
bytepath.instHtml: All files are included. If you like the game, consider supporting the developer by purchasing it from https://store.steampowered.com/app/760330/BYTEPATH.

bzflag.title: BZFlag
bzflag.descHtml: BZFlag is a 3D multi-player tank battle game that allows users to play against each other in a networked environment. There are five teams: red, green, blue, purple and rogue (rogue tanks are black). Destroying a player on another team scores a win, while being destroyed or destroying a teammate scores a loss. Rogues have no teammates (not even other rogues), so they cannot shoot teammates and they do not have a team score.
bzflag.instHtml: All games files are included. To enter your name START+D-PAD DOWN to enter Input mode UP / Down to enter your name and START to exit the Input mode.

c-dogs.title: C-Dogs
c-dogs.descHtml: C-Dogs is a classic overhead run-and-gun game

caidenquest.title: Caiden's Quest
caidenquest.descHtml: Caiden's Quest features hand-crafted levels and intense, skill-based gameplay with over 100 handmade levels featuring puzzles, platforming, and secrets to discover. Help Caiden unravel the mystery at Bumblestich. Why are the dead rising from their graves? You'll need to use magic--and your wits-- to defeat the powerful minions of darkness and save the humble villagers.

cairn.title: Cairn
cairn.descHtml: In Cairn, you play as Daisy, an intrepid adventurer bound for the top of a seemingly endless tower. Along the way, you're aided by mysterious wildlife that allow you to shift parts of the ground, writing your name into the path before you. Will you create advantages for yourself to reach the Heaven?
cairn.instHtml: Download cairn_win_1_1_2.zip file for free from Itch, extract it and in folder 220912win_1_1_2_shiny find cairn.pck file. Place cairn.pck file into cairn/gamedata folder in your ports.

ctp2.title: Call to Power 2
ctp2.descHtml: Call to Power II is a 4X turn-based strategy game where players guide a civilization from ancient times through to the far future, building cities, researching technologies, and competing with rival nations
ctp2.instHtml: You need to copy the "ctp2_data", "ctp2_program", and "Scenarios" folders from either your original Call to Power 2 installation directory or extract them from the GoG version's setup file (setup_call_to_power2_2.0.0.13.exe) using innoextract. You can purchase Call to Power 2 from GOG at https://www.gog.com/en/game/call_to_power_2

cally3.title: Cally's Caves 3
cally3.descHtml: Cally's parents have been abducted, as her arch-enemy Herbert has taken control of the Caves to perform his evil experiments. Join Cally and her friends in this action-packed run and gun platformer, conquering insane bosses, exploring to find secrets, and levelling up EVERYTHING.
cally3.instHtml: Download at Steam and copy data.win and .ogg files into assets folder.

cally4.title: Cally's Caves 4
cally4.descHtml: Cally’s Caves 4 is a run-and-gun action game, with tons of powerups, weapons, and levels. When your friend needs your help, there’s only one thing to do: LEVEL UP EVERYTHING!
cally4.instHtml: Purchase on Steam and copy data.win and all .ogg files to assets folder.

callystrials.title: Cally's Trials
callystrials.descHtml: Cally's Trials is a roguelike action-platformer with a weapon-levelling system that lets you evolve weapons as you use them. Cally must save her parents from the maniacal Herbert, who has laid waste to the Caves and built a massive new base.
callystrials.instHtml: Purchase at Steam and place data.win and .ogg's into gamedata folder.

canabalt-hf.title: Canabalt-hf
canabalt-hf.descHtml: Escape the destruction of your city with just one button! Canabalt-hf is a HaxeFlixel port of the game that popularized the infinite runner genre.
canabalt-hf.instHtml: If your device has an internet connection, assets will be downloaded automatically. If not, download main.zip and put it in ports/canabalt/gamedata/.

candleprick.title: Candle Prick
candleprick.descHtml: Candle Prick is a crunchy pixel adventure about stabbing enemies and using them as extensions of yourself to solve increasingly complex puzzles. Simple mechanics will give way to complicated scenarios as you discover different ways to interact with the environment.
candleprick.instHtml:
The demo is included and ready to run. It's a fun preview — but buy the FULL GAME for the real challenge at: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1920700/Candle_Prick/

Once it's in your Steam library: Right-click the game, then 'Manage', 'Browse Local Files' and Copy Candle Prick.pck into the gamedata folder. Delete the existing Candle Prick Patched.pck demo file — otherwise, the full game won't load properly. If not fullscreen? From the in-game starting menu, go to: Options > Options > Video > Fullscreen

candybag.title: Candy Bag
candybag.descHtml: You have until midnight to gather as much candy as you can. Maximize flavor in order to get the highest score! Some candies are better at giving you energy, others taste great but take up lots of space!
candybag.instHtml: Game files are included and ready to run. Thanks Jon Topielski who created this!

candycrisis.title: Candy Crisis
candycrisis.descHtml: A candy-colored falling-block puzzle game in the style of Kirby's Avalanche. Match candies to clear the board and send junk candy to your opponent.

cannonball-lr.title: Cannonball
cannonball-lr.descHtml: This is the libretro port of the OutRun game engine recreation written by Chris White in 2014.
cannonball-lr.instHtml: Add the OutRun Revision B ROMs into /ports/cannonball/gamedata folder.

cannonball-st.title: Cannonball Standalone
cannonball-st.descHtml: CannonBall is an souped up game engine for the OutRun arcade game. The original 68000 and Z80 assembler code has been rewritten in C++. This makes it possible to make improvements suitable for modern platforms, including a higher frame-rate and widescreen support. It requires the original ROMs, as these contain elements including the graphics and audio data.
cannonball-st.instHtml: Add the OutRun Revision B ROMs into /ports/cannonball/roms folder. Support for console tracks and newer features

cantoi.title: Canto I
cantoi.descHtml: Face the Dark Forest of the Divine Comedy in this action platformer inspired by the Sommo Poeta’s masterpiece! Help Dante avoid pitfalls, spikes & specters using double jumps, magical attacks and dashes. Find the scrolls containing the triplets of the Canto exploring this gloomy, pixelart forest!
cantoi.instHtml: This game is Ready To Run! Thank You LudosGD!!!

cardswithpersonalities.title: Cards with Personalities
cardswithpersonalities.descHtml: Single-player deck-building game full of charm! This deck-building game is trying to be accessible for both newcomers and veterans to the genre, with simple controls and clear rules. Still, each turn needs to be thought-out to beat the charming bosses!
cardswithpersonalities.instHtml: Purchase and download the game https://store.steampowered.com/app/2147020/Cards_with_Personalities/ and copy the exe file into the port folder.

carmageddon.title: Carmageddon
carmageddon.descHtml: Carmageddon is the original freeform driving sensation, where pedestrians (and cows!) equal points, and your opponents are a bunch of crazies in a twisted mix of automotive killing machines.
carmageddon.instHtml: You need to copy the original game files to ports/carmageddon folder.

carniforest.title: Carni-Forest
carniforest.descHtml: A turn-based, strategy RPG with puzzle blocks!

carpetgallery.title: Carpet Gallery
carpetgallery.descHtml: An endless walker with procedural scenery and objects. Please remove footwear upon entry.

carriesorderup.title: Carrie's Order Up
carriesorderup.descHtml:
Carrie's Order Up! is a challenging arcade game inspired by the likes of Pac-Man and Game & Watch. As Carrie, a crab waitress in a port town's restaurant, you have to serve spaghetti, pancakes, and burgers to all kinds of sea creatures without bumping into them!

Mechanics may be simple, but a level of depth to the mechanics exist, with tons of achievements to reward those that learn to master being a crab waitress! If you're looking for a cute and challenging game that lifts inspiration from arcade titles, you'll find hours of entertainment in Carrie's Order Up!
carriesorderup.instHtml:
Purchase the game from: Steam OR Itch.io

From Itch: Download CarriesOrderUp.zip from and unzip the contents to /ports/cariesorderup/assets

For Steam: Download the game and copy the contents from /Carrie's Order Up! to /ports/cariesorderup/assets

simonsqrev.title: Castlevania 2 Simon's Quest Revamped
simonsqrev.descHtml: A fantastic fan-made revamp of Castlevania 2 Simon's Quest!

cattactics.title: Cat Tactics
cattactics.descHtml: Assume the role of Sprinkles and Spyro, cats out for revenge in this Tactical Turn-Based Mini-RPG in 64x64! Jump fences, climb trees and scale rooftops as you adventure through the neighbourhood.

catwarrior.title: Cat Warrior
catwarrior.descHtml: Cat Warrior is an action-platformer of retro and cute style about a cat knight on his way to recapture his stolen treasure. Deep into the dangerous fantasy world,defeat the challenging big boss with your slash, dash, jump, walljump and other skills to find the treasure back!
catwarrior.instHtml: Install portfiles. Buy game on Steam and download windows (and/or linux) version. Copy all files from the "catwarrior" folder to "gamedata" folder.

cataclysm-dda.title: Cataclysm: Dark Days Ahead
cataclysm-dda.descHtml: Cataclysm: Dark Days Ahead is a turn-based survival game set in a post-apocalyptic world. Struggle to survive in a harsh, persistent, procedurally generated world. Scavenge the remnants of a dead civilization for food, equipment, or, if you are lucky, a vehicle with a full tank of gas to get you the hell out of Dodge. Fight to defeat or escape from a wide variety of powerful monstrosities, from zombies to giant insects to killer robots and things far stranger and deadlier, and against the others like yourself, that want what you have…
cataclysm-dda.instHtml: Cataclysm: Dark Days Ahead has a very complex control scheme. Make sure to read the control section either on the Wiki or in the README file inside cataclysm-dda folder.

catacomb89.title: Catacomb (1989)
catacomb89.descHtml: Catacomb (1989-1990 DOS) contains 10 levels in this first release. Petton Everhail is contacted by Terexin, High Wizard of the Kieralon. Terexin informs him the Kieralon Empire has fallen. Petton must travel to the Kieralon Palace to collect the lost treasures of Terexin, who has offered to split them fifty-fifty. Petton agrees, puts down his cup of Orange Pekoe tea, and marches off for the Catacombs under the Kieralon Palace.
catacomb89.instHtml: Copy your *.CAT files into ports/catacomb89/ and filenames should be uppercase. If game files are lowercase, the launcher will attempt to convert them to uppercase automatically. Both the floppy disk and GOG versions are compatible.

catacomb3d.title: Catacomb 3D
catacomb3d.descHtml: You are a mage descending into the dungeons of Grelminar the Lich, in order to kill him and save one guy named Nemesis.
catacomb3d.instHtml: Purchase from GOG and copy the Abyss, Apocalypse, Armageddon, and Cat3D directories into the port folder.

catacomb.title: Catacomb II
catacomb.descHtml: Catacomb II (Renamed to The Catacomb in 1991) contains 30 new levels and a few new monsters in this follow-up to the 1989-1990 release. Petton Everhail is contacted by Terexin, High Wizard of the Kieralon. Terexin informs him the Kieralon Empire has fallen. Petton must travel to the Kieralon Palace to collect the lost treasures of Terexin, who has offerd to split them fifty-fifty. Petton agrees, puts down his cup of Orange Pekoe tea, and marches off for the Catacombs under the Kieralon Palace.
catacomb.instHtml: Copy your *.CA2 files into ports/catacomb/ and filenames should be uppercase. If game files are lowercase, the launcher will attempt to convert them to uppercase automatically. Both the floppy disk and GOG versions are compatible.

catsonmars.title: Cats on Mars
catsonmars.descHtml: Play a dancing space cat in this pixel rhythm RPG!
catsonmars.instHtml: Game files are included and ready to run. Thanks Jon Topielski and the team who created this!

cattails.title: Cattails - Become a Cat!
cattails.descHtml: Become a cat! Cattails is a unique animal simulation RPG. Hunt for food, fight invading cats, explore to gather herbs, and socialize with other cats in an expansive open world. Get married and raise a family of kittens, befriend your neighbors, and learn to live in the dangerous wilderness!
cattails.instHtml: Purchase the game on Steam and copy all game files into the assets folder.

cavebuster.title: Cave Buster
cavebuster.descHtml: Play as a little alien guy who crash landed into the core of a dangerous planet. Make your way through fiery caverns and alien fauna. Find the super duper Burger and eat it!
