cavebuster.instHtml: 1.Download 1 of the zip files from https://jontopielski.itch.io/cave-buster 2. Copy the "**.pck" file from your downloaded zip into the gamedata folder of the cavebuster folder in your ports. Then rename it to "cavebuster.pck".

cavecrawler.title: Cave Crawler
cavecrawler.descHtml: Cave Crawler is a short, 2D side-scrolling action platformer. Explore caves filled with interesting enemies and fun platforming challenges.
cavecrawler.instHtml: Ready to Run! Special thanks to evan12811 for allowing PortMaster to distribute the game.

cavecrawler2.title: Cave Crawler 2
cavecrawler2.descHtml: Cave Crawler 2 is a retro-inspired 2D side-scroller. Escape a series of winding caves full of strange creatures and treacherous platforming challenges.

caveexpress.title: Cave Express
caveexpress.descHtml:
CaveExpress is a classic 2D platformer with physics-based gameplay and dozens of levels. Master your pedal-powered flying machine to pick up packages from your cave-dwelling clients and drop them off at the collection point.

But beware! Mighty mastodons, terrifying pterodactyls and others would rather see you extinct.

cavelotf.title: Cave Legend Of The Forge
cavelotf.descHtml: Exploration craft'em-up. Uncover the mysteries of a mountain and forge powerful tools!
cavelotf.instHtml: Go to https://bitbrain.itch.io/cave/devlog/302573/legend-of-the-forge-update-v01 and download 'cave.exe' from the list of downloads. Put 'cave.exe' into the gamedata folder.

cavepacker.title: Cave Packer
cavepacker.descHtml: CavePacker is a sokoban game. It is a puzzle game where you have to move the packages onto their targets without getting stuck. The lesser steps you made for solving a level, the better. You may only push but not pull packages.

cave.story-evo.title: Cave Story (Evo)
cave.story-evo.descHtml: Cave Story using the Nxengine-evo engine from https://github.com/nxengine/nxengine-evo

cave.story.title: Cave Story lr
cave.story.descHtml: Cave Story using the Libretro Retroarch Nxengine core.

caveblazers.title: Caveblazers
caveblazers.descHtml: Caveblazers is a challenging and brutal roguelike platformer. Journey into a mysterious cave, fighting orcs and goblins with an abundance of weapons and magical items! Make friends along the way, then watch in despair as they are crushed in to a bloody pulp under a troll's fist.
caveblazers.instHtml: Purchase the game on Steam, open the Steam console and use this command to download the compatible version: download_depot 452060 452061 848592866728747997. Copy downloaded files into assets folder.

celeste.title: Celeste
celeste.descHtml: Help Madeline survive her inner demons on her journey to the top of Celeste Mountain, in this super-tight, hand-crafted platformer from the creators of multiplayer classic TowerFall.
celeste.instHtml:
• Install the port via PortMaster.
  • Download the DRM-Free version of the game:
  • Itch.io Store: Celeste (linux)
  • EGS Store: Celeste (windows)
  • Copy the Celeste Linux files into celeste/gamedata.
  • Run the port, the first time setup will take a few minutes.
  • Enjoy!

celeste64.title: Celeste 64
celeste64.descHtml: A 3D platformer inspired by classic N64 games. Play as Madeline, explore a small version of Celeste Mountain, collect strawberries, and master Celeste's signature movement.

cceleste.title: Celeste Classic
cceleste.descHtml: Celeste Classic is a C source port of the original celeste (Celeste classic).
cceleste.instHtml: All files are included and game is ready to play.

chargekid.title: Charge Kid
chargekid.descHtml: Charge Kid is a game where each jump is a puzzle. You can compare it to Portal, where you have to find clever uses of the mechanics and physics to "solve" each location by reaching the desired location. You have limited resources to make each jump, comparable to Celeste. But instead of focusing on precision-platforming, the game focuses on the puzzle aspect. Unlike Celeste, the hard part is figuring out how to use your resources to make each jump instead of the execution. But don't get fooled; the execution is also hard, which means finding each solution is even harder!
chargekid.instHtml: If you liked the game, kindly consider supporting the devs at the following: Itch.io: https://eldskald.itch.io/charge-kid Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1334300/Charge_Kid/ Nintendo Switch eshop: https://www.nintendo.com/us/store/products/charge-kid-switch/

chasm.title: Chasm
chasm.descHtml: Explore the depths below a remote mountain town in this procedurally-generated Adventure Platformer. Taking inspiration from hack 'n slash dungeon crawlers and Metroidvania-style platformers, Chasm will immerse you in a fantasy world full of exciting treasure, deadly enemies, and abundant secrets.
chasm.instHtml: Purchase the game from GOG and place the install script in ports/chasm/gamedata. Optionally, purchase the game from Steam. Open steam console via Windows+R: Type: steam://open/console, download the latest version by typing: download_depot 312200 312202 6524806414975889296 in the console. When the download is complete, it will tell you the location of the folder. Transfer all the game files to ports/chasm/gamedata

chasmal.title: Chasmal
chasmal.descHtml: Chasmal is a top down action shooter with procedurally generated elements. Descend into a ruined machine using powerful items to overcome foes and reach the bottom of the depths.
chasmal.instHtml: Download the game on Steam and copy the Chasmal.x86_64 into the gamedata folder.

chessisstupid.title: Chess is Stupid
chessisstupid.descHtml: A small, weird Smash TV style shooter made by a painfully mediocre chess player who wanted to shoot the pieces after badly losing. Features all types of official chess piece, plus some made-up ones, funny stage names, tile breaking, like Battle Network, cutscenes, references to chess culture, if anyone cares, and UFO 50 palette

chicoryact.title: Chicory: A Colorful Tale
chicoryact.descHtml:
Chicory: A Colorful Tale is a top-down adventure game in a coloring book world where you can draw on anything. Use your painting powers to explore new places, solve puzzles, help your friends, and change the world!

Note: Only Steam version works with the port! Patching time is 30 to 60 minutes and uses a swap file (which may reduce the lifespan of your microSD card) for 1GB devices! For MuOS pixie: Go to General Settings > Advanced Settings > Set VRAM to 256 and SWAP to 512 for patching. Disable this after patching is done! This game has been tested for AmberELEC, ArkOS, MuOS and ROCKNIX firmwares ONLY. This port package does not work on the TrimUI Smart Pro/Brick Crossmix or Knulli. Requires a device with 2 analog sticks.
chicoryact.instHtml: Purchase your game from Steam. Download the correct version using the Steam console: download_depot 1123450 1123452 2137359438458453377 After the download is complete, place the depot_1123452/ folder into ports/chicoryact.

chipndale.title: Chip n Dale Rescue Rangers: Remastered
chipndale.descHtml: Nutcase was kidnapped by the cat Fatso, and Chip and Dale went to save her. As they begin the operation, they discover that the enemy has plotted more serious difficulties for the entire world. Not only will you need to help Gaika, but also destroy the antagonist's further plans. In the remaster, the developer completely changed the textures and character animations

chocolate-keen.title: Chocolate Keen
chocolate-keen.descHtml: Chocolate Keen is a reverse engineering of Commander Keen in C/C++ and SDL. The goal is to be as accurate to the original as possible.
chocolate-keen.instHtml: Place your respective .CK2 and .CK3 files into the respective keen directories for Keen 2 and Keen 3. Episode 1 (shareware) is included and ready to play. You will still need to provide your purchased copies for episodes 2 and 3 and should work by copying the entire contents of those two episodes (you can use your old DOS copies and 2 & 3 are also available from Steam and GoG) into GAMEDATA/KEEN2 and GAMEDATA/KEEN3.

chroma.title: Chroma
chroma.descHtml: Chroma is an abstract puzzle game. A variety of colourful shapes are arranged in a series of increasingly complex patterns, forming fiendish traps that must be disarmed and mysterious puzzles that must be manipulated in order to give up their subtle secrets. Initially so straightforward that anyone can pick it up and begin to play, yet gradually becoming difficult enough to tax even the brightest of minds.

chromavescence.title: Chromavescence
chromavescence.descHtml: Chromavescence is a retro puzzle platformer where you need to swap between 2 intertwined worlds to get past obstacles on your way. Created by Barnes for the Kenney Game Jam.

chromium_bsu.title: Chromium BSU
chromium_bsu.instHtml: The game is ready to play. The resolution is set to 640x480 by default, and can be adjusted in-game or by editing chromium-bsu.conf.

circainfinity.title: Circa Infinity
circainfinity.descHtml: Purchase the game on Steam and place the CircaInfinity.exe into the assets folder.
circainfinity.instHtml: Purchase the game on Steam and place the CircaInfinity.exe into the assets folder.

circlebreaker.title: Circle Breaker Madness
circlebreaker.descHtml: Circle Breaker Madness is a brick destroying game. Use balls to destroy the bricks but watch out in this circular playing field, as the ball is always on its way out! Catch it and send it back into the center on its mission to destroy the bricks. Simple graphics, catchy music and captivating gameplay with arcade and retro feeling.
circlebreaker.instHtml: Purchase the game on Itch.io and copy the place Circle Breaker Madness 1.0.1.exe into the assets folder.

cityglitch.title: cityglitch
cityglitch.descHtml: Cityglitch is an indie puzzle game where you play as a sorcerer saving a glitching city. Navigate fragmented urban landscapes, solve intricate puzzles, and use magic to restore harmony. With a minimalist art style and soothing soundtrack, Cityglitch offers a captivating and thought-provoking experience.
cityglitch.instHtml: Download the game from steam https://store.steampowered.com/app/756790/cityglitch/ or from itch https://mindfungus.itch.io/cityglitch and copy the exe or love file into the port folder.

clannad.title: Clannad
clannad.descHtml: The story follows the life of Tomoya Okazaki, a high school delinquent who meets many people in his last year at school, including five girls, and helps resolve their individual problems. Follows a branching plot line which offers pre-determined scenarios with courses of interaction, and focuses on the appeal of the five female main characters by the player character.

clashmastery.title: Clash Mastery
clashmastery.descHtml: This boss fight is too hard. You'll need some practice. Master each attack pattern, one-by-one. Practice makes you tough!
clashmastery.instHtml: Ready to run. Thanks to Abhi Sundu for creating this great game and kindly granting PortMaster permission to distribute the game files.

classicube.title: ClassiCube
classicube.descHtml: ClassiCube is a custom Minecraft Classic compatible client written in C from scratch.
classicube.instHtml: Download and run. If your device doesn't have wifi, install ClassiCube on your PC and copy the "audio" and "texpacks" folders to the port directory.

cleavingcaliber.title: Cleaving Caliber
cleavingcaliber.descHtml: A Brick-Beaking, Rail-Shooting game trying to be a mixture of Silent Scope and Arkanoid. Get Powerups and use your best mental trigonometry to land Critical Shots!

cliff_hanger.title: Cliff Hanger
cliff_hanger.descHtml:
Traverse the different levels of this huge cave, in less than 12 seconds, or else, you die!

For some reason tho, time doesnt seem to keep going when you grab on ledges and maybe some other things, idk.

Make sure to collect all of those shiny diamond thingies, they surely are important for you, I assure you!

climb.title: Climb
climb.descHtml: Climb is a bullet-ridden 2D platformer in which you play a knight fighting and climbing out of a prison tower with the help of a magical sword that shoots bullets! Includes 5 levels of increasing difficulty! Various enemy types! Traps! A unique mechanic where you shoot at the floor to jump higher! Single life challenge!
climb.instHtml: Download game from https://junchmakes.itch.io/climb, copy data.win to /ports/climb/gamedata

clockwind.title: Clockwind
clockwind.descHtml: The mechanic of this game is time travel. Make your way through 4 levels utilizing the passage of time in different ways. This may involve making trees grow or turning a car in to a flying car.

cmdungeon.title: CMDungeon
cmdungeon.descHtml: CMDungeon is a platform puzzle game where you need to "cheat" to win, using the terminals around the rooms planning your strategy based on your keys. Developed by Lucas "Cuca" Coelho.
cmdungeon.instHtml: Go to the game's itch site at https://cuca.itch.io/cmdungeon and download the cmdungeonv0.2.0_linux_x11.zip and place it into port folder.

cognizance.title: Cognizance
cognizance.instHtml: Download the game (for free) here: https://managore.itch.io/cognizance -- extract the .exe as if it's a 7-Zip archive (which it is), and copy the files to the port gamedata folder.

coincrypt.title: Coin Crypt
coincrypt.descHtml: A roguelite deckbuilding adventure game about magical coins. You play as a lootmancer, who can unlock the hidden power inside of coins and use them in magical duels. The loots you take from chests and enemies also become your next moves, so plan carefully!
coincrypt.instHtml: Purchase the game from steam or humble. Download the game and place the game files in coincrypt/gamedata

colorlines.title: ColorLines
colorlines.descHtml: A forked and updated version of SDL re-implementation of classic Color Lines game, originally written by Nikita Zimin in 2010.
colorlines.instHtml: All files are included and game is ready to play.

comeback.title: COMEBACK
comeback.descHtml: In a cold and empty world, only you and your peculiar light weapon can help you survive. Use it to trap enemies, kill them and return home.
comeback.instHtml: download the zip from itch.io and put the game files in ports/comeback/assets.

commander.genius.title: Commander Genius
commander.genius.descHtml:
Commander Genius is an open-source clone of Commander Keen, originally developed by Id Software.

You are eight-year-old Billy Blaze, boy genius to your neighborhood. Commander Keen to the rest of the universe. It's time to grab your trusty pogo stick and neural stunner, climb into the cockpit of your homemade Megarocket and blast off for adventure. To prevent the obliteration of life as we know it, you'll have to battle your way past deadly hazards and devious creatures, or end up as space toast.

Supports addition of official/community-made content
commander.genius.instHtml:
Includes all of the officially released free content for the Commander Keen series, such as, the shareware episodes (1, 4), the demo episode (6), and the lost episode: Keen Dreams.

You can add additional content to this port manually (check gamedata/instructions.txt) or, if you have an internet connected device, directly through the launcher itself (button is bottom-left).

hawkthorne.title: Community: Journey to the Center of Hawkthorne
hawkthorne.descHtml:
This 2d platformer is based on Community's Digital Estate Planning episode.

A group of warriors are summoned to the kingdom of Hawkthorne™ to take on a quest to recover the fabled "White Diamond of Discipline"™ found in the depths of the dark pit of despair known as The Black Cave™.

cookservedelicious.title: Cook, Serve, Delicious!
cookservedelicious.descHtml: One of the few hardcore restaurant sims in existence, Cook, Serve, Delicious! is a deceptively easy game to learn but incredibly challenging to master as you progress through your career from owning a terrible zero star cafe into a five star world famous restaurant.
cookservedelicious.instHtml:
Buy the game from: https://store.steampowered.com/app/247020/Cook_Serve_Delicious/ OR https://chubigans.itch.io/cook-serve-delicious

Download the game and copy over the game files into ports/cookservedelicious/gamedata/"

Note: requires twin sticks!

corsairs.title: Corsairs
corsairs.descHtml: J2ME pirate trading and naval combat game originally developed by Akella for Nokia 6230i. Trade, sail, and fight naval battles in a pixel-art Caribbean setting. Includes English translation (original game is Russian only).
corsairs.instHtml: Place the original Corsairs JAR as corsairs.jar into ports/corsairs/. The game JAR can be found in J2ME game archives.

corsixth.title: CorsixTH
corsixth.instHtml: Load your Theme Hospital files into the ports/corsixth/HOSP folder. As an example, the demo files of Theme Hospital is already included.

cosmiccleaning.title: Cosmic Cleaning Crew
cosmiccleaning.descHtml: 3000 AD: Earth is polluted to the point of being uninhabitable. Humans have constructed rockets to convey the populace to Mars. Catastrophe! The heavens have been crammed with trash, barring all escape. It is up to you, the Galactic Garbage Man, to save all humanity! This game was created for the GBJam 11.

cosmo-engine.title: Cosmo-Engine
cosmo-engine.descHtml: A new game engine to play the MS-DOS game Cosmo's Cosmic Adventure on modern systems.
cosmo-engine.instHtml: Episode 1 is included and you can add Episode 2 and 3 gamefiles to the 'ports/cosmo-engine/data' folder.

cosmosmash.title: Cosmosmash
cosmosmash.descHtml: Cosmosmash, a space rock shooting video game. It is a clone of the 1981 Astrosmash game for the Intellivision by Mattel Electronics.

counter-strike.title: Counter-Strike 1.6
counter-strike.descHtml: An iconic tactical shooter that shaped online multiplayer gaming, Counter-Strike delivers fast-paced, objective-based combat built around teamwork and skill.
counter-strike.instHtml:
1. Buy the game on Steam https://store.steampowered.com/app/10/CounterStrike.

  2. Copy your valve folder into: /roms/ports/counter-strike/valve

  3. Copy your cstrike folder into: /roms/ports/counter-strike/cstrike

  4. Do not overwrite existing port files when copying game data. If prompted, choose Skip / Keep existing files.

  5. Launch Counter-Strike from PortMaster.

crabjuice.title: Crabjuice
crabjuice.descHtml: Play as the monster for once in this fast-paced action game where you consume, smash, and escape through increasingly chaotic levels, featuring tight gameplay and addictive speedrun potential.

crashpsychedout.title: Crash Bandicoot Psyched Out
crashpsychedout.descHtml: Crash Bandicoot is back in another fan-game adventure! This time the evil N.Trance has brainwashed the entire planet and brought his army of interdimensional aliens to wreak havoc across the globe. Only Crash and his nemesis Dr. Neo Cortex are spared from being N.Trance's slaves, and must once again team up to put an end to his twisted reign! Play as both characters as you travel the planet and quite literally pick the brains of your favorite characters from the crash-verse! Are you ready to get psyched?
crashpsychedout.instHtml: Download the game from Gamejolt and extract all game files into the assets folder.

crashlands.title: Crashlands
crashlands.descHtml: Crash land and craft, battle, and quest your way through this story-driven Crafting ARPG overflowing with sass! Become Flux Dabes, a galactic trucker whose latest shipment gets derailed by a chin-strapped alien menace named Hewgodooko, leaving you stranded on an alien planet. As you hustle to retrieve your packages you’ll become enmeshed in a nefarious plot of world domination, which will require all of your wits and both of your glutes to overcome. Learn recipes from the local sentient life, make new friends, uncover ancient secrets and deadly bosses, tame everything and build yourself a home-away-from-home as you learn to thrive after crash landing on planet Woanope.
crashlands.instHtml:
To download the game, open the Steam console and paste the folowing text to download a compatible version: download_depot 391730 391732 5160663558593528303

Place all game files from the Resouces folder into port's Assets folder.

crazycook.title: Crazy Cook
crazycook.descHtml: Cook burgers and throw them into the mouths of your impatient customers. But be cautious! They have specific preferences. If you feed a vegetarian beef, he'll vomit it back at your face! Your goal is to earn enough money before the time expires. Cook fast and become the best chef!

crimsonland.title: Crimsonland
crimsonland.instHtml:
Place crimson.paq and sfx.paq in crimsonland/assets; music.paq or loose music/*.ogg files are optional.

Controls Left stick: movement Right stick: aim/fire Y: perk selection L1/L2: reload X: Backspace during high-score name entry D-pad/buttons navigate menus and compact UI screens

criticalcore2.title: Critical Core 2
criticalcore2.descHtml: The core has been flooded and its Deadly Doom™ is back to destroy everything! Use bubbles of power to keep the core from doing something bad.

cromagrally.title: Cro-Mag Rally
cromagrally.descHtml: This is a port of Pangea Software’s racing game Cro-Mag Rally. Take control of the caveman Brog as you race through the Stone, Bronze, and Iron Ages in primitive vehicles.

crop_and_claw.title: Crop and Claw
crop_and_claw.descHtml:
Crop and Claw is a classic-style JRPG all about dragons. Delve into swamps, temples, and ruins and fend off flora, fauna, and unsavory dragonfolk.

If you'd like to buy the game and support Dinoleaf, you can purchase it on either Steam and itch.io. The full game is provided by Dinoleaf for Portmaster's distribution free of charge.
crop_and_claw.instHtml:
Crop and Claw uses the non-Steam PCK to run, and ships with the full game on Portmaster. It should run out of the box on most systems.

Classic Mode Color Accuracy

Due to performance issues on lower end hardware, the Classic mode color accuracy shader has been disabled. This can be re-enabled by removing --disable-nes-colors from Crop and Claw.sh, but is only worth doing on stronger devices that should run the game in Classic mode.

cropandclaw2.title: Crop and Claw 2
cropandclaw2.descHtml:
Story

Many years after the events of Crop and Claw have passed. A hermit dragon by name of Wend and his friends set sail to a far away continent in search of a new home. But an ominous wind carries news that Wend's past has come to haunt him, even across the ocean itself.

Key Features

  • Build a custom party of dragons and join story characters throughout an adventure.
  • Dragons, everywhere.
  • A non-linear adventure allowing for exploration, routing, and replay-ability.
  • You are a dragon.
  • Turn-based combat against flora and dragons alike.
  • Multiple interactions and solutions to puzzles with characters and environments, encouraging exploration and experimentation.
  • Dragons. It really is a dragon adventure.

Demo

  • Contains the first act of the full game, for roughly one to two hours of play.
  • Allows for both story party and custom mercenaries.
  • Save compatibility for the full game of Crop and Claw 2 is not guaranteed!
cropandclaw2.instHtml:
Demo is ready to run.

To play the full game, wait until it releases.

cropsmare.title: Cropsmare!
cropsmare.descHtml: A Sokoban-like puzzle game inspired by Adventures of Lolo.
cropsmare.instHtml: You can purchase Cropsmare at: https://mrkdji.itch.io/cropsmare. Download the cropsmare-linux.zip version version and extract it, and place the cropsmare.pck file in the gamedata directory. This has been tested using the Linux version, but should also work with the Windows version.

crossbowcavern.title: Crossbow Cavern
crossbowcavern.descHtml: A recently uncovered network of caverns is rumored to contain the legendary "greatest treasure!" Take up the challenge of being the first one to explore this underground labyrinth and see if you can discover the untold riches that are said to lie in wait. Take care, however, as dangerous beasts and deadly traps stand in your way to glory! Crossbow Cavern is an exploratory platformer mainly revolving around the mechanic of utilizing your own projectiles as makeshift platforms.

crunkyfun.title: Crunky's Fun Rager
crunkyfun.descHtml: In Crunky's Fun Rager, you play as Crunky, a bouncy energetic bunny seeking revenge against the mischievous Crunko Pops. Your goal? Keep Crunky hopping, dodge obstacles, and defeat enemies. Jump on Crunko Pops to squash them or collect power-ups that grant Crunky unique abilities.
crunkyfun.instHtml: Download the game on Itch.io and copy the SuperCrunky-v1.0.0-drm-free.zip into the assets folder.

crushborgs.title: CrushBorgs
crushborgs.descHtml: "Run and Gun" oldschool single-player platformer with NES aesthetics, including an authentic 8-bit chiptune.
crushborgs.instHtml: Purchase the game on Steam and copy game files into the assets folder.

baconthulhu.title: Crypt of Baconthulhu
baconthulhu.descHtml: At a picnic with friends, Bob the Hamster eats so much bacon that he blacks out. When he wakes up, he finds himself in a mysterious crypt filled with dangerous monsters, ominous cultists, and whispers of the dreaded BACONTHULHU! If you love bacon and you love mazes, this is the game for you! ... If you HATE bacon but love mazes, this is probably still the game for you.

necrodancer.title: Crypt of the NecroDancer
necrodancer.descHtml:
Crypt of the NecroDancer is an award-winning hardcore roguelike rhythm game. Move to the music and deliver beatdowns to the beat! Groove to the epic Danny Baranowsky soundtrack, or choose from the collection of remixes.

This port uses Machismo to run the native Apple Silicon (arm64) Mac build directly on aarch64 Linux — no CPU emulation needed.
necrodancer.instHtml:
Installation

Requires the macOS version from GOG or Steam.

GOG (recommended)

  1. Purchase on GOG
  2. Download the macOS .pkg installer(s) — base game plus any DLC
  3. Place all .pkg files in necrodancer/gamedata/
  4. Launch — extraction happens automatically (may take 10+ minutes per .pkg)

Steam

  1. Purchase on Steam
  2. Download both Mac depots: download_depot 247080 247082 and download_depot 247080 247086
  3. Place depot_247082/ and depot_247086/ in necrodancer/gamedata/
  4. Launch — the patcher merges the depots automatically

cryptrio.title: Cryptrio
cryptrio.descHtml: Match three of the same type of monster to defeat them. Their weird and wobbly shapes mean you'll have to think hard about where to connect each piece, lest you find yourself backed into a corner ...
cryptrio.instHtml: Purchase the full game, or grab the free demo, at itch.io. Download and extract the .zip, and copy the game files to this port's gamedata folder.

crysalis.title: Crysalis
crysalis.descHtml:
Crysalis – the water of life. For generations, people lived their lives, blessed by the divine water. After finding out from the king that the town Ciuna’s Crysalis spring has run dry, Mio, a Crysalis researcher, is called in.

Go on an epic journey with Mio, and friends. Beautiful maps, elegant music, and fun areas to explore!
crysalis.instHtml: Copy Crysalis.exe (extract it from crysalis.zip) and RPGVXAce_RTP.zip in the roms/ports/crysalis folder.

crystalbreaker.title: Crystal Breaker
crystalbreaker.descHtml: Shoot the enemy at close range! Crystal Breaker is a vertically scrolling shmup that focuses on close range attack and quick destruction important for both stage clear and score attacks.
crystalbreaker.instHtml: Purchase the game on Steam and copy all game files into the assets folder. You can use the demo version as well.

crystalien.title: Crystalien Conflict Remake
crystalien.descHtml: A Crystalien Conflict Remake made in the Godot game engine. (Crystalien Conflict was a cult classic flash game made by the Lego group to promote the "Mars Misson" toyline, with gameplay similar to Command & Conquer.) Special thanks to B1er0l14m sharing the source code and agreeing to let the game be ready-to-run.
crystalien.instHtml: Game is ready to run. Use D-pad to move camera, use either joystick to move cursor. Use r1 to select and l1 to deselect.

crystalsamalgam.title: Crystals of Amalgam
crystalsamalgam.descHtml:
Your ship has been pulled into an interdimensional gap and is now trapped within a field of crystal orbs.

Match 3 or more orbs to destroy them. Mix primary colors to get a secondary color, or secondary colors to get a silver orb!

Silver orbs will give you special powers when you match them.

But be aware that time is your enemy. Don't let the orb wall reach the limit range or your ship will be destroyed.

cubosphere.title: Cubosphere
cubosphere.descHtml: Game similar to Kula World Over 450 levels in 34 different designs!

curseofthearrow.title: Curse of the Arrow
curseofthearrow.descHtml: Explore areas, solve puzzles, and fight against the curse that was imposed on you by an ancient statue! Your only weapon is a bow and a single arrow to defend yourself against your own corruption! Use your arrows as platforms, fight against enemies, toggle switches, and push boxes, and die (over and over)!

curseball.title: Curseball
curseball.descHtml: Welcome To Curseball! Your goal: hit the ball before time runs out. Simple, right?

cursedcastilla.title: Cursed Castilla (Maldita Castilla EX)
cursedcastilla.descHtml: Cursed Castilla (Maldita Castilla EX) is an arcade action platformer full of creatures from medieval myths from Spain and the rest of Europe, as well as from chivalric romances. The extended version of the classic Maldita Castilla, originally created by the indie Locomalito.
cursedcastilla.instHtml: Buy the game on Steam. Open the Steam console and use the following command to download the compatible version of the game: download_depot 534290 534291 8142126060031850682 Copy all game files into the assets folder.

cursedgem.title: Cursed Gem
cursedgem.descHtml: Help Oliver in this retro-pixel and challenging platformer. Explore a cursed cave, full of traps, secrets and diamonds. Complete all levels, get the biggest diamond for your girlfriend and break the curse that is dooming you.

cutefamehalloweenbash.title: Cute Fame: Halloween Bash
cutefamehalloweenbash.descHtml:
Spooktober game jam! 2023

3 Endings. 3 Outcomes. 3 People.

(This. The game that is being played. It is a night of deaths. Deaths that may end with you dying. Be careful, As one wrong choice can lead to your death! But, Time to explain this game, I will call it a party, Since that was the location it had happened. An Halloween party)

This game is a visual novel! Most events in this story were meant to be fiction. Although no research has concluded certain events like this never happened to anyone ever. It is also similarly based off the current "Cute Fame" universe, With changes that make some things feel fresh.

cybarian.title: Cybarian
cybarian.descHtml: Cybarian The Time Travelling Warrior is a classically inspired arcade action game, with a mixture of modern and retro gaming tropes. Designed to be played through in a single sitting, there are limited checkpoints and no saves.
cybarian.instHtml: Download the game from Steam and place Cybarian.exe to the assets folder.

cyberseraph.title: Cyber Seraph
cyberseraph.descHtml: A vertically-scrolling shoot-'em-up where you will be facing diverse bosses on your quest to save your homeworld from annihilation. Collect chips from wounded bosses to unlock special abilities and push onward to final victory.
cyberseraph.instHtml: Purchase the game at itch.io, grab the Windows version (Cyber Seraph.zip), extract and and copy the game files into cyberseraph/gamedata folder.

cylindrix.title: cylindrix
cylindrix.descHtml: Cylindrix is a 3-vs-3 combat game set inside cylindrical arenas, with a retro Tron-style aesthetic of flat polygons and saturated colors. You don't fly alone: you pilot your own ship, command two AI wingmen, and your goal is to take down the enemy team's radar base, capture pylons, and survive while the opposing team tries to do the same to you. Movement is fully free on all three axes, the pace is fast, and the difference between winning and losing comes down to picking the right ship, giving the right orders to your wingmen, and reading the arena, rather than pure aim. A weird and very 90s hybrid between dogfighter, arena shooter, and pocket-sized RTS.

dfencervstheorb.title: D-FENCER VS THE ORB
dfencervstheorb.descHtml: D-FENCER VS THE ORB is a short, experimental STG (shmup)
dfencervstheorb.instHtml: Download the game from https://danbo.itch.io/d-fencer-vs-the-orb and copy the exe file into the port folder.

daikatana.title: Daikatana
daikatana.descHtml: Travel through time to fight a corrupted dictatorship and right the wrongs inflicted on the world.
daikatana.instHtml: You must add the retail data files from the 'data/' folder to the port's 'daikatana/gamedata/' folder.

damoclesgaze.title: Damocles Gaze
damoclesgaze.descHtml: Damocles Gaze is a radically tight roguelite top-down shooter where every run takes 12 minutes. No matter how many times you die, no matter how good or bad you are, the run ends only after the 720 seconds went out.
damoclesgaze.instHtml: Purchase the game on tch.io or Steam. For Itch.io, download the MacOS version and extract the game files into gamedata folder. For Steam, download the MacOS depot via the Steam console using this command: download_depot 2521530 2521532 6713100392068965472, then copy the files into gamedata folder.

darkcrypt.title: Dark Crypt
darkcrypt.descHtml: Dark Crypt is a turn-based puzzler with a teleporting mechanic about sneaking through an ancient crypt, while avoiding its traps and the undead.
darkcrypt.instHtml: Purchase the game on Steam or Itch.io and copy the DarkCrypt.pck into the gamedata folder.

darkmoon.title: Dark Moon
darkmoon.descHtml: A single-player horror survival arcade shooter. Styled on classic retro titles from the Atari days, you'll be trudging across the surface of an alien world, collecting your equipment from scattered containers, looking for any way out. A test of endurance, can you escape the horrors of Dark Moon?
darkmoon.instHtml: Ready to run. Thanks to Project Level studios for creating this great game, and kindly granting permission for PortMaster to distribute the game files.

darksheep.title: Dark Sheep
darksheep.descHtml: Dark Sheep is a block-pushing puzzle game with horror elements, and a love letter to the Commodore 64, both in visuals and audio! Plays like classic Sokoban with new twists that force you to find creative solutions!
darksheep.instHtml:
Grab the windows version from itch.io and copy DarkSheep.pck into /roms/ports/darksheep/gamedata

Text is harder to read on 320p, but playable. Works best on 480p and up.

darkplaces.title: DarkPlaces
darkplaces.descHtml: DarkPlaces is a Quake engine source port by LadyHavoc that has greatly improved graphics and image quality. The realism of shell casings falling to the floor, much improved bullet impacts, 32bit color alpha blended explosions, blood flying everywhere and sticking to the walls...
darkplaces.instHtml: You will need to populate the id1, hipnotic, rogue, and dopa directories with your pak files and music tracks. Details can be found in the included text documents. The shareware version of Quake is included, but most expansions and mods will require the full registered version.

daserbe.title: Das Erbe
daserbe.descHtml:
A C#/.NET reimplementation of the German point-and-click adventure Das Erbe, not just a straight port of the 1991 original. It adds several quality-of-life features:

  • Hotspot highlighting (mapped to Y in this port): flashes every interactive hotspot on screen.
  • Click-to-action / mouse-over hovering: hotspot hints show on hover, skipping the original's separate confirmation click.
  • Translation overlay support.
  • DKSN fallback-response mode: varied German fallback responses for hotspot actions with no scripted response, instead of nothing.
  • Amiga intro music.
  • In-game keypad support via keyboard/numpad.
daserbe.instHtml: Install via PortMaster and run. The original game files are bundled with the port

daserbe2.title: Das Erbe 2
daserbe2.descHtml: A C#/.NET reimplementation of Das Schmutzige Erbe (Das Erbe 2), the 1993 sequel to Das Erbe. Reverse-engineered from the original Amiga release, recreating its presentation, interaction flow, scene progression, save/load behavior, and TFMX music playback, built on raylib instead of the original Amiga hardware.
daserbe2.instHtml: Install via PortMaster and run. The original game files are bundled with the port; Das Erbe 2 was freeware. The bundled pictures, font, music, and samples are original game assets, not covered by this port's GPL license; all rights remain with their respective owners.

davedavedave.title: Dave Dave Dave
davedavedave.descHtml: Dave Dave Dave, is a retro style hardcore platforming game set in an unknown world for you to explore with a single goal, reaching freedom.

davegnukem.title: Dave Gnukem
davegnukem.descHtml: Dave Gnukem is a cross-platform 2D scrolling platform shooter inspired by Duke Nukem 1.

dayofdrift.title: DAY OF DRIFT
dayofdrift.descHtml: DAY OF DRIFT is an arcade - style drifting racing game!
dayofdrift.instHtml: Purchase the game on Steam and use this Steam console command to get correct game files: download_depot 3650050 3650051 7183993842836823568. Copy all these files into the assets folder.

daydreamer.title: Daydreamer
daydreamer.descHtml: A minimalistic boss battle shmup that truly challenges your skills with 18 bosses, each with its own challenging pattern. This is a strategy shmup that is on another level! You will die a lot!
daydreamer.instHtml: Download from Nizakashii Locate and place data.win & both .ogg files into gamedata folder.

deadcells.title: Dead Cells
deadcells.descHtml: Dead Cells is a roguelike-metroidvania action platformer where you explore an ever-changing castle, fighting through procedurally generated levels with tight, fluid combat and a vast array of weapons and abilities. Death is permanent but progression carries over, unlocking new gear and paths that make each run feel fresh and rewarding.
deadcells.instHtml:
GoG Instructions

Place the LINUX version installer (eg: dead_cells_1_25_3_91669.sh) in the port's gamedata folder. If you have installed the linux version already, you can copy the res.pak and hlboot.dat files from the installations game folder into the port's gamedata folder.

GoG DLC

You can copy the GoG DLC installers into the gamedata folder too.

Steam Instructions

  • Open Steam console: steam://open/console
  • Copy and paste command: download_depot 588650 588653 325905742812183616
  • Open the folder where this depot was downloaded and copy res.pak and hlboot.dat into the port's gamedata folder. On windows this folder will be C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\content\app_588650\depot_588653

deadendcity.title: Dead End City
deadendcity.descHtml: A post-apocalyptic arcade shooter. Collect fuel and dodge enemy fire as you fight back against the evil Scorpio gang. Mixes cars, shmups and themes that would have been right at home in 80's anime and arcades.
deadendcity.instHtml: Purchase the game on Steam and copy all game files into assets folder.

deadicedeluxe.title: Dead Ice Deluxe
deadicedeluxe.descHtml: A small and kinda silly 1-v-1 Player-Vs-CPU Ice Hockey game, but the rink is full of zombies, powerups, mines, and meat.

deadknight.title: Dead Knight
deadknight.descHtml: You are dead. Get yourself some body parts and you'll be fine.
deadknight.instHtml: Grab the game at itch.io. Download it (an .exe file) and copy to this port's gamedata folder. Tested with Dead Knight v0-1.exe

deathraymanta.title: Death Ray Manta
deathraymanta.descHtml: Death Ray Manta is a short form top down arena shooter where you blow up enemies using colourful laserbeams. You spawn in the centre of the screen, moments later the screen is filled with mines, robots, rabbits and lasers from beyond the stars. Collect space gems for a bonus and shoot everything else that you can in order to flash lights at yourself. Aim for your own personal high score. How far into fish space can you get?
deathraymanta.instHtml: Purchase your game Steam OR Itch.io Download the latest version of the game. Copy the game files into ports/deathraymanta/assets

deathroad.title: Death Road to Canada
deathroad.descHtml: Control a car full of jerks as they explore cities, recruit weird people, rescue dogs, argue with each other, and face gigantic swarms of slow zombies. Randomly generated for a new story and rare events every time you play!
deathroad.instHtml: STEAM:Open the Steam Console and use 'download_depot 252610 252612 5968100789458006612' to download the correct version of the game. The Steam Console will tell you where the location to find these files is after the download. GOG:Using GOG, you'll need to go to your games list and find 'Manage' for this game. Turn off automatic downloads and then download the version that is from 04-02-2026 (or closest to this). Use those game files. Then dump them straight into /ports/deathroad/. From there, just go launch the game via your device

deathchase3d.title: Deathchase 3D
deathchase3d.descHtml: SDL Remake of the ZX Spectrum game Deathchase from 1983

deathroids.title: Deathroids
deathroids.descHtml: Relive the golden age of arcades playing a game with all the classic '80s/'90s space-shooting features. See how far you can get by destroying all enemy robots that are ready to attack planet Earth.
deathroids.instHtml: The game is available for purchase on Steam. Use depot_download or DepotDownloader to retrieve a specific manifest: -app 1389010 -depot 1389013 -manifest 3629779867370273043 -- then place Deathroids.app in this port's gamedata folder

deeprune.title: Deep Rune
deeprune.descHtml: A side-scrolling adventure game that seamlessly blends RPG mechanics and puzzle solving, all set in a mysterious world rooted in Norse mythology. Inspired by King's Field, Tower of the Sorcerer, and DROD RPG.
deeprune.instHtml: Download the game for free at https://jc-bailey.itch.io/deep-rune, extract it, and copy the game files to the deeprune/gamedata folder.

deep_sleep.title: Deep Sleep
deep_sleep.descHtml: It's morning and you gotta wake up for work, you hear the alarm clocks, but to wake up you need to collect all the clocks and escape the room before deep sleep ghosts catch you. They'll follow your every step and will eventually catch and make you fall into Deep Sleep if you're not careful. Use your Dream Pillow to traverse through 15 different and challenging levels! Good luck!

defendguin.title: Defendguin
defendguin.descHtml: Defendguin is a clone of the arcade game 'Defender,' but with a Linux theme. Your mission is to defend little penguinoids from being captured and mutated.

defshot.title: Defshot
defshot.instHtml: Download defshot_linux64.zip from https://securas.itch.io/defshot Extract the defshot_linux64.zip file Copy the defshot.pck to your defshot ports folder Notes: Thanks to securas for creating this game and making it available for free on itch.io. Also thanks to Cebion for the packaging for portmaster.

deirdre.title: Deirdre
deirdre.descHtml:
Deirdre is an Action Roguelike game where you fight a looping Gauntlet of Bosses.

One day, a group of tormented prisoners with weapons formed together to get their revenge on the Goddess of Time and her Angels. Over time, they have discovered the magical attributes of Torque. The essence of spin would fuel Deirdre’s Domain the same way Time fuels ours. The heroes would enchant their arsenal with Torque, allowing stronger methods to torment their enemies back. Will they be able to break Deirdre’s curse? Or are they truly hopeless against Time…
deirdre.instHtml: Ready to Run! Thanks to MegaStrimp for giving us permissions to distribute game files!

deltarune.title: Deltarune
deltarune.descHtml: Dive into the parallel story to UNDERTALE! Fight or spare your way through action-packed battles as you explore a mysterious world alongside an endearing cast of new and familiar characters. Chapters 1-4 will be available on launch, with more planned as free updates!
deltarune.instHtml: Choose where to download the game from and add all files to ports/deltarune/assets/install.

demodome.title: Demolition Dome
demodome.descHtml: DEMOLITION DOME is basically 1-v-1 volleyball. Except if the ball smacks you on the back of the head too much, you die. And tanks can shoot at you. And the field has human-sized pinball machine parts. Developed by Harley Wilson aka CURSED BOOTLEG INC.

demonkeep.title: Demon Keep
demonkeep.descHtml: Demon Keep is a minimalistic, classic roguelike with a dice rolling twist that is a kin to a mix between Porklike and Dicey Dungeons.
demonkeep.instHtml: Download the game https://youdoyoubuddy.itch.io/demon-keep and copy the exe or love file into the port folder.

demonofsakurapass.title: Demon of Sakura Pass
demonofsakurapass.descHtml: A brutal single-player racing game with simplified driving mechanics that reward a good racing line and savagely punish bad technique. Focus on learning each track's unique challenges to overcome each racer and move on to the next. Unwrap the mystery haunting Sakura Pass in a 7-stage campaign.
demonofsakurapass.instHtml: Purchase the game on itch.io, download the The Demon of Sakura Pass.exe version and copy it to the port's gamedata folder.

demonslayer.title: Demon Slayer
demonslayer.descHtml: A tough as nails game in the spirit of such titles like Castlevania or Faxanadu. Demon Slayer is an action packed retro pixel art platformer adventure game, with elements of survival strategy, problem solving, and resource management.
demonslayer.instHtml: Purchase at itch.io Place data.win into assets folder

demonizer.title: Demonizer
demonizer.descHtml: The fantasy bullet battle to end monstergirl genocide! Turn hateful humans into lovable demons in this 90s arcade style shooter, inspired by Raiden Fighters, Strikers 1945, and Battle Garegga.
demonizer.instHtml: You need to copy the game file (demonizer-demo.love or demonizer-full.love or demonizer demo.exe or ...) in gamedata directory and named it demonizer.love.

demonstone64.title: Demonstone64
demonstone64.descHtml: A one hit strategy game where you must move through each room, timing your attacks and dodging guards. Can you conquer Castle Demonstone?

depthsoflimbo.title: Depths of Limbo
depthsoflimbo.descHtml: Depths of Limbo is a action roguelike with a dark theme. The fast-paced combat is spiced up with a variety of unique items and weapons found throughout the procedurally generated world. It has elements of the Binding of Isaac's room by room then floor by floor style, and with Nuclear Throne's twin stick controls and focus on weapons and ammo.
depthsoflimbo.instHtml: Download the game from https://store.steampowered.com/app/568400/Depths_of_Limbo/ and copy the .exe or .love file into the port folder.

derclou.title: Der Clou!
derclou.descHtml: A burglary simulation game originally created by neo Software Produktions GmbH.
derclou.instHtml: Der Clou!'s files are already included and ready to go.

derelict.title: Derelict
derelict.descHtml: The Derelict is a scifi platformer developed by Programmancer for the GBJam5. Navigate the abandoned derelict spacecraft to restore power and stop the evil robot AI, the Master Circuit!
derelict.instHtml: Download the game from Itch.io and place the Derelict.zip into the port's assets folder.

descent.title: Descent
descent.descHtml:
Play as a mercenary sent into planetary mines to destroy them before a computer virus spreads! You'll fly through 3D mazes in search of keycards to gain access to each level's reactor--which, once destroyed, will begin a self-destruct! Make sure you know where the exit hatch is! It will only open when the reactor is destroyed. Oh, and watch out for those virus-infected robots. They'll shoot at you.

Includes shareware/demo files. See instructions to use full version.
descent.instHtml: Ready to play with shareware and demo files. To upgrade to full game, purchase on Steam/GOG and then add .hog and .pig files to ports/descent/data.

descent2.title: Descent II
descent2.descHtml:
Return as a mercenary sent into deep space mines to destroy them before a computer virus spreads! You'll fly through 3D mazes in search of keycards to gain access to each level's reactor--which, once destroyed, will begin a self-destruct! Make sure you know where the exit hatch is! It will only open when the reactor is destroyed. Oh, and watch out for those virus-infected robots. They'll shoot at you.

Includes shareware/demo files. See instructions to use full version.
descent2.instHtml: Ready to play with shareware and demo files. To upgrade to full game, purchase on Steam/GOG and then add .hog and .pig files to ports/descent2/data. Fully compatible with Descent 2: Vertigo and Descent Maximum levels!

descent3.title: Descent III
descent3.descHtml: Play the exciting final installment in the Descent trilogy! Saved by amateur do-gooders, the Material Defender sets out to stop the robot virus and Dravis' evil plans once and for all! Pilot through 3D space, navigating through familiar indoor mines and outdoor open space terrain. It's a big universe, but fortunately they threw in a guidebot.
descent3.instHtml: Purchase the full game from GOG or Steam, or use CD game data patched to v1.4. Then, add data files to descent3/gamedata. See the readme for specific files needed.

destructivator.title: Destructivator
destructivator.descHtml:
Destructivator is a retro styled platform shooter for the gamer that enjoys a challenge - 20 levels of fast and furious arcade action. Blast your way to Zallagor's lair to rid the world of this evil monster, blah blah blah etc...

Basically just shoot all the bad guys.
destructivator.instHtml: Download the game from https://pugfuglygames.itch.io/destructivator and place the contents of the zip into the /gamedata folder

destructivator2.title: Destructivator 2
destructivator2.descHtml: A platform shooter that brings 90's gaming smashing into your face! Blast and insta-melee your way through hordes of alien soldiers, robots, bosses and loads more. Fight on foot, in a fighter or in a bomber. Take on bosses and ensure that the alien menace won't threaten Earth ever again!
destructivator2.instHtml: Purchase the game from Steam or Itch. Copy the data.win to /ports/destructivator2/assets

caseandbot_murder.title: Detective Case and Clown Bot in: Murder in the Hotel Lisbon
caseandbot_murder.descHtml: Join Detective Case and his quirky sidekick Clown Bot in a comedic investigation filled with mystery, humor, and retro charm. It is a classic point-and-click adventure game featuring engaging puzzles, witty dialogue, and a fun narrative.
caseandbot_murder.instHtml: Buy the game and download the Windows version from itch.io or Steam * Copy the game files into assets folder

caseandbot_express.title: Detective Case and Clown Bot in: The Express Killer
caseandbot_express.descHtml: Join Detective Case and his quirky sidekick Clown Bot in a comedic investigation filled with mystery, humor, and retro charm. It is a classic point-and-click adventure game featuring engaging puzzles, witty dialogue, and a fun narrative.
caseandbot_express.instHtml:
• Buy the game and download the Windows version from Steam
  • Copy the game files into assets folder

devilspire.title: Devil Spire
devilspire.descHtml: Devil Spire is a hardcore first-person pseudo-3D roguelite action RPG dungeon crawler stylized after retro PC games, developed by a guy and his bros while locked in quarantine. Inspired by classics like King's Field and Heretic.
devilspire.instHtml: Purchase the game on Steam and copy all game files into the assets folder. You can also use the free demo version.

devilutionx.title: DevilutionX
devilutionx.descHtml: DevilutionX is a source port of Diablo from https://github.com/diasurgical/devilutionX.
devilutionx.instHtml: Includes the Diablo shareware version. You can add your own full version DIABDAT.MPQ file to the ports/devilutionx folder. To run the Diablo: Hellfire expansion you will need to also copy hellfire.mpq, hfmonk.mpq, hfmusic.mpq, hfvoice.mpq. See wiki if you experience issues with version upgrades or configuration changes.

devbootleg.title: DEVOLVER Bootleg
devbootleg.descHtml: Devolver Bootleg contains 8 original rip offs of Devolver games.
devbootleg.instHtml: Purchase at Steam Locate the data.win, MAP File, DUNGEON File, 2 folders and copy them into ports/devbootleg/assets/.

diceheck.title: Diceheck
diceheck.descHtml: TIME TO GO TO DICEHECK WHO KNOWS WHAT YOU'LL ROLL
diceheck.instHtml: Download Dicehckwin.zip from itch.io and put the game files in ports/diceheck/assets

diceydungeons.title: Dicey Dungeons
diceydungeons.descHtml:
Become a giant walking dice and battle to the end of an ever-changing dungeon! Can you escape the cruel whims of Lady Luck?

In this fast-paced deckbuilding roguelike from Terry Cavanagh, Chipzel, and Marlowe Dobbe, you'll fight monsters, find better loot, and level up your heroes as you work together to take down the Goddess of Fortune, Lady Luck herself. Balance your carefully planned strategies against the unknown of a dice roll.
diceydungeons.instHtml: Purchase the game and download the linux version. For GOG, place dicey_....sh in ports/diceydungeons/gamedata. For Steam/itch, place game files in ports/diceydungeons/gamedata.

digger.title: Digger
digger.descHtml: Digger port based on the DOS version (remastered)

topnep.title: Dimension Tripper Neptune TOP NEP
topnep.descHtml: Guide Older Neptune as she takes to the skies with the help of her state-of-the-art Generator Unit! Combat through five unique stages and bosses based on the Gamindustri Nations. Blast through fast-moving obstacles and even fight some familiar Neptunia enemies and bosses! And if you gather enough coins on each stage, a friend will assist you on attacks. Challenge yourself and see what your highest score can be! Now, put on your gaming goggles, Maverick, and ready up for the wildest Neptunia ride of your life!
topnep.instHtml: Purchase the game from steam From your Steam Library, Dimension Tripper Neptune: TOP NEP> Manage > Browse local files Copy the files into ports/topnep/gamedata. The game will patch on first startup.

dinothawr.title: Dinothawr
dinothawr.descHtml: Dinothawr is a block pushing puzzle game on slippery surfaces.

disccreatures.title: Disc Creatures
disccreatures.descHtml: Humans live alongside creatures, each with different personalities, abilities, and moral codes. The invention of the DiscKid has changed life for everyone. Humans can copy creatures and use their power to help others and solve mysteries around the world.
disccreatures.instHtml: Purchase and download from Steam, then add game files to port folder on your device. It will take a minute to patch on first launch.

discroom.title: Disc Room
discroom.descHtml:
Are you ready to get sliced in half? The year is 2089 and a giant disc has appeared in orbit of Jupiter. Step into the oversized space suit of a brave scientist and explore this sprawling intergalactic slaughterhouse. Explore the expansive orbiting disc ship, moving room to room surviving and completing increasingly complex goals set forth. Use unlocked abilities to outmaneuver dozens of different disc types while solving mysterious puzzles. And remember: what kills you only makes you stronger.

Note: Currently only works with the Steam/GOG Version of the game!
discroom.instHtml: Purchase the game from steam or gog. Download the windows version of the game and add the game data to discroom/gamedata.

diverdown.title: Diver Down
diverdown.descHtml: Diver Down is a stealth-platformer. Avoid the lights on 20 different stages using your mysterious Diver Down ability, that allows you to dive onto solids! .

donottakethiscathome.title: Do NOT Take This Cat Home
donottakethiscathome.descHtml:
WARNING: This game is not suitable for children or the easily disturbed. It includes depictions of horror elements, human/animal violence and death, abuse/abusive relationship(s), disturbing images, loud noises, flashing images/lights and more.

Imagine it’s your day off, and the dreary weather only adds to your gloom. Your curiosity gets the better of you as you follow a mysterious, distant call to a dark and lonely alley. There, in a cardboard box, sits an irresistibly cute cat. What will you do next?
donottakethiscathome.instHtml: Download the DoNOTTakeThisCatHome-1.0-pc.zip from https://pixeliminal.itch.io/do-not-take-this-cat-home and extract it. Then copy its game folder in the ports/donottakethiscathome/ folder

doddgoestothemuseum.title: Dodd Goes to the Museum
doddgoestothemuseum.descHtml: Explore Dodd's local museum in this short, casual and relaxing adventure! Visit various exhibits within the museum's four wings and talk to various characters along the way!

dodgindiamonds2d.title: Dodgin Diamonds 2D
dodgindiamonds2d.descHtml: This is a little shoot’em up arcade game for one or two players. It aims to be an ‘old school’ arcade game with low resolution graphics, top-down scroll action, energy based gameplay and different weapons with several levels of power.

dokimon.title: Dokimon: Quest
dokimon.descHtml: Dokimon: Quest is a game where you capture monsters to battle alongside and push through the dangerous open world. In advances to uncover the the mystery about your missing friend, you must become stronger, allowing you to venture on into increasingly dangerous areas. Battle against fellow Dokimon battlers who are also on the quest to get stronger, and take down evil corporations that stand in your way and disrupt the peace.
dokimon.instHtml: Includes the demo! To use the full game, buy it on Steam or Itch.io and copy all the data to ports/dokimon/assets. The patcher will run whenever it finds new files in the assets folder.

domeromantik.title: Dome Romantik
domeromantik.descHtml: Dig your way through to the core of the planet. Mine minerals, bring them back to your dome and install upgrades just in time to defend from hostile lifeforms.

ceferino.title: Don Ceferino Hazaña
ceferino.descHtml: A game similar to the classic Super Pang. Don Ceferino Hazaña is a gaucho from Argentina who must rescue his cow from the aliens. In the best Super Pang style, in this game the most important thing is the skill of the player.
ceferino.instHtml: Ready to run! Main Menu is a tad slow but ingame it works great!

donthide.title: Don't Hide
donthide.descHtml: Trapped in a maze with a beast, you must find five keys and their door to escape. The monster can only smell and hear you, but as long as it hasn't fully caught your scent, you can move freely.
donthide.instHtml: Download the game For Free from Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2131620/Dont_Hide/ Or From Itch.io: https://sulfic-games.itch.io/dont-hide and Copy the DontHideGame.pck file into the gamedata folder

donut.dodo.title: Donut Dodo
donut.dodo.descHtml: If a long lost arcade game from 1983 resurfaced today, it would be Donut Dodo -- a classic 2D platformer from the golden era, tough as nails and challenging for the whole family! Ready to top the high score table?
donut.dodo.instHtml:
You can purchase Donut Dodo at: https://zapposh.itch.io/donut-dodo-retropie-edition

Download and extract it, and place the DonutDodo.pck file in the gamedata directory. This has been tested with DonutDodo_1_39.zip

doom2d.title: Doom 2D
doom2d.descHtml: Doom 2D is a fan-made DOS-based freeware side-scrolling video game released by Prikol Software in August 1996. It is based upon Doom, similar to Doom 2D - Knee deep in the dead. Doom 2D is essentially the original Doom translated into a two-dimensional arcade or console-like shooter, comparable to the original Duke Nukem. The player resumes their role as Doomguy, who must do battle with various hell-spawn.

doom3.title: Doom 3
doom3.descHtml: Doom 3 is a 2004 survival horror first-person shooter video game developed by id Software and published by Activision.
doom3.instHtml: You need to add your own full game pak files to the ports/doom3/base folder.

doomengines.title: Doom Engines
doomengines.descHtml:
Doom engines! A Love2D launcher makes selecting games and mods easy. See the readme for instructions and details.

Includes shareware demo files and freedoom.
doomengines.instHtml: Comes with shareware files for Doom and freedoom bundle for mod use. Add your full game files to their respective folders to play.

doom2rpg.title: Doom II RPG
doom2rpg.descHtml: DOOM II RPG is a follow-up in the style of the Wolfenstein RPG, chronologically set before the events in DOOM RPG. Thanks to secret experiments, the various UAC Bases on Mars, the Moon, Earth and wherever else the cooperation has set foot have experienced incidents involving demons. A team of soldiers including a scientist are sent to Tycho Station on the Moon to investigate.
doom2rpg.instHtml: Search for "Doom 2 RPG.ipa" on archive.org to get the original mobile game assets file: and copy the "Doom 2 RPG.ipa" file into the doom2rpg folder.

doomrpg.title: Doom RPG
doomrpg.descHtml: Doom RPG is a mobile phone game developed by Fountainhead Entertainment . It combines the Doom first-person shooter franchise with role-playing video game elements. The storyline incorporates many similar events of Doom 3, but involves different characters than those in the third game.
doomrpg.instHtml: Search for Doom RPG BREW on archive.org to get the original mobile game assets file: doomrpg.bar (CRC32: d7cf11c5) and copy the doomrpg.bar file into the gamedata folder.

doomies3.title: Doomies: Bloody Fur
doomies3.descHtml: Doomies: Bloody Fur is a third entry in an intense, super gory game series about killing mutant animals and overcoming your previous hi-score!

doomrl.title: DoomRL
doomrl.descHtml: DRL (D**m, the Roguelike) is a fast and furious coffee-break Roguelike game, that is heavily inspired by the popular FPS game Doom by ID Software.
doomrl.instHtml: Game files are already included. Controls are rather complex, make sure to read the control sheet carefully.

doukutsu-rs.title: Doukutsu-rs
doukutsu-rs.descHtml:
Arguably the most well-known indie game of all time, Cave Story (Doukutsu Monogatari) features a completely original storyline wrapped with personality, mystery and hours of fast-paced fun.

This port is a build of doukutsu-rs, a fully playable re-implementation of the Cave Story engine written in Rust. You can play the original freeware game (bundled with the port), or Cave Story+ which has enhanced graphics, sound, challenges and co-op play.
doukutsu-rs.instHtml: The original freeware game is included, and will be used automatically if you don't provide any files. You can download one of the translations from here, or buy Cave Story+ on Steam or elsewhere. Put the files from either version (data and surrounding files) in ports/doukutsu-rs.

downwell.title: Downwell
downwell.descHtml: Downwell is a curious game about a young person venturing down a well in search of untold treasures with only his Gunboots for protection. Make your way further and further down into the darkness filled with nasty creatures and mysterious secrets to collect the spectacular red gems scattered about the rocks. Step into precariously placed shops and buy some helpful items or level up between levels to battle well-dwelling monsters and uncover hidden caves filled with riches and relics. No two trips down the well are ever the same!
downwell.instHtml: Purchase and download the game from: https://store.steampowered.com/app/360740/Downwell/ OR https://www.gog.com/en/game/downwell. Locate your gamefolder and copy all the files from the folder to /ports/downwell/assets. Alternatively place the gog installer (.exe) in /ports/downwell/assets.

drbloodshot.title: Dr. Bloodshot
drbloodshot.descHtml: Dr. Bloodshot is a short survival horror game. It's set in an old mansion filled with monsters that the player has to avoid (either by running away or by hiding in cabinets). The objective is to reach the well secured laboratory of Dr. Bloodshot, which can be done by sabotaging various power stations across the mansion.

draculatower.title: Dracula's Tower
draculatower.descHtml:
Dracula is back from the dead again, and this time he brought a really tall tower!

Jump over rolling skulls, whip candles and throw axes through 6 levels of extremely brutal platforming as you climb both ladders and the highscore table.
draculatower.instHtml: Download the DRACULAS_TOWER_V2_itchio.zip from Itch.io, and place it into assets folder.

dragondragonfirefire.title: Dragon Dragon Fire Fire
dragondragonfirefire.descHtml: Play as a dragon and spit fire in this classic arcade platformer, creatively titled "Dragon Dragon Fire Fire"! Relive the charm of late-80s arcade games as you blast through destructible stages, incinerate your enemies, and chase the high score.

dragonvshunters.title: Dragon vs Hunters
dragonvshunters.descHtml: Defend your nest, burn your enemies, and rule the skies! Dragon vs Hunters is a fast-paced, retro-style action game where you play as a mighty dragon trying to protect its precious eggs from waves of relentless hunters.
dragonvshunters.instHtml: Buy the game on itch.io, download dragonvshunters-v1.0-pyxapp.zip and unzip it in the dragonvshunters/gamedata directory.

drally.title: dRally
drally.descHtml: Death Rally is a vehicular combat racing video game developed by Remedy Entertainment, published by Apogee Software and distributed by GT Interactive.
drally.instHtml: The game needs the original assets, they are freely available. Download the DeathRallyWin_10.exe from https://www.chip.de/downloads/Death-Rally-Vollversion_38550689.html and place it into the ports/drally/ directory and it will be automatically extracted.

dreamchess.title: DreamChess
dreamchess.descHtml: Open source 3D chess game with a freely rotatable board and its own xboard-compatible Dreamer engine.
dreamchess.instHtml: D-Pad/left stick or right stick as a pointer, A confirms, B back.

driftsurvivor.title: Drift Survivor
driftsurvivor.descHtml:
Paying Tribute to Classic Arcade Shooting Games. Drift Survivor is an addictive and fast-paced arcade shooting game that combines "drifting" with a "bullet hell" gameplay style!
:Note: Use Start to resume the game from the pause menu!
driftsurvivor.instHtml: Instructions: Purchase the game from steam. Download the game. Place all the game files into ports/driftsurvivor/assets

drilbertiidiggeredoo.title: Drilbert II Diggeredoo
drilbertiidiggeredoo.descHtml: Drilbert the Drill Boy is back! Help Drilbert fulfill his dream of drilling as deep as he can! A little puzzle game where you dig + push. Dig Deep; collect loot; get out.
drilbertiidiggeredoo.instHtml:
You can download Drilbert II Diggeredoo for free at: https://wheybags.itch.io/drilbert-ii-diggeredoo

Download the Drilbert_II_Diggeredoo.zip version and extract it. Within the extracted files, there's a folder named linux with an assets.zip file; extract the contents of assets.zip into the port's gamedata directory.

drinkndrive.title: Drink'n'Drive
drinkndrive.descHtml: A vertical arcade racing game where your vehicle is out of control. You must refrain from crashing into oncoming cars and see how many you can dodge.
drinkndrive.instHtml: Download the .exe and place it into the gamedata folder

drivenout.title: Driven Out
drivenout.descHtml: Beautiful 16 bit retro art style with fluid animations and deliberate combat. Read the enemy and act accordingly in this seamless world without any load screens.
drivenout.instHtml: Purchase the game on Steam and copy all game files into assets folder. You can also use the free demo.

droid7.title: DROID7
droid7.descHtml: Jump your way up on a generated tower while a laser beam chases you from below. The higher you go, the faster it gets, and it isn't long before disappearing (and reappearing) platforms and spikes are introduced to make your life harder.
droid7.instHtml:
You can purchase DROID7 at: https://juancolacelli.itch.io/droid7

Download any Windows or Linux version and extract it, and place the DROID7.pck file in the gamedata directory. This has been tested with Windows 64-bit, Dec 30 2022 release

ducklingsmaze.title: Ducklings Maze
ducklingsmaze.descHtml: Embark on a feathered adventure in Ducklings Maze, where you play as a courageous duck on a mission to rescue your adorable ducklings and lead them safely back home through a challenging maze. Inspired by the fairy tale "Den grimme aelling" by Hans Christian Andersen, the game is a medium/high difficulty maze with all the elements that an 80s arcade game requires.

dudelingsarcadesportsball.title: Dudelings: Arcade Sportsball
dudelingsarcadesportsball.descHtml: A video game that crosses the tried-and-true gameplay of Pong with the competitive frenzy of foosball. Billed as the world's first 'sportslike', tongue firmly planted in cheek.
dudelingsarcadesportsball.instHtml: Purchase the game at https://heavy-element.itch.io/dudelings -- download the Android version, place the apk in dudelingsarcadesportsball/gamedata

duelingdragons.title: Dueling Dragons
duelingdragons.descHtml:
In its search for power, humanity dug too deep. Cracking open the earth above an ancient nuclear waste tomb, radiation spread throughout the world, warped by centuries of rotting. Sorcerers and dragons were created by the radiation's twisted power, and soon dragon riders took to the skies and began terrorizing the planet.

You are an errant dragon rider on a quest to find and defeat the legendary Dragon Lord. Time your attacks well, gather new spells, and soar through the skies atop your dragon.

duke.nukem.3d.title: Duke Nukem 3D
duke.nukem.3d.descHtml: Duke Nukem 3D using the rednukem build open source port by Alexey Khokholov.
duke.nukem.3d.instHtml: You'll need to add your own full version duke3d.grp and duke.rts Duke Nukem 3D Atomic files to the ports/rednukem/gamedata folder.

duke3dawo.title: Duke Nukem 3D - Alien World Order
duke3dawo.descHtml: Duke Nukem 3D - Alien World Order is the fifth episode of Duke Nukem 3D. The fifth episode was added to the game as part of the 20th Anniversary Edition and contains eight levels, including one secret level. Levels in this episode are based in cities from around the world, including Amsterdam, Moscow, London, Giza, Paris, San Francisco, Hollywood, and Rome. The final boss is the Cycloid Incinerator.
duke3dawo.instHtml: Obtain game files from your Steam copy of Alien World Tour. See 'ports/duke3dawo/Place Duke3D AWT files here.txt' for instructions to place your Alien World Tour contents into the duke3dawo directory.

dumbasssmartass.title: Dumbass Smartass
dumbasssmartass.descHtml: Dumbass/smartass is a short pixel-art point & click adventure made for the $108 Adventure Game Challenge. It's a surreal, somewhat existential story about language barriers, holograms, and cognitive bias.

dumpyandbumpy.title: Dumpy & Bumpy
dumpyandbumpy.descHtml: Experience a clever take on retro Japanese puzzle games. Bite, blow up, and break through 80 charming but challenging levels. Crack each level's code and crush the evil Ghostlord. Be sure to make haste, though, or the Ghost minions will make waste ... of you!
dumpyandbumpy.instHtml: Purchase the game on itch.io or Steam. First, extract the .zip (if itch.io version), then copy the game files to this port's gamedata folder.

dunelegacy.title: Dune Legacy
dunelegacy.descHtml: Dune II: The Building of a Dynasty (aka Dune II: Battle for Arrakis) is the first-ever real-time strategy game. The player takes the role of the commander of one of the three interplanetary houses, the Atreides, the Harkonnen or the Ordos, with the objective of wresting control of Arrakis from the other two houses. This port is a build of Dune Legacy, which is an effort by a handful of developers to revitalize the game. It is as similar as possible to the original gameplay but integrates modern UI features like selecting multiple units.
dunelegacy.instHtml: You need to copy the original game's .PAK files (e.g. from the PC release) to ports/dunelegacy/.

dungeonantiqua.title: Dungeon Antiqua
dungeonantiqua.descHtml: Dungeon Antiqua is a simple RPG inspired by the Wizardry and Final Fantasy games of the 1980s and 1990s, in which players traverse dungeons by repeatedly exploring and developing their characters.
dungeonantiqua.instHtml: Buy the game on Steam, install it and copy dungeon-antiqua.pyxapp in the dungeonantiqua/gamedata directory.

dungeonantiqua2.title: Dungeon Antiqua 2
dungeonantiqua2.descHtml: Dungeon Antiqua 2 is a **2D dungeon hack-and-slash RPG ** featuring SNES-style pixel art and sound. A retro-flavored adventure awaits you, blending strategic exploration with a highly flexible character building system.
dungeonantiqua2.instHtml: Buy the game on Steam, install it and copy dungeon-antiqua2.pyxapp in the dungeonantiqua2/gamedata directory on your device.

dungeoncrawlstonesoup.title: Dungeon Crawl Stone Soup
dungeoncrawlstonesoup.descHtml: Dungeon Crawl Stone Soup is a game of dungeon exploration, combat and magic, involving characters of diverse skills, worshipping deities of great power and caprice. To win, you'll need to be a master of tactics and strategy, and prevail against overwhelming odds.
dungeoncrawlstonesoup.instHtml: Game files are already included. Controls are rather complex, make sure to read the control sheet carefully.

dungeoninabottle.title: Dungeon in a Bottle
dungeoninabottle.descHtml:
Dungeon in a Bottle is a precision platformer about choosing the right kind of jump. The acrobatic thief, Reya, has gotten himself trapped in a magic bottle, and now he must use every jump at his disposal to escape the treacherous dungeon within! Hopefully he'll grab some treasure while he's at it.

Note: Game is tested with the Steam version only!
dungeoninabottle.instHtml: Purchase the game on Steam. Copy diab.exe to ports/dungeoninabottle.

dungeonsouls.title: Dungeon Souls
dungeonsouls.descHtml: Dungeon Souls is an action-adventure roguelike dungeon crawler which draws heavy inspiration from Nuclear Throne, Risk of Rain, and Overture. Explore vast procedurally generated dungeons, collect loot, and slay hordes of challenging enemies!
dungeonsouls.instHtml: Download game from https://store.steampowered.com/app/383230/Dungeon_Souls/ or Humble, GOG files do not work at this time. Use 7-Zip to extract files from the DungeonSouls.exe and copy data.win and all .ogg files to /ports/dungeonsouls/gamedata . If controls are incorrectly mapped, from the title screen select options, enable gamepad, then select back and quit from the main menu. Controls should be good to go on subsequent launches.

dungeonrush.title: DungeonRush
dungeonrush.descHtml: A opensource game inspired by Snake, written in pure C with SDL

dustaet.title: Dust - an Elysian Tail
dustaet.descHtml: Immerse yourself in a gorgeous hand-painted world on a search for your true identity. As the mysterious warrior, Dust, your action-packed journey will take you from peaceful glades to snowy mountaintops and beyond.
dustaet.instHtml:
• Purchase Dust: an Elysian Tail on Steam.
  • Open the Steam Console with this Windows+R then paste this: "steam://open/console".
  • Run this command to download the Linux version: download_depot 236090 236092 3643140810355546394
  • Copy all files to ports/dustaet/gamedata
  • Run Dust: An Elysian Tail.

dustracing2d.title: Dust Racing 2D
dustracing2d.descHtml: Traditional top-down 2D car racing game with a track editor.
dustracing2d.instHtml: Ready to run out of the box, no additional files needed.

dynamate_playdate.title: Dynamate Playdate
dynamate_playdate.descHtml: Dynamate is a puzzle game where the aim of the game, in any level, is to clear the level of the numbered / colored pieces. Pieces can be removed in a predefined way by moving another piece into them. There are also pieces affecting the currently moving piece. This is a port of the Playdate Version which was based on the gp2x version of the game.

dum2.title: DüM 2 Heck on Earf
dum2.descHtml: A Doom inspired arcade style shooter, made in 1 month for the Awful Summer Jam 2017.
dum2.instHtml: Download at itch.io extract zip file and copy data.win to assets folder.

ez.title: E.Z
ez.descHtml:
E.Z is a simple hardcore platformer game the goal being get across to the other side of each of the 100 levels while each death throws you back to the previous levels.

With a semi-random level sequence, level variability and quick level swapping, E.Z is hard to get used to. It will bring a challenge to your skill, reaction, and adaptability.

Note: Text may be unreadable on smaller devices but this does not affect gameplay!
ez.instHtml: Purchase the game from steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/795040/EZ/ Download the game and from your Steam library, right click on E.Z > Manage > Browse local files. Copy the data.win from the assets folder to /ports/ez/gamedata

eatgirl.title: EAT GIRL
eatgirl.descHtml: EAT GIRL is a surreal top-down action game about moving quickly and efficiently through tight corridors while eating dots. Explore an interconnected world of more than 30 levels, meet creatures who may or may not be docile, and take in an atmosphere that is by turns meditative and unsettling, with every level scored by its own blend of ambient music.
eatgirl.instHtml: Buy EAT GIRL on itch, then copy eatgirl.love from the download into ports/eatgirl.

echo_chamber.title: Echo Chamber
echo_chamber.descHtml:
Wizard roguelike Traverse a dungeon and add a new spell each time you clear a floor.

Your spells cycle in a loop.

edna.title: Edna - Out of Sight
edna.descHtml: Play as Edna and make your way through a castle by possessing statues within your line of sight. Solve puzzles by manipulating doors, switches, and mirrors.
edna.instHtml: Download [windows] Edna - Out of sight, out of control.zip from https://kz.itch.io/edna and copy edna.pck to the gamedata folder.

eity.title: Eity
eity.descHtml: Eity is a rhythm game with cool music.

elecdude.title: Elec Dude
elecdude.descHtml:
"Dr. Darkglass" wants to Conquer the World, so he stole all the Energy supplies to create his Evil Robots. There is only one benign and that is "Elec Dude", he is the last Hope to save Mankind. This Game is about collecting all the Energy per Level and there by getting to the next Level. But be careful not to collide with Enemy Robots.

Note: Only works with the steam version for now!
elecdude.instHtml:
Itch: Download ElecDude.zip from https://misteryjay.itch.io/elec-dude-full and unzip the contents to /ports/elecdude/gamedata

Steam: Claim the game from steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1907980/Elec_Dude/ Download the game and from your Steam library, right click on Elec Dude> Manage > Browse local files. Copy the all the game files from /Elec Dude to /ports/elecdude/gamedata

elechead.title: ElecHead
elechead.instHtml:
Purchase the game from https://namatakahashi.itch.io/elechead or Steam or GOG. Download the game and copy over the files to ports/elechead/gamedata.

Tested with itch.io (ElecHead(Win1.0.5).zip,), Steam and GOG (GOG elechead 1.0.5.1)

elsewhereinthenight.title: Elsewhere in the Night
elsewhereinthenight.descHtml: A 2D psychic noir point-and-click adventure where you play as Lady Tick Tock, a detective who speaks to the dead to solve a string of murders in a dystopian city. With EGA-inspired pixel art and a narrative-focused design free of arcade sequences or dead ends, the game offers a gripping story you can explore at your own pace.
