elsewhereinthenight.instHtml: Download the Elsewhere in the Night.rar version for free at itch.io. Extract the .rar, and copy the Elsewhere in the Night.pck file to this port's gamedata folder.

endlessdungeon.title: Endless Dungeon
endlessdungeon.descHtml: Endless Dungeon is a top-down 2D dungeon crawler game with a multitude of different enemies to fight, spells to unlock and weapons and armor to find.
endlessdungeon.instHtml: Download the game https://randomnovice.itch.io/endless-dungeon and place Endless Dungeon.exe or Endless Dungeon.app file to the port folder

enigma.title: Enigma
enigma.descHtml: Enigma is a puzzle game inspired by Oxyd on the Atari ST and Rock'n'Roll on the Amiga

entropipes.title: EntroPipes
entropipes.descHtml: EntroPipes is a puzzle type game. Simply connect all pipes.

entwined.title: Entwined Time
entwined.descHtml: In this two time manipulation puzzle game, help Light and Heavy reach and repair the Chrono Station's reactor after a catastrophic failure rends their timelines asunder (and also blows the Station to smithereens, turning it into hundreds of puzzles to traverse)!

environmentalstationalpha.title: Environmental Station Alpha
environmentalstationalpha.descHtml: Environmental Station Alpha is an action-adventure platformer with a retro aesthetic and heavy emphasis on exploration. In the game the player controls a robot sent to investigate a mysterious, abandoned space station with the mission to find out what exactly took place there.
environmentalstationalpha.instHtml: Purchase your copy of the game on Steam and copy the required Linux depot into the port's gamedata/ folder. Refer to the full documentation in environmentalstationalpha.md for details.

erebos.title: Erebos
erebos.descHtml: As you wake up from cryo, you quickly realize that something's amiss on board the Erebos. It's up to you to figure it out and stay alive. Can you get all 6 endings?!
erebos.instHtml: Grab the game from here. Make sure you grab the Linux version and then put the erebos_linux.pck in the gamedata folder. https://steamknight.itch.io/erebos

escape.title: Escape
escape.descHtml: Escape is a fun puzzle game in the tradition of Adventures of Lolo or Chip's Challenge Unlike either of those games, Escape doesn't rely at all on reflexes—it's all about your brain.

estigma.title: ESTIGMA
estigma.descHtml: Classic 80's arcade ESTIGMA is back (and finally finished)! Estigma is a mix between Q-bert and Pacman!

eveofthedead.title: Evening of the Dead
eveofthedead.descHtml: Creepy monsters are terrorizing your cozy farm! Grab your gun and get rid of em'!
eveofthedead.instHtml: Download at itch.io and place data.win and options.ini into assets folder.

everpatch.title: Everpatch
everpatch.descHtml: A super cute and super short platformer where you must collect every coin in order to meet the next level. But beware, the path isn't a complete picnic.

evoland.title: Evoland Legendary Edition
evoland.descHtml: Evoland Legendary Edition contains both Evoland 1 and 2. Travel through the history of gaming as gameplay and graphics evolve from 2D to 3D across multiple genres.
evoland.instHtml:
The patcher will automatically patch the bytecode and compress textures on first launch. This takes about 10-30 minutes.

Steam Instructions

  • Open Steam console: steam://open/console
  • Copy and paste command: download_depot 1020470 1020471
  • Open the folder where this depot was downloaded and copy sdlboot.dat and all .pak files into the port's gamedata folder.

GOG Instructions

Place the GOG installer files (setup_evoland_legendary_edition_1.0_(57388).exe and .bin) into evoland/gamedata/.

exvitro.title: Ex Vitro
exvitro.descHtml: EX VITRO is a dark sci-fi 2D platformer where you delve into the ruins of a military research facility and discover the horrors within. Whether machine, creature, or something else entirely, you’ll face the violent legacy of the last survivors of humanity.
exvitro.instHtml: Download the game from Steam and copy all game files into the assets folder. At minimum, a H700 device is required, RK3566 and above recommended.

exactchinesechess.title: Exact Chinese Chess
exactchinesechess.descHtml: A controller-first Xiangqi / Chinese Chess port using a GPLv3-compatible rules engine and optional Pikafish AI.
exactchinesechess.instHtml:
Controls

D-pad: Move board cursor A: Select piece / move B: Cancel selection / close dropdown X: Undo Y: New game L1: Previous reviewed move R2: Next reviewed move Right stick: Move UI pointer R1: Click UI pointer Start: Cycle Main / Moves / Help panel Select / Back: Quit

AI Levels

Easy: Pikafish MultiPV 4, depth 1; sometimes chooses candidates 2–4 Medium: Pikafish MultiPV 4, depth 1; less often chooses candidates 2–4 Hard: Pikafish MultiPV 1, movetime 1200 ms

exhumed.title: Exhumed
exhumed.descHtml: A port of the PC version of Exhumed based on EDuke32.
exhumed.instHtml: You'll need to add your own full version STUFF.DAT, DEMO.VCR and BOOK.MOV files to the ports/Exhumed folder.

exilesquadron.title: Exile Squadron
exilesquadron.descHtml: Exile Squadron is an action-packed, sidescrolling shoot ‘em up, inspired by the classics of the genre. As part of an elite fighter group, you will be granted a huge variety of upgradeable weapons, which you can use to stop the invading Colonial forces. Destroy your enemies as fast as possible, collect points, and put your highscore on the online leaderboard.
exilesquadron.instHtml: Purchase the game on Steam or Itch.io and copy game files into the assets folder.

exult.title: Exult
exult.instHtml: You'll need A copy of the black gate and/or serpent isle added to ports/exult/data/blackgate and/or ports/exult/data/serpentisle.

eyecontact.title: Eye Contact
eyecontact.descHtml: The eyes reveal the world around you. Roll the eyes to see the world differently. Fill the sockets with the eyes looking outwards.

f-zeropocket.title: F-Zero Pocket
f-zeropocket.descHtml: Select one of the 30 most skillful drivers of all-time and boost your way to the top in F-Zero Pocket, a racing fan-game made as a tribute to both the GameBoy Color and the F-Zero series.

f1race.title: F1 Race
f1race.descHtml: F1 Race is a port of the F1 Race game from MTK OS.
f1race.instHtml: All game files are included and game is ready to play

f1spirit.title: F1 Spirit
f1spirit.descHtml: This is the unofficial remake of Konami's F-1 SPIRIT which was originally released in 1987 for the MSX home computer systems.

fade_to_black.title: F2bgl
fade_to_black.descHtml: A reimplementation of the Fade to Black game.
fade_to_black.instHtml: You will need the original files of the PC release or PC demo copied to the ports/f2bgl folder.

talumos.title: Fables of Talumos
talumos.descHtml: Fables of Talumos is a pixel-art adventure game set in the fantasy world of Talumos. The game has fast-paced and challenging combat, interesting characters, powerful weapons and items, and a unique fantasy setting.
talumos.instHtml: Purchase the game on Steam or Itch. For Steam version, copy all game files into the assets folder. For Itch version, download the zip with the game and extract all files into the assets folder.

faithdemonsiege.title: FAITH Demon Siege
faithdemonsiege.descHtml: Starting with nothing, you enter the grove and fend off demons. After each wave, a shop will open where you can upgrade your stats or buy items that modify your attacks and defense.

faiththeunholytrinity.title: FAITH: The Unholy Trinity
faiththeunholytrinity.descHtml: From the developer, Airdorf Games: "FAITH is a pixel horror game inspired by the era of classic 8-bit gaming and the Satan Scare of the 1980s. Use your holy crucifix to perform exorcisms, fight back against possessed cultists, and cleanse haunted objects. Discover a world of dread, isolation, and mystery as you explore haunted forests, abandoned churches, and the inner sanctums of a Satanic cult."
faiththeunholytrinity.instHtml: Purchase the game on Steam or GOG and add the game data to 'ports/faiththeunholytrinity/assets', important files are data.win, audiogroup1.dat through audiogroup18.dat, and UTconfigs.cvs files.

fallenleaf.title: Fallen Leaf
fallenleaf.descHtml: Take control of Leaf, an eager treasure hunter tasked with putting a stop to a repressive, merciless ruler reawakened by his own hand! Aided by newfound magical gauntlets, and an ever-growing list of extended relatives, he'll venture high and low through dark caves, deep oceans, dense city skylines, and even the clouds just to find that one special item with the power to vanquish evil!
fallenleaf.instHtml: Copy game into the assets folder. The game is available on Steam https://store.steampowered.com/app/1459010/Fallen_Leaf/

falling_time.title: Falling Time
falling_time.instHtml: Falling Time files are already included and ready to go.

fallout1.title: Fallout 1
fallout1.instHtml: You need to copy critter.dat, master.dat and data from the original game to ports/fallout1 folder.

fallout2.title: Fallout 2
fallout2.instHtml: You need to copy critter.dat, master.dat, patch000.dat and data from the original game to ports/fallout2 folder.

falseskies.title: False Skies
falseskies.descHtml: Create a party, layer on new classes, and uncover the mystery behind the seeming reappearance of a long-gone city in this classicly-styled RPG.
falseskies.instHtml: Purchase the game on itch.io or Steam. Copy the .rpg file to the falseskies folder. You can also play the demo version by following the same steps.

fanwor.title: Fanwor
fanwor.descHtml: A small top-down action-adventure in the style of The Legend of Zelda - explore the world of Fanwor, fight monsters with your sword, and recover the eight stolen Gems of Power.
fanwor.instHtml: Ready to run, no additional files needed.

fares.title: Fares
fares.descHtml: Join the blue haired treasure hunter Fares in the adventure of a lifetime in this retro inspired 16-bit platformer. Discover hidden treasures and artifacts as you travel through dangerous lands of a lost civilization. Can you complete Fares collection? See if you can in this colorful and cute adventure!
fares.instHtml: Purchase the game on Steam and copy all files into the assets folder.

farmkeeper.title: Farm Keeper
farmkeeper.descHtml: A tile-based farming game where success means maximizing yields to survive the rent, expanding your farm through random tile choices.
farmkeeper.instHtml: Purchase the game on Steam and copy the FarmKeeper.pck into gamedata folder. You can also use the free demo version.

farmner.title: Farmner
farmner.descHtml: single stick command included in the directory, rename and boot Your daughter has gone missing. You have followed footsteps next to a path to what seems to be an abandoned farmland. There are torches still glowing hot, where is everyone? Find your daughter, quickly!.
farmner.instHtml: The game files are already included and ready to go.

fatebreak.title: Fatebreak
fatebreak.descHtml: Fatebreak is a casual, fantasy-inspired card combat game of strategy and chance.
fatebreak.instHtml: Download the Fatebreak_v1.1_win_portable.zip from Itch.io and extract it into the assets folder.

feather.park.title: Feather Park
feather.park.descHtml: Explore an autumn park and play minigames. Make friends and enter the barn.

fell.title: Fell
fell.descHtml:
Fell is a short precision platformer about a kid who Fell down a hole. Play through 30 one-screen levels to get to the crown and then try to beat it backward!

The game features a toggleable speedrun timer and death counter!
fell.instHtml: Install port. Then download Fell.zip file from Itch, extract it and place files into the ports/fell/assets folder.

fheroes2.title: Fheroes 2
fheroes2.descHtml: fheroes2 is a recreation of the Heroes of Might and Magic II game engine
fheroes2.instHtml: Add your own data, maps, music, sound folders from HOMM2 GOG version to ports/fheroes2 folder. Folder names are case sensitive and should be lower case. Files inside folders should not be renamed.

fightorperish.title: Fight or Perish
fightorperish.descHtml: Fight or Perish is a dungeon crawling adventure for up to four players. Choose from four different characters. Pickup keys to unlock doors. Collect treasure to increase your score. Eat food to keep your health up. Use bombs to wipe of masses of enemies.

final_quest.title: Final Quest
final_quest.descHtml: Embark on an exciting journey in Final Quest: A Godot Research, a unique blend of a captivating 2D platform game and an in-depth research guide for the Godot game engine.

finding_paradise.title: Finding Paradise
finding_paradise.descHtml: Finding Paradise is an adventure game developed and published by Freebird Games. Serving as a sequel to To the Moon and A Bird Story, the story continues with doctors Eva Rosalene and Neil Watts as they help to fulfill a wish for Colin Reeds, who is now a bedridden old man.
finding_paradise.instHtml: If using the GOG Version place the finding_paradise_*.sh installer to the root of the finding_paradise folder or extract the contents of the data/noarch/game/ folder into finding_paradise/gamedata/

firebrimstone.title: Fire & Brimstone
firebrimstone.descHtml: Delve into the ruins of a temple in the guts of a volcano, in the search for a powerful artefact that may let you have friends. A unique and tight roguelike with a randomized skilltree and hand-designed monsters and items.
firebrimstone.instHtml: Download the MacOS version from Itch.io and extract the game files into gamedata folder.

fire_and_fondness2.title: Fire and Fondness 2
fire_and_fondness2.descHtml:
A puzzle game about rescuing your loved one from hazardous situations! Also, a send-up of daytime television.

Daytime television just got hot: in the hit gameshow, Fire & Fondness, young lovers put their relationships to the test in the ultimate courtship ritual: attempting to navigate a succession of convoluted, flamethrower-filled deathtraps.

It also has a dog.

firearrow.title: Fire Arrow Plus
firearrow.descHtml: Fire Arrow and Fire Arrow X are time attack (or 'Caravan', what used to be an important tradition in Japanese STGs in the 90s) style shooters with a heavy emphasis on scoring, also known as "coffee break shmups"
firearrow.instHtml: Purchase at Steam and copy the FA1 and FAX folders into the port folder (/ports/firearrow/). The itch.io version's two zip files can be copied directly into the port folder - v2.7.17 has been tested working. Additionally, you can copy the data.win and all .ogg files from each of these folders into the respective gamedata folders (/ports/firearrow/firearrow/gamedata/ & /ports/firearrow/firearrowx/gamedata/).

fireboy.title: Fire Boy
fireboy.descHtml: This is bob, Bob says you will like this game. Bob was captured by a group of scientists, Now he's trying to escape!

firemadness.title: Fire Madness
firemadness.descHtml: Top-down bullet hell shooter inspired by CrossFire (1981). Eliminate waves of enemy bots that grow tougher each time you destroy them, up to the occasional boss.
firemadness.instHtml: Move with the left stick/d-pad, fire in 4 directions with the right stick or the face buttons.

firework.title: FIREWORK
firework.descHtml: Follow Yan the Defective One through his fight against the Fire Troops and let him unveil the Facility's mystery in this action platformer.
firework.instHtml: Purchase the game on Steam and place game files into the assets folder.

fishfillets.title: Fish Fillets NG
fishfillets.descHtml: Fish Fillets is strictly a puzzle game. The goal in every of the seventy levels is always the same: find a safe way out. The fish utter witty remarks about their surroundings, the various inhabitants of their underwater realm quarrel among themselves or comment on the efforts of your fish. The whole game is accompanied by quiet, comforting music.

fistbump.title: Fist Bump
fistbump.descHtml: In this puzzle platformer, help the square and circle unite, so that they can fist bump! This game was made for the GeoJam by FartFish.

flare.title: Flare Engine
flare.descHtml: Flare is an open source, 2D action RPG. Its game play can be likened to the games in the Diablo series. The game files are already included and ready to go.

flaskoman.title: Flaskoman
flaskoman.descHtml: A puzzle platformer in a steampunk laboratory. Use mysterious liquids to activate lab mechanisms and your abilities.
flaskoman.instHtml: Purchase the game from Steam and copy the game files to the port gamedata directory.

flinthook.title: Flinthook
flinthook.descHtml: Live the life of space captain Flinthook! Armed with your mighty hookshot, your uncanny slow-motion powers and your trusty blasma pistol, plunder and fight your way through an infinite variety of randomly-assembled spaceships for treasure, loot and fame!
flinthook.instHtml:
1. Install portfiles.
  2. Buy the game on Steam
  3. Copy Flinthook.exe and all surrounding files to ports/flinthook/gamedata
  4. Run the port!

flipclock.title: Flip Clock
flipclock.descHtml: This is a flip clock simulator, which displays time on digit cards and flips them when time changes.

flipofdark.title: Flip of Dark
flipofdark.descHtml: A small precision platformer where you can instantly flip onto the ceiling and walls. You lost your slice of fruit, and have to get it back. Flip of Dark is a fangame for Flip of Light, by Leko.
flipofdark.instHtml: Download flipofdark.zip from itch.io and unzip the contents to ports/flipofdark/assets

flipoflight.title: Flip of Light
flipoflight.descHtml: Taking inspiration from platformers of the last decade, Flip of Light will test genre veterans with mind-bending, gravity-swapping challenges. Run, jump, and flip your way through a variety of vibrant stages, each themed around one chromatic color.
flipoflight.instHtml:
Purchase your game from Itch.io or Steam.

Download the latest version of the game and place all your game files in ports/flipoflight/assets.

flynnsoc.title: Flynn: Son of Crimson
flynnsoc.descHtml: The peaceful and beautiful island of Rosantica is under threat once more by a relentless evil. The magical barrier between Rosantica and The Scourge has started to crack, allowing dangerous creatures to slowly seep back in to try and take over the island. Flynn stumbles upon this invasion and discovers he must stand up against The Scourge to stop its spread into Rosantica. Accompanied by his mythical companion Dex, Guardian Spirit of the Land, Flynn will be challenged by the evil from The Scourge and its powerful overlord.
flynnsoc.instHtml: Purchase the game from GOG and copy all the game files into the ports/flynnsoc/assets.

flywrench.title: Flywrench
flywrench.descHtml: Flywrench is a frenetic action game from the makers of Nidhogg about piloting an aerobatic ship through the depths of space.
flywrench.instHtml:

There is a single player mode and a multiplayer mode via Split screen, LAN and Internet. The game features 100 levels and includes a level editor. (source: wikipedia)

galaxychampionstv.title: Galaxy Champions TV
galaxychampionstv.descHtml: A super-intense, top-down, closed-arena shooter game inspired by the classic arcade game Smash TV. Get powerful weapons and power-ups, kill huge amounts of enemies, level up, unlock upgrades, and beat all the bosses to become the champion of the most violent TV show of all time!
galaxychampionstv.instHtml: Purchase the game at Steam and download using download_depot 842750 842751 9184074893661984887, then copy the game files into the galaxychampionstv/gamedata folder.

galaxyforcesv2.title: Galaxy Forces 2
galaxyforcesv2.descHtml:
A great multiplayer game brought to you by Ronnie Hedlund. The source code is available here.

A 2D multiplayer space shooter, inspired by the Amiga classic Gravity Force. Play race, mission or dogfight. Single player, with friends or against AI. There are 50+ levels and a map-editor included.

Global hi-score and achievements with replays on the website.
galaxyforcesv2.instHtml:
Start the program

Multiple instances of the game may be started on the same machine for testing. The server (Server.exe) need only be run if you want a stand alone server. Firewall ports

TCP port 1999 needs to be forwarded in your firewall/router to be able to host games and have other players join you. Login as member

To use achievements and hiscores you need to create a user here. Then login as that user, or select cancel to just play directly. Connect to server

Enter the IP address or host name of a server and click "connect". You can enter 127.0.0.1 to connect to your own server. All games on that server will be shown. You can join green games. You can't join red games, they are full or already started. If no game is shown you have to create a new game. Join existing game

Enter your name and choose a green game from the list. Click "Join". Create new game

Enter your name, and the name of the game. Click "New". Start game

The player that created the game should set the level to play and make other settings before starting the game. This player will be the master. Others that have joined can only chat until the game starts.

The master can kick players by selecting a player and press delete. If the master leaves the game, mastership is transferred to another player.

gardenstory.title: Garden Story
