grizzland.instHtml: Purchase the game on Steam and copy game files into the assets folder.

growseedpinball.title: Grow,Seed!Pinball
growseedpinball.descHtml: Sid did not want to fall to the bottom. Help our little Sid friend growing up without getting burried! This is a pinball game developed by kNARF for the Ludum Dare 34 competition.

guacamelee.title: Guacamelee
guacamelee.descHtml: Guacamelee! Gold Edition is a Metroidvania-style action-platformer set in a magical Mexican-inspired world. The game draws its inspiration from traditional Mexican culture and folklore, and features many interesting and unique characters.
guacamelee.instHtml: Add your Humble Bundle Linux Guacamelee_DRMFREE.sh, or GOGs gog_guacamelee_gold_edition_2.0.0.3.sh to the guacamelee folder and run the game.

guardiansphere.title: Guardian Sphere
guardiansphere.descHtml: A fast-paced shoot 'em up where you spend your own life points as currency to buy upgrades. Strengthen your Guardian and repel waves of invaders in a story of energy-wielding defenders battling an alien threat.

gumgirlgb.title: GUM GIRL Gameboy Edition
gumgirlgb.descHtml: Use your bubble gum to create temporary platforms to solve puzzles and traverse through the cosmic Starbase. Defeat the treacherous drill in order to save your solar system.

gumchugirl.title: GUMCHU GIRL
gumchugirl.descHtml: Take on the role of Skye, a 10 yr old kid who lives for chewing and pew-pewing in this retro inspired platformer!

gumgem.title: Gumgem
gumgem.descHtml: Venture into a procedurally generated castle, different every time you play. The evil gummy bear has taken the prince prisoner, and you're our only hope!
gumgem.instHtml:
You can purchase Gumgem at: https://dazel.itch.io/gumgem

Download the GameShell version and extract it, and place the Gumgem.pck file in the gamedata directory. This has been tested with Gumgem 2.2 - GameShell

gungodz.title: GUN GODZ
gungodz.descHtml: GUN GODZ is a first person shooter about gun, gangster rap and the rich culture of Venus. Players try to escape the jail of a hotel, which is the only building on Venus and is owned by a record-label owner who happens to be the God of Guns.
gungodz.instHtml: This game is ready to run! Press R1/R2 to start the game at the splash screen, Use R Stick to control the cursor at the menu

gungungun.title: GUNGUNGUN
gungungun.descHtml: A frantic bullet filled 2D arcade arena shooter with an eye for (gun) details and a penchant for high body counts
gungungun.instHtml: Purchase the game from steam. Download the game and place the game files in ports/gungungun/assets.

gunpowder.title: Gunpowder on The Teeth: Arcade
gunpowder.descHtml: Mega hardcore! In this game you will receive damage first, and only then you will locate the enemy. The implementation of military operations in the classic mechanics of platformer.
gunpowder.instHtml: Purchase the game on Steam and copy all game files into the assets folder. You can also use the free demo. Devices with RK3326 CPU are not recommended due to frequent slowdowns.

gunroar.title: Gunroar
gunroar.instHtml: Make sure to start the game in standard mode!

gunsandguns.title: Guns and Guns
gunsandguns.descHtml: "Guns and Guns" is a personal project that originated during the GMTK jam as "Overgun," albeit with a temporary title placeholder. Departing from traditional shooting mechanics, this platformer adventure focuses on puzzle-solving with three distinct guns, each presenting its own set of challenges. Players navigate through intricately designed puzzles, exploring innovative twists on the platformer genre.

gyrobossdx.title: Gyro Boss DX
gyrobossdx.descHtml: Your home planet is under siege from a band of intergalactic pirates led by the fiendish Gyro Boss! Dodge an endless assault of weapons as you orbit around the boss on a fixed circle, it's not as easy as it looks. Can you secure bragging rights as the best space pilot to bite the dust against the alien menace?
gyrobossdx.instHtml: Purchase the game on Steam or Itch.io and place all game files into the assets folder.

habroxia.title: Habroxia
habroxia.descHtml: Blast your way through a myriad of extra-terrestrial incursions in this arcade-style scrolling shooter! Pilot the ship Habroxia through 15 levels featuring intense boss fights, rescue missions, shifting perspectives, and untold surprises.
habroxia.instHtml: Purchase the game on Steam and copy all game files into the assets folder.

habroxia2.title: Habroxia 2
habroxia2.descHtml: Blast off for a sequel that pushes every facet of 2D shoot'em ups to escape velocity! Habroxia 2 is a non-linear, old-school space shooter with upgrades, boss fights, and even New Game+, all wrapped in a retro package combining pixel graphics, chiptunes, and stellar gameplay.
habroxia2.instHtml: Purchase the game on Steam or Itch.io. For the Steam version, copy all files into the assets folder. for Itch release, download the DRM-free version and extract all files into the assets folder.

hackgrid.title: Hack Grid
hackgrid.descHtml: Hack Grid is a hacking-themed puzzle game and love letter to the retro charm of DOS gaming, both in visuals and audio! Dive back into the 80's and become a hacker!
hackgrid.instHtml: Purchase the game on Steam or Itch and copy the HackGrid.pck into the gamedata folder. The DLC folder goes directly into the hackgrid folder.

hakopalace.title: Hakopalace
hakopalace.descHtml: A tight boss rush that's challenging without being too brutal. The graphics have a sleek minimalist style with tons of little visual flairs.
hakopalace.instHtml: Download from https://nizakashii.itch.io/hakopalace extract and place data.win inside ports/hakopalace/gamedata

half-life.title: Half-Life
half-life.descHtml: Half-Life is Valve's debut title which blends blends action and adventure with award-winning technology to create a frighteningly realistic world where players must think to survive.
half-life.instHtml: You need to have your own copy of the game. You need to copy the steam valve directory from your steam installation into ports/Half-Life/valve directory. You can also run Half-Life Blue Shift/Opposing Forces by copying the contents of the bshift/gearbox steam files into their respective ports/Half-Life/ directory.

hallowe_en.title: Hallowe'en
hallowe_en.descHtml: The player controls a magician that must collect a number of green pumpkins from a series of platforms. The character can move left and right, and can jump over enemies. They are also able to shoot a magical bolt which can erode a hole in the platform's floor blocking enemies. The player must climb up a number of ladders, and must avoid enemies including: spiders, choppers, bolts, skulls, bolts, and duplicators.

hallowedcandy.title: Hallowed Candy
hallowedcandy.descHtml: An old-school arcade one-screen point-em-up. Emphasis is on skill and beating your friend's high score within a cute seasonal Halloween setting.
hallowedcandy.instHtml: Ready to run. Thanks to Project Level studios for creating this great game and kindly granting permission for PortMaster to distribute the game files.

halloween3d.title: Halloween 3D
halloween3d.descHtml: Halloween 3D is a free and open source game/engine first person shooter where you must battle spooky monsters and collect all the HALLOWEEN letters scattered throughout the levels.
halloween3d.instHtml:
Ready to run.

NOTE: PLAY ON EASY DIFFICULTY. The second arena is missing the second 'L' to finish spelling 'HALLOWEEN'. Higher difficulties require completing spelling 'HALLOWEEN' to win the stage. This currently makes it impossible to complete this stage on NORMAL or HARD.

halloweenforever.title: Halloween Forever
halloweenforever.descHtml: Something mysterious is happening in the pumpkin patch this Halloween! You control Pumpkin Man, a humanoid pumpkin thing animated by occult forces on a quest to discover why things are so creepy. And you vomit candy corn.
halloweenforever.instHtml: Purchase the game on itch.io, download the Halloween Forever - Modern Edition (2021) version, extract it, and copy the game files to the port's gamedata folder.

hammerwatch.title: Hammerwatch
hammerwatch.descHtml: Hammerwatch is a pixel-art hack-and-slash dungeon crawler where you battle through hordes of enemies, solve puzzles, and upgrade your character. It’s got a classic retro vibe, with different character classes, co-op gameplay, and tons of secrets to uncover. Think Gauntlet-style action with modern polish!
hammerwatch.instHtml: This port is compatible with the 1.3 Steam release of the game. Installing: - Open the Steam console and type in the following command to download the game files: download_depot 239070 239071 6038447391393479561 - Put the gamefiles (without any surrounding folders) into hammerwatch/gamefiles/

hargrave.title: Hargrave
hargrave.descHtml:
Hargrave is a retro sci-fi shooter-platformer set in a maze of rooms loaded with obstacles and guarded by strange robots.

Race to destroy the guardians and escape as quickly as possible, or explore the maze to find new powers and challenge the greater guardians that are sealed deep within.
hargrave.instHtml:
Claim the game from Steam.
Download using the Steam Console: download_depot 1288930 1288931 6282474293410899739
When the download is complete it will tell you the location of the game files.
Place all the game files in ports/hargrave/assets.

harmonist.title: Harmonist
harmonist.descHtml: Harmonist is a stealth coffee-break roguelike game. The game has a heavy focus on tactical positioning, light and noise mechanisms, making use of various terrain types and cones of view for monsters. Aiming for a replayable streamlined experience, the game avoids complex inventory management and character building, relying on items and player adaptability for character progression.

hatchwell.title: Hatchwell
hatchwell.descHtml: A top-down action RPG set in a day in a town called Hatchwell. Join the townspeople as they prepare for the Hatchwell Festival! A day celebrating the peace brought by a hero’s bravery a hundred years ago.
hatchwell.instHtml:
Purchase the game from Steam

Download the game and place the game files in ports/hatchwell/gamedata

hauntedlands.title: Haunted Lands
hauntedlands.descHtml: Slay grim cultists, infernal minions, and nightmarish creatures in this dark and bloody retro-inspired action platformer. Uncover secrets, acquire powerful artifacts, and face challenging bosses in the Haunted Lands.
hauntedlands.instHtml: Purchase the game on Steam and copy all game files into assets folder. Alternatively you can download the original Episode Alpha from Itch.io and place the Haunted_Lands_EA.exe into assets folder.

hauntedlandsburial.title: Haunted Lands Burial Grounds
hauntedlandsburial.descHtml: Dark and bloody retro inspired action platformer. Slay the grim cultists, the infernal minions and twisted nightmarish creatures that roam the Haunted Lands.
hauntedlandsburial.instHtml: Download at itch.io and copy Haunted Lands Burial Grounds 1.1.0.exe into gamedata folder.

hawkisland.title: Hawk Island
hawkisland.descHtml: Hawk Island is a short Metroidvania adventure originally created for the Who Killed HawkZombie? Gamejam, and dedicated to the streamer, HawkZombie. Developed by Lumi and Frostnoble.

heart.of.darkness.title: Heart of Darkness
heart.of.darkness.descHtml: Heart of Darkness using the hode reimplementation of the engine developed by Amazing Studio.
heart.of.darkness.instHtml: Just add your own Heart of Darkness game files to the ports/hode/gamedata folder.

hota.title: Heart Of The Alien Redux
hota.descHtml: Heart of the Alien is a cinematic platform game developed by Interplay Productions and was released by Virgin Interactive Entertainment in 1994.
hota.instHtml: Heart Of The Alien (U).iso and Heart Of The Alien (U) xx.ogg or Heart Of The Alien (U) xx.mp3 02-42 need to be placed in the data folder

hebihebi.title: Hebi Hebi
hebihebi.descHtml: Mean Bean Machine meets Snake in a mind-bending puzzle game!
hebihebi.instHtml: All files included and ready to run. Thanks to Taylor Ritenour for the fantastic game and permission to distribute the files.

heboris-sdl.title: Heboris C7-EX
heboris-sdl.descHtml: Heboris is a game developed in 2001 by Kenji Hosimoto, aka Hosiken. Many, but not all, of its behaviors bear a resemblance to Tetris The Absolute The Grand Master 2, the latest TGM series game at that point. The game was developed using YaneuraoGameScript 2000 (YGS2K), which is a scripting language and runtime environment created by Urao Yane.

heirloom.title: Heirloom
heirloom.descHtml: A small 2D platformer. Run, jump and avoid obstacles through 4 challenging levels. Explore a beautiful, hand-crafted pixel world. Meet captivating NPCs and reach the Old Summit to retrieve the family Heirloom.
heirloom.instHtml: Purchase the game on Steam or Itch.io and copy all files into the assets folder. You can also download the free demo from Steam.

hellfire.title: hellFIRE
hellfire.descHtml: In hellFIRE you play as the BESTEST THIEF EVER TO EXIST. Jump across a dangerous landscape and help him steal all the fire from Hell.

hellstarsquadron.title: HellStar Squadron
hellstarsquadron.descHtml: Purchase the game either on Steam or Itch.io and copy the exe file into assets folder.
hellstarsquadron.instHtml: Purchase the game either on Steam or Itch.io and copy the exe file into assets folder.

help.no.brake.title: HELP! NO BRAKE
help.no.brake.descHtml: Hey umm, your car won't brake anymore. So better clear all the levels to get it fixed I guess. Game files are already included and ready to go.

hernamewasfire.title: Her Name Was Fire
hernamewasfire.descHtml: A tarotpunk twin-stick roguelike where you progressively unlock spells and upgrades to defeat hordes of void creatures. Survive the 5 stages of grief and vanquish the Major Allegories.
hernamewasfire.instHtml: Purchase the game at itch.io or Steam. Download, extract (if .zip), and copy the HNWF.pck file to the hernamewasfire/gamedata folder.

heroes.title: Heroes
heroes.descHtml: Heroes is similar to the "Tron" and "Nibbles" games of yore, but includes many graphical improvements and new game features. In it, you must maneuver a small vehicle around a world and collect powerups while avoiding obstacles, your opponents' trails, and even your own trail.

hex-a-hop.title: Hex-A-Hop
hex-a-hop.descHtml: Hex-a-hop is a puzzle game in which a girl has to destroy green hexagons by stepping on them.
hex-a-hop.instHtml: Hex-a-Hop files are already included and ready to go.

hexa.title: HEXA
hexa.descHtml:
HEXA is a unique, quick to pick up, and super fun logic puzzle game based on everybody’s favorite polygon. Try for a high score in Arcade Mode, take on the dynamic Daily Run; or conquer dozens of unique challenges in Mission Mode! See if you can’t conquer the HEXAPLEX, wrangle those Power-ups, and maybe even become ruler of the universe along the way.

Give it a try... it's HEXA-good!
hexa.instHtml:
Buy HEXA on itch. Download the Universal zip file, unzip it and place 'HEXA.love' in ports/hexa

Enjoy!

hexen2.title: Hexen 2
hexen2.descHtml: Hexen II is a dark fantasy 1st-person shooter developed by Raven Software and published by id software. Portal of Praevus features new levels, new enemies and a new playable character class, The Demoness.
hexen2.instHtml: You must copy your Hexen 2 pak0.pak and pak1.pak files into hexen2/data1 and your pak3.pak into hexen2/portals and make sure they're lowercase. Thanks to sezero (Ozkan Sezer) for the HoT source port

hijinx.title: Hijinx
hijinx.descHtml: Hijinx is a platformer that incorporates the theme of "pick your poison" by having players pick from a set of handicaps for each level, with help from Carl, the bumbling tortoise.

hikoban.title: Hikoban
hikoban.descHtml: This is a short puzzle game with 15 levels and 5 bonus levels.
hikoban.instHtml: Download Hikoban.exe from itch.io Place Hikoban.exe in ports/hikoban

hocoslamfy.title: Hocoslamfy
hocoslamfy.descHtml: You are a small bee and you must fly to avoid the bamboo shoots.
hocoslamfy.instHtml: Hocoslamfy files are already included and ready to go.

hojiya.title: Hojiya
hojiya.descHtml: Hojiya is a 2D adventure platformer in a coastal fantasy world, where the daylight will be crucial for our plant boy protagonist. STORY: Nogaru and Iara are two brave siblings, will explore forest, jungles, and deserts; by collecting artifacts, challenging cunning creatures, and defeating perilous villains, will find their origins, in this emotive adventure throughout marvelous lands, to uncover the fate of a lost culture. Solve mysteries, help people to save their islands of the impending doom caused by the evil corporation Xiphos. FEATURES: A lot of Items to search,collect and trade! Various creatures and enemies and meet the people of this world
hojiya.instHtml: Get 'Hojiya.zip' from https://leafxel.itch.io/hojiya and once you've downloaded it, extract the zip file and copy everything into the assets folder.

holeyhell.title: Holey Hell
holeyhell.descHtml: Try to stay alive as you run and jump deeper and deeper into the Holey Hell.
holeyhell.instHtml: Download the Holey Hell.zip from Itch.io and copy it into the assets folder.

holonomy.title: Holonomy
holonomy.descHtml: Play as a pip on the surface of a die, using the effects of Holonomy to navigate a non-euclidean environment to find your spot.
holonomy.instHtml: Made in 48 hours for the 2022 GMTK Game Jam

holotzcastle.title: Holotz Castle
holotzcastle.descHtml: A great mystery is hidden beyond the walls of Holotz's Castle. Will you be able to help Ybelle and Ludar to escape alive from the castle? Test your dexterity with this tremendously exciting platform game!

holyshit.title: Holy Shit
holyshit.descHtml: Navigate through a maze of mischievous park mechanisms where dung balls are your key allies. Carefully plan the order of collection, movement routes, and merging timing to find the optimal solution in chaos.

honeyguardian.title: Honey Guardian
honeyguardian.descHtml: Short score-attack shmup in the caravan style.
honeyguardian.instHtml: Download the game from https://ioribranford.itch.io/honey-guardian and copy the .exe or .love file into the port (honeyguardian) folder.

hoopervania.title: Hoopervania
hoopervania.descHtml:
COUNT DRACULA CHALLENGES YOU... ARE YOU UP TO THE TASK?

Welcome to HooperVania, a free and non-profit French fan-game celebrating Castlevania, the French videomaker Hooper, his community and video games as a whole! Navigate through various stages using the famous Vampire Killer to defeat numerous enemies, large bosses and ultimately vanquish Dracula himself!

hopowl.title: Hop Owl
hopowl.descHtml: Hop Owl is a precision platformer featuring a little cute owl. Hop around obstacles while collecting ancient dust!

hotlinesanzu.title: Hotline Sanzu
hotlinesanzu.descHtml: An arcade shooter / immersive sim where you solve problems with guns, backstabs, and strategic use of vents. Perform hostile corporate takeovers, clean up criminal syndicates, and try to get out of your literal dead-end job at the japanese ministry of death and reincarnation.
hotlinesanzu.instHtml: Download the game from Itch.io and extract all game files into the assets folder.

hovertank3d.title: Hovertank 3D
hovertank3d.descHtml: In Hovertank you play mercenary Brick Sledge, hired to rescue people from cities targeted for nuclear strikes. Get in your Hovertank and get them before the missile hits.
hovertank3d.instHtml: Place the original dos game datafiles in the hovertank3d folder.

humming.out.title: Humming Out
humming.out.descHtml: A casual 2D pixel-art platformer with puzzle elements. You play as a small, fragile hummingbird navigating dark crystal caves filled with hostile creatures. Avoid obstacles and solve puzzles to escape the mysterious depths.
humming.out.instHtml:
You can purchase Humming Out at: https://mfproject.itch.io/hummin-out

Download the Linux version and extract it, and place the HumminOut.x86_64.pck file in the gamedata directory. This has been tested with the HumminOut_Linux.zip, Dec 04 2022 release.

hftsr.title: Hunt for the Shadow Rider
hftsr.descHtml: A rogue Shadow Rider has escaped to the year 2078. You are the only Hunter left who can take him down

hunters.title: Hunters
hunters.descHtml: Lead your down-on-their-luck salvage crew on your latest contract - the drifting derelict wreck of the Nirvana - and discover what secrets it might hold

hurrican.title: Hurrican
hurrican.instHtml: Just add the data and lang folders from here to the ports/hurrican folder or just launch Hurrican from the ports menu in Emulationstation and it will download the files and install them automatically.

hydra.castle.labyrinth.title: Hydra Castle Labyrinth
hydra.castle.labyrinth.descHtml: Hydra Castle Labyrinth is a platform game with some old school action. It's also reminiscent of games of the 16 bit era.

hylics.title: Hylics
hylics.descHtml: Hylics is a surrealistic stop-motion style JRPG game created by Mason Lindroth. It boasts unique claymation graphics, RPG battles, and "overuse of random text generation", spread across 2+ hours of content. It's praised for its abstract, uncanny art style, as well as its alien atmosphere.
hylics.instHtml:
Buy the game on Steam or itch.io

Download it and copy all the files from the game folder into the portfolder. If you bought the game on itch.io, just put the .exe file into the portfolder.

hyper.jump.title: hyper JUMP
hyper.jump.descHtml: Pick up the yellow orbs, dodge everything else.

hyperlightdrifter.title: Hyper Light Drifter
hyperlightdrifter.descHtml:
Echoes of a dark and violent past resonate throughout a savage land, steeped in treasure and blood. Hyper Light Drifter is an action adventure RPG in the vein of the best 16 bit classics, with modernized mechanics and designs on a much grander scale.

Note: Only the Steam version works!
Videos have been patched out as they are currently not compatible with gmloader.next.
1gb ram devices will crash occasionally due to running out of ram when transitioning between maps due to external textures!
Not recommended for 1gb ram devices with ArkOS as it will crash very frequently!
hyperlightdrifter.instHtml: Purchase the game from steam. Run steam console via Windows+R: Type: steam://open/console, download the game by typing: download_depot 257850 257851 2557763276340557312 in the console, when the download is complete, it will tell you the location of the folder, copy all folders and game files to /ports/hyperlightdrifter/assets

hyperoverlap2.title: Hyper Overlap 2: Turbo Edition
hyperoverlap2.descHtml: In the future year of 199X, the world was finally united in 7 grand cartridges. But one day, the [Glitch Wizard] decided to take it one step further! Play every game at once (not in a good way!) as you fight against the glitches and corruption.
hyperoverlap2.instHtml: Download the game from Itch.io and extract all files into the assets folder.

hyperprincesspitch.title: Hyper Princess Pitch
hyperprincesspitch.descHtml:
The good Mecha Santa plans to spread happiness and cheer all over the world. Princess Pitch, previously just a sidekick in Garden Gnome Carnage, sets out to put an end to those silly plans.

Hyper Princess Pitch is sort of a remake of DOS Operation: Carnage, keeping the fast-paced arcade action, short completion time, high replay value and cheesy characters. Whether you tire of games with moral choices, or you've ever wanted to be made of equal halves explosions and piledrivers, this is the game for you

hypercycles.title: Hypercycles
hypercycles.descHtml: A raycasting first-person shooter, ported from the 1995 DOS game Hypercycles.

hyperfight.title: Hyperfight
hyperfight.descHtml: HYPERFIGHT is a fighting game where every hit is lethal, and every win counts. You'll have to risk your points to gain access to your character's special and super moves, which can turn the tide of the game in a heartbeat. Designed to be easy to pick up and hard to master, so grab a friend, any friend!

igachahead.title: I Gacha Head
igachahead.descHtml: A puzzle game where the top of your head falls off when you walk into low platforms.
igachahead.instHtml: Ready to run. Thanks to Dylan Brown for permitting PortMaster to include the game files.

ichorous.title: Ichorous
ichorous.descHtml: A long-imprisoned God of Blood has made you their disciple. Kill their monstrosities still roaming the land and return the godly blood, Ichor, to restore your Patron to their full power. Master the Offerings of The Patron and combine them for crazy synergies and boosts!
ichorous.instHtml: Download the game (Ichorous.zip) from https://mattstov.itch.io/ichorousand place the data.win in ports/ichorous/gamedata

iconoclasts.title: Iconoclasts
iconoclasts.descHtml: A platformer that offers fun and wacky gameplay. Recommended only for 640x480 devices or better.
iconoclasts.instHtml: You must have a copy of Iconoclasts for Linux copied to the ports/iconoclasts/gamedata folder. Be sure the folder contains subfolders named 32, 64 and data.

icytower.title: Icy Tower
icytower.descHtml: Reach new heights by jumping from platform to platform in the Icy Tower game!

ioawn4t.title: If On A Winter's Night, Four Travelers
ioawn4t.descHtml: If On A Winter's Night, Four Travelers is a free narrative-driven point-and-click adventure that explores the stories of four different characters in a masked ball taking place on a train in the late 1920s.
ioawn4t.instHtml: Download the windows version of the game on Itch or Steam. Copy all assets, including the executable, into the gamedata folder.

iichantra_pear.title: iiChantra
iichantra_pear.descHtml: iiChantra is a cross-platform 2D-Action, «retro» in style but modern in gameplay.
iichantra_pear.instHtml: iiChantra files are already included and ready to go.

iii.title: iii
iii.descHtml: A little 'catroidvania' about a one-eyed cat leaving his comfort zone. Explore underground caverns, gain vision of other dimensions, help the inhabitants, and expand your horizons.
iii.instHtml: Download the game (free) on itch.io, extract it, and copy the game files to the port's gamedata folder.

ikemen.title: Ikemen
ikemen.descHtml: An open-source fighting game engine that supports M.U.G.E.N resources.
ikemen.instHtml:
Ready to run.

Use Ports -> IkemenGamepad to remap input. Use Ports -> IkemenDebug to debug

imagestriker.title: ImageStriker
imagestriker.descHtml: This game is a 2D vertical scrolling shooter. You can operate the fighter “Image Striker” to fire shots and destroy enemies in 6 stages.
imagestriker.instHtml: Download the game from Steam for free and copy game files into assets folder.

imagestriker2.title: ImageStriker2
imagestriker2.descHtml: ImageStriker2 is a vertical scroll Shoot 'em up made to pay homage to ImageFight, featuring 7 stages, Arcade Mode and 3 minutes score attack Caravan mode.
imagestriker2.instHtml: Download the game from Itch.io and copy the ImageStriker2.exe into the assets folder.

impostorfactory.title: Impostor Factory
impostorfactory.descHtml: A narrative-driven RPG Maker game from Freebird Games, continuing the story told in To the Moon and Finding Paradise.
impostorfactory.instHtml: Buy the game from your favorite store Steam / GOG and copy the gamedata of your game to impostorfactory/gamedata/. If using the GOG linux version, place the impostor_factory_*.sh installer at the root of the impostorfactory folder, or extract the contents of data/noarch/game/ into impostorfactory/gamedata/.

inertiablast.title: Inertia Blast
inertiablast.descHtml: The rebellion captured several warships but lack the energy pod to power the ships. You are part of a risky expedition to steal the energy pods. Defense systems will attempt to stop you. The energy pods are often stored in tunnels making them hard to retrieve. The massive weight of the pod increases the difficultly in getting out.
inertiablast.instHtml: Inertia Blast is a remake of an C64 game called Thrust.

inferna.title: Inferna
inferna.descHtml:
Originally made in 1 week for the 8x8 Game Jam!
Charge and burn your way through a labyrinthine complex as a ball of fire!

infested.title: Infested
infested.descHtml: A point-and-click game where you must find your way through an infested space ship. Discover a way to escape using the resources and environment around you.
infested.instHtml: Ready to run. Thanks to Grahf Metal for permitting PortMaster to include the game files.

infra_arcana.title: Infra Arcana
infra_arcana.descHtml: Infra Arcana is a Roguelike set in the early 20th century. The goal is to explore the lair of a dreaded cult called The Church of Starry Wisdom. Buried deep beneath their hallowed grounds lies an artefact called The Shining Trapezohedron - a window to all secrets of the universe. Your ultimate goal is to unearth this artefact.
infra_arcana.instHtml: All game files are included. The controls are rather complex, carefully study the instructions for the controls.

ink.title: INK
ink.descHtml:
INK is a fast-paced platformer about using colorful paint to uncover your surroundings. Defeat all enemies in the room and reach the goal! However, the terrain is invisible, so you need to discover the terrain by physically bumping into it, by performing a double jump or by, well, dying.

Note: Only tested with the Steam version!
ink.instHtml: Purchase the game on Steam. Copy INK.exe to ports/INK.

insaniquarium.title: Insaniquarium Deluxe
insaniquarium.descHtml:
Insaniquarium Deluxe (PopCap, 2004) running natively on aarch64.

Not an emulator: this is the WinFish decompilation of the game, ported from the original SexyAppFramework to PopLib, which replaces DirectDraw with SDL3. Module music is played with libopenmpt. The binary is native aarch64 and depends on no closed-source libraries.

The game is played entirely with the pointer, so the gamepad acts as a mouse: stick and d-pad move it, A left clicks, B right clicks, and L1/R1 slow it down for hitting coins and small fish. Options has an Auto Collect switch that puts every coin in the tank on the Y button, for anyone who would rather not wear out A.
insaniquarium.instHtml:
This port does NOT include the game. Copy the data, images, music, properties, sounds and fishsongs folders from your copy of Insaniquarium Deluxe (Steam) into ports/insaniquarium/.

Watch the letter case: Windows ignores it and Linux does not. If the game complains about an image that clearly exists, that is almost always why.

threecoins.title: Insert Three Coins
threecoins.descHtml:
Welcome, rookie. Get your three coins and try your best shot to beat all the arcade machines. This arcade have a single rule: You beat a machine, you get your coin back.

Do you have what it takes to be the arcade king?

interstatedrifter.title: Interstate Drifter 1999
interstatedrifter.descHtml: Drift between the states, collect bits, beat rivals and get a high score.
interstatedrifter.instHtml:
• Download the game for free on Steam or Itch
  • Right click game in steam library, browse local files.
  • Copy "Interstate Drifter 1999.exe" or "Interstate Drifter 1999 itch.exe" to roms/ports/interstatedrifter/assets

intothedeepweb.title: Into the Deep Web
intothedeepweb.descHtml: A short strategy game that mixes dice mechanics with auto-battler and deckbuilding elements, wrapped in retro-inspired art, and a playful Windows-93 vibe.

invaders.title: Invaders
invaders.descHtml: A memory accurate reimplementation of Space Invaders by loadzero.
invaders.instHtml: You'll need to provide your own invaders.e, invaders.f, invaders.g, and invaders.h files from a MAME_078 romset into the invaders/inv1 folder.

ionfury.title: Ion Fury
ionfury.descHtml: Ion Fury using the EDuke32 source port. Ion Fury is a prequel to Bombshell. Shelly "Bombshell" Harrison, a bomb disposal expert working for the Global Defense Force (GDF), returns as the game's protagonist, fighting against the cybernetic forces of Dr. Jadus Heskel. Note: This supports up to v1.10 of Ion Fury!
ionfury.instHtml: Requires early version of Ion Fury v1.10 or older. Purchase the game from Steam OR GOG Steam: Download/Install the game using the Steam Console by typing download_depot 562860 562861 189007903929408028, copy fury.def, fury.grp, and fury.grpinfo into ports/ionfury GOG: Download Version 1.10. Do this by first installing Ion Fury using GOG Galaxy, then go to More > Manage Installation > Configure > Uncheck auto-updates > Show more versions > Select Version 1.10. Copy fury.def, fury.grp, and fury.grpinfo into ports/ionfury. Ion Fury also works on lower-end devices such as with an RK3326 CPU, but with reduced performance.

ironferret.title: IRON FERRET
ironferret.descHtml: Iron Ferret Is a small game where you play as a ferret riding a tank. Ultimately it's one giant escort mission, but at least your escortee is much more tankier than you and can shoot bullets.

itcamefromtheforest.title: It Came from the Forest
itcamefromtheforest.descHtml: A 2D dungeon crawler inspired by old classics and made using similar techniques as back then. No 3D here, just simple 2D graphics painted back to front (Painter's Algorithm).

lonelyspace.title: It's Lonely Out in Space
lonelyspace.descHtml: A challenging yet atmospheric game where you precisely control a spaceship in zero-gravity. Move carefully, explore the area, find upgrades, and escape!

itta.title: ITTA
itta.descHtml:
ITTA is a bullet-hell adventure set in a world filled with monstrous bosses. When Itta wakes up and finds herself surrounded by her dead family, her only guide is a strange spirit that takes the form of the family cat who gifts her a glowing revolver for protection.

Note: Slowdowns occur during bossfights when there are many particles on the screen! Requires Twin Sticks!
itta.instHtml: Download the latest version of the game from Steam OR GOG Copy all the game files over to ports/itta/gamedata

izelsobservatory.title: Izel's Observatory
izelsobservatory.descHtml: You are Izel, and your passion is studying the stars. But your discoveries threaten the power of the high priests. They destroy your research and sentence you to execution. Escape from jail and take up your spear -- fight your way through underwater caverns, coral reefs, a nest of electric eels, a sunken ship and more. Collect upgrades and abilities to open new paths and find your way home.

jaggedalliance2.title: Jagged Alliance 2
jaggedalliance2.descHtml: Jagged Alliance 2 is strategy game where you lead a group of mercenaries on the island state of Arulco, against the army of the evil Queen Deirdranna.
jaggedalliance2.instHtml: You must have an updated copy of the original Jagged Alliance 2 game files. Copy the retail game's data into the ports/jaggedalliance2/game folder. The GOG version of the game is also supported. Download the installer from GOG (https://www.gog.com/en/game/jagged_alliance_2), place it into the ports/jaggedalliance2 folder, and it will install the game files as required.

jazz2.title: Jazz2 Resurrection
jazz2.descHtml:
"Jazz² Resurrection" is a reimplementation of "Jazz Jackrabbit 2", a superb 2D platformer released in 1998 by Epic Megagames as a sequel to the shareware classic "Jazz Jackrabbit" (also available on PortMaster).

Supports various versions of the game (Jazz Jackrabbit 2 (v1.20/1.23), as well as Shareware Demo, Holiday Hare '98, The Secret Files, and Christmas Chronicles).
jazz2.instHtml:
Do I need the original Jazz Jackrabbit 2 game?

Yes, this project uses assets from the original game. Jazz Jackrabbit 2 game files must be copied into the ports/jazz2/Source/ directory.

Which versions of Jazz Jackrabbit 2 are supported?

The Following versions of the original game can be used: * Jazz Jackrabbit 2: Shareware Demo * Jazz Jackrabbit 2 (v1.20/1.23) * Jazz Jackrabbit 2: Holiday Hare '98 * Jazz Jackrabbit 2: The Secret Files * Jazz Jackrabbit 2: Christmas Chronicles

Only the versions listed in bold are required for a complete collection. When importing multiple versions into Jazz² Resurrection, copy each game's files into ports/jazz2/Source/—in the order listed above—replacing all files each time.

Some releases of The Secret Files contain an extra xmas1.j2l file which shouldn't be there. This file breaks The Christmas Chronicles. To fix this issue, either do not copy the file, or, replace it with the version of the file from The Christmas Chronicles. Holiday Hare '98 and The Christmas Chronicles are nearly identical, except that The Christmas Chronicles also contains Lori as playable character, so it is the preferred version. The Secret Files Demo is not supported, only the original Shareware Demo is.

jestershelper.title: Jester's Helper
jestershelper.descHtml: Collect all of the cherries before the executioners catch you.

jetlancer.title: Jet Lancer
jetlancer.descHtml:
Jet Lancer is a high-velocity aerial combat shooter where you duel enemy aviators, hunt giant robots, and defy death at supersonic speeds as you evolve from an unknown rookie aviator into a once-in-a-generation ACE pilot.

Note: This is version 1.0.17! ArkOS 1gb devices may crash because of running out of ram!
jetlancer.instHtml: Purchase the game from Steam OR GOG. Steam: Download the latest version of the game or use steam console and type download_depot 913060 913061 5560224757383287130, copy over all the game file to ports/jetlancer/assets GOG: Download Version 1.0.17. Do this by going to More > Manage Installation > Configure > Uncheck auto-updates > Show more versions > Select Version 1.0.17. Copy over all the game file to ports/jetlancer/assets

jetsetwilly.title: Jet Set Willy
jetsetwilly.descHtml: Jet Set Willy is a flip-screen platform game in which the player moves the protagonist, Willy, from room to room in his mansion collecting objects. Unlike the screen-by-screen style of its prequel, the player can explore the mansion at will. Willy is controlled using only left, right and jump.

jimmyslostfruits.title: Jimmy's Lost Fruits Journey
jimmyslostfruits.descHtml: Welcome to Jimmy's Lost Fruits Journey! It's a game inspired by NES classics, such as Super Mario Bros., Mega Man 2 and Ice Climbers. It's about a young boy named Jimmy, who wants to save his own lands from starvation. Dr. Vegg has lost in the food contest, and is now trying to get rid of every single possible fruit tree in the fruit plains in order to prevent the citizens of the said place from winning in the contest ever again. Can you prevent Dr. Vegg's evil plans and return the peace once and for all? Find out in Jimmy's Lost Fruits Journey!

jubilee.title: Jubilee
jubilee.descHtml: Challenging precision platformer based on tight, fluid movement. Open map layout with multiple routes. Collect gems and save animals.
jubilee.instHtml: Purchase the game from steam. Download the game and place all the game files in ports/jubilee/assets

jugglrx.title: JUGGLRX
jugglrx.descHtml: JUGGLRX and is about juggling as many balls as possible without dying!
jugglrx.instHtml: Download the game https://a327ex.itch.io/jugglrx-prototype and place exe file to the port folder.

jumpnbump.title: Jump n Bump
jumpnbump.descHtml:
This is a game for the whole family. You play cute fluffy little bunnies and hop on each other's heads.

At the beginning you are in the menu, where you have to let each active player jump over the tree trunk to enter the play area, and then walk to the right. You will then enter the arena. The aim is to jump on the other bunnies' heads.

https://github.com/fabiangreffrath/jumpnbump
jumpnbump.instHtml:
Up to Jump and left and right.

Single player use D PAD and Sticks.

Network play see startup screen

jumpoffthebridge.title: Jump Off The Bridge
jumpoffthebridge.descHtml: Jump Off The Bridge is a platformer with an emphasis on difficulty and unique level design. Each level, the player is required to jump off the bridge, but dying in any other sense, is failure. You may encounter characters that require items, methodical puzzle levels, intensely difficult platforming, tough levels that test your reaction time, and even bosses. Jump Off The Bridge is a meticulously crafted world that avoids the overuse of previously introduced sprites and characters. Every level feels unique, and is memorable.
jumpoffthebridge.instHtml: Purchase the game from steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1057780/Jump_Off_The_Bridge/ Download the game and from your Steam library, right click on Jump Off The Bridge > Manage > Browse local files. Copy the data.win, audiogroup2.dat and audiogroup3.dat from the assets folder to /ports/jumpoffthebridge/gamedata

jumponhead.title: Jump on Head
jumponhead.descHtml: A platform fighter with one goal: JUMP ON HEAD. Casuals and pros alike can enjoy its fast-paced, responsive gameplay. Play against a friend (local multiplayer only) on six diverse stages, and try to be the last player standing!
jumponhead.instHtml: Purchase the game on itch.io, download the JUMP ON HEAD.exe version and copy this file to the port's gamedata folder.

justanotherpong.title: Just Another Pong
justanotherpong.descHtml: It's just another pong game. Play alone or with a friend, each holding one side of your handheld!

justkissheralready.title: Just Kiss her Already
justkissheralready.descHtml: Just Kiss Her Already! is a fluffy girls love story about Nanala (from Just Kiss Him Already!) attempting to get a girlfriend

justkisshimalready.title: Just Kiss Him Already
justkisshimalready.descHtml: Just Kiss Him Already! is a fluffy high school boys love story about two idiots who need a gentle push in the right direction to get together- and you're here to help with that!

juurru.title: Juurru
juurru.descHtml: Travel through the roots of ancient flora. 24 tiny caves to solve, and many many roots to grow!

jvgs.title: JVGS
jvgs.descHtml: A retro-styled 2D puzzle platform game with nods to xkcd

kaijubigbattel.title: Kaiju Big Battel: Fighto Fantasy
kaijubigbattel.descHtml: Giant monster mayhem! The evil Dr. Cube has used a forbidden weapon to tear apart time and space. It's up to the Kaiju Big Battel Heroes to travel through time and set things right!
kaijubigbattel.instHtml: Purchase the game from https://super-walrus-games.itch.io/kaiju-big-battel-fighto-fantasy and download the Windows version (Linux should work fine, and probably the Steam versions too). Copy the game file named kaiju.rpg to the port directory. Alternatively, you could play the DEMO version (also on the itch page) -- but using the file named kaijudemo.rpg

kaima.title: Kaima
kaima.descHtml: KAIMA is the story of a planet being eaten away by monsters, and a girl determined to survive.
kaima.instHtml:
Download the game from Itch, https://nomnomnami.itch.io/kaima tested with Windows version. Copy all assets to the gamedata folder.

Note: This game is not ideal for devices with low resolution displays.

kanon.title: Kanon
kanon.descHtml: Kanon is a visual novel that follows Yuichi Aizawa's return to a town where he reconnects with childhood friends and encounters new ones, each with hidden pasts and supernatural ties. As Yuichi unravels their stories, themes of love, forgiveness, and second chances intertwine in this emotionally charged narrative.

kemonorogue.title: Kemono Rogue
kemonorogue.descHtml:
Based on a Japanese Anime, KemonoRogue is a fun map adventure game!

Move your character through each level of the map, attacking foes and collecting coins on the way.

kenslabyrinth.title: Ken's Labyrinth
kenslabyrinth.descHtml: Ken's Labyrinth is a first-person shooter for MS-DOS published in 1993 by Epic MegaGames. It was programmed by Ken Silverman, who later designed the Build engine used for rendering in 3D Realms's Duke Nukem 3D (1996). Ken's Labyrinth is about an ordinary man, heavily implied to be Ken Silverman himself, who wakes up one night to discover that his dog has been kidnapped by aliens. He tags along on their ship and ends up on their homeworld, where he must defeat the murderous creatures and rescue his beloved pet.

khimera.title: Khimera: Destroy All Monster Girls
khimera.descHtml: Khimera: Destroy All Monster Girls is your premiere monster girl beat-em-up platformer experience! Use Suits & Sandals' patented (not actually patented) GIANT STONE FIST technology to punch your way through hordes of monster-pirates to reclaim your home's stolen treasure.

kingofmachines.title: King of Machines
kingofmachines.descHtml: King of Machines is a mecha-themed side-scrolling beat 'em up, in a world where powered exo-suits are commonplace, and also the weapon of choice in a violent uprising. Inspired by classic beat 'em ups like TMNT and Armored Warriors, as well as modern character action games.

kleebuucravesfruitsalad.title: Kleebuu Craves Fruit Salad
kleebuucravesfruitsalad.descHtml: Eat fruit, jump around, and escape the nightmares!
kleebuucravesfruitsalad.instHtml: Ready to run. Thanks to Dylan Brown for permitting PortMaster to include the game files.

klorets.title: Klorets
klorets.descHtml: Simple bullet hell shooter from the creator of Magic Vigilante
klorets.instHtml: Download game from https://nizakashii.itch.io/klorets , copy data.win to /ports/klorets/gamedata

kobodeluxe.title: Kobo Deluxe
kobodeluxe.descHtml: Kobo Deluxe is an enhanced version of Akira Higuchi's game XKobo for Un*x systems with X11. Kobo Deluxe adds sound, smoother animation, high resolution support, OpenGL acceleration (optional), an intuitive menu driven user interface, joystick support and other features.
kobodeluxe.instHtml: All files are included and game is ready to play.

koboldkastilla.title: Kobold Kastilla
koboldkastilla.descHtml: Inspired by La-Mulana, L'Abbaye des Morts and ZX Spectrum games in general, you'll be exploring and learning the history of an abandoned observatory while collecting items to further your progress and solving some puzzles.

koboo.title: Koboo: The Tree Spirit
koboo.descHtml: Koboo is a fast paced action rogue-lite platformer where you battle against towering hunters as a small tree spirit by attacking their weak points. Forge powerful synergies, explore the Ancient Forest's branching paths, fish, catch bugs and garden to rebuild your home!
koboo.instHtml: Purchase the game on Steam and copy all game files into the assets folder. This game requires a device with 2GB RAM.

kor.title: Kor
kor.descHtml: Kor is a retro RPG with a variety of eccentric characters, goofy dialog, and turn-based combat where - in addition to strategizing - players must skillfully execute button combos in order to make attacks!
kor.instHtml: Purchase the game on Steam and copy game files into assets folder.

koreader.title: KOReader
koreader.descHtml: KOReader is a super flexible reading app that lets you enjoy ebooks, PDFs, and more just the way you like. With features like custom fonts, easy zooming, and built-in dictionaries, it makes reading comfy and fun. Great for book lovers who wants to read on a Handheld📚💫
koreader.instHtml: Add yours books to the ports/koreader/books folder

kudamonomerge.title: Kudamono Merge
kudamonomerge.descHtml: Kudamono Merge is a retro-style puzzle game made with Pyxel. Drop and merge identical fruits to evolve them into bigger ones. Keep stacking and aim for a high score! Inspired by Suika Game, but with a classic 8-bit twist.
kudamonomerge.instHtml: Download the game at https://takeshic.itch.io/kudamono-merge, and place the KudamonoMerge.pyxapp file in the kudamonomerge/gamedata folder.

kuklomenos.title: Kuklomenos
kuklomenos.descHtml: An abstract shoot-em-up. Minimalistic graphics, short game-length. Gameplay lies somewhere between Centipede and Starship Command. Very challenging at the higher difficulty levels. Can you make Elite?

abbayedesmorts.title: L'Abbaye des Morts
abbayedesmorts.descHtml:
The plot is set in 13th century. The player takes a role of Jean Raymond – one of clerics who preached about the poverty of Christ and a life without material aspirations, and who were for this reason treated as heretics by the Catholic Church.

Jean is running away from crusaders who want him dead. He finds an old church and decides to hide there. He doesn't know what ancient evils hide in that place.

la-mulana.title: La-Mulana
la-mulana.descHtml: La-Mulana is an 'Archaeological Ruin Exploration Action Game' in the vein of classic MSX platformers. As a daring archaeologist you venture inside the ancient ruins of the Mayan city La-Mulana, seeking out the Secret Treasure of Life. Apart from the plethora of traps lying in wait to stop intruders, there are also monsters on the prowl, protecting the ruins. Head for the innermost depths of the ruins while solving a variety of mysteries, fending off monsters, and disarming traps.
la-mulana.instHtml: Buy the game on gog.com, download the offline Linux installer (gog_la_mulana_2.0.0.1.sh), and copy it to ports/la-mulana/gamedata. When you launch the game for the first time, there will be a short delay while the files are automatically extracted.

labremnants.title: Lab Remnants
labremnants.descHtml: Lab Remnants is a monochromatic roguelike full of secrets and challenges. Play as an artificially made creature and make your way through your own creators to escape from their crazy experiments. Explore dungeons, labs, forests, and many other locations to collect as many coins and power-ups as you can. Unlock new characters and upgrade them to defeat even the strongest of bosses.
labremnants.instHtml: Purchase the game from steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1953020/Lab_Remnants/ Download the game and from your Steam library, right click on Lab Remnants > Manage > Browse local files. Copy the LabRemnants.pck from the assets folder to /ports/labremnants/gamedata

labyrinthoflegendaryloot.title: Labyrinth of Legendary Loot
labyrinthoflegendaryloot.descHtml: Labyrinth of Legendary Loot is a simple turn-based roguelike dungeon crawler focused on tactical combat. Every room is almost like a puzzle as you try to figure out the best way to defeat all enemies without taking too much damage.

lasagnaboyclassic.title: Lasagna Boy Classic
lasagnaboyclassic.descHtml: A puzzle horror game with a gameboy aesthetic.

laserkombat.title: Laser Kombat
laserkombat.descHtml: Laser Kombat is a classic puzzle game, now available for modern systems. Destroy all the tanks to beat the level. Stay out of line of sight, though, or you will get shot. Shoot your lasers at mirrors, blow up bomb or push your enemies into water with movable blocks to win.
laserkombat.instHtml: All files are included and game is ready to play

lastmission.title: Last Mission
lastmission.descHtml: The Last Mission is a side-view arcade game without scrolling (viewpoint moves from screen to screen) with map of big dimensions. The game takes its inspiration from games such as Underwurlde and Starquake.

lastscenario.title: Last Scenario
lastscenario.descHtml:
Hilbert, a boy who lives in the small town of Whitelake, considers himself the town's hero, much to the disbelief of most of its residents. After doing some "heroic" tasks around town he meets a mysterious woman named Zawu, who informs him that he is in the lineage of the mighty demon slayer Alexander and is destined to follow in his footsteps. This knowledge inspires Hilbert to go out into the world and fulfill his destined fate.

Last Scenario is an RPG with turn-based battles. The party for battles can contain up to four members. Other than physically attacking and using items in battles, players can also use magic in the form of Spellcards.

There is also a minigame called Hex that can be played against certain people throughout the world. Hex is a card battle type game played on a hexagonal grid.
lastscenario.instHtml: Download Last Scenario from https://site.scfworks.com/?page_id=8 and extract its contents (Game.rgssad, Audio, etc.) into the port's game folder, then launch.

lawnbusterforhire.title: Lawn Buster for Hire
lawnbusterforhire.descHtml: Play as Lawn Buster and trim the grass in randomly generated lawn levels, following an increasingly complex series of rules and priorities.
lawnbusterforhire.instHtml: You can purchase Lawn Buster for Hire at: https://turdboomerang.itch.io/lawn-buster-for-hire. Download the Lawn Buster for Hire.zip and extract it, and place the Lawn Buster for Hire.exe file in the gamedata directory. This has been tested with the Lawn Buster for Hire.zip, Mar 01, 2022 release.

lbreakouthd.title: LBreakoutHD
lbreakouthd.descHtml: LBreakoutHD is a scaleable 16:9 remake of LBreakout2. You try to clear levels full of different types of bricks and extras by using your paddle to aim balls at the bricks.
lbreakouthd.instHtml: All files are included and game is ready to play.

leadhaul.title: Lead Haul
leadhaul.descHtml: Lead Haul is a short old-school first person shooter with an emphasis on powerful weapons and a sprinkling of secret hunting
leadhaul.instHtml: This game is ready to run! In the Menu, Use R-stick to move the cursor and press R1 / R2 to select the button.

leapyear.title: Leap Year
leapyear.descHtml: Leap Year is a clumsy platformer about knowledge and discovery. Explore a compact, hand drawn world filled with hidden paths. Understand the game’s secrets to reach new areas and collect all the pages of your calendar.
leapyear.instHtml: Purchase and download the game from Itch Locate your gamefolder and copy all the files from the folder to leapyear/assets/

leapyearmarch.title: Leap Year: March
leapyearmarch.descHtml: Continues the adventure for players who have beaten Leap Year and want an even greater challenge. Use the same tools you learned to explore another hand-drawn world that's both larger and much more complex. Master your understanding of the game's secrets to complete another month of your calendar.
leapyearmarch.instHtml: Purchase and download the game from itch.io, extract, and copy game files to leapyearmarch/assets. For less powerful devices (like RK3326), rename data.win to data_potato.win

leftdeadspace.title: Left Among Dead In Space
leftdeadspace.descHtml: You are the last survivor on a space ship invaded by a mysterious alien life-form that has taken over the dead corpses of fellow spacemen... All your surviving comrades have escaped via escape pods, leaving you behind. The only hope is to fight the aliens head on...

legbreaker.title: Legbreaker
legbreaker.descHtml: A puzzle-platformer where you can only jump twice.
legbreaker.instHtml: You can download Legbreaker for free at: https://almbkn.itch.io/legbreaker -- grab the Legbreaker_Win.zip version and extract it. Among the extracted files, there's a file named Legbreaker.pck; copy this into the port's gamedata directory.

lierolibre.title: LieroLibre
lierolibre.descHtml: Liero is a simple game. Pick your five weapons, and unleash your inner fury.

liltanks.title: Lil Tanks
liltanks.descHtml: A side scrolling shmup where you are a prototype tank, defending humanity from the onslaught of alien lifeforms.
liltanks.instHtml: Purchase on Steam from Lead Money Games Locate data.win file and place it into the gamedata folder.

limbo.title: Limbo
limbo.descHtml: Monochrome puzzle-platformer from Playdead. A boy wakes alone in a forest and must solve his way through it and a derelict, industrial world beyond, guided by nothing but silhouette, shadow and atmosphere. No dialogue, no HUD, just physics puzzles, traps, and a signature grain-and-fog visual style.
limbo.instHtml:
• Purchase Limbo (Mobile) on the Epic Games Store (Play Store version WILL NOT work!) and install it on an Android device.
  • Extract the installed APK (single APK, no split install — any APK extractor or adb pull works).
  • Use 7zip to unzip the .apk file.
  • Copy the whole assets/ and lib/ folders into ports/limbo/.
  • Run Limbo.

linegame.title: Line game
linegame.descHtml: An on-rails bullet hell. Weave past bullets and fill containers through 3 worlds.
linegame.instHtml: Install port zip. Download LineGameWINDOWS.zip file from the Itch. Extract zip into the ports/linegame/assets folder.

lineoff.title: Lineoff
lineoff.descHtml: "clean the dangerous line machine from ancient dust! ✿ unlockable colour palettes ✿"

linovictus.title: Linovictus: Portable Edition
linovictus.descHtml: Linovictus is a twin stick arcade shootemup where you play the role of Linovictus: An immune response of the second manifold. Autonomous beings from another world are infiltrating your domain to strip mine resources, threatening the stability of every higher dimension.

lisathebashful.title: LISA: The Bashful
lisathebashful.descHtml: Lisa the Bashful is a Fangame set in the lisa universe made by DoYouSellVHS
lisathebashful.instHtml:
download the game from gamejolt,https://gamejolt.com/games/Lisathebashful/430290 tested with Windows version. Copy all assets to the gamedata folder.

Note: This game is not ideal for devices with low resolution displays and/or absent joysticks.

lisathehopeful.title: LISA: The Hopeful
lisathehopeful.descHtml: Lisa The Hopeful is a fan game set in the Lisa universe
lisathehopeful.instHtml:
download the game from itchio, https://taco-salad.itch.io/lisa-the-hopeful tested with Windows version. Copy all assetsto the gamedata folder.

Note: This game is not ideal for devices with low resolution displays and/or absent joysticks.

lisathejoyful.title: LISA: The Joyful
lisathejoyful.descHtml: LISA: The Joyful is the soul-twisting conclusion to the quirky side-scrolling RPG series, LISA. Explore Olathe in your quest to punish the world that has treated you wrong. Along the way, learn about this strange land, your family, and the monsters/men in power. The world’s out to get you… now, get it back.
lisathejoyful.instHtml:
Purchase and download the game from Steam, tested with Windows version. Go the LISA steam directory. Copy all assets within the ''Lisa The Joyful'' folder to the gamedata folder.

Note: This game is not ideal for devices with low resolution displays and/or absent joysticks.

lisathepainful.title: LISA: The Painful
lisathepainful.descHtml: LISA: The Painful is the miserable, hilarious RPG of your wildest nightmares. Undertake a relentless journey through the post-apocalyptic wasteland of Olathe. Beneath its charming exterior is a world full of disgust and moral desolation, where you will learn what kind of person you are by being FORCED to make choices that permanently affect the gameplay. Make sacrifices to keep your party members alive, whether it's taking a beating for them, losing limbs, or some other inhuman torture. In this world, you will learn that being selfish and heartless is the only way to survive...
lisathepainful.instHtml:
Purchase and download the game from Steam, tested with Windows version. Copy all assets except the ''definitive'' folder to the gamedata folder.

Note: This game is not ideal for devices with low resolution displays and/or absent joysticks.

lisathepointless.title: LISA: The Pointless
lisathepointless.descHtml: Lisa the pointless is a Fangame set in the lisa universe made by EdvinasKandrotas
lisathepointless.instHtml:
download the game from gamejolt,https://gamejolt.com/games/lisa-the-pointless/221705 tested with Windows version. Copy all assetsto the gamedata folder.

Note: This game is not ideal for devices with low resolution displays and/or absent joysticks.

lisathetimeless.title: LISA: The Timeless

littlebusters.title: Little Busters!
littlebusters.descHtml: 'Little Busters!' follows Riki Naoe and his group of childhood friends, the titular Little Busters, as they form a baseball team and navigate through various personal struggles and mysteries. As the story unfolds, Riki uncovers deeper secrets about his friends and the world around him, leading to poignant revelations and emotional growth for the characters.

littlefroggame.title: Little Frog Game
littlefroggame.descHtml: A little game, about a little frog! Jump around through three varied stages to collect flies and beetles, while avoiding enemies and hazards along the way!
littlefroggame.instHtml: You can download Little Frog Game for free at: https://jamphibious.itch.io/little-frog-game. Download the Little Frog Game (Linux - FrogCon Update).zip version and extract it, and place the Little Frog Game.pck file in the gamedata directory.

littlerunmo.title: Little Runmo
littlerunmo.descHtml:
Little Runmo - The Game, is a 2D platformer game originating from an animated Youtube film called "Little Runmo" made by the creator Gooseworx. The Story revolves around a fictional videogame character trying to survive with his last life.

The gameplay of Little Runmo - The Game, is based on the video but also takes inspiration from the Super Mario games. For fans that come from the animation, the game is not a 1 to 1 replica of the animated film. I am not trying to make this a hardcore Meatboy-type game, I want to introduce challenging moments but I will try to make the difficulty curve as smooth as possible.

The early game will be pretty chill, just imagine how the Mario games were designed, then newer harder mechanics get slowly introduced. Big inspirations again were Mario World and Super Mario Bros Wii and also a fan-game called Mario 63.

littlegptracker.title: LittleGPTracker
littlegptracker.descHtml: LittleGPTracker (a.k.a 'The piggy') is a music tracker optimised to run on portable game consoles.

lividmeadow.title: Livid Meadow
lividmeadow.descHtml: A short, story driven action platformer. Explore the forsaken city and reveal its mysteries.
lividmeadow.instHtml: Game files are included and ready to run. Thanks, NoEye-Soft!

lizandlaz.title: Liz & Laz
lizandlaz.descHtml: A freak accident scatters the control cubes, and Liz and Laz must team up to recover them! Liz must use a life-sized game controller, jumping on buttons to guide Laz safely through a hazardous landscape to collect the cubes.
lizandlaz.instHtml: Purchase the game at itch.io. Extract the .zip, and copy the game files to this port's gamedata folder.

locust.title: LOCUST USA
locust.descHtml: Horror-Mystery-Exploration-Brick-Breaking with BOSS FIGHTS and 80s REFERENCES - fight a malevolent supercomputer, scour a dead guy's house for clues, collect keycards, banish a basement demon! From the master of breakout games Harley Wilson aka CURSED BOOTLEG INC. at https://hwilson.itch.io/locustusa2

lode.title: Lode
lode.descHtml: Explore by using the strange technology scattered throughout the world to change the way gravity affects you and your surroundings. Traverse every surface within reach, or use the room's gravity to move objects around. Features 64 x 64 pixel resolution and original chip tune sounds and music.
lode.instHtml: Download game from https://fabledforgegames.itch.io/lode, place data.win in /ports/lode/gamedata

loguploader.title: LOG Uploader
loguploader.descHtml: This tool is for uploading your logs from a broken game to easily get support on the Portmaster Discord
loguploader.instHtml: Open the Tool, select your Broken game and either send the Link that you will see or make a picture of it. If you dont get a Link grab the logs.zip from the ports/loguploader/ folder

loopcat.title: Loop Cat
loopcat.descHtml: Get ready for an epic adventure with the brave Loop Cat! Join this intrepid cat as he faces challenges in an exciting dungeon filled with enemies. Inspired by classic arcade games from the 80s, Loop Cat combines unique and exciting gameplay with bullet hell elements that will put your skills to the test.

loophero.title: Loop Hero
loophero.descHtml: The Lich has thrown the world into a timeless loop and plunged its inhabitants into never ending chaos. Wield an expanding deck of mystical cards to place enemies, buildings, and terrain along each unique expedition loop for the brave hero.
loophero.instHtml: Purchase Loop Hero on the Android Epic Games Store. Extract the APK, instructions in the portfolder! Copy the extracted APK to ports/loophero. Run Loop Hero.

loosepo.title: LOOSEPO
loosepo.descHtml: This is an ultra-lightweight Top-Down shooting game with roguelike elements. You need to constantly recycle your empty wine bottles to replenish ammunition. Use the initial props cards and the upgrade cards in the game to build a powerful butt baby, and then help it defeat the evil rotten demons.
loosepo.instHtml: Buy the game form Steam here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1581660/LOOSEPO/ Once installed, right click it in your library and select Manage-Browse Local Files, then COPY these files to the 'assets' folder.

lose95.title: Lose95
lose95.descHtml:
Lose95 yourself to the depths of your folders and try to make space for the downloads!

The download constantly ticks trying to kill your drive; click on files to delete them, but watch out for bugs and errors which can stun you and make you loose precious time! You can collect power ups to click on and hack your way out.

lostethereal.title: Lost Ethereal
lostethereal.descHtml: Save your dead family from the spirit world. A pressureless and puzzling romp through the spirit world.
lostethereal.instHtml: Download Lost Ethereal.exe for free at https://lucregames.itch.io/lost-ethereal -- simply drop the Lost Ethereal.exe file straight into the port's gamedata folder.

lostinsideact1.title: LOST INSIDE Act 1
lostinsideact1.descHtml: LOST INSIDE is a non-traditional, character-focused, action-adventure RPG about a human child who stumbles their way into the Spirit World. On their way home, the child comes to learn that this Spirit World is the home of countless friendly monsters who have been waiting for a prophesized hero to come and rescue them from a mysterious curse.

lostpotato.title: Lost Potato
lostpotato.descHtml: Lost Potato is a minimalistic top-down roguelite where you can't damage enemies directly. Push them into spikes, reflect bullets and help a young potato find its way out of a jungle filled with man-eating tribes!
lostpotato.instHtml: Purchase the game either from itch OR steam. Download the game and copy over all the game data to ports/lostpotato/assets

love3.title: LOVE 3
love3.descHtml:
LOVE 3 is a precision platformer with minimalistic pixel graphics and tight controls. Face challenging obstacles, discover hidden secrets, and place custom checkpoints after you overcome each new danger.

3 Other games included for free: Includes every level from LOVE, LOVE 2: kuso, and LOVE Remastered, in addition to the original 42 track soundtrack.
love3.instHtml:
Purchase the game on Itch. Fred Wood has kindly provided a PortMaster package, download it. This will replace the gamedata folder in your portfolder.

If you already own the game on Steam. You will need to download the Linux version. If you're running windows, use this command in the Steam Console: download_depot 1604300 1604302 2416319664696347085. Locate the gamefiles and copy over the assets to the gamedata folder.

love.title: LOVE by Fred Wood
love.descHtml: LOVE is a short and addictively challenging platformer with a minimalist design. It has a custom respawn system, 16 levels, 12 track original soundtrack, competitive scoring, and multiple ways to play. The difficult levels are balanced with the inclusion of a simple yet unique respawn system wherein the player can leave a checkpoint at any location at any point, as long as they are on solid ground. Beyond the visual aesthetic, the challenging level design, and the abundance of features, there is the fantastic soundtrack composed by James Bennett, which brings rich life to the seemingly simple three-color atmosphere.
love.instHtml: Purchase and download LOVE (3.0.1, Linux) or (3.0.1, Windows) from https://thatsmytrunks.itch.io/love. Copy the game files from into the /assets folder

minetest.title: Luanti / Minetest - Mineclonia
minetest.descHtml: Luanti (formerly Minetest) is a free software game engine to create various games based on voxel gameplay, inspired by InfiniMiner, Minecraft, and the like.
minetest.instHtml: If you have a 1gb device you will need to either enable zram (recommended) or enable swap space as this game requires more ram.

lucid.title: LUCID
lucid.descHtml: LUCID is a Point & Click / Top-down hybrid adventure about a young kid in a very bizarre world of odd characters and even weirder happenings.

luck.be.a.landlord.title: Luck be a Landlord

luck.be.a.landlord.instHtml:
You'll need to purchase the game from https://store.steampowered.com/app/1404850/Luck_be_a_Landlord. You'll need a specific release, which you can obtain using a tool like DepotDownloader (https://github.com/SteamRE/DepotDownloader). There are also GUIs for DepotDownloader, like https://depotdownloader.00pium.net. The command may vary depending on your system, but the -app, -depot, and manifest digits must match those below:

./DepotDownloader -app 1404850 -depot 1404853 -manifest 5385995170406685945 -username <STEAM_USERNAME> -password <STEAM_PASSWORD>

Once you've grabbed this, locate the Luck be a Landlord.pck file and place this in the port's gamedata folder.

luftrausers.title: LUFTRAUSERS

Select from over 125 combinations of weapons, bodies, and propulsion systems and take to the skies to battle enemy fighter planes, battleships, submarines, and rival aces for glory, honor, and high scores. Bravely volunteer for one of over 100 daring missions to unlock new Rauser combinations and vibrant color variations and become the most legendary Rauser pilot of all time!

lugaruhd.title: Lugaru HD

luminousslash.title: Luminous Slash
luminousslash.descHtml: Play as a nimble neon rabbit as you glide through the air slashing blocks, collecting carrots, care packages, and roaming through space in this fast-paced arcade-style hack-and-slash platformer! Beware, however, of any red-colored blocks or packages, and don't let your jump meter run out!!

lxdredhoney.title: LXD Red Honey
lxdredhoney.descHtml:
Liquid Xtal Dream. A strange machine appeared in the sky, breaking down much of the plant life across the region into their core elements, including your humble garden. Collect and harness the power of these fragments in order to rebuild your world piece by piece. Explore 6 unique areas in order to find and defeat the evil that sought your world's destruction.

Made in 18 Days for Metroidvania Month 24.

mableandthewood.title: Mable and the Wood

macchasworld.title: Maccha's World
macchasworld.descHtml: You find yourself cut off from your family in desperate need of a new liver to save your life. With 100,000 gold coins needed, you enter "The Pit", a cave full of money, monsters and alcohol. Can you make it out in one piece?

maddeningeu.title: Maddening Euphoria

magerecall.title: Mage Recall

magicalbroom.title: Magical Broom Extreme
magicalbroom.descHtml: Magical Broom Extreme is a freeware horizontal shooter from Japan, where the player controls a witch flying on a broom.

magnibox.title: Magnibox
magnibox.descHtml: Magnibox is a colourful and challenging puzzle game about a magnet that's also a box. Hand-crafted for your brain to enjoy!

mago.title: Mago

makenewfriends.title: Make New Friends
makenewfriends.descHtml: The people of LudumDare Land are lonely and in need of friends! Use the Friend-o-matic to summon new friends out of thin air! Will you be able to create friends for everyone before you die?!?

maldita.castilla.title: Maldita Castilla
maldita.castilla.descHtml: An arcade action video game developed by Locomalito and released in December 2012. The gameplay is inspired by the games Shinobi and Ghost and Goblins.

manicminer.title: Manic Miner
manicminer.descHtml: You can't think of the ZX Spectrum without also thinking of Manic Miner written by Matt Smith. 20 wonderfuly crafted and memorable levels of a game which has deservingly achieved legend status

maoucrucible.title: Maou's Crucible
maoucrucible.descHtml: Maou's Crucible is a community-driven horde survivor roguelite featuring original characters from various creators. Enter the Crucible, survive against hordes of enemies, and claim the title of Demon Lord!
