marcotreasurequest.title: Marco's Treasure Quest
marcotreasurequest.descHtml: Help our Hero called Marco to find a treasure...

margot_beatrice_adventure.title: Margot-Béatrice Adventure
margot_beatrice_adventure.descHtml: The courageous princess Margot-Béatrice try to re-take the forest gem but she encounter a terrible (in every way) sorcerer that emprison her in a cristal prison. She now forced to call her animal friends to free her and save the forest.

maskless.title: Maskless
maskless.descHtml: A surreal, atmospheric adventure with evocative art, sound, and an open-ended exploration of identity and self-expression.
maskless.instHtml: Ready to run. Thanks to Kultisti for creating this great game and kindly granting PortMaster permission to distribute the game files.

matchstickelegy.title: Matchstick Elegy
matchstickelegy.descHtml: For the cost of a match, the fire springs to life. The house has become cluttered; burn everything.

maxdownforce.title: Max Downforce
maxdownforce.descHtml: Max Downforce is an arcade racing game. The goal is to finish each of ten laps before the timer reaches zero. A portion of the seconds remaining upon completing a lap is carried over to the next lap.

maxpayne.title: Max Payne
maxpayne.descHtml:
Max Payne Mobile Android version ported to ARM64 Linux devices.

A fugitive undercover cop framed for murder, hunted by cops and the mob, Max is a man with his back against the wall, fighting a battle he cannot hope to win. Max Payne is a relentless story-driven game about a man on the edge, fighting to clear his name while struggling to uncover the truth about his slain family amongst a myriad of plot-twists.
maxpayne.instHtml:
Installing

  1. Install Max Payne through PortMaster
  2. Install the game (Max Payne Mobile 1.7 or newer so that it includes Arm64 libs) on your Android device from Google Play or other legit source.
  3. Retrieve the APK and OBB files from your Android device. You can use a apk extractor app or connect your device to a computer and copy the files directly. Many ways to achieve this so just google it. If you don't have an Android device or you are running a a too new Android version, you can use an emulator like BlueStacks 5 and set your Android version to an older one.
  4. Copy the APK and OBB files over to the console (SD card or over SSH). Place them in the /ports/maxpayne/ directory.
  5. Launch Max Payne from the Ports menu. The first time you launch the game, it will unpack the APK and OBB files. This may take a few minutes.
  6. After unpacking, the game will start loading. Enjoy playing Max Payne on your device!

maximilien_adventure.title: Maximilien Adventure
maximilien_adventure.descHtml: Maximilien, a young adventure, survive a terrible plane crash. With the help of some locals, he will needs to get through the jungle and find his brother and sister.

mayhemmail.title: Mayhem Mail
mayhemmail.descHtml: The mail has been scattered! Take on the mail route from hell, recover and deliver the mail to its rightful place! Mayhem Mail is a classic single-screen arcade platformer in the vein of Donkey Kong, Bubble Bobble and Mario Bros, with some added puzzle elements.
mayhemmail.instHtml: Purchase the game on Steam and copy all game files into the assets folder. You can also use the free demo.

meandmyshadow.title: Me and My Shadow
meandmyshadow.descHtml: Me and My Shadow is a puzzle/platform game in which you try to reach the exit by solving puzzles. Spikes, moving blocks, fragile blocks and much more stand between you and the exit. Record your moves and let your shadow mimic them to reach blocks you couldn't reach alone.
meandmyshadow.instHtml: All files are included and game is ready to play.

meanderland.title: Meander Land
meanderland.descHtml: In a world torn by war, it's up to cartographer Corylus Flint to chart out what remains. When he crash lands on a mysterious island, however, he finds himself smack-dab in the middle of mafia territory! Along the way, Corylus meets a variety of strange characters, both friend and foe. Can he escape the island and continue his life's work?

openmohaa.title: Medal of Honor: Allied Assault
openmohaa.descHtml:
Medal of Honor: Allied Assault War Chest is a treasure trove of historical battles presented as a gritty World War II action FPS. Call in artillery and air strikes against the opposing forces and keep your squad away from the jaws of defeat and despair. Drive various assault vehicles, always charging onwards to victory. Uncle Sam wants YOU!

OpenMoHAA is an open-source version of MoHAA that is fully compatible with both the original game and the Spearhead and Breakthrough expansions, which are all included in the War Chest release.
openmohaa.instHtml: Purchase the Medal of Honor: Allied Assault War Chest on gog.com. Download all three offline installer files (setup...exe, setup...1.bin, setup...2.bin) and put them in ports/openmohaa/. The first time you run the game, the patcher will be used to extract the game files.

megamanspace.title: Mega Man Space
megamanspace.instHtml: Download at itch.io and place Mega Man Space v1.2.0.0.exe, into the assets folder.

megamanspace2.title: Mega Man Space 2
megamanspace2.descHtml: Mega Man Space 2 is a Mega Man based fangame with a drastic change on the genre, tanking the blue bomber into an arcade-like space action adventure.
megamanspace2.instHtml: Download the Windows version at itch.io and place Mega Man Space 2 - 20w18a.pck into the megamanspace2 folder.

megamansunrise.title: MEGA MAN Sunrise
megamansunrise.descHtml: A fan made Mega Man game, made in the style of a GameBoy game.

megawitter.title: MEGA MAN Witter's Domination
megawitter.descHtml: An action platformer fangame where you run, shoot, jump, slide and collect special weapon after defeating bosses known as Robot Masters. There are 2 playable characters - Megaman, a robot using mostly ranged weapons and a close combat fighter named Slizer who is learning various abilities. Also you can find a secret challenge on each level that rewards with some form of boost.
megawitter.instHtml: Download Free at itch.io and place the Mega Man Witter Domination.zip into the assets folder.

megaserval.title: Mega Serval
megaserval.descHtml: Serval's friends are in danger and it's up to her to save the day! Progress through 12 action-packed platforming stages in this "Kemono Friends Project" derivative work!

megaball.title: Megaball
megaball.descHtml: The goal is to roll the ball over every flashing panel to complete the stage. For each stage you complete, you gain one extra life. If you need to, you can self-destruct (and lose a life) and shatter into ten pieces, killing any enemy which collides with these pieces; you'll then immediately re-spawn and the enemy will reappear in 5 seconds.
megaball.instHtml: Ready to run! Thanks helpcomputer for releasing this game under an MIT license.

megaman.title: Megaman Rock N Roll
megaman.descHtml: A mysterious robot force is invading the city and abducting Robot Masters. Protoman and Megaman both succumb to the terror leaving Roll alone and scared. Back at Dr. Light's lab Roll decides to go through the procedure her brother did to become a super fighting robot.
megaman.instHtml: Run Megaman.sh Suggested to play on device with 2 gb of ram to lower a lot the possibility of slowdowns, but is has been defined playable also on lower specs device.

megamanx816-bit.title: Megaman X8 16-bit
megamanx816-bit.descHtml: The Mega Man X8 16-Bit Demake is a fan-made project that reimagines the original Mega Man X8 in the style of the classic 16-bit era. This demake brings the modern aesthetics and mechanics of the original game into a retro environment reminiscent of the SNES era, particularly the earlier Mega Man X titles on that system.
megamanx816-bit.instHtml: https://sonicfangameshq.com/forums/showcase/mega-man-x8-16-bit.2184/?sfnsn=wa grab the zip from here, extract it and put the files in the megamanx816-bit/gamedata folder

megazeux.title: Megazeux
megazeux.descHtml: MegaZeux is a game engine that features hundreds of user-created games, mostly in a retro, tile-based style. The games cover various genres, including RPGs, platformers, puzzles ans shoot 'm ups. They often use the engine’s scripting system for unique mechanics and gameplay. With its simple graphics and creative possibilities, MegaZeux offers a wide variety of games to explore, all created by its community.
megazeux.instHtml:
• Install testing zip.
  • Download over 500 games from DigitalMZX.
  • Place extracted game folders to roms/ports/megazeux/gamedata.
  • Run the games by selecting the mzx files in the built-in browser.

mslugsbf.title: Metal Slug FB Fanthology
mslugsbf.descHtml: Metal Slug SB Fanthology is a fan game developed by SuperBlinky, which has been in development since 2020. The main goal of the project is to create 8 new Metal Slug experiences based on the 8 mainline games.
mslugsbf.instHtml: Download the game from GameJolt and put all the files from the GAME folder (the one with all the audiogroups) into the ports/mslugsbf/assets folder.

metanethunterg4.title: Metanet Hunter G4
metanethunterg4.descHtml: Metanet Hunter G4 is an action platformer set in the heart of Cyberspace! Take on the role of a lone Cyberspace Samurai as you navigate through six adrenaline-pumping stages, each filled with intense side-scrolling challenges and epic boss battles. Armed with over 20 sub-weapons. Dive into Time Attack Mode to unlock funky color palettes and discover secrets and cheats scattered throughout the digital landscape. Get ready to experience the thrill of old-school platforming reimagined for the modern era in Metanet Hunter G4!
metanethunterg4.instHtml: Download the game https://nightkawata.itch.io/metanet-hunter-g4 and copy the exe file into the port folder. Demo or full version (v1.2) can be used.

mezzer.title: MEZZER
mezzer.descHtml: MEZZER is a brutal and bloody game about slicing your foes in half.
mezzer.instHtml: Download Mezzer.exe from https://danieldavis.itch.io/mezzer and place it in /ports/mezzer

miceamaze.title: MiceAmaze
miceamaze.descHtml: MiceAmaze is a free video game that features a maze with mice and snakes. Place your arrows to guide mice to your house, but watch out for snakes and sick mice. The Eagle can be obtained with a Gold Mouse which will protect your house from those pesky snakes.

microplatformer.title: Micro Platformer
microplatformer.descHtml: A minimalistic platformer with a 1x1 tileset. No enemies, no bullets, no lasers. Just sheer platforming.

mightymike.title: Mighty Mike
mightymike.descHtml: This is Pangea Software's Mighty Mike (also known as Power Pete). Set in a toy store, this top-down action game is a staple of 90's Macintosh games.

milkinside.title: Milk inside a bag of Milk inside a bag of Milk ...
milkinside.descHtml: Milk inside a bag... is a small visual novel, showing either funny abstraction and wordplay or painful psychological episodes. The claim that history is based on real events will be too specific, so it is easier to pretend that it is just a set of abstractions and wordplay.
milkinside.instHtml: Buy and Download the itch.io version https://nikita-kryukov.itch.io/pmkm and extract the zip. Then go into the extracted zip and copy out of game/archive.rpa into the milkinside/gamefiles on your device

mimisdeliverydash.title: Mimi's Delivery Dash
mimisdeliverydash.descHtml:
Originally created in 10 days for Movie Game Jam 2018 as a tribute to Kiki's Delivery Service.

Meet Mimi! A young witch in-training who has just recently decided what her special skill is: delivering mail - by broomstick!

The town is a bustling place so she'll need to be on the look out for potential customers, and they always tip well for a speedy delivery.

But watch out, Mimi! Angry crows are one thing, but flying a broom around town can be just as dangerous!
mimisdeliverydash.instHtml: Download from https://caffinate.itch.io/mimis-delivery-dash and extract data.win and both .ogg files to /ports/mimisdeliverydash/gamedata/

mina.title: Mina the Hollower
mina.descHtml: Mina the Hollower is a top-down action-adventure from Yacht Club Games, set in a richly detailed 8-bit world. Play as Mina, a resourceful engineer-hero, whipping foes and solving dungeon puzzles across the cursed island of Tenebrous Isle.
mina.instHtml: Requires the macOS game files from GOG (a .pkg installer) or Steam (the Mac depot). See README.md for details.

mindustry.title: Mindustry
mindustry.descHtml: Mindustry is a open-source sandbox tower-defense game focused on resource management and automation. Players design factories, build supply chains, and defend against waves of enemies using strategic planning and custom defenses. It offers campaign, multiplayer, and creative modes for diverse gameplay.
mindustry.instHtml: The port is ready to run for version 146 (latest release build). Just start the game. If you want to update the game to a different version, replace Mindustry.jar in the game directory. Your milage may vary, newer versions might not be compatible.

minecraftjava.title: Minecraft - Java Edition
minecraftjava.descHtml:
Minecraft is a game where you can do pretty much whatever you want. Want to build a giant castle? Go for it. Feel like exploring caves and fighting skeletons? Totally an option. You start in a big, blocky world with nothing, and little by little, you gather, build, explore, and create your own adventures. Whether you're surviving the night or just chilling in Creative mode building dream houses, it’s a game about freedom, creativity, and having fun your own way.

Not all versions are Supported, currently only 1.7.10 (with Forge) and 1.12 (with Forge) are supported
minecraftjava.instHtml:
To play Minecraft on your device via PortMaster, you’ll need to copy over the necessary game files from your PC. Follow these steps carefully: ✅ Step 1: Prepare Minecraft on Your PC

Install Minecraft on your PC via the official launcher.

Launch the version you want to play at least once to make sure all files are generated.

(Optional but important!)
If you want to use a mod loader like Forge or Fabric, install it and launch that version once as well.

📂 Step 2: Find the Game Files

On your PC, Minecraft stores game files in this folder:

C:\Users\\AppData\Roaming.minecraft\versions

To access that folder Press the Windows Key on your Keyboard and R Win + R You should see a new Window called Run, in there write %appdata% and press Enter

Now you should see a .minecraft directory

📁 Step 3: Copy to Your PortMaster Device

Connect your device to your PC or insert the SD card.

On your device, go to:

/ports/minecraftjava

Now copy the earlier found .minecraft Directory from Step 2 into the /ports/minecraftjava folder
If it asks to overwrite files press NO !!!

minesofmoria.title: Mines of Moria
minesofmoria.descHtml: Descend the Mines of Moria, level by level, and slay the Balrog waiting at the bottom. Rufe.org's rebuild of Umoria, itself the 1983 roguelike by Robert Alan Koeneke that Angband and much of the genre grew out of: permadeath, a randomly generated dungeon on every stairway, a town to spend your gold in between dives. This build uses the graphical client, with sprite tiles and a map that fills the screen.

minidoom2.title: Mini Doom II
minidoom2.descHtml: What if Doom was a platformer instead of a first person shooter? The answer is MiniDoom 2, a fan game that pays homage to the Doom franchise by reimagining it as a 2d retro platformer. It takes the beloved cast of classic DOOM enemies and weapons and blends them with old school 80s and 90s games like Contra and Metal Slug resulting in a fast paced pixelated carnage fest with a killer heavy metal soundtrack.
minidoom2.instHtml: Download the windows version of Mini Doom II on itch.io and copy miniDoom2-v3-1.zip in the minidoom2 port folder

minimonstersgravity.title: Mini Monsters Gravity Consensus
minimonstersgravity.descHtml: Mini Monsters Gravity Consensus is a charming 2D puzzle game with a unique gravity control mechanic. Perfect for a relaxing evening, it offers simple yet engaging puzzles that progressively challenge you as you unlock new levels and gameplay mechanics, making each step forward more exciting and fun.
minimonstersgravity.instHtml: Download the game from steam here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3205470/Mini_Monsters_Gravitational_Consensus/ and COPY the 'MiniMonsters.pck' file into the root of the portfolder.

minidoom.title: MiniDoom

missdriller.title: Miss Driller

FOR ITCH

FOR STEAM

monsterbattlegrounds.descHtml: Welcome to Monster Battlegrounds (MBG)! Pick your Monster and defeat your foes in battle! MBG is a 1 versus 1 fighting game with simple controls and deep mind-games.

moonchildfe.descHtml: A modern source port of the 1997 Windows 95 classic, Moon Child. This (FE) Friend Edition is designed as a definitive way to experience the game on modern hardware. Remember, you've got the power to be his friend!

moonleap.title: Moonleap
moonleap.descHtml: Explore a world full of mysteries that transform with each jump! Moonleap is a game about a moon boy on his journey to recover shooting stars. Change day to night with your jump and catch all the stars in this challenging puzzle-platformer!
moonleap.instHtml: Purchase the game from steam. Download the game and place all the game files in ports/moonleap/assets

moonlightnew.title: Moonlight New
moonlightnew.descHtml: "Moonlight Embedded is an open source client for Sunshine and NVIDIA GameStream for embedded Linux systems. Moonlight allows you to stream your full collection of games and applications from your PC to other devices to play them remotely" Now with a brand new custom-made launcher!"
moonlightnew.instHtml:
• Install the latest version of Sunshine on your PC (GFE is not updated anymore but may give good results for NVIDIA users)
  • This guide will use the windows installer version.
  • Run the installer, agree with the terms. Wait for it to finish.
  • Open Sunshine for the first time. It will open up a window in your default browser.
  • It may give a warning about your connection not being private. Click on advanced and continue to localhost.
  • Here you will set the username and password for Sunshine, set it to something simple and memorable. It will ask for it every time.
  • The page will reload and then you will log into Sunshine.
  • Now its time to open Moonlight on your handheld.
  • First head to the "Settings Menu" and set them how you would like. Preferably start off with a low bitrate and your devices native resolution and framerate.
  • Lets move to the "Connect Menu". Here you will first set your host device IP-address.
  • You will be able to find this by going to your network settings, properties and under "IPv4 address".
  • Now its time to pair. Head to the "Pin" section on your host PC.
  • Click "Pair" in the Moonlight port. This will now show a pin. Fill this pin into Sunshine. Also fill in the device name, this can be named after your device such a "RG35XX".
  • After sending the signal on you host PC, you will receive a message "Succesfully paired" in the moonlight app on your handheld.
  • Head over to the "Reload Apps" function on your handheld. Click on it and you will see the currently configured apps from Sunshine. Every time you update the Apps in Sunshine, use this function.
  • Head to the "Play Menu" and select the app you want to stream, Steam for example.
  • The Moonlight app will close on your handheld and it will start streaming. Wait 5 seconds for the controls.
  • Have fun!

Recommendations:

  • Moonlight requires a very good internet connection to get a decent experience. There are many factors at play such a the detail of the game your running. Simpler 2d games are easier to stream and require less power to decode on your handheld. You will have to try and find a balance of bitrate and framerate for your setup.
  • Experiencing input and/or audio delay? Lower the bitrate, resolution, or framerate. Reconnecting may help random desyncing issues.
  • Moonlight will maintain aspect ratio of your host PC monitor. You can get a better picture by manually changing the resolution to your devices native resolution, such as 640x480. There are ways to automate this process, such as ResolutionAutomation. Use these programs on your own risk.
  • Inputs may be reversed. Mouse mode does not work on Moonlight-Embedded. Both can be resolved by using SteamInput.
  • Its recommended to check your connection before streaming, use the pair function for this. Does it say "Already paired", then youre good to go. It may also say something like "App already opened", you need to use "Force Close" under the troubleshooting options in Sunshine.
  • Most important of all, dont expect an amazing experience going in. These handhelds are not ideal for Streaming, even though they may seem like it.

moonlight.title: Moonlight Old
moonlight.descHtml: A free, open-source NVIDIA Gamestream Client. For more info on the setup needs at https://github.com/christianhaitian/arkos/wiki/ArkOS-Emulators-and-Ports-information#moonlight-nvidia-gamestreaming-app-available-through-portmaster.

moonstriker.title: MoonStriker
moonstriker.descHtml: MoonStriker is a vertical scrolling shoot 'em up game. The player ship can attack with normal shots or with lock-on laser, by moving the target reticle over enemies while the fire button is held. Initially five lasers can lock-on, but this can be increased by collecting power-ups. The game offers a 7-level arcade mode, with 3 difficulty levels, and a 3-minute caravan mode.
moonstriker.instHtml: Download the MoonStriker.exe from Itch.io and place it the assets folder.

openmw.title: Morrowind
openmw.descHtml: The Elder Scrolls III: Morrowind is an open-world fantasy role-playing game set in the richly detailed province of Morrowind, part of the Elder Scrolls universe. Originally released by Bethesda in 2002, it offers deep lore, open-ended gameplay, and a sprawling world filled with quests, factions, and exploration. This version runs on OpenMW, an open-source reimplementation of the Morrowind engine, offering improved stability and numerous enhancements while preserving the original gameplay experience.
openmw.instHtml:
Install "Morrowind Game of the Year Edition" from either Steam or GoG and copy the contents of Data Files into ports/openmw/data/.

Alternatively place the GoG offline installer files (setup_the_elder_scrolls_iii_morrowind_goty_1.6.0.1820_gog_0.1_(77582).exe and setup_the_elder_scrolls_iii_morrowind_goty_1.6.0.1820_gog_0.1_(77582)-1.bin) into ports/openmw/data/ and it will be installed correctly by the port when launched.

mrplatformer.title: Mr. Platformer
mrplatformer.descHtml: Run! Jump? Swim?! Mr. Platformer can do it all! A game from Terry Cavanagh.
mrplatformer.instHtml: Ready to run. Thanks to Terry Cavanagh for permitting PortMaster to include the game files.

mrrescue.title: Mr. Rescue
mrrescue.descHtml:
Mr. Rescue is an arcade-style 2D action game centered around evacuating civilians from burning buildings.

The game features fast paced fire extinguishing action, intense boss battles, a catchy soundtrack and lots of throwing people around in pseudo-randomly generated buildings.

mreader.title: mReader
mreader.descHtml: .epub and .txt reader for PortMaster capable devices. Ported from pixel-reader by ealang. Add your books to /ports/mreader/Books, or just navigate via gui to your preferred location. Additional fonts can be added to /mreader/resources/fonts.
mreader.instHtml: Ready to read, because knowledge is power!

multimanicminer.title: Multi Player Manic Miner
multimanicminer.descHtml: This is a recreation of the first level, the Central Cavern, of Manic Miner, except it allows up to 4 players to play simultaneously on the same PC.

multris.title: Multris
multris.descHtml: A version of Tetris with randomly generated polyominoes of varying sizes.

murtop.title: Murtop
murtop.descHtml: Fast-paced arcade game packed with action, as if plucked directly from the '80s, where Dig Dug meets Bomberman.
murtop.instHtml:
You can purchase Murtop at: https://hiulit.itch.io/murtop

Download and extract it, and place the Murtop.pck file in the gamedata directory. This has been tested with Murtop ARM 64, version 1.2.0

mpd.title: Music Player Daemon
mpd.descHtml: Listen to your favourite songs while playing your favourite games
mpd.instHtml: Add your songs to mpd/songs and if you want you can also add playlist files to mpd/playlists

must-have-been-the-wind.title: Must have been the wind
must-have-been-the-wind.descHtml:
A survival game, but you're the environment

Does it feel like the world is against you? Not today! Today you're the world, and you're against an unsuspecting player.

Puzzle yourself through nature-filled islands to become the ultimate survival environment - as harsh as possible!

Made in 48 hours for the GMTK-Jam 2023

Mechanic explanation (if you're confused): The sound from different events (trees falling, fire spreading) alerts the player to run away if it's on the same grid line horizontally or vertically, whether there's an obstacle in the way or not. Another way to imagine it is a + shape.

mutant_tank_knights.title: Mutant Tank Knights
mutant_tank_knights.descHtml: A wonderful game from the respected Russian game developer for portable game consoles GP2X and GP2X Wiz - quasist 'a. Stylized tank arcade game with retro graphics.

mybigsister.title: My Big Sister
mybigsister.descHtml: My Big Sister is a game about Luzia and Sombria, two sisters who are trying to get back home after being kidnapped by strangers and Luzia takes it upon herself to ensure they both make it home.
mybigsister.instHtml: The port supports both original and remastered version. Just purchase either of those and copy all game files into the gamedata folder.

mystikbelle.title: Mystik Belle
mystikbelle.descHtml: A Metroidvania with Point and Click style elements like Psychonauts. Help Belle fix the mystic Walpurgisnacht Brew by finding three rare magical ingredients in order to clear her name.
mystikbelle.instHtml: Download the Linux version through Steam with download_depot 332610 332613 3942707501747355559 and add the contents of the assets folder to mystikbelle/assets.

mythos.title: Mythos
mythos.descHtml: Esote is one of many small towns located within Daedalis's Great Labyrinth, formed years after the Legendary Hero Theseus defeated the awful minotaur. Although Theseus was able to escape the Labyrinth many of the remaining survivors who couldn't had to settle down resigning themselves to forever live trapped within. You (Sophos) have gotten fed up with the defeatist attitude all the townsmen carry on their faces, you hate the solemn and quiet atmosphere that persists day to day. After hearing tales of the Outside from your late parents years ago you decide to go see it for yourself. What is there to fear? Make decisions and manipulate your escape chance. It's up to you whether you FIND THE EXIT or STAY LOST
mythos.instHtml: This port is ready to run! Special thanks to Aiwi for allowing the distribution of the game via Portmaster.

nainainights.title: NAi NAi Nights-Nokia Edition
nainainights.descHtml: A short adventure / simple farming game made within the restrictions of a Nokia 3310 phone, created in one week for Nokia Jam 3. The theme was ON/OFF, so you can turn your "phone" off and on again at anytime to pass time quickly.

nam.title: NAM
nam.descHtml: NAM using the rednukem build open source port by Alexey Khokholov.
nam.instHtml: You'll need to add your own full version NAM.GRP and NAM.RTS and .CON files and optionally CD audio tracks as OGG file in the format trackXX.ogg (where XX is the track number) to the ports/rednukem-NAM/gamedata folder.

nanobounce.title: Nanobounce
nanobounce.descHtml: Guide the bouncing ball to the exit. On the way, you will rely on some blocks and try to avoid others.
nanobounce.instHtml: All files are included and game is ready to run.

nanosaur.title: Nanosaur
nanosaur.descHtml: This is Pangea Software’s Nanosaur, which casts a cybernetic dinosaur from the future who’s sent back in time 20 minutes before a giant asteroid hits the Earth.

nanosaur2.title: Nanosaur 2
nanosaur2.descHtml: Nanosaur 2 is a continuation of the original Nanosaur storyline, only this time you get to fly a pteradactyl who's loaded with hi-tech weaponry.

nazizombies.title: Nazi Zombies
nazizombies.descHtml: Nazi Zombies: Portable is a Call of Duty: Zombies remake running on the Quake (1996) engine
nazizombies.instHtml: The installer automatically takes care of setting up the game

netouchezpas5.title: Ne Touchez Pas 5
netouchezpas5.descHtml: Navigate 100 levels using six unique characters, each with distinct controls. Dodge deadly fans, evade lasers, hit switches, collect bits, and leap into the void to progress.
netouchezpas5.instHtml: Purchase the full game at itch.io. Download and extract the .zip, and copy the game files to this port's gamedata folder.

nebulus.title: Nebulus
nebulus.descHtml: In this puzzle platformer where you have to help a cute little green dude switch off some kind of "evil" mechanism. The "power off switch" is hidden somewhere in high towers. On your way to the target you need to avoid a lot of strange robots that guard the tower.
nebulus.instHtml: All files are included and game is ready to play.

nfs2se.title: Need For Speed II SE
nfs2se.descHtml: "Need for Speed II" is a racing video game released in the late 1990s, featuring a variety of exotic cars and tracks from around the world, allowing players to race against computer-controlled opponents or human players in various modes, including single race and tournament.
nfs2se.instHtml: Copy FEDATA and GAMEDATA directories from the Need For Speed™ II SE original CD-ROM into nfs2se directory. Folder needs to be +500 Mb.

nehonobasa.title: NEHONOBASA
nehonobasa.descHtml: This is a bullet hell shooter. It might be hard. Defeat all 4 stages + the final boss.
nehonobasa.instHtml: Download the NEHONOBASA1.10_wh.zip at itch.io and copy data.win to the assets folder.

neogensokyo.title: Neo-Gensokyo
neogensokyo.descHtml: Slash and dash through robotic enemies, dodge through danmaku in bullet-time, rack up combos to increase your Power level, pinpoint a boss's openings and dance through their moves to counterattack with perfect timing.

neoncityriders.title: Neon City Riders
neoncityriders.descHtml: Explore a decaying futuristic city in search of items, superpowers and companions to free all the turfs of the evil gangs and unite their people again!
neoncityriders.instHtml: Download the game from Steam and copy all game files into assets folder. The game is not recommended for RK3326 devices due to poor performance in many areas.

ner.title: Ner
ner.descHtml: Ner is an atmospheric horror game set in a desolate underground complex where your only option is to descend further and further into the dark unknown.
ner.instHtml: Download the game https://youdoyoubuddy.itch.io/ner and copy the Ner.love file into the port folder.

netsurf.title: NetSurf Web Browser
netsurf.descHtml: Small as a mouse, fast as a cheetah and available for free. NetSurf is a multi-platform web browser for UNIX-like platforms.
netsurf.instHtml: Onscreen keyboard can be accessed on the bottom right corner (A) symbol.

neverball.title: Neverball
neverball.descHtml:
Tilt the floor to roll a ball through an obstacle course within the given time. If the ball falls or time expires, a ball is lost.

Collect coins to unlock the exit and earn extra balls. Red coins are worth 5. Blue coins are worth 10. A ball is awarded for 100 coins.

Includes Neverputt.
neverball.instHtml:
All files are included and game is ready to run.

Dpad and left stick are movement A is select/enter B is back/escape Select is escape Start is enter

nextdoor.title: Next Door
nextdoor.descHtml: Short cinematic pixel horror game inspired by Junji Ito's manga.
nextdoor.instHtml: Install port then download NextDoor_v1.00.exe from here and place it in nextdoor/gamedata folder.

nezumidash.title: NEZUMIDASH
nezumidash.descHtml: Control the mouse and aim for the goal. Each stage has 5 coins scattered throughout, so try to collect as many as you can. Clear all 20 stages and collect at least 70 coins!
nezumidash.instHtml: Download at itch.io and copy data.win into assets folder.

nicechess.title: NiceChess
nicechess.descHtml: NiceChess is built off of Brutal Chess 0.5.2 as its base and updated to use SDL2 along with some nice quality-of-life improvements.

nidhogg.title: Nidhogg
nidhogg.descHtml:
Nidhogg is the epic award-winning fencing tug-of-war, full of graceful acrobatics and clumsy stabs. IRL yelling and excitement may occur, in this ultimate two-player showdown of fast-paced fencing and melee attacks. The combat arena stretches in both directions, although besting an opponent only gains you ground. Matches aren’t won or lost with a single kill, but with a series of kills granting you right-of-way to run/fight/flee to your own goal-zone. Each arena holds different strategic formations and chokepoints to use to your advantage. Until you reach your goal-zone, anything is possible. Only one thing is certain in Nidhogg… the only way to win is to outwit your opponent. En Garde!

Note: Only single player available for this port!
nidhogg.instHtml: Purchase the game from https://store.steampowered.com/app/94400/Nidhogg/ From your Steam Library, Right-Click Nidhogg and select Properties. Go to Betas and select "before_may_2017 - before_may_2017" Download and install the before_may_2017 version. After installation is complete, from your steam library, Right-Click Nidhogg [before_may_2017] and select Manage > Browse local files Copy all the files from this folder into ports/nidhogg/assets On first startup, the game will patch and put the files in the appropriate places.

nightofelchupacabra.title: Night Of El Chupacabra
nightofelchupacabra.descHtml: "Night of El Chupacabra" is a retro-style arcade shooter set in 1995, where players defend their family from the legendary creature wreaking havoc in the countryside. Featuring 8-bit pixel art and fast-paced gameplay, the game challenges you to survive waves of attacks using quick reflexes and strategic movement. With browser-based and downloadable options, it’s a nostalgic thrill for fans of classic arcade games.

nightmareframes.title: Nightmare Frames
nightmareframes.descHtml: Nightmare Frames is a supernatural thriller where you'll step into the shoes of Alan Goldberg, in the search for the scariest horror film of all time. An enthralling journey through the streets of the Hollywood of the 80s, a small haunted town, and even Hell itself.
nightmareframes.instHtml: Download the free demo or purchase the game on Steam or Itch.io and copy English.tra and Nightmare Frames.exe (or Nightmare Frames Prologue.exe for the demo version) to gamedata folder.

nikwi.title: Nikwi Deluxe
nikwi.descHtml: You play the role of a 9 year old boy in his absolute dream: a world made of sweets! Guide Nikwi through his dream to eat everything in each of the 30 levels, while you avoid the monsters who try to turn Nikwi's dream into a nightmare.

ninjasenkidx.title: Ninja Senki DX
ninjasenkidx.descHtml: On its 5th anniversary, Ninja Senki leaps from the shadows onto Steam to become Ninja Senki DX! When Princess Kinuhime is slain by a demon, Hayate becomes obsessed with revenge! Casting aside the art of invisibility, the blue ninja unleashes the power of shurikenjutsu upon mythological creatures, demons and other adversaries in his action-filled quest for vengeance!
ninjasenkidx.instHtml: Purchase the game on Steam and copy the NinjaSenkiDX.exe into assets folder.

noparachute.title: No Parachute
noparachute.descHtml: No Parachute is a fast-paced arcade game with a pixel art style, in which you will dodge various obstacles in free fall. The man jumped out of a plane, and his parachute didn’t open. But instead of crashing, he fell into a mysterious hole in the ground. He’ll have to fly through a lot of mines and tunnels and meet unexpected visitors. As the game progresses, the unsuccessful skydiver will have to use all his skill and reaction to survive. You will have very little time to assess the situation and make the right decisions, so be prepared to engage your entire concentration. Try to catch Zen (without burning your ass)!
noparachute.instHtml: Purchase and download the game https://store.steampowered.com/app/1575300/No_Parachute/ and copy the exe file into the port folder.

notransmission.title: No Transmission
notransmission.descHtml: Parasites know that the best place to infect people is at underground raves. Don't kill (hang) the DJ or the obliviously high dancing civilians.... unless you have to. YCJY made this for a Global Game Jam - to experiment with 3d in gamemaker.
notransmission.instHtml: Download the game from https://ycjy.itch.io/no-transmission Extract the .exe from the zip and place it in notransmission/gamedata On first startup, the game will patch!

noskin.title: NO-SKIN
noskin.descHtml: NO-SKIN is a roguelike game characterized by a horror atmosphere and a smooth yet complex gameplay. Face the horrors that the house hides behind every corner and discover who the No-Skin Man truly is!
noskin.instHtml: Purchase the game on Steam or Itch.io and copy all game files into the assets folder. You can also use the free demo from Itch.io, download it and extract all files into the assets folder.

nonstopspaceprobe.title: Non-Stop Space Probe
nonstopspaceprobe.descHtml:
Take control of the Orblr-1 Space Probe and blast chaotically through the cosmos on your mission to collect precious minerals.

Fly through 40 levels avoiding dangerous space debris and collect the gems before heading to the goal. There's just one problem... once you've started you can't stop!
nonstopspaceprobe.instHtml: Download the game from https://ci.itch.io/non-stop-space-probe and place the contents of the zip into the nonstopspaceprobe/gamedata folder

nonny.title: Nonny
nonny.descHtml: Nonny is a simple nonogram game that lets you play and create nonogram puzzles!
nonny.instHtml: All files are included and ready to play.

notenoughtime.title: Not Enough Time
notenoughtime.descHtml: Not enough time is a short pixel-art point & click adventure. It is a sequel to Uncle Lee strikes again and Once upon a Möbius strip, but it can be enjoyed as a standalone game as well. Our improved recipe features 500% more characters than the previous games!

nvpw.title: NOT VERY PRO WRESTLING
nvpw.descHtml: Push the enemy off the island in a three-out-of-five series

nothing.title: Nothing
nothing.descHtml:
A simple platformer with a powerful editor.*

*Use keyboard and mouse for the editor

nova_pinball.title: Nova Pinball
nova_pinball.descHtml:
A pinball game created with the Love game framework.

Your mission: Make the star go nova. There are in-game hints that point out the next target to achieve your goal.

nox-decomp.title: Nox-Decomp
nox-decomp.descHtml: It may be the most fun action RPG you've never played and supports multiplayer. An excellent action/RPG hybrid with very unique gameplay. Your name is Jack Mower, a 20th century dude who just happened to be sucked into the world of Nox via his TV set. The world is in danger and you have to save it! But before you embark on your epic journey you must choose your path: warrior, wizard, or conjurer. Nox-Decomp is a source port of Westwood Studios Nox from https://github.com/sookyboo/nox-decomp
nox-decomp.instHtml: Copy the GOG version of nox "setup_nox_*.exe" into the gamefiles directory. This will be extracted on first start.

npuzzle.title: NPuzzle
npuzzle.descHtml: NPuzzle is a 15 puzzle style sliding game where you have to rearrange the tiles in order.
npuzzle.instHtml: All files are included and game is ready to play.

nuclearblaze.title: Nuclear Blaze
nuclearblaze.descHtml: Nuclear Blaze is a 2D action firefighting game by Deepnight Games. Fight through a mysterious military facility as an elite firefighter, rescuing survivors and battling increasingly dangerous blazes.
nuclearblaze.instHtml:
Steam Instructions

Copy linux/hlboot.dat and res.pak from the Steam install into the port's gamedata folder.

Itch.io Instructions

Copy hlboot.dat and res.pak from the itch.io download into the port's gamedata folder.

The patcher will automatically patch the bytecode and compress textures on first launch. This takes about 15-30 minutes.

nuclearthrone.title: Nuclear Throne
nuclearthrone.descHtml: Nuclear Throne is a post-apocalyptic roguelike-like top-down shooter. Not 'the final hope of humanity' post-apocalyptic, but 'humanity is extinct and mutants and monsters now roam the world' post-apocalyptic. Fight your way through the wastelands with powerful weaponry, collecting radiation to mutate some new limbs and abilities. All these things and more you could do if only you were good at this game. Can you reach the Nuclear Throne?
nuclearthrone.instHtml: Purchase your game Steam. Open Steam console Copy and paste command: download_depot 242680 242683 1972149697962479575 Copy the contents of the assets folder into ports/nuclearthrone/assets

nulldrifter.title: Null Drifter
nulldrifter.descHtml:
Null Drifter is a 1BIT LO-FI shooter, a journey into the void inside a computer simulation!
Lose yourself in this frenetic yet chill experience!

A Minimalistic twin-stick shooter! A Simulation for space-fighter pilots! Made to train them to defeat the awakened forces of the void! Secretly part of the “Project Starship” World, used by the poor 4 souls of “Project Starship X”, before embarking for their mission: defeating the army of Cthulhu!
nulldrifter.instHtml:
Purchase the game from https://store.steampowered.com/app/1170050/Null_Drifter/
From your Steam Library, Right-Click Null Drifter > Manage > Browse local files
Copy the game files into ports/nulldrifter/assets

ocda.title: OCDA
ocda.descHtml: OCDA is a precision platformer in which you play as an animated potato who also just happens to somehow be literate. Run and jump your way through levels, find secrets and master your ability to dash. It's just you, the game and your tenacity to continue. The game is short and sweet, but offers more content in the form of hunting collectibles and secrets. Clearing the game unlocks speedrun mode as well. Post your fastest time in the comments!
ocda.instHtml: Download OCDA.zip from https://kirstu.itch.io/ocda and unzip the contents into the /ports/ocda/gamedata folder

octoberpanic.title: October Panic
octoberpanic.descHtml: An arcade-style platformer with five levels and no saving/loading. A small trick-or-treat bag packed to the brim with both treats and tricks.
octoberpanic.instHtml: Download the game from Steam and copy all game files into the assets folder.

oddworld.title: Oddworld: Abes Oddysee Exoddus
oddworld.descHtml: It is a platformer with puzzle-solving elements.
oddworld.instHtml: You need to copy all .lvl and .ddv files (and sound.dat for Exoddus) from the original game(s) to ports/relive/oddysee or ports/relive/exoddus directory.

ofmiceandmoggies.title: Of Mice and Moggies
ofmiceandmoggies.descHtml: A smart puzzle game, where you play a cat that tries to catch various animals. The levels can look simple at first, but require you to constantly find new ways of combining the animals and objects.
ofmiceandmoggies.instHtml: Purchase the game at https://bippinbits.itch.io/of-mice-and-moggies -- download the Windows version, extract it, and place the game files in ofmiceandmoggies/gamedata

ohmygodlookatthisknight.title: OH MY GOD, look at this knight
ohmygodlookatthisknight.descHtml: Grab your shiny helmet and trusty sword, gather all the valor and honor you have, and show everyone what being a true knight actually means!
ohmygodlookatthisknight.instHtml: Claim free on Steam, download, and copy the game files to the ohmygodlookatthisknight/gamedata folder.

oilwar.title: OilWar
oilwar.descHtml: Evil army is attacking your land and tries to steal your oil.

omegastrike.title: Omega Strike
omegastrike.descHtml: "Omega Strike is a metroidvania game with a vast, open ended world and multiple playable characters. Explore the world, learn new abilities, upgrade your weapons and defeat Doctor Omega and his mutant armies!"
omegastrike.instHtml: Purchase the game on Steam. Add the assets to the gamedata folder.

omegabot.title: OmegaBot
omegabot.descHtml: A tight action side-scroller with challenging robotic bosses. Dodge metallic dangers, acquire powerful weapons and blast your way through a destroyed world full of deadly machines where running out of energy means defeat.
omegabot.instHtml: Purchase the game on Steam and copy all files into the assets folder.

omelettes.title: Omelettes
omelettes.descHtml: Platforms have height. You can move up or down one level at a time. You can push objects on the same level as you. Eggs will break if they fall two or more levels; eggs will always break if they land in a pan. Make an omelette in each pan to complete a level.
omelettes.instHtml: Ready to run. Thanks Steven Miller for creating this game and permitting PortMaster to distribute the files.

omnispeak.title: OmniSpeak
omnispeak.descHtml: OmniSpeak is an open-source re-implementation of "Commander Keen in Goodbye Galaxy".
omnispeak.instHtml: Place your respective GAMEMAPS.CK#, EGAGRAPH.CK#, and AUDIO.CK# files into the respective keen directories and match the required supported versions (v1.4 for Keen 5 and v1.4 OR v1.5 for Keen 6). Episode 4 (shareware) and the fan-made episode 7 modded for OmniSpeak are included and ready to play. You will still need to provide your purchased copies for episodes 5 and 6 (5 is available from Steam and GoG).

onceuponamobiusstrip.title: Once upon a Möbius strip
onceuponamobiusstrip.descHtml:
Once upon a Möbius strip is a short point & click adventure in glorious 1-bit pixel art. It serves as a prequel to Uncle Lee strikes again, but it can be enjoyed as a standalone game as well.

You play as Ines, a 10-year-old girl who would really, REALLY, like to go the bathroom this morning—the universe, however, has other plans.

onenighthotsprings.title: one night, hot springs
onenighthotsprings.descHtml: haru ( a transwoman) is invited by her old friend manami to spend a night at the hot springs. all haru wants to do is enjoy the hot springs like everyone else, but she doesn't want to cause any trouble...
onenighthotsprings.instHtml: Download the one-night-hot-springs-win-linux.zip from https://npckc.itch.io/one-night-hot-springs and copy the game/ directory out of the zip into ports/onenighthotsprings/

openchaos.title: Open Chaos
openchaos.descHtml: Fan Modernization of Urban Chaos. Urban Chaos throws you into the heart of a modern urban jungle at the turn of the millenium. To succeed you'll need a lethal combination of stealth, physical agility and martial art skills as you interact with the city around you.
openchaos.instHtml:
This package does not include Urban Chaos game data. Copy your own game resources into openchaos/assets/ before launching, including:

  • clumps/
  • data/
  • text/
  • config.ini
  • the other resource folders from the original game install

When those resources are present, the launcher runs Open Chaos from openchaos/assets/. At minimum, the game expects clumps/frontend.txc, data/DARCI1.all, and a language file such as text/lang_english.txt. Steam game files have been verified to work with this package.

openggs.title: Open Great Giana Sisters
openggs.descHtml: Open Great Giana Sisters is a Free Software/Open Source implementation/remake of The Great Giana Sisters.
openggs.instHtml: All files are included and game is ready to play.

openhexagon.title: Open Hexagon
openhexagon.descHtml: Open Hexagon is an open-source arcade game developed by Vittorio Romeo, inspired by Terry Cavanagh's Super Hexagon. Players control a triangle, rotating it to avoid incoming walls and survive as long as possible. The game introduces mechanics like a 180° swap move and curving walls, enhancing the original concept. Its powerful Lua scripting system enables players to create and share custom levels, fostering a community of user-generated content.
openhexagon.instHtml: Download the game on Steam (Paid) or Itch.io (Paid), or the game files on Github (Free) and copy the "Packs" and "Assets" folders into the "openhexagon" directory.

opentyrian2000.title: Open Tyrian 2000
opentyrian2000.descHtml:
OpenTyrian2000 is an open-source port of the DOS game Tyrian. It is a fork of OpenTyrian, with the end goal being to replicate the experience of Tyrian 2000 as closely as possible.

Tyrian is an arcade-style vertical scrolling shooter. The story is set in 20,031 where you play as Trent Hawkins, a skilled fighter-pilot employed to fight MicroSol and save the galaxy.

Tyrian features a story mode, one and two-player arcade modes, and networked multiplayer.
opentyrian2000.instHtml: OpenTyrian2000 uses the Tyrian 2000 data files, which have been released as freeware. Alternatively, the game is also available free of charge on GOG. Game data is placed in the gamedata subdirectory.

openblok.title: OpenBlok
openblok.descHtml: A customizable, cross platform, open-source falling block game, packed with a bunch of features.

openclaw.title: OpenClaw
openclaw.descHtml: A Reimplementation of the 1997 Captain Claw platformer.

opendefender.title: OpenDefender
opendefender.descHtml: OpenDefender is an open source defender clone created with Game maker : Studio 1.

openenroth.title: OpenEnroth
openenroth.descHtml: Might and Magic VII: For Blood and Honor is a role-playing game for Windows published in 1999 by 3DO and developed by New World Computing as part of the science fantasy series Might and Magic. OpenEnroth is a reimplementation which allows you to play MMVII on modern platforms.
openenroth.instHtml: Purchase Might and Magic VII on gog.com, or extract the game files from an original Windows CD-ROM. Place the GoG offline installer (setup...exe) or extracted files (DATA etc) in ports/openenroth/gamedata/. If you use the GoG installer, the patcher will extract the files the first time you run the game.

openfodder.title: OpenFodder
openfodder.descHtml: Open Fodder is an open source version of the Cannon Fodder engine.
openfodder.instHtml: It comes with demo files, you can add the full version files by reading the included README.md

openjazz.title: OpenJazz
openjazz.descHtml: A free, open-source version of the classic Jazz Jackrabbit games by Alister Thomson.
openjazz.instHtml: Includes the Jazz Jackrabiit shareware files. You can add your own full game Dos files to the ports/openjazz/gamedata folder.

openmrac.title: OpenMRac
openmrac.descHtml: OpenMRac is a split-screen racing game. It is a tweaked source release of MultiRacer.

opennotrium.title: OpenNotrium
opennotrium.descHtml: You have crash-landed on Notrium. Your food supplies are running low, and a pack of predatory aliens have your scent. You're out of bullets for your pistol, your only weapon a handful of rocks. A freezing night is setting in, and you are desperately looking for firewood. Can you survive?

openomf.title: OpenOMF
openomf.descHtml: An Open Source remake of 'One Must Fall 2097' by Diversions Entertainment.

openra.title: OpenRA
openra.descHtml: OpenRA is an open source project that recreates and modernizes classic real time strategy games, like Red Alert, Command & Conquer, and Dune 2000.
openra.instHtml: The installer automatically takes care of setting up the game. The port comes bundled with Tiberian Dawn (Command & Conquer), Dune 2000 and Red Alert from OpenRA, the Hard Vacuum mod from OpenHV, and the Generals Alpha mod from Mustafa Alperen Seki. When you run a mod for the first time, the game offers to automatically download the free version of the game assets, or you can use the original game disks.

openrct2.title: OpenRCT2
openrct2.descHtml: OpenRCT2 is Open source re-implementation of RollerCoaster Tycoon 2.
openrct2.instHtml: Add your Roller Coaster Tycoon 2 game files to the ports/openrct2/RCT2 directory, and optionally add your Roller Coaster Tycoon 1 files to ports/openrct2/RCT1.

opensupaplex.title: OpenSupaplex
opensupaplex.descHtml: OpenSupaplex is a 1:1 reimplementation of the original game in C and SDL, with just a few changes to make it easy to use with game controllers, and also easy to port to any platform.
opensupaplex.instHtml: All files are included and game is ready to play. Every levelset requires a there to be a player created. Levelset 1 had a premade PLAYER1 created but all others will require you to create a new one. You can use start + dpad down to enter text input mode.

opensyobon.title: OpenSyobon
opensyobon.descHtml: An SDL-based cross-platform port of Syobon Action

openttd.title: OpenTTD
openttd.descHtml: OpenTTD is an open source simulation game based upon Transport Tycoon Deluxe which was originally released in November of 1994.
openttd.instHtml: Everything is included and ready to run.

opentyrian.title: OpenTyrian
opentyrian.descHtml: OpenTyrian is an open-source port of the DOS game Tyrian.
opentyrian.instHtml: OpenTyrian 2.1 files are already included as they were made freeware sometime ago.

openxcom.title: OpenXcom Extended
openxcom.descHtml: OXCE is an open source engine for running XCOM:Ufo Defense and Terror From the Deep.
openxcom.instHtml: You will need to provide your own UFO Defense/TFTD game files. Read the README-port.txt file for details.

operationsteel.title: Operation S.T.E.E.L
operationsteel.descHtml: A roguelike shmup with hand drawn graphics, procedurally generated levels, enemies, and pickups.
operationsteel.instHtml: Purchase at itch.io "OR" Steam -Locate OperationSTEEL.pck and place it in to ./operationsteel folder.

operius.title: Operius
operius.descHtml: Operius is a game where you shoot and dodge enemies inside a tunnel while going through an infinite amount of levels!

operiusdx.title: Operius DX
operiusdx.descHtml:
Blast off into Operius DX, the ultimate evolution of the popular, retro-inspired, high-speed arcade shooter, Operius! Navigate twisting polygonal tunnels, battle endless waves of enemies, and face off against challenging bosses across infinite sectors. Each run in this game offers a fresh, action-packed challenge. In a world where all computers have suddenly lost their internet connections, it’s up to you to enter the mysterious UFO looming in the sky, explore its depths, and reclaim digital freedom for all! This enhanced version of the classic brings improved visuals, reworked difficulty, new game modes, new color schemes, and much more!

Note:Currently only works with the Itch.io version
operiusdx.instHtml:
Ready to Run! Game comes with demo files courtesy of Mors!
For the full game, purchase and download operius-dx-windows.zip from Itch.io and place the zip in ports/operiusdx/ OR the game files into ports/operiusdx/assets.

oquonie.title: Oquonie
oquonie.descHtml:
A textless isometric puzzle game.

You must make your way through a seemingly endless succession of rooms. You will not be alone. Your incarnations will have the help of bizaroid characters that speak an obscure language.
oquonie.instHtml: Place oquonie.rom from https://hundredrabbits.itch.io/oquonie into the oquonie folder.

orbo.title: orbo
orbo.descHtml: Use your orbit to move around. Simple, yet challenging single button game.

orcishskies.title: Orcish Skies
orcishskies.descHtml: Orcish Skies blends Roguelike deckbuilding, turn-based, Slay The Spire-styled gameplay with a grid-based map. Fire a missile into a cluster of enemies. Rain down lightning on an enemy Carrier from afar. Fly past a swarm of frigates to pick off the sniper shooting you from across the map.
orcishskies.instHtml: Purchase the game on Steam and copy all games files into assets folder. You can also use the free demo.

orthodon.title: Orthodon
orthodon.descHtml:
Journey throughout the abandoned human earth to get back home! Play as Otto, a magician sent on a challenge under the threat of losing his powers.

Use the power of gravity to affect your surroundings and manipulate the world so you can reach the portal in 30+ stages, but be careful, Otto's powers can be as life saving as they can be dangerous!

osanasrevenge.title: Osana's Revenge
osanasrevenge.descHtml: Osana's Revenge is a top down shooter filled with memes and private jokes arisen from Yandere Simulator drama and development setbacks, in particular, its first rival (Osana Najimi) being delayed for multiple years. However, you don't have to be familiar with all of this in order to play and enjoy it.
osanasrevenge.instHtml: Add the .solarus file from here: https://metaquarius.itch.io/osanas-revenge to the ports/osanasrevenge folder.

osmos.title: Osmos
osmos.descHtml: Osmos is a serene, physics‑based puzzle game where you control a tiny “mote” that grows by absorbing smaller ones while avoiding larger predators, all propelled by ejecting your own mass to move. Each level challenges you to balance growth and movement, with 72 stages set across ambient, sentient, antimatter, and gravitational-force environments, accompanied by a hypnotic electronic soundtrack and minimalist visuals.
osmos.instHtml:
This port is compatible with the Demo or Full version from https://osmos-game.com and the Steam version. (Steam version not compatible with TrimUI devices).

Free demo:

  • Download the latest linux demo: https://www.hemispheregames.com/latest_osmos_demo_linux_deb
  • Place the .deb file in "osmos/installer/webdemo"

Full version from website:

  • Purchase the game on https://www.osmos-game.com/
  • Download the latest linux deb installer
  • Place the .deb file in "osmos/installer/webfull"

Steam version:

  • Purchase the game on Steam or activate your steam key from Humble
  • Enable the steam console by typing steam://open/console in your web browser
  • enter the following "download_depot 29180 29183 1530492746741201567"
  • find the folder "depot_29183" and copy the files within it to "osmos/installer/steam"

ot.title: Ot
ot.descHtml: Autumn arrived; now Ot must gather the leaves. A 2D grid-based puzzle game with 22 levels.

ottomatic.title: Otto Matic
ottomatic.descHtml: This is Pangea Software’s Otto Matic. Take control of the robot Otto Matic and save earth from aliens from Planet X

ottostennisgame.title: Otto's Tennis game
ottostennisgame.descHtml: A two-player, one-button Pong with gravity. Press the button to jump, or spam it to fly. Aim for boost shots by hitting the centre of your paddle, and score by sending the ball past your opponent. Choose a mode, or let Random mix it up.

outofammo.title: Out of Ammo
outofammo.descHtml: A mix of retro shmup (think Judgement Silversword) and breakout, in the style of something like The Lost Shield or Wizorb, with aesthetics hugely inspired by ZeroRanger (because it's brilliant, and green+orange goes well with EVERYTHING).

outlawn.title: OutlawN
outlawn.descHtml: Are you ready for 16 levels of OLD WEST LAWN MOWIN' ACTION!? Are you a bad enough buddeh to fight 4 types of lawmen AND snakes while takin' care of a LAWN?! Well, OutlawN is for you!
outlawn.instHtml: Download free at itch.io Copy data.win into gamedata folder.

overbowed.title: Overbowed
overbowed.descHtml: Explore a magic-corrupted kingdom in this Game Boy-inspired metroidvania featuring fluid bow combat, interconnected ruins, and secrets to uncover as you fight servants of the Dark Sorcerer.
overbowed.instHtml: Purchase the game from itch.io or Steam and download. Extract (if itch.io). Copy the game files to the overbowed/assets directory. Alternatively, you could play the DEMO version (also on the itch.io page).

overgun.title: OverGun
overgun.descHtml: OverGun is a shoot'em up 2D platform where your character’s weapon is bigger than he can handle! Take control of the crazy pixeled shooter to help him keep control of his gun and bullets through the dungeon.

overwrite.title: Overwrite
overwrite.descHtml: Push batteries and open gates. Take pictures and change your surroundings. Restore power.

owlboy.title: Owlboy
owlboy.descHtml: A story-driven platform adventure game, where you can fly and explore a brand new world in the clouds. Text is not readable on devices with screens less than 5 inches.
owlboy.instHtml: You must have a copy of Owlboy for Linux copied to the ports/owlboy/gamedata folder.

oxytone.title: Oxytone
oxytone.descHtml: Oxytone is the ultimate puzzle game, equally easy to learn and challenging to master. Are you ready for a unique adventure like no other? Oxytone invites you to explore the depths of your mind while offering a tranquil escape from the hustle and bustle of everyday life for those seeking relaxation. For more determined players, there are 99 challenges, colorful themes to unlock, and 12 meticulously designed maps.
oxytone.instHtml: Purchase on Steam or Itch.io and copy game files into assets folder. You can also use demo versions.

pachi.title: Pachi el Marciano
pachi.descHtml: Pachi el marciano is a platform game inspired by games like Manic Miner and Jet Set Willy from the legend Mathew Smith. The goal of the game is to collect all the objects of each level, when this is met, the exit gate to the next stage will appear and you can pass through.

pachycefalosaurus.title: Pachycefalosaurus
pachycefalosaurus.descHtml:
HIT. EVERYTHING.

In this parody of Dinosaur Game (or Chrome Dino), you are a Pachycefalosaurus (one of those dinosaurs with the super-tough skulls) and, instead of dodging the obstacles, you have to hit them all! Headbutt your way through this comical endless runner!

paintedheart.title: Painted Heart
paintedheart.descHtml: Near the village of Appleby, a young and aspiring painter, Corbin, is prodded into the cathedral’s painting to cleanse the vibrant world from cultural extinction by the Pestilence. To this day, nobody knows where the Pestilence had come from, and Corbin is even less sure how he can help restore the infected painting.
paintedheart.instHtml: go to https://rmn.rmarchiv.de/ or https://archive.org/details/rpgmaker-net-game-archive(first site recommended) and search "Painted Heart" and download Painted Heart.exe. rename .exe to .zip and extract the gamedata. Place these extracted files into the "gamedata" folder.

panicroom.title: Panic Room
panicroom.descHtml: You are a skeleton in a very small dungeon, and more traps keep appearing. You have no choice but to delay your inevitable doom by collecting as many coins as possible... or do you? How long can you last? Where are these spikes coming from? Will you ever be free?
panicroom.instHtml: Download PANIC ROOM v1.1.0.exe from https://ghostomato.itch.io/panic-room and place it in the /ports/panicroom/ folder. On first startup, the game will patch and put the files in the appropriate places.

panzerpaladin.title: Panzer Paladin
panzerpaladin.descHtml: The sinister Ravenous and his legions of brutal demons are poised for battle. The situation is dire, but humanity has one final ace in the hole: the Panzer Paladin!
panzerpaladin.instHtml: Copy all the files from your Steam Windows copy of the game to /roms/ports/panzerpaladin/gamedata. PanzerPaladin.exe, a bunch of dll files and the Content folder should be directly inside of gamedata

papersplease.title: Papers, Please
papersplease.descHtml:
Congratulations. The October labor lottery is complete. Your name was pulled. For immediate placement, report to the Ministry of Admission at Grestin Border Checkpoint. An apartment will be provided for you and your family in East Grestin. Expect a Class-8 dwelling. Glory to Arstotzka.

Content warning: "Papers, Please" includes brief pixel-art violence and pixel-art nudity. The narrative reflects mature themes related to crime, smuggling, immigration, and border control.
papersplease.instHtml: Purchase the game on Steam and use the Steam console to download Linux version 1.2.76 using this command: download_depot 239030 239033 4681415496149094331. Other versions are not compatible. Put PapersPlease and surrounding files/folders in ports/papersplease/gamedata/.

parsec47.title: PARSEC47
parsec47.descHtml: PARSEC47 is a retromodern hi-speed shoot 'em up where you get to defeat retro enemies modernly. The player must destroy enemies while avoiding their projectiles and collecting green clusters of boxes for points.
parsec47.instHtml:
Select the stage by a keyboard or a joystick. Press a shot key to start the game. All stages are endless and created randomly each time. The game continues until you lose all ships.

Control your ship and destroy enemies. While holding a slow key, the ship becomes slow.

passage.title: Passage
passage.descHtml:
Passage is a five-minute experimental art game that metaphorically represents an entire human lifetime, allowing players to navigate a pixelated world while exploring themes of love, aging, and mortality.

The game only lasts 5 minutes. If you don't get the point at first, please keep playing.

pathofachra.title: Path of Achra
pathofachra.descHtml: Path of Achra is a dark fantasy roguelike of the ancient earth, with a focus on streamlined controls and rapid hero customization. A "broken build sandbox." Fight through the deadly lands of Achra to reach the horrors of the Obelisk, and discover what lies beyond...
pathofachra.instHtml: Either download the free demo or purchase the game on Steam and place the PathofAchra.pck in the port's Gamedata folder.

paused.title: PAUSED
paused.descHtml: What do ducks have to do with rabbits? Exactly, adventure and physics stuff are what you're looking for!
paused.instHtml: Game files are already included and ready to go.

pekka-kana-2.title: Pekka Kana 2
pekka-kana-2.descHtml: Pekka Kana 2 (Pekka the Rooster 2) is a jump 'n run game made in the spirit of old classic platformers such as Super Mario, Sonic the Hedgehog, Jazz Jackrabbit, Super Frog and so on.
pekka-kana-2.instHtml: Pekka Kana 2 files are already included and ready to go.

penguneverleft.title: Pengu Never Left
penguneverleft.descHtml: Fish and relax as the days pass by; maybe you'll fish up something interesting? There's plenty to fish up, unlock and discover!
penguneverleft.instHtml: Purchase the game from itch.io. Download the Windows version and copy Pengu Never Left.exe to the penguneverleft/gamedata folder.

penguincommand.title: Penguin Command
penguincommand.descHtml: This is a clone of the classic "Missile Command" Game, but it has better graphics and music. The gameplay has only been slightly modified.
penguincommand.instHtml: Ready to run! Beware that the Start of the game via R1 can take a second.

pentasma.title: Pentasma
pentasma.descHtml: Pentasma is a side-scrolling arcade shooter inspired by Williams Electronics' 1981 classic 'Defender'. Protect The terraforming Humanoids from the deadly Aliens and raid the Alien planets to keep the galaxy peaceful!

ppengui.title: Pepper Pengui
ppengui.descHtml:
It looks like the penguin is having a bad day. Flaming thugs have cut off your nap and now are destroying the silent cave.

Help the penguin to end the party before things get too hot!

HOW TO PLAY

Eliminate all invaders using your egg bomb, but beware of hot areas as you will have difficulty moving through them.

You can restore the ice using your snotty sneeze. It will undo the heat and can also block enemies.

In case you end up getting stuck, sneeze over a block to break it. Use the bomb timer to your advantage.. also it is possible to push it forward in order to make a surprise attack!

perfectdark.title: Perfect Dark
perfectdark.descHtml:
A corporation is planning a conspiracy against mankind. A single woman dares to face the threat. That woman is Joanna Dark!

This is a build of the decompilation and port to modern platforms of the Nintendo 64 classic.
perfectdark.instHtml: Copy your original N64 Perfect Dark ROM to ports/perfectdark. It must be version ntsc-final/US V1.1/US Rev 1, with md5sum e03b088b6ac9e0080440efed07c1e40f. Other versions will not work. You can check the md5sum using online tools.

permanence.title: Permanence
permanence.descHtml: Objects with solid outlines are in your line of sight, objects with dashed outlines are not. Keep things out of your line of sight to leave them the way they were. You can move forwards and backwards or rotate.
permanence.instHtml: Ready to run. Thanks Steven Miller for creating this game and permitting PortMaster to distribute the files.

psrl.title: Phantasy Star RL
psrl.descHtml: A love letter to a classic RPG title from Master System with a roguelike twist! Recruit a party of up to four characters, choosing from a variety of race and class options, and make your way through twenty procedurally generated first person dungeons. Developed by Requinnzious for the Seven Day Roguelike Challenge 2024.

phasingpuller.title: Phasing Puller
phasingpuller.descHtml: Make your way using a Phasing Puller! By phasing through objects, this tool can pull and fasten physical objects to the bypassed item from the other side. Despite achieving a remarkable advance in technology, the facility now appears to be forlorn. Enveloped by a desolate atmosphere, an android sets out.

pigeon.title: Pigeon Ascent
pigeon.descHtml: Optimized for 4:3 640x480 and 5:3 1920x1152. Take care of your own pigeon as they fight increasingly stronger foes, and then face the legendary Pigeon God at the end... can you keep death far from your bird?
pigeon.instHtml: Pigeon Ascent files are already included and ready to go.

pigments.title: Pigments
pigments.descHtml: Be a fruit locked in a room, dodge circular saws and paint as much of the level as you can! It's a pretty addictive score-attack game with very short runs, perfect for a coffee break!
pigments.instHtml: Purchase the game on Itch.io or Steam. For Itch.io, download the MacOS version and extract the game files into gamedata folder. For Steam, download the MacOS depot via the Steam console using this command: download_depot 2339080 2339082 577923055002199486, then copy the files into gamedata folder.

pillarsofdust.title: Pillars of Dust
pillarsofdust.descHtml: n this retro-style RPG, Prince Carlton and pauper Gregg must make their separate ways through a mysterious land to learn their origins - and find some nuggets along the way.
pillarsofdust.instHtml: Buy and download the game from Steam and copy all game files into the assets folder.

pinballcrush.title: Pinball Crush
pinballcrush.descHtml: A cozy GBA inspired pinball game with a dating sim progress system. Hit specific targets to access cutscenes and events with your date. There are 300+ unique events to explore, so you'll always have something new!

pinball_disc_room.title: Pinball Disc Room
pinball_disc_room.descHtml: How did you end up in this pinball of death? The blades teleport in. Dodge the discs to survive. Knock down the popups to open the passage way but beware you can't control when you exit.

pingo.title: Pingo
pingo.descHtml: Pingo is a puzzle game in which your goal is to paint the whole level in as little steps as possible. Try to earn all 3 stars in 60 hand crafted levels!

pingus.title: Pingus
pingus.descHtml: Pingus is a free clone of the popular Lemmings game. Your goal is to guide a horde of penguins through a world full of obstacles and penguin traps to safety. Although penguins (unlike lemmings) are rather smart, they sometimes lack the necessary overview and now rely on you to save them.

pinky.title: Pinky
pinky.descHtml: This game follows the untold journey of Pinky, the tiny slime from Terraria. Next time you slay Pinky, pause -- if only for a moment -- to reflect on the adventures, hardships, and quiet heroism that led him to that final encounter.
pinky.instHtml: Download the Pinky.zip version for free at itch.io. Extract the .zip, and copy the game files to this port's gamedata folder.

pipflipparadise.title: Pip Flip Paradise
pipflipparadise.descHtml:
Flip the floor, roll the dice and be ready to adapt to changing situations as you find your own solution!

Collect bells by flipping floor tiles and dodging hazards. Watch out, however, as flipping six tiles will re-roll them into different forms that may help or hinder your progress!

pippubaublequest.title: Pippu - Bauble Quest
pippubaublequest.descHtml: Take Pippu on an epic platforming adventure to defeat the nefarious Obkins and retrieve the stolen Baubles! Run, climb and swim your way through 14 worlds to bash the baddies and save your planet.
pippubaublequest.instHtml: Purchase the full game at itch.io. Download the Pippu (Zipped Folder) version and extract the .zip, and copy the game files to this port's gamedata folder.

pixeldescent.title: Pixel Descent
pixeldescent.descHtml: An action rogue-lite in which you navigate a series of complex dungeons packed to the brim with monsters that want you dead. Sign the contract and descend into the deepest depths of the abyss knowing full well that you will definitely die there, it's just a matter of when.
pixeldescent.instHtml: Purchase the game at https://jc-bailey.itch.io/pixel-descent, download and extract it, and copy the game files to the pixeldescent/gamedata folder.

pixelskaterdude.title: Pixel Skater Dude
pixelskaterdude.descHtml: A simple skateboarding game made with Gameboy spec's. Very much a prototype but playable.
pixelskaterdude.instHtml: Go to https://jmation.itch.io/pixel-skater-dude and download Pixel_Skater_Dude_v0.6.zip un-zip that and put data.win into ports/pixelskaterdude/assets

pixelwheels.title: Pixel Wheels
pixelwheels.descHtml: Pixel Wheels is a free, top‑down retro-style arcade racer featuring dozens of creative tracks and a variety of vehicles with unique characteristics. Players can collect fun bonuses like missiles, guns, and mines to jostle rivals and scramble their path to the finish line.
pixelwheels.instHtml: Ready to run! If you wish to update the game, just replace "gamefiles/pixelwheels.jar" with your updated file.

pizzatower.title: Pizza Tower
pizzatower.descHtml: Pizza Tower is a fast paced 2D platformer, with an emphasis on movement, exploration and score attack. Featuring highly stylized pixel art inspired by the cartoons from the '90s, and a highly energetic soundtrack.
pizzatower.instHtml: Purchase the game on Steam and copy all game data to pizzatower/assets.

plague.title: Plague
plague.descHtml: PLAGUE is heavily inspired on Gargoyle's Quest for the original Gameboy. It's a platformer where you can control a plague doctor, throwing explosive potions and dashing mid-air.

planetd4rk.title: Planet D4RK
planetd4rk.descHtml: This game takes heavy inspiration from games like Celeste and Katana Zero. The game creator's speedrun PB is 5:17.399, so see if you can beat that time!
planetd4rk.instHtml: Ready to run. Thanks to Abhi Sundu for creating this great game and kindly PortMaster granting permission to distribute the game files.

planetmerge.title: Planet Merge
planetmerge.descHtml: Suika game with celestial bodies! Merge planets, moons, and more to create massive cosmic objects and rack up high scores.

planetwaves.title: Planet Waves
planetwaves.descHtml: An arcade tower defense about protecting a small planet made for the gotm.io jam #3 by Escada Games

plantsvszombiesnd.title: Plants vs Zombies Neighborhood Defense
plantsvszombiesnd.descHtml: Plants vs Zombies Neighborhood Defense is a PVZ fangame with high difficulty and new content!

pvz_portable.title: Plants Vs Zombies Portable
pvz_portable.descHtml:
Features: _ Full controller support - Adventure mode fully playable - Vasebreaker, Whack a Zombie, and other minigames

Fan port (original game by PopCap/EA)

Original PvZPortable source code: https://github.com/wszqkzqk/PvZ-Portable
pvz_portable.instHtml: Provide the main.pak file and properties/ folder from a legal copy of Plants vs. Zombies GOTY into the pvz_portable folder.

plaqueattackremake.title: Plaque Attack Remake
plaqueattackremake.descHtml: Optimized for 4:3 and 16:9 (or similar ex. rg552). Could scale weirdly on gameboy like aspect ratio. Atari 2600's Plaque Attack game remake made for Highjam #1 by Escada Games.
plaqueattackremake.instHtml: Plaque attack Remake files are already included and ready to go. To Force a particular version rename the desired one in the installation folder as PlaqueAttackRemake.zip and delete the other one, then boot.

pleasedonttouchanything.title: Please, Don't Touch Anything
pleasedonttouchanything.descHtml: Please, Don’t Touch Anything is a cryptic, brain-racking button-pushing simulation. Covering for a colleague who is taking a bathroom break, you find yourself in front of a mysterious panel which only component is a red button. And since you’ve clearly been instructed not to touch anything, the only thing you want to do now is push that damn button. Push it and expect to be held liable for any unintended aftermath. And there will be many.
pleasedonttouchanything.instHtml: 1. Download the latest port version. 2. Download the game from Itch.io. 3. Transfer data.win to the pleasedonttouchanything/gamedata folder. 4. Enjoy the game! :)

plugaway.title: Plug Away
plugaway.descHtml: Get to the end of each stage without touching any walls! Reach the outlet and complete the circuit!
plugaway.instHtml: Visit the itch.io page 'https://dechro.itch.io/plug-away' and download 'Plug Away! Windows' version of the game. Unzip the folder and COPY the 'plugaway.pck' file into the gamedata folder. Launch The Game.

plumberssdl.title: Plumbers Don't Wear Ties
plumberssdl.descHtml: Plumbers Don't Wear Ties is an adult-oriented "romantic comedy" visual novel/dating sim developed by United Pixtures and published by Kirin Entertainment for the 3DO Interactive Multiplayer. Although the game did have a Microsoft Windows version, it had very limited distribution and was published by United Pixtures itself. The game stars Edward J. Foster and Jeanne Basone as John and Jane, respectively; two people who are being pressured by their respective parents to go out and find a spouse. The player's task is to get John and Jane together.
plumberssdl.instHtml: This port requires the pc version. Copy GAME.BIN and folders SC00 - SC32 and SC99 to the DATA folder

plunderislands.title: Plunder Islands
plunderislands.descHtml: A fast paced 2D platformer, Plunder Islands has you running, jumping and climbing for treasure. Are you ready for the challenges the islands reveal?
plunderislands.instHtml: Purchase the game on Steam https://store.steampowered.com/app/2279370/Plunder_Islands/ and copy the Plunder Islands.pck into the gamedata folder.

pockettactics.title: Pocket Tactics
pockettactics.descHtml:
A GameBoy themed reimplementation of Tiny Tactics

After the collapse of human civilization, rogue warriors fight for scraps on the surface, fighting for what few remnants they can find from the old world, and sheltering in caves from the chemically modified rain that pours like thick soup onto the landscape below.

pocketwondersport.title: Pocket Wonder Sport
pocketwondersport.descHtml: 10 totally not bootleg games in 1 cartridge file! Inspired by weird rom collections on pirate multicarts, but hopefully with a tiny bit more quality.
pocketwondersport.instHtml: All game files are included. Thanks to Harley Wilson at https://hwilson.itch.io/pocket-wonder-sport for creating the game and allowing us to distribute.

postvoid.title: Post Void
postvoid.descHtml: Post Void is a hypnotic scramble of early first-person shooter design that values speed above all else. Keep your head full and reach the end; Kill what you can to see it mend; Get the high score or try again.
