postvoid.instHtml: Purchase the game from steam. Download the latest version of the game and place the all game files from /Post Void into ports/postvoid/assets

postal.title: Postal
postal.descHtml: Postal is a 1997 isometric shoot 'em up where players control the "Postal Dude" as he commits mass murder in Paradise, Arizona, progressing by killing a set percentage of armed hostiles per level.
postal.instHtml:
1. Download Postal from either GOG or Steam.
  2. Locate the res folder and POSTAL.INI file inside your installed game directory.
  3. Copy the res folder and the POSTAL.INI file and paste it inside the postal/ folder in the ports/ directory on your device.

powder.title: Powder
powder.descHtml: A roguelike is a dungeon crawler where no two games are the same. The maps are different, the items are different, there are no guaranteed win paths.
powder.instHtml: Powder files are already included and ready to go.

powerlevel.title: Power Level
powerlevel.descHtml: You have 5 minutes to explore a randomly generated dungeon and gear up for a tough boss fight. Search for treasure, upgrades, and that glorious EXP in this quick-paced action game!
powerlevel.instHtml: Download Power Level v1.2.zip from Itch.io and place it into /ports/powerlevel/assets.

powerputtlegend.title: PowerPutt Legend
powerputtlegend.descHtml: PowerPutt Legend is a unique minigolf game with RPG elements, meant to look and feel like it's straight out of the NES. Slay monsters, level up, and unlock a series of items to improve your strategy.
powerputtlegend.instHtml: Ready to run! Thanks to Team Bugulon granting us permission to distribute.

prehistorik.2.title: Prehistorik 2
prehistorik.2.descHtml: A caveman-era platform game using the Blues Brothers game engine developed by Titus Interactive.
prehistorik.2.instHtml: Includes the demo files. You can add your own full game Dos files to the ports/prehistorik2/gamedata folder.

prisnhax.title: Prisnhax
prisnhax.descHtml: A relaxing yet challenging puzzle game where you hack prison locks using beams of light. Place mirrors, prisms, and splitters to redirect and manipulate lasers, unlocking cells across 50 intricately designed levels.
prisnhax.instHtml: Purchase the full game at itch.io. Download and extract the .zip, and copy the game files to this port's gamedata folder.

proborush.title: Probo Rush
proborush.descHtml: Probo Rush is a classic shoot 'em up bullet hell game with a boss rush twist. Fight against machines, aliens, and nature as you take on 15 challenging boss battles. With adjustable health and an Assist Mode, Probo Rush offers a challenging but accessible gaming experience.
proborush.instHtml: Purchase the game on Steam and copy all the game files into the assets folder.

professorlucifer.title: Professor Lucifer
professorlucifer.descHtml: "What lurks behind these walls remains untold... Wandering through the darkness of night with his lantern in hand, What does Lucifer desire enough to brave the pitch black?"
professorlucifer.instHtml: Go to RowanFutures itch page here: https://rowanfuture.itch.io/gbjam12 Download 'Professor Lucifer Desktop.zip' then extract the folder and COPY 'ProfessorLucifer.pck' into the root of the portfolder. Launch The Game!

projectshmoop.title: Project S.H.M.O.O.P
projectshmoop.descHtml: Project S.H.M.O.O.P is a horizontal shoot-em-up (shmup) that hearkens back to shmups of the 90's. It features 5 levels, 14 bosses, 2 playable ships, and 0 original assets.
projectshmoop.instHtml: Download the Shmoop.rar from Itch.io and extract Shmoop.exe into assets folder.

projectstarship.title: Project Starship
projectstarship.descHtml: Project Starship is an arcade bullet-hell with random mechanics. No match will ever be the same. Who will you be? Garret or Gwen? Will you save the world from the mighty cthulhu?
projectstarship.instHtml: Purchase at Steam place project_starship.exe into assets folder.

starfighter.title: Project: Starfighter
starfighter.descHtml: Project: Starfighter is a space shoot 'em up game originally developed by Parallel Realities in 2002, and released in 2003. You assume the role of Chris Bainfield in his quest to put an end to WEAPCO, the weapons corporation which has enslaved the galaxy.

prototype.title: Prototype
prototype.descHtml: This is ProtoType, an RType remake from Dark Castle Software. This version compile on OpenPandora, Linux, ODROID and AmigaOS4, has the FMOD dependancy removed (using SDL_mixer instead, but can be re-activated), and has a few fixes in the code. This game now use stb_image for Image Loading.

psebay.title: Psebay
psebay.descHtml: Psebay is an atmospheric adventure in moto trial genre. Features exciting gameplay with dynamic gravity, special atmosphere and unique sound, stunning scenery in silhouette style, and comfortable and easy controls.
psebay.instHtml: Purchase and download the game from Steam and copy all game files into the assets folder. You can also use the free demo

pullchain.title: Pull Chain
pullchain.descHtml: Carry a light source with you. Attract moths, weigh down buttons, and more.

pullywog.title: Pullywog
pullywog.descHtml: Sling yourself through the air by catching flies with your tongue. Eating several things without touching the ground will score you a combo, so try to stay in the air for as long as you can! The timer constantly ticks down; you can eat anything to keep it going a little longer, but watch out for ghosts which are lethal to the touch! You can stop bombs from exploding by eating them before they hit the water.

pulstario.title: Pulstario
pulstario.descHtml:
Pulstario is a small game in which you pilot a ship through the void and collect missing souls. It has challenging moments and hopefully the gameplay is a rewarding experience. From the creator of LOVE and kuso.

Pulstario is a short game that will likely take a player 30 minutes to complete the main game. There are also achievements, secret levels, and unlockable ship skins for the player to earn and collect.

The gameplay for Pulstario has been described as:

"Wobbly Free Range Pac-Man" "Lunar Lander - Without the landing" "Asteroids with gravity" "Luftrausers for Pacifists"
pulstario.instHtml: Purchase and download Pulstario_Linux_DRMFree_V001.zip OR Pulstario_Windows_DRMFree_V001.zip from https://thatsmytrunks.itch.io/pulstario. Copy all the files (game.unx/data.win, options.ini) from /assets or the zip into the pulstario/gamedata folder

pupaipospacedx.title: PuPaiPo Space Deluxe
pupaipospacedx.descHtml:
PuPaiPo Space is a colorful space shoot-em-up in which you travel from Stage to Stage in search of the legendary space pizza. Piloting your trusty spaceship, you will have to battle waves of opponents, dodge hundreds of bullets, pick sweet power ups and face powerful bosses!

Travel through 7 different stages. Jumping from one stage to another requires your space jumping engine to recharge for roughly 90 seconds. During that time you will have to defend yourself from all the opponents in the area and defeat its boss.
pupaipospacedx.instHtml:
Purchase the game from https://bolhut.itch.io/pupaipo-space-deluxe or from https://store.steampowered.com/app/1148500/PuPaiPo_Space_Deluxe/

Itch: Download PuPaiPo Space DX - Linux and copy the game.unx from the assets folder to /ports/pupaipospacedx/gamedata

Steam: Run steam console via Windows+R: Type: steam://open/console, download the linux version by typing: download_depot 1148500 1148502 in the console, when the download is complete, it will tell you the location of the folder, copy the game.unx from the assets folder to /ports/pupaipospacedx/gamedata

puremetal.title: Pure Metal: Feature 1
puremetal.descHtml: Base has been attacked and you are the last hope of saving Pure Metal. Shoot down hoards of enemies and unforgiving bosses in classic shooter style. Touch controls feature smooth analog from the onscreen D-pad. Use the arrow keys and the z and x buttons to shoot the enemy with the keyboard. You have one life to make it through each level, but don't worry your ship can take 3 consecutive hits before being destroyed. Also your ship will regenerate to full power if you can manage to avoid enemy fire long enough. Bob and weave your way through the enemy fire and kill every thing in site. This game is designed to brutally come after you but pay attention and look for the patterns and avoid the onslaught of bullets.
puremetal.instHtml: Just copy the game.win or data.win inside the gamedata folder. Windows store version works too.

push.title: Push!
push.descHtml: A simple game in which you control a rabbit and eat carrots. Push rocks to fill holes and create traversable paths.
push.instHtml: Download the game free at https://yyuta342.itch.io/push, and place the push.pyxapp file in the push/gamedata folder.

putridshotultra.title: Putrid Shot Ultra
putridshotultra.descHtml: A chaotic shoot-em-up roguelite with magic spell casting. Defeat enemies with your gun! Stack tons of passive spells that trigger when you shoot while weaving your unique active spell in between. Blast your enemies with gunfire and magic spells while you dodge through the rubble.
putridshotultra.instHtml: Download the game (demo or full version) https://store.steampowered.com/app/2053360/PUTRID_SHOT_ULTRA/ and copy the exe file into the port folder.

puztrix_playdate.title: Puztrix Playdate
puztrix_playdate.descHtml: Puztrix Playdate is the Playdate version of a remake of the Gravnic game from inside the NES Puzznic game.

puzzlescriptpm.title: PuzzleScript PM
puzzlescriptpm.descHtml: Minimalist, text-based engine for creating grid-based puzzle games, often in the Sokoban style, where simple rules produce deep emergent gameplay. This port includes 50+ games and supports adding more.

pyk.title: Pyk
pyk.descHtml: A quick arcade game of reflexes, precision, and occasional patience. Control a nimble round creature and dodge the relentless Bad Red Shapes -- out to cut, crush, burn, and blast you. Collect keys to unlock blockades and reach the teleporter to escape each level.
pyk.instHtml: You can download Pyk for free at: https://rafalkowalski.itch.io/pyk. Download the Pyk_1.0.zip (Windows) version and extract it, and place the pyk.pck file in the gamedata directory.

pyromind.title: PyroMind
pyromind.descHtml:
The most unforgiving little puzzler you will ever play, PyroMind is a simultaneously turn-based and real-time game full of bombs, explosions and narrow escapes!
Play alone, blow up your friend or challenge a bot in a unique dimension, where everything explodes and one small mistake can blast you to smithereens.

Note: Slowdowns on rk3326 devices!
pyromind.instHtml:
Purchase the game from Steam.
Download the game using the steam console by typing download_depot 695570 695571 2901679312042701621 and place the game files in ports/pyromind/assets.

pyxeljack.title: PyxelJACK
pyxeljack.descHtml: PyxelJack is a card game where the goal is to get a hand value as close to 21 as possible without going over, beating the dealer’s hand to win. It’s all about smart decisions, like when to hit or stand, to outplay the dealer! So its Blackjack but made in Pyxel

qyoblaster.title: Q-YO Blaster
qyoblaster.descHtml: A shooting game with peculiar characters, strange enemies, weapons, and many explosions. Enter the miniature world and stop the threat.
qyoblaster.instHtml: Purchase the game on itch.io: https://teamblackhatrobot.itch.io/q-yo-blastergame -- download the Q-YO BLASTER 1.6.1.1.exe version, install/extract it and copy the game files to the qyoblaster/gamedata folder

q2pro.title: Q2Pro
q2pro.descHtml: Enhanced Quake 2 engine with work-in-progress support for the Nightdive remaster. Includes support for mods/mission packs The Reckoning, Ground Zero, Zaero, and the Nightdive remaster.
q2pro.instHtml: Copy the files from your Quake 2 installation to the matching folders in ports/q2pro. For example, copy the contents of Quake 2/baseq2 into ports/q2pro/baseq2. If you have the Nightdive remaster, copy the contents of its baseq2 folder (Quake 2/rerelease/baseq2) into ports/q2pro/rerelease, and copy Q2Game.kpf to ports/q2pro.

quadrupleback.title: Quadrupleback
quadrupleback.descHtml: A video game where intruders must be circled. It is a clone of the 1982 Doubleback game by Dale Lear for the Tandy Color Computer.

quake.title: Quake 1
quake.descHtml: Quake 1 is one of the first fully 3D First-person shooter games released by id software.
quake.instHtml: Includes shareware pak file. You can add your own full game pak files to the ports/quake/quakepaks/id1 folder.

quake.2.title: Quake 2
quake.2.descHtml: Quake 2 is the sequel to Quake 1, one of the first fully 3D First-person shooter games released by id software.
quake.2.instHtml: You need to add your own full game pak files to the ports/quake2/baseq2 folder and for the expansion packs - ports/quake2/rogue and ports/quake2/xatrix.

quake3.title: Quake 3
quake3.descHtml: Quake III Arena is a 1999 multiplayer-focused first-person shooter developed by id Software.
quake3.instHtml: You need to add your own full game pak files and product key to the ports/quake3/baseq3 folder.

quakespasm.title: Quakespasm
quakespasm.descHtml:
QuakeSpasm is a modern, cross-platform Quake game engine based on FitzQuake. This source port for quake supports many mods, Dimension of the Machine, and Dawn of the Machine.

Quakespasm-for-GL4ES based on jfgomez21-Quakespasm who began modifying Quakespasm to work with GL4ES.
quakespasm.instHtml: You will need to populate the id1, hipnotic, rogue, dopa, ad, mg1, and mg3 directories with your pak files and music tracks. Some users may need to use flac instead of ogg or mp3. It is recommended to use an RK3566 or faster CPU to run Arcane Dimensions, Dimension of the Machine, or Dawn of the Machine.

quarion.title: Quarion
quarion.descHtml: A short 2D pixel-style metroidvania where you explore, fight bosses, aquire items and abilities and find secrets. Inspired by games such as You Have to Win the Game and VVVVVV.
quarion.instHtml: Purchase the game from itch.io or Steam Itch.io: Download Quarion for Windows and place Quarion.exe in ports/quarion Steam: Download the Windows version of the game and place Quarion.exe in ports/quarion

questofgraaldx.title: Quest of Graal DX
questofgraaldx.descHtml: Fast-paced platform racer where players battle through monsters, traps, and magical mayhem to reach the golden cup first. Featuring more than 20 levels inspired by Arthurian legend, it blends cooperation and betrayal with weapons, magic, and powerful golden statues.
questofgraaldx.instHtml: Purchase the game at itch.io. Download the Quest Of Graal LINUX.rar version, extract, and copy the Quest Of Graal LINUX.pck file to the questofgraaldx folder.

quester.title: Quester
quester.descHtml: Assume control of a courageous adventurer and blaze through monster infested mazes. Dance with death as you balance fighting with scavenging for loot and power in this classic-arcade inspired roguelike.
quester.instHtml: Purchase the game on Steam and copy game files into the assets folder.

rwatch.title: R&Watch-Dobtopus
rwatch.descHtml: A tight boss rush that's a challenge without being too brutal. The graphics have a sleek minimalist style with loads of visual flairs.
rwatch.instHtml: -Download at (https//:nizakashii.itch.io/R&Watch)-Extract and place data.win into gamedata folder

raceintospace.title: Race Into Space
raceintospace.descHtml: Free software recreation of Buzz Aldrin's Race into Space, a turn-based strategy game where you run the US or Soviet space program in the race to land on the Moon.
raceintospace.instHtml: Ready to run, no additional files needed. Game data is extracted from data.tar.gz on first launch.

ragingblasters.title: RagingBlasters
ragingblasters.descHtml: Raging Blasters is a vertical scroll shmup featuring high speed scrolling and the exhilaration of destruction.
ragingblasters.instHtml:
Purchase and download the game from: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1464550/RagingBlasters/

Locate your gamefolder and copy all the files from the folder to /ports/ragingblasters/assets

rakuen.title: Rakuen
rakuen.descHtml: Rakuen is an adventure game about a little Boy who lives in the hospital. One day, the Boy asks his Mom to escort him to the fantasy world from his favorite storybook, so that he can ask the Guardian of the Forest to grant him one wish. In order to receive his wish, the Boy must complete a set of challenges that revolve around helping his neighbors in the hospital by interacting with their alter-egos in the fantasy world...
rakuen.instHtml: Add the contents of your rakuen copy into the rakuen/gamedata/ folder.

rambleplanet.title: Ramble Planet
rambleplanet.descHtml: Play as a creature stranded on the hostile planet Badmark, a hostile frontier planet and tourist hotspot. To escape, you must scour the wilderness, ruins, and settlements of this alien world to find replacement parts for your spaceship.
rambleplanet.instHtml: Download the Windows version of the game (for free) here: https://willyelektrix.itch.io/ramble-planet -- extract, and copy the rambleplanet11.rpg file to the port folder.

randungeon.title: Randungeon
randungeon.descHtml: a simple roguelike make for a gamejam
randungeon.instHtml: locate and move pck file to gamedata.

raptor.title: Raptor
raptor.descHtml: Reversed-engineered source port from Raptor Call Of The Shadows
raptor.instHtml: Shareware files are included and game is ready to run. See readme for detailed instructions for full version game files and other configuration options. In the name and callsign section, make sure the crosshair is not on input fields, press start + down to enable text entry. Press start once done to complete entry.

ratcheteerdx.title: Ratcheteer DX
ratcheteerdx.descHtml: Explore the interconnected caverns below the frozen surface and a vast Snowcean above as you set out to rescue friend, foe, and stranger alike in this lo-fi action-adventure!
ratcheteerdx.instHtml: Buy the game on steam and copy linux version game assets to gamedata folder with the following steam console command steam console command: download_depot 3166150 3166153 7362828488398565453, alternatively see the README / website for instructions on installing the macOS Steam or itch.io versions.

ravenshike.title: Raven's Hike
ravenshike.descHtml: Help Raven reach the top of the tower, restoring equilibrium and saving the world from oblivion. Trust on your reflexes or find the safest way through every room, collect all the gems and get out. Who knows what to expect in the next trial? 60+ handcrafted open-ended levels spread through 4 stages filled with puzzles, combat with a dynamic soundtrack by Vincent Colavita.
ravenshike.instHtml: Purchase the game on Steam https://store.steampowered.com/app/1689270/Ravens_Hike and copy the game files into the gamedata folder.

rawgl.title: RAWGL
rawgl.descHtml: A re-implementation of the engine used in the game Another World aka Out of this World in the US.
rawgl.instHtml: Includes the Out of this World demo files. You can add your own full game files to the ports/rawgl/gamedata/ folder. See https://github.com/cyxx/rawgl#supported-versions for more supported files info.

rebound.title: Rebound
rebound.descHtml: Rebound is a side scrolling rpg inspired by Lisa the Painful, BBQ Quest, and Paper Mario.
rebound.instHtml:
Download the game from https://rebound.itch.io/rebound tested with Windows version. Extract fishing update contents to the gamedata folder.

Note: This game is not ideal for devices with low resolution displays and/or absent joysticks.

recursiverun.title: Recursive Run
recursiverun.descHtml: A fast-paced platformer with a speed-run timer, where every level is the previous level + a twist or something new. Made for IcoJam 2024 with the theme of Patterns. Share your scores at itch.io

redhandsomehood.title: Red Handsome Hood
redhandsomehood.descHtml:
Join Red Handsome Hood on his journey, having only his hood, thong and knuckles, there is nothing that can stop this strong man! Or is there? The path is full of dangerous opponents, but he is just as dangerous!

The charming run of an untold tale, but we are not going to tell it, YOU can tell us what you think the story is about!
redhandsomehood.instHtml: This port is ready to run. Special thanks to BolHut games and and Jaime Gifte(@GIFTEador) for allowing the distribution of the game via PortMaster Source: https://bolhut.itch.io/red-handsome-hood

redronin.title: Red Ronin
redronin.descHtml: Red Ronin is a Turn-based but fast paced dash 'n slash game where a bloodthirsty ronin and her companion bot search for revenge.
redronin.instHtml: Purchase the game from steam. Download the game. Place all the game files into ports/redronin/assets

redtrees.title: Red Trees
redtrees.descHtml: In a small town encircled by trees, mysterious events are unfolding. Pet rabbits are going missing, people have been injured, and the townsfolk are whispering about something lurking in the woods... Since none of the adults want to do anything about this, it's going to be up to you to get to the bottom of it. Before you can do that, however, simply getting into the woods might be a problem.
redtrees.instHtml:
Download the game from Itch, https://caramel.itch.io/redtrees tested with Windows version. Copy all assets to the gamedata folder.

Note: This game is not ideal for devices with low resolution displays.

redtrianglesc.title: Red Triangle Super Collection
redtrianglesc.descHtml: Red Triangle Games' collection of short OHRRPGCE games all in one place! With nine great games, there's something for everyone in this collection!
redtrianglesc.instHtml: Ready to run! Thanks to Red Triangle Games for granting permission to distribute the game files.

redneck.rampage.title: Redneck Rampage 1
redneck.rampage.descHtml: Redneck Rampage 1 using the rednukem build open source port by Alexey Khokholov.
redneck.rampage.instHtml: You'll need to add your own full version REDNECK.GRP and REDNECK.RTS and .CON files and optionally CD audio tracks as OGG file in the format trackXX.ogg (where XX is the track number) to the ports/rednukem-redneck1/gamedata folder.

redneck.rampage.rides.again.title: Redneck Rampage 2
redneck.rampage.rides.again.descHtml: Redneck Rampage 2 using the rednukem build open source port by Alexey Khokholov.
redneck.rampage.rides.again.instHtml: You'll need to add your own full version REDNECK.GRP and REDNECK.RTS and .CON files and optionally CD audio tracks as OGG file in the format trackXX.ogg (where XX is the track number) to the ports/rednukem-redneck2/gamedata folder.

redo.title: REDO!
redo.descHtml: REDO! - Dark Sci-Fi Metroidvania inspired by the works of Tsutomu Nihei, Lovecraft and others. REDO! is a game about a girl trying to find another human in a dystopian world overrun by biomachines. It's a lonely and evocative game about exploring the unknown and overcoming obstacles to see what is left.
redo.instHtml: Copy and paste the game assets from your purchased copy of REDO! to the gamedata folder.

redpulse.title: REDPULSE
redpulse.descHtml: REDPULSE is a run 'n gun game inspired by bullet hell shooters that encourages speedy and aggressive gameplay.
redpulse.instHtml: Download the REDPULSE v1.1.zip from Itch.io and extract all files into the assets folder.

relichunters.title: Relic Hunters
relichunters.descHtml: Relic Hunters Zero: Remix is a remaster of the FREE 1 million player hit game about blasting evil space ducks and turtles with tiny cute guns. It's fast, it's tactical, and feels deliciously smooth to play. Unlock new weapons, characters and relics to defeat the Ducan Commander!
relichunters.instHtml: Download game from https://www.gog.com/en/game/relic_hunters_zero_remix, install, copy data.win and .dat files to /ports/relichunters/gamedata

reminiscence.title: Reminiscence
reminiscence.descHtml: A reimplementation of the Flashback game using the reminiscence engine by Alex Chermenin.
reminiscence.instHtml:
You will need the original files of the PC/DOS/Amiga version copied to ports/reminiscence/gamedata folder.

  • Steam or GOG data files can be found in Flashback_Data/StreamingAssets/data, copy these files into the ports/reminiscence/gamedata folder.
  • Amiga audio files (optional) can be copied into the ports/reminiscence/music folder, but the files must be named filename.mod format. Some sources come with files named mod.flashback-filename, which will need to be renamed. e.g. mod.flashback-chute -> chute.mod
  • voice.vce file (optional) for voice acting in cutscenes should be placed in ports/reminiscence/gamedata folder.

remoteplanets.title: Remote Planets
remoteplanets.descHtml:
Remote Planets is a cute, relaxing puzzle game set in a mysterious alien galaxy.
Explore the colorful world, solve logic challenges using unique mechanics and help the friendly cast of villagers restore power to their homes. Reshape the level space with the help of mysterious alien technology.
remoteplanets.instHtml:
Purchase the game from Steam.
Download the game and copy over the game files into ports/remote/planets/assets/

repose.title: REPOSE
repose.descHtml: In the facility, each step, each shot, each mistake costs precious energy. Rendered entirely in black and white, this mystery can be unravelled. The puzzle can be solved. Don't ask who tried to solve it before. Do the job. Find oxygen and sleep. Go deeper. And don't ask about Aaron.
repose.instHtml: Purchase the game on store of your preference (GOG, Steam or Itch.io) and copy all game files into assets folder.

residentvania.title: Residentvania
residentvania.descHtml: "Residentvania" is a fan-made demake of "Resident Evil 8" that reimagines the game in the style of the classic "Castlevania" series. Players control Ethan Winters as he navigates through the castle, battling monsters with gameplay mechanics reminiscent of the NES "Castlevania" games
residentvania.instHtml: Download the game of Itch.io https://oco.itch.io/residentvania . After that extract it and put the data.win into the re8/gamedata folder

resistor.title: Resistor
resistor.descHtml: You play as a public enemy, pursued by a police force who answer to none but themselves, and must prove your innocence before you are caught to escape the clutches of "justice". Resistor is a cyperpunk take on Pac-Man created by John Gabriel for the forty-fifth Godot Wild Jam.

restore.portmaster.title: Restore PortMaster
restore.portmaster.descHtml: Restore PortMaster is a script designed to restore a broken PortMaster installation.
restore.portmaster.instHtml: Download this "Port" then run the "Restore PortMaster.sh" from within your Ports Directory. This will restore PortMaster to the latest stable version with default settings.

retrohighway.title: Retro Highway
retrohighway.descHtml:
Return to the days of pure arcade fun!
Retro Highway is a throwback racing game aiming to combine the accessibility of modern titles with the high-skill challenge and charming aesthetics of old.
retrohighway.instHtml: Purchase the game from Itch.io. Download the Windows version and place RetroHighway.zip in ports/retrohighway/assets.

retrotime.title: Retro Time
retrotime.descHtml: RetroTime is a game containing 8 retro based games playable in 3 game modes being Retro Carousel, Time Attack and Lives mode.
retrotime.instHtml: All files are included and game is ready to play.

retsend.title: retsend
retsend.descHtml: Transfer files between handhelds or your phone and PC over wifi, using the LocalSend protocol — no cable, no SSH.
retsend.instHtml: Ready to run. Install LocalSend on your phone or PC, connect both devices to the same wifi, and they will find each other.

return.title: Return
return.descHtml:
Return to your home planet after 200 years of space travel in this atmospheric, art-driven adventure. Shoot, slash, and roll your way through dangerous enemies and ancient bosses, purchase items and unlock powerful weapons, and explore your unfamiliar home for parts to repair your ship.
Note: Only works with the Steam version!
return.instHtml: Purchase the game from Steam. Download the game and place the game files in ports/return/assets.

iortcw.title: Return to Castle Wolfenstein
iortcw.descHtml: Return to Castle Wolfenstein using the iortcw project. With porting work done by JohnnyonFlame. Packaged by Romadu.
iortcw.instHtml: You'll need to add your own pak0.pk3, sp_pak1.pk3, sp_pak2.pk3, and sp_pak3.pk3 to the ports/iortcw/main folder.

revengeofthetitans.title: Revenge of the Titans
revengeofthetitans.descHtml: Revenge of the Titans is a game by Puppygames that blends tower defense with real-time strategy elements. You defend Earth’s bases from waves of alien “Titans” by building and upgrading turrets, mining resources, and researching new technologies. The game features a lengthy campaign, extensive tech trees, and retro-inspired visuals.
revengeofthetitans.instHtml: Download the Linux version of Revenge of the Titans from Humble Bundle and copy the tar to the install directory (unpacking takes a few minutes on first launch).

revbros.title: Reverse Bros
revbros.descHtml:
Make way for both characters reach the prize

RULES White character only walks on black tiles and vice versa; White character turns black tiles into whites and vice versa;

ri_li.title: Ri-li
ri_li.descHtml: A simple and fun arcade-style game in which you control a wooden toy train and collect wooden letters while avoiding obstacles.

rick.dangerous.title: Rick Dangerous
rick.dangerous.descHtml: An open source implementation of the legendary game "Rick Dangerous" using the xrick libretro retroarch core.

riddledcorpses.title: Riddled Corpses
riddledcorpses.descHtml: Frenetic arcade style twin-stick shooter. Fight your way through hordes of enemies alone or with a friend!
riddledcorpses.instHtml: Purchase at Steam place the data.win and all .ogg files into the assets folder.

rigelengine.title: Rigel Engine
rigelengine.descHtml: A modern re-implementation of the classic DOS game Duke Nukem II.
rigelengine.instHtml: You'll need to add your own full game files to the ports/RigelEngine/ folder.

riptale.title: Riptale
riptale.descHtml: Riptale is a challenging 2D roguelike action game aiming to make sword combat be as bloody and impactful as possible. The player collects gems that allow them to execute different attacks in the order of their choosing. All this results in a symphony of combos that fill the screen with blood and guts.
riptale.instHtml: Purchase from Steam Using only the latest Steam or Windows version, locate game.unx/data.win, audiogroup1.dat & audiogroup2.dat, plus all 8 folders. Place each of those files and folders inside the gamedata folder. Note: no need to rename game.unx

riseofthepenguinsgb.title: Rise of the Penguins GB
riseofthepenguinsgb.descHtml: A retro penguin platformer designed for Gameboy. Perfect for fans of penguins and anyone looking for a moderate challenge in a cold setting!

rott.title: Rise of the Triad
rott.descHtml: An open source port of Rise of the Triad by icculus. The shareware files for the first episode are included. The registered game files will be required to play Dark War.
rott.instHtml: The demo files are already included for the first episode. To play Dark War you will need to provide your DARKWAR.WAD, DARKWAR.RTC, and DARKWAR.RTL game files in the /ports/rott/ directory.

riskofrain.title: Risk of Rain (2013)
riskofrain.descHtml: Risk of Rain is an action platformer with roguelike elements. With permanent death as a primary feature, players will have to play their best to get as far as possible. Fight on a mysterious planet with randomly spawning enemies and bosses.
riskofrain.instHtml: Buy the game on Steam and place all windows assets in "riskofrain/gamedata" folder.

rite.title: RITE
rite.descHtml: RITE is a high-speed precision platformer where you must conquer a series of demanding trials, a rite of passage for every Nim. Find the key and reach the exit to move on to the next trial, and maybe collect some gold along the way. Who knows, they could prove valuable to those who like a brutal challenge..
rite.instHtml: Locate the data.win file from the windows version of RITE. Copy this file to the assets folder.

rlone.title: Rlone: A Rogue Clone
rlone.descHtml:
Rlone is a real-time rogue clone. The result of a 2 week, friendly competition to create a roguelike using whatever tools we desired.

This game features procedural map generation, random weapon and enemy stats, and difficulty and complexity scaling as you descent further into lower floors. It also supports modifications to the graphics, audio, and other things through the config files in "res/cfg/".

rlvm.title: Rlvm (deprecated)
rlvm.descHtml: Rlvm is a Free Software reimplementation of the Key RealLive interpreter for Visual Novels. Notable games include CLANNAD, AIR, & KANON. (Superseeded by dedicated ports for each VN).
rlvm.instHtml: Add your game files to the ports/rlvm/games/GAME_NAME directory, multiple games can be installed and you will get a choice of which game you want to play at launch. HD Releases do not currently work properly.

road.invaders.title: Road Invaders
road.invaders.descHtml: An action game that's part vertical-scrolling racer, part match-2 game. Move your car and punch cubes, matching cubes to shift gear on your way to achieving the highest score!
road.invaders.instHtml: Game files are already included and ready to go.

roadwarriors2.title: Road Warriors 2
roadwarriors2.descHtml: Road Warriors 2 is a vertical, arcade-style shmup inspired by titles like Giga Wing and Ikaruga, with tight, fast-paced gameplay with a focus on getting the highest possible score through a limited number of stages
roadwarriors2.instHtml: Download the Compressed application ZIP from the itch.io https://yaru.itch.io/road-warriors-2 and place it in port's gamedata folder.

rockbot.title: Rockbot
rockbot.descHtml: A game freely inspired by old classic 8-bit jump-and-shoot games style, with some modern here and there. Rockbot and RockDroid were created by Upperlands and were inspired by the old NES MegaMan games.
rockbot.instHtml: Everything is included and ready to run!

rockbox.title: Rockbox
rockbox.descHtml: Rockbox is a free, open-source firmware replacement for digital audio players (DAPs), offering an alternative to the original operating system. It's designed to be highly customizable, with features like advanced equalizers, themes, and support for various file formats.

rockdodger.title: Rockdodger
rockdodger.descHtml: Rock Dodger is a horizontal scrolling action game where you have to navigate your spaceship through a stream of rocks flying in from the right. Your only help is a laser to destroy rocks and a limited amount of shield. This game had once upon in time the 4th place in NoStarch game contest.

rockheads.title: ROCKHEADS
rockheads.descHtml: Stop the pesky Dwarves from mining your town. Take advantage of their own bombs and winch in order to blast them to bits in this Arkanoid styled gameplay.

rocksndiamonds.title: Rocks N Diamonds
rocksndiamonds.descHtml: A Boulderdash type game by Holger Schemel with many unique features, such as the ability to play remade levels from Boulderdash, Emerald Mine and Supaplex and many more levels.

roguelegacy.title: Rogue Legacy
roguelegacy.descHtml: Rogue Legacy is a genealogical rogue-"LITE" where anyone can be a hero. Each time you die, your child will succeed you. Every child is unique. One child might be colorblind, another might be a dwarf with vertigo. But that's OK, because no one is perfect, and you don't have to be to succeed.
roguelegacy.instHtml: Purchase the game. Copy the Content folder from your personal copy of the game to ports/roguelegacy/gamedata.

roguesentry.title: Rogue Sentry
roguesentry.descHtml: Rogue Sentry is a difficult twin-stick adventure shoot-em-up about a sentry droid who turns rogue to save humanity.
roguesentry.instHtml: Purchase the game from itch.io or steam. Download the game. Place all the game files into ports/roguesentry/assets

roguelight.title: Roguelight
roguelight.descHtml: The deeper you travel the darker it gets, and you only have your arrows to light the way.
roguelight.instHtml: Download Roguelight (windows) from https://managore.itch.io/roguelight. Place Roguelight.exe into ports/roguelight.

rollingbird.title: Rolling Bird
rollingbird.descHtml: Rolling Bird is a retro arcade shooter, heavily inspired by Namco's 1986 classic 'Rolling Thunder'.
rollingbird.instHtml: Download the Rolling Bird 1.8.6.zip from Itch.io and extract it into assets folder.

roswyn.title: Roswyn & The Dragons
roswyn.descHtml:
Roswyn and The Dragons is an exciting Action-RPG game (with direct combat). As Roswyn, your goal (you don't know exactly why, but it's not important :) ) will be to defeat the 9 dragons to save the world (once again...).

In your quest, you'll travel through 500 levels(screens) including plains, marshes, dungeons, caves, mountains and much more. You'll get more and more powerful by finding new heart-pieces, or by upgrading your sword to crush pots and rocks or even throw fireballs !!
roswyn.instHtml: 1-2-3 are mapped to Y-X-A and attack on B!

rota.title: ROTA
rota.descHtml: Rotate gravity as you walk over the edge! Push, pull and rotate gravity-blocks to traverse the stage and solve puzzles. Collect all 50 gems to unlock doors and explore 8 vibrant worlds! Listen to an original ambient soundtrack that will keep you relaxed while solving challenging puzzles. (: Watch out for spikes! 0:

rotationalshift.title: Rotational Shift
rotationalshift.descHtml: A team of workers are tasked with processing boxes and have to meet the quota in the time limit. The catch? Every time the wheel spins, a worker is selected at random to work the next shift. With such short margins, all workers must play a part in helping each other be as effective as possible, so that no second is wasted.
rotationalshift.instHtml: Download game from https://gleeson.itch.io/rotational-shift. Place data.win in /ports/rotationalshift/gamedata

rrootage.title: rRootage
rrootage.descHtml: rRootage is an arcade-style vertical shooting game, with music to match. Avoid the barrage of bullets and destroy the enemy's battle ship with your laser. rRootage has 40 levels, each playable in four different modes.

runmaverick.title: Run Maverick, Run!
runmaverick.descHtml: Run Maverick, Run! is a game about my dog, Maverick, who never stops running and eating. The game was made in 48 hours for the Patch Notes v1.0 Jam.

russiansubwaydogs.title: Russian Subway Dogs
russiansubwaydogs.descHtml: A fast-paced arcade game inspired by the real-life stray dogs of the Moscow metro. Juggle vodka, bark fire, cook bears, and more! Can you steal enough food to survive?
russiansubwaydogs.instHtml: Download the game from https://store.steampowered.com/app/762610/Russian_Subway_Dogs/ copy all the game files to /ports/russiansubwaydogs/assets

rustyseas.title: Rusty Seas
rustyseas.descHtml: A retro-style game reminiscent of the 16-bit console era with a splash of 90s computer gaming. You play as Mirig, a diner waitress who takes an offer to collect high-tech salvage from the beaches of Northshore, competing with a colourful cast of adversaries. Features action gameplay, visual novel story segments, and isometric pixel art.
rustyseas.instHtml: Copy data.win from your purchased copy of Rusty Seas (itch.io or Steam) into the rustyseas/assets/ folder before launching.

rvgl.title: RVGL
rvgl.descHtml: An open source port of Re-Volt by the RV Team.
rvgl.instHtml: Necessary files will be downloaded and installed upon initial launch while connected to the internet.

sadgod.title: SAD GOD
sadgod.descHtml: In this platformer-shooter-roguelike, we invite you to descend into a pit of monsters and traps. Gain strength from coins, and weapons from altars. Touch an orb. Then race to the surface before the lava gets you.
sadgod.instHtml: Purchase on itch.io, download, extract, and copy sadgod.exe to the sadgod port folder.

salvagette.title: Salvagette
salvagette.descHtml: Turn-based bullet-hell class warfare! Swipe to move in each of the four directions. Ram into things to destroy them, but avoid the dangerous projectiles.

samuraibrothers.title: Samurai Brothers
samuraibrothers.descHtml: Samurai Brothers is a fast paced shared-screen multiplayer game. In addition to the solo mode, two modes are available for multiplayer games. Do you want to fight against your friends ? Or work as a team against the multitude of enemies ?
samuraibrothers.instHtml:
Download for FREE and install "Samurai Brothers" from STEAM.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3403860/Samurai_Brothers/

Once installed, in your library, right click "Manage-Browse Local Files" COPY the Samurai-Brothers-v1-2.pck into the GameData Folder.

sandtrix.title: Sandtrix
sandtrix.descHtml: Sandtrix is a retro falling sand puzzle game that puts a unique twist on Tetris-style gameplay: When blocks land, they dissolve into sand with realistic physics, filling spaces around them. To clear lines, you must connect the same color of sand from wall to wall across the screen, making it more challenging than traditional block-stacking games.
sandtrix.instHtml:
Free Version (Itch.io): - Download the game (Linux version) from https://mslivo.itch.io/sandtrix - Place the tar.gz file in sandtrix/gamefiles/ - First startup can take a while, as files need to be extracted

Paid version / Demo Version (Steam): - Purchase the game from https://store.steampowered.com/app/2546310/Sandtrix/ (Or get the demo) - Download the game and locate the folder with the game files - Look for the .jar file and place it in sandtrix/gamefiles

santassurprise.title: Santa's Surprise
santassurprise.descHtml: 'Twas the morning of Christmas Eve. The whole North Pole was preparing for the big night of present delivering and joy giving. Only Santa was nowhere to be seen... He was out in the forest on a very important mission - to get a present for Mrs. Claus. She had always wanted a cute little puppy, but there was only one problem - the workshop didn't make any puppies! So this year Santa ventured deep into the woods to meet with a local sled owner and adopt one of his adorable little huskies. It won't be easy, but it will be worth it to make the one he loves happy.

saprophyte.title: SAPROPHYTE
saprophyte.descHtml: A scifi stealth horror inspired by Zygote (Oats Studios), The Thing, Alien, etc... and graphically inspired by Laser Squad for the Spectrum.

satlovecake.title: SATAN LOVES CAKE
satlovecake.descHtml: SATAN wields a trident that shoots electric beams, that are able to tramsform his enemies into cake. Meet a host of enemies and bosses - and eat them all!
satlovecake.instHtml: Download from itch.io and place data.win into the satlovecake folder.

satryn.title: Satryn
satryn.descHtml: A chaotic, infinite twin stick shooty! 12 fearsome baddies (not cuddly), 9 power-ups that will make you smile and say “i’m having fun”, 5 hazards that add to the chaotic nature of this strange place, a manual that reveals helpful hints and useless lore as you discover things, and the love of your friends makes you stronger

savant.title: Savant Ascent
savant.descHtml:
A malicious orb has cast Savant out of his tower and transformed his surroundings into dangerous enemies!

Dodge and shoot your way back up the tower, and blast down waves of enemies as you make your way towards the top! As you progress, you unlock CDs that not only give you new tracks to play to, but also grant you powerful new abilities!

Can you make it to the top?
savant.instHtml:
Make sure to buy the original version of Savant Ascent: https://store.steampowered.com/app/259530/Savant__Ascent/

Note: dual analog sticks are required for this game!

Go to your steam directory and copy all files from Savant Ascent into the assets folder.

savingprincess.title: Saving Princess
savingprincess.descHtml: You are Portia Crane, Asset Recovery Specialist. All you know about your mission is: "IF THEY GET PRINCESS, THE WAR IS LOST. IT'S UP TO YOU." Explore a space station crawling with rogue machines and even rival bounty hunters with the same objective as you - but with far, far different intentions! Expand your arsenal as you collect upgrades to your trusty arm cannon and armor! Test your might against several bosses - including a FREAKING SPACE NINJA! Can you SAVE PRINCESS?
savingprincess.instHtml:
Head to https://brainos.itch.io/savingprincess.
Purchase the game and download Saving Princess.exe and place it into ports/savingprincess/assets.
Works with Saving Princess - DEMO - Windows.exe too!

scaletheskulltower.title: Scale the Skull Tower
scaletheskulltower.descHtml: Can you climb the tower and defeat the evil necromancer? Jump from ledge to ledge and throw your sword into walls to make MORE LEDGES! Also, bounce on some slimes.
scaletheskulltower.instHtml: You can download Scale the Skull Tower for free at: https://cortok.itch.io/scaletheskulltower. Download the Scale the Skull Tower JAM VERSION (LINUX).zip version and extract it, and place the Game.pck file in the gamedata directory.

scavenger.title: Scavenger
scavenger.descHtml: SDL Scavenger A fun 2-D game like Lode Runner. With 196 very good puzzle screens to solve.

scavengerofdunomini.title: Scavenger of Dunomini
scavengerofdunomini.descHtml: Wall-E meets tetris meets tower-defense game. Match tiles, build resources, defend your trash pile!
scavengerofdunomini.instHtml: Requires MAC game files from itch.io or Steam. See README.md for install instructions.

sdlsopwith.title: SDL Sopwith
sdlsopwith.descHtml: SDL Sopwith is a port of the game Sopwith, which was originally by BMB CompuScience Canada.
sdlsopwith.instHtml: All files are included and game is ready to play.

sdlpop.title: SDLPoP
sdlpop.descHtml: An open-source port of Prince of Persia, based on the disassembly of the DOS version, extended with new features by NagyD

sdlzombies.title: SDLZombies
sdlzombies.descHtml: Linux clone of zombie game. You are penguin and zombies want to catch you. There is only one way how to survive - they must fall into a pit.

secretteagarden.title: Secret Tea Garden
secretteagarden.descHtml: A cozy looking Tea Party where you must serve townspeople their tea while dodging hurdles and maneuvering around obstacles.
secretteagarden.instHtml: Download from Angus Beer then extract and place data.win inside gamedata folder

self.title: Self
self.descHtml: Who are you? A short game about a lost soul. Recover the fragments of your SELF. Be touched by the higher being.

septuple.title: Septuple
septuple.descHtml: A precision platformer about the septuple jump paper! Created by NNB.

serioussam-tfe.title: Serious Sam - The First Encounter
serioussam-tfe.descHtml: Serious Sam is a high-adrenaline arcade-action shooter heavily focused on frantic arcade-style single player action. Sam travels through the beautiful world of ancient Egypt and several diverse planets, confronting countless Mental’s minions on his way to the Mental’s base. This source port of Serious Sam was originally modded to work on the Dragonbox Pyra handheld. GL video accelerated with GL4ES by ptitseb (same dev who also does box86 and box64)!
serioussam-tfe.instHtml: You will need to populate the sstfe directory with your game data. Copy all contents except the 'Bin' folder from your Serious Sam - The First Encounter Classic GOG, Steam, or CD install and DO NOT overwrite existing files. The Serious Sam Classics: Revolution copy of The First Encounter works, too

serioussam-tse.title: Serious Sam - The Second Encounter
serioussam-tse.descHtml: Serious Sam is a high-adrenaline arcade-action shooter heavily focused on frantic arcade-style single player action. Sam travels through the beautiful world of ancient Egypt and several diverse planets, confronting countless Mental’s minions on his way to the Mental’s base. This source port of Serious Sam was originally modded to work on the Dragonbox Pyra handheld. GL video accelerated with GL4ES by ptitseb (same dev who also does box86 and box64)!
serioussam-tse.instHtml: You will need to populate the sstse directory with your game data. Copy all contents except the 'Bin' folder from your Serious Sam - The Second Encounter Classic GOG, Steam, or CD install and DO NOT overwrite existing files. The Serious Sam Classics: Revolution copy of The Second Encounter works, too

sevenkingdoms.title: Seven Kingdoms - Ancient Adversaries
sevenkingdoms.descHtml: A long, long time ago, when people lived among gods and monsters, seven kingdoms struggled for rule over the land. Lead one of those civilizations to glory through sophisticated trade, diplomacy, espionage and conquest. Choose from one of seven cultures: Greek, Persian, Viking, Norman, Mayan, Chinese and Japanese and compete for domination. Each Race in Seven Kingdoms has its own distinct advantages and disadvantages, its own unique God unit, a different military skill, its own strengths and weaknesses. Learn how to use them! Use military means, economy or subterfuge to bring down your enemies. And don't forget about brute force, cunning and intelligence.

shackolantern.title: Shack-o'-Lantern
shackolantern.descHtml: The sun has set and darkness dwells in every corner. A light source, connected by chain, acts as shelter from the night. Keep it close and stay out of the dark.

shackle.title: Shackle
shackle.descHtml: A ball and chain obstructs your movement, but do not let it weigh you down. Conquer over 45 levels and learn to use your restraint as your strength.
shackle.instHtml: Ready to run. Thanks Steven Miller for creating this game and permitting PortMaster to distribute the files.

shadow.warrior.title: Shadow Warrior
shadow.warrior.descHtml: Shadow Warrior open source port by Jonathan Fowler.
shadow.warrior.instHtml: You'll need to add your own full version SW.GRP and SW.RTS Shadow Warrior files to the ports/shadow-warrior folder.

shadowwrangler.title: Shadow Wrangler
shadowwrangler.descHtml: Your shadows have split from you and you must guide them to the exit. You can move at will, but the shadows require commands. Pick up command boxes (turn, jump, explode) and drop them where you want the shadows to act.
shadowwrangler.instHtml: Purchase the game at itch.io (https://jdmgames.itch.io/shadow-wrangler). Extract the .zip, and copy the ShadowWrangler.exe file to this port's gamedata folder.

shamogu.title: Shamogu
shamogu.descHtml: Shamanic Mountain Guardian (Shamogu) is a coffee-break roguelike game with a focus on tactical movement and careful timing of totemic spirit invocation and comestible consumption. Visibility and noise stealth mechanics also play an important role.

shardsofgod.title: Shards of God
shardsofgod.descHtml: On a distant desert planet, a crime has been committed. As Mother Tiabata and Sister Ava set out to solve the mystery, they soon find themselves facing an impossible conundrum: how does one murder a god?

shatteredpixeldungeon.title: Shattered Pixel Dungeon
shatteredpixeldungeon.descHtml: ​Shattered Pixel Dungeon is a traditional roguelike dungeon crawler featuring six unique heroes, procedurally generated levels, and hundreds of items. Each playthrough offers a distinct challenge, emphasizing strategic gameplay and replayability.
shatteredpixeldungeon.instHtml: Ready to run, version 3.02! Replace the jar file if you want to update the game.

sheepo.title: Sheepo
sheepo.descHtml: Sheepo is a quirky metroidvania platformer featuring a shape-shifting sheep-thing, who must traverse an uncharted planet in order to collect samples of each living species for an intergalactic species database.
sheepo.instHtml: Purchase the game from steam. Run steam console via Windows+R: Type: steam://open/console, download the 5 September 2020 version of the game by typing: download_depot 1281790 1281791 2354247233124576146. When the download is complete, it will tell you the location of the folder. Copy all files from /depot_1281791 to /ports/sheepo/gamedata

shelloutshowdown.title: Shell Out Showdown
shelloutshowdown.descHtml: A vending machine Rapid Fire Food Combat Generosity Arena! Throw food, dodge food, don't litter, and give to win in this hectic, platform combat arena free-for-all!
shelloutshowdown.instHtml: Purchase the game on itch.io, download, extract, and copy ShellOutShowdown.exe to the shelloutshowdown port folder. Alternatively, you can use the free demo files.

sft.title: Shin Fangame Tensei
sft.descHtml: Build a team of demons and summon the right party to defeat your enemies. Each demon has a unique set of skills that determine their behavior in battle, so carefully consider their positioning as to not waste their talents, or worse .... If your team sucks, you can fuse your demons to make stronger ones, but even weak demons will shine with proper tactics. Enemies grow stronger as the FULL MOON approaches, and something awaits beyond that ...
sft.instHtml: Download SFT.zip from itch.io (https://jab-lao.itch.io/shin-fangame-tensei) and extract the contents to this port's gamedata folder

shippy.title: Shippy
shippy.descHtml: The Earth is under attack. The only trained pilots, Sora and Fumiko, race to defeat the invaders. The experimental ships are Earth only hope.
shippy.instHtml: Can play in one or two player mode

shipwreck.title: Shipwreck
shipwreck.descHtml: Shipwreck is a top down adventure game in which you must travel the land, explore dungeons, and defeat monsters to earn safe passage off the island on which you are stranded. Note there are several games called Shipwreck, this is the one by Brushfire Games.
shipwreck.instHtml: You must have a copy of Shipwreck for Linux copied to the ports/shipwreck/gamedata folder.

shirobimetal.title: Shirobi: Metal Ninja
shirobimetal.descHtml: Old school, 8-bit, Metroidvania. A Robotic Ninja searches an uncharted planet for his long lost father, made in 5 days as part of Global Game Jam 2021
shirobimetal.instHtml: Download the game from gamejolt https://gamejolt.com/games/shirobimetalninja/582435 and extract the data.win and ogg files into the port folder.

shotgunking.title: Shotgun King: The Final Checkmate
shotgunking.descHtml: Shotgun King: The Final Checkmate is a roguelike where you're the Black King and your only weapon is a shotgun. Blast enemy chess pieces across procedurally generated boards, collecting upgrades and adapting your strategy each run.

shovelknightpocketdungeon.title: Shovel Knight Pocket Dungeon
shovelknightpocketdungeon.descHtml:
Delve with Shovel Knight into the depths of the Pocket Dungeon in an action-packed puzzle adventure mashup like none other! Join your mysterious guide Puzzle Knight as you shovel through scads of foes, procure new equipment, and battle bosses both familiar and new. Explore a tale with endless twists and turns, quest as your favorite heroes, and even challenge a friend for fast-paced head-to-head competition in Shovel Knight Pocket Dungeon!

Note: This is version 1.13 which does not come with the free DLCs/expansions
shovelknightpocketdungeon.instHtml: Purchase the game from steam. Use download_depot 1184760 1184761 5529913677570552716 with Steam Console to download the game and add the game data to shovelknightpocketdungeon/assets

shovel.knight.title: Shovel Knight Treasure Trove
shovel.knight.instHtml: You must have a copy of Shovel Knight Treasure Trove for Linux copied to the ports/shovelknight/gamedata folder.

shrubnaut.title: Shrubnaut
shrubnaut.descHtml:
A small metroidvania made in 6 days for a self-imposed GAME-A-WEEK challenge by gleeson. Use your hookshot to explore a space garden and find all the secrets!

Note: This is a short game, intended to be played in one sitting. Note that there is no save function and the game resets to the beginning after idling for 30 seconds
shrubnaut.instHtml: Download SHRUBNAUT - Windows.zip from https://gleeson.itch.io/shrubnaut and place the data.win from the zip into /ports/shrubnaut/gamedata. On first startup, the game will patch the data.win

sidescape.title: Side Scape
sidescape.descHtml: Two old-school games collide in this Platformer/Dungeon Crawler hybrid. Join Captain Grisham and Sir Knight, as they set out to restore their worlds and stop the evil cyborg, Allegair. Switch at will between Captain Grisham and Sir Knight, each with a unique set of abilities; and perspective!
sidescape.instHtml: Purchase the game on Steam and copy all files into the assets folder. You can also use the free demo from Itch.io. The game does have slowdowns on RK3326 devices.

siegeofosaka.title: Siege of Osaka
siegeofosaka.descHtml: A retro hybrid of beat-em-up and brick-breaker. Send enemy ninjas rolling into walls and fortifications to bring down castles. Localized/parodied for American audiences.

signus.title: Signus - The Artefact Wars
signus.descHtml: Classic turn-based strategy war game similar to the old Battle Isle series. Commercially released in 1998, open-sourced by the original authors in 2002.

simplesokoban.title: Simple Sokoban
simplesokoban.descHtml: Simple Sokoban is a simple Sokoban game that supports animated movements,unlimited level solutions, unlimited undos and more. It does not have any sound

simtheory.title: Simulation Theory
simtheory.descHtml: Simulation Theory is a game by NimbleBeasts for Github's GameOff 2021 Game Jam. Our interpretation of the theme 'bug' is that the level is not completely cleared due to a bug and you meet your old records again in the form of ghosts.

simutrans.title: Simutrans
simutrans.descHtml: Simutrans is a freeware and open-source transportation simulator. Your goal is to establish a successful transport company. Transport passengers, mail and goods by rail, road, ship, and even air. Interconnect districts, cities, public buildings, industries and tourist attractions by building a transport network you always dreamed of.

singoubreaka.title: SINGOU BREAKA シンゴウブレイカ
singoubreaka.descHtml: Look carefully at the red and blue signals, and DESTROY them. It's an eccentric action puzzle game where you destroy blocks modeled after pedestrian traffic lights.
singoubreaka.instHtml: Purchase the game on Steam and copy all game files into the assets folder. You can also use the free demo version.

skautfoldinsanity.title: Skautfold: Shrouded in Sanity
skautfoldinsanity.descHtml: Discover the secrets of the estate, as you look for answers among the violent inhabitants. A strange and repelling madness took hold of the servants roaming the halls, and they will attack on sight, for their madness is one rooted in a deeper understanding of cosmic insignificance.
skautfoldinsanity.instHtml: Purchase the game on Steam and copy all files into the assets folder. Only paid version is supported due to technical reasons.

skeletonboomerang.title: Skeleton Boomerang
skeletonboomerang.descHtml:
Skeleton Boomerang is a platformer where the hero, Hunter, must use an enchanted boomerang to put an end to an army of bony soldiers led by the voodoo master Mr. Saturday. Get high scores, collect upgrades, find secrets, and overcome many skeletal challenges!

As you progress through the game, your total score can unlock new boomerangs, new abilities, and health boosts. Your score is tied to performing combos by defeating multiple enemies in a single throw of your boomerang. The world is also full of secrets. Finding hidden items can unlock new stages and bosses.
skeletonboomerang.instHtml:
Purchase the game from Steam

Latest version (NOT compatible with expansion): Download the game from your Steam library. Right-click on Skeleton Boomerang > Manage > Browse local files. Copy all the files from the folder to /ports/skeletonboomerang/gamedata

Prevamped version (better performance): From your Steam library, right-click Skeleton Boomerang and select Properties. Go to Betas and select "prevamped - The pre-reVamped build of the game." Download and install the prevamped version. Copy all the files from the folder to /ports/skeletonboomerang/gamedata.

Note: This package is not compatible with the expansion. :(

skelepunch.title: Skeleton Punchers
skelepunch.descHtml:
Explosive 2D Pixel Art Action! Help the Skeleton Punchers defeat the Zerpian army of the night and recover the Patrician's Hoard before it's too late!

Collect and upgrade power ups, cycle trough the Day/Night phases, complete Stages and Bonus Mini games to unlock new Characters and Equipment!
skelepunch.instHtml: Install port. Download game on Steam. Copy all game files into the ports/skelepunch/assets folder.

skifree.title: SkiFree
skifree.descHtml: SkiFree is a single-player skiing computer game created by Chris Pirih and released with Microsoft Entertainment Pack 3 for Windows 3.0 in October 1991. The SkiFree official site is https://ski.ihoc.net/

skullpong.title: Skull Pong
skullpong.descHtml: A reimagining of the classic Pong game, but with a Halloween theme!
skullpong.instHtml: Download at itch.io and place data.win and option.ini into assets folder.

skullyardpinball.title: Skullyard Pinball
skullyardpinball.descHtml: Skullyard Pinball is a short one-table horror themed pinball game.
skullyardpinball.instHtml: Download the game from itch.io and extract all game files into assets folder.

slashjump.title: Slash/Jump
slashjump.descHtml: How do you platform if walking and jumping aren't an option? With a sword of course! Bounce and slash your way through this short and sweet, uniquely controlled precision platformer!

slaythespire.title: Slay the Spire
slaythespire.descHtml: Ascend a mysterious spire filled with deadly enemies, bizarre events, and powerful relics. Build your deck one card at a time, discover devastating synergies, and adapt your strategy with every run. No two climbs are ever the same.
slaythespire.instHtml: Install the Steam version of the game - Doesnt matter for what OS and then copy the desktop-1.0.jar to the slaythespire folder!

slime3k.title: Slime 3k Demake
slime3k.descHtml: A blob of goo, initially used to nourish artificial humans, has become sentient and risen up against its creator—the Despot, an evil AI and the unfortunate ruler of the world in the year 3000! The future is bleak, and humanity is beyond redemption, but at least you have the power to save yourself. This demake is a mini-version of our game, Slime 3K: Rise Against Despot which will be dropping on October 31, 2024.

slimecrown.title: Slime Crown
slimecrown.descHtml: Slime Crown is a colorful Pixel Art Game with a unique but challenging Gameplay. The Colors Green, Blue, Red and Yellow are the Key to Success.
slimecrown.instHtml: Purchase the game on Steam and copy all game files into assets folder.

smoothiegalaxy.title: Smoothie Galaxy
smoothiegalaxy.descHtml: "Smoothie Galaxy is an adventure game inspired a lot by Zelda 2D games, you play a spacenaut crashed on an unknown planet and you need to find fours pieces of ship scattered in the world, for repair your ship and escape the planet.."

snailworld.title: Snail World
snailworld.descHtml: A mini shmup with a slight Fantasy Zone vibe. Shoot enemies, collect money, upgrade!
snailworld.instHtml: Download free at itch.io copy data.win and .ogg files to assets folder.

snaklipse.title: Snaklipse
snaklipse.descHtml: Snake game, with the addition of jumping, traps, and the need for speed. Features: Wormholes and jumping, many colors to unlock, and many many stars to eat

snapdragon.title: Snapdragon
snapdragon.descHtml: In this dragon-stretching minimalist roguelike you can stretch your body, shrink it and swap the positions of your head and tail to attack enemies or avoid damage. The game features grid-locked turn-based movement, procedural stages, randomized items, and classic bump-combat.
snapdragon.instHtml: Ready to Run! Thanks to sarn (one of the programmers from Team Bugulon) for giving us permissions to distribute game files!

sneakr.title: SneakR
sneakr.descHtml: A short stealth game. Avoid sentries and learn their movements to complete your objective.
sneakr.instHtml: Download game from https://josephgribbin.itch.io/sneakr, rename SneakR.exe to SneakR.zip, extract. Copy data.win to /ports/sneakr/gamedata

sneggpit.title: Sneggpit
sneggpit.descHtml: Oh no, your friend Cursy has fallen into a pit full of dangerous snakes! Help Cursy to evade the hungry reptiles, steal the snakes' eggs and prevent them from spawning. Sneggpit is a charming little arcade game that could have rocked the early eighties - but is brand-new from 2024! While taking some inspiration from all-time classics such as Pacman or Nibbler/Snake, Sneggpit stands out with its unique and highly addictive gameplay and instantly runs on almost any modern device.
sneggpit.instHtml: Cursy's movements can be controlled using the cursor keys (of course!), by any game controller, or via swipe gestures on mobile touch devices.

snkrx.title: SNKRX
snkrx.descHtml: SNKRX is an arcade shooter roguelite where you control a snake of heroes that automatically attack nearby enemies. Combine different heroes to unlock class bonuses and create unique builds, and steer your unstoppable party as they ravage through endless waves of enemies.
snkrx.instHtml: Download the game https://store.steampowered.com/app/915310/SNKRX/ and place SNKRX.exe file to the port folder

snout.title: SnOut
snout.descHtml: Compete for the top score in this combination of two classic arcade games! The idea Is Simple: -You control the snake -Gain length (and points) for the ball hitting your body -Body hits power up the ball to destroy blocks and create space -Just go for as long as you can! You lose if your head hits the ball, the wall, or your own body!
snout.instHtml: This port is ready to run! If your D-pad on your device is poor, go to Menu->Options->Control Scheme: L/R to switch controls to triggers.

snowmanstack.title: Snowman Stack
snowmanstack.descHtml: A puzzle game where you have to switch pieces in order to make a snowman (hat on top, head, then body), with three single-player game modes: Stages, Forever, Panic.

snowyland.title: Snowyland
snowyland.descHtml: Snowyland is a pixel art platformer where the player must eat to survive on an empty, barren island. You should freeze family members to create ice platforms that help you reach your dinner. Choose where these ice platforms are placed, and create solutions that even the developers have not seen yet!
snowyland.instHtml: Purchase the game on Steam https://store.steampowered.com/app/1731730/Snowyland/ and copy the Snowyland.pck into the gamedata folder.

sokobos.title: Sokobos
sokobos.descHtml: Sokoban meets Greek tragedy! Sokobos is a minimalistic & challenging puzzle game that expands on the classic block-pushing formula.
sokobos.instHtml: Purchase the game on Steam and copy the Sokobos.pck into the gamedata folder. The DLC folder (AphroditeDLC) needs to be placed directly into the sokobos folder.

sokobrawn.title: Sokobrawn
sokobrawn.descHtml: It's like Sokoban but you're really strong.

sokofrog.title: SokoFrog
sokofrog.descHtml: SokoFrog is a puzzle game about pushing boxes, help your frog friend get to the next level.
sokofrog.instHtml: Instructions: Purchase the game from steam. Download the game. Place all the game files into ports/sokofrog/assets

sokoplan.title: SOKOPLAN
sokoplan.descHtml: Sokoban but you plan your moves ahead of time! The goal is to end up with all of the boxes on a circle. Each level has criteria for getting crowns (maximum number of wall bonks, moves and time). Perfect every level for a bonus! Developed as an entry to the LÖVE Jam 2025.

somnokid.title: Somnokid
somnokid.descHtml:
Somnokid is a unique shmup/platformer hybrid in which you must construct the stage before platforming and battling on it. Stave off your nightmares by slaying monsters, then survive on whatever ground you could build in time!

Features: 25 Levels of precarious combat 18 monsters haunting your dreams An original soundtrack Controller Support High quality pixel art graphics

Somnokid was made in 72 hours for Ludum Dare 50 with the theme "Delay the Inevitable".

songo5.title: Songo #5
songo5.descHtml: A music player app focused on a clean and fast UI/UX. Now supporting all major audio formats.
songo5.instHtml: After installation just ensure you have your music somewhere on your device. Start up the app and go to settings to tell Songo where your music is stored. After this it will scan that directory for new music on startup.

sonic.1.title: Sonic 1
sonic.1.instHtml: Add your own Data.rsdk file to the ports/sonic1 folder.

sonic1sms.title: Sonic 1 SMS Remake
sonic1sms.descHtml: This game mixes Sonic Chaos and Sonic Triple Trouble in a new universe. Inspired in the Master System games series, released by SEGA between 1993/94.

sonic.2.title: Sonic 2
sonic.2.instHtml: Add your own Data.rsdk file to the ports/sonic2 folder.

sonic2sms.title: Sonic 2 SMS Remake
sonic2sms.descHtml: This game is a new universe, inspired in the Master System games series, released by SEGA at 1992.

sonic3air.title: Sonic 3 AIR
sonic3air.descHtml: A fan-made widescreen remaster of Sonic 3 & Knuckles.
sonic3air.instHtml: Copy a rom of Sonic 3 & Knuckles to ports/sonic3air and rename it to Sonic_Knuckles_wSonic3.bin.

sonic3sms.title: Sonic 3 SMS Remake
sonic3sms.descHtml: This game mixes Sonic Chaos and Sonic Triple Trouble in a new universe. Inspired in the Master System games series, released by SEGA between 1993/94.

sonic.cd.title: Sonic CD
sonic.cd.instHtml: Add your own Data.rsdk file to the ports/soniccd folder.

sonic.mania.title: Sonic Mania
sonic.mania.instHtml: Add your own Data.rsdk file to the ports/sonicmania folder.

srb2kart.title: Sonic RB2 Kart
srb2kart.descHtml: Sonic Robo Blast 2 Kart fangame by Sonic Team Junior. All necessary files are already included. !!!Warning!!! This is a 184MB package and will take a while to download and install.

srb2.title: Sonic Robo Blast 2
srb2.descHtml: Sonic Robo Blast 2 fangame by Sonic Team Junior. All necessary files are already included. !!!Warning!!! This is a 184MB package and will take a while to download and install.

sonictimetwisted.title: Sonic Time Twisted
sonictimetwisted.descHtml: Sonic Time Twisted is a fan-made game where Sonic must stop Dr. Eggman's plan to use time travel to resurrect Metal Sonic and conquer the world. Sonic travels through past, present, and future versions of levels, collecting Time Stones to thwart Eggman's scheme.

sonictt16b.title: Sonic Triple Trouble - 16-Bit
sonictt16b.descHtml: What if Sonic Triple Trouble had been originally released on the Sega Genesis / MegaDrive, after Sonic 3 & Knuckles?
sonictt16b.instHtml: Download the 64-bit android apk from Gamejolt and put it in ports/sonictt16b.

sophstar.title: Sophstar
sophstar.descHtml: A vertical arcade shoot'em up with an inventive teleport system, lots of fast-blazing action and explosions, tons of boss fights, a risk/reward based score system and a proper challenge for both veteran and new players of the genre.
sophstar.instHtml: Purchase the game on Steam and copy all game files into the assets folder.

sorr.title: SorR
sorr.instHtml: Just add your own sorr.dat file, mod folder, and palettes folder into the ports/sorr folder. See the wiki for more info on this.

space.cadet.pinball.title: Space Cadet Pinball
space.cadet.pinball.descHtml: A reversed engineered version Space Cadet Pinball.
space.cadet.pinball.instHtml: Just add your own Space Cadet Pinball PINBALL.DAT files and sound files to the spacecadetpinball folder.

spacegladiators.title: Space Gladiators
spacegladiators.descHtml: Ever dreamt of being a space potato? Now’s your chance! Space Gladiators is a 2D hand-drawn roguelite platformer following a bunch of captives fighting their way out of a planet prison. Defeat hordes of aliens in the gladiatorial arenas and earn your freedom!
spacegladiators.instHtml: Purchase the game from steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1144910/Space_Gladiators/ Download the game and from your Steam library, right click on Space Gladiators > Manage > Browse local files. Copy all the files from the folder to /ports/spacegladiators/gamedata

sip2.title: Space Invaders Part 2
sip2.descHtml: This is clone of the 1979 game space invaders part II implemented in C++ with a single file custom engine using SDL2 and Opengl 2.1. SDL2 is used for window management and to create the Opengl context whereas Opengl is used for all rendering.

spacemothdx.title: Space Moth DX
spacemothdx.descHtml: Fact: everything is better with lasers. So we put lasers on over 30 angry giant insects who want to stop you, Space Moth, from escaping Earth and going to the Moon. Show them who's boss and blast your way into space!
spacemothdx.instHtml: Purchase at Steam and copy your Space Moth DX.exe into the gamedata folder.

spacewingwar.title: Spacewing War
spacewingwar.descHtml: Blast through adorable enemies in this side scrolling shmup that's sure to remind you of a gameboy classic game, only, this game has over 40 color pallets to choose from.
spacewingwar.instHtml: Purchase from Steam, Pneuma Games Locate data.win plus audiogroup1 & audiogroup2 files and place them inside the gamedata folder.

spearmintmountain.title: Spearmint Mountain
spearmintmountain.descHtml:
Spearmint Mountain is a short but sweet action platformer, where you take control of a sentient piece of mint that's fallen off the big, sacred Mint. Pick up spear plants, and poke them at enemies or they'll crush you! Throw the spears at walls to create platforms, and bounce off of them to reach new heights!

There are also collectible mint coins hidden in difficult-to-reach locations. How many can you find?
spearmintmountain.instHtml: Download game (Spearmint Mountain 1.1.1 Ubuntu) from https://baku.itch.io/spearmint-mountain, copy all the files from /assets to /ports/spearmintmountain/gamedata

spectralslash.title: Spectral Slash
spectralslash.descHtml: A combat-focused deckbuilder where your weapon deals no damage. Slash enemies to gain energy, use energy to play powerful cards. Add creative modifiers to your cards! Build a powerful deck! Each loadout has unique playstyle. Try out all 6 loadouts and see which one you like most!
spectralslash.instHtml: Download the game https://abhimonk.itch.io/spectral-slash and place SpectralSlash.exe file to the port folder

spectrumforces.title: Spectrum Forces
spectrumforces.descHtml: Make up your squads out of 9 unique ships and save 3 planets from hordes of robots in this colorful horizontal shoot-em-up! Each of the 9 pilots in the Spectrum Forces has unique capacities. It's up to you to select the right ones for the right job. You've been commissioned to clear 3 planets from the residing Abandonware. Try your best to not lose anyone while doing so!
spectrumforces.instHtml: Purchase the game on Itch.io or Steam. For Itch.io, download the MacOS version and extract the game files into gamedata folder. For Steam, download the MacOS depot via the Steam console using this command: download_depot 2319550 2319552 7814243358072475815, then copy the files into gamedata folder."

spellsling.title: Spell Sling
spellsling.descHtml: Spell Sling is a classic first-person roguelike with a focus on consumable spells and dungeon crawling
spellsling.instHtml: Download the game https://youdoyoubuddy.itch.io/spell-sling and copy the exe file into the port folder.

spelltower.title: Spell Tower
spelltower.descHtml: Spell Tower is a first person dungeon crawler and deckbuilder hybrid with the usual assortment of interesting card interactions, broken combos and cards with uses you might not have thought of at first.
spelltower.instHtml: Download the game https://youdoyoubuddy.itch.io/spell-tower and copy the exe or love file into the port folder.

spellworm.title: Spellworm
spellworm.descHtml: Help Spellworm to eat his way through over 100-word search puzzles, chomping through different themes, including shapes, colours, countries, planets and much more.
spellworm.instHtml: Purchase the full game at itch.io. Download and extract the .zip, and copy the game files to this port's gamedata folder.

spelunky.title: Spelunky
spelunky.descHtml: Spelunky Classic HD. A modified version of Derek Yu's game Spelunky Classic. Based on the source code published in Humble Weekly Bundle: Play and Create with GameMaker (not original 1.1 release)."

spinch.title: Spinch
spinch.descHtml:
Transcend the material realm and assume your true form as Spinch, a hyper-agile organism consumed by the quest to rescue a litter of its missing offspring, in this side-scrolling, psychedelic platformer from the mind of award-winning Canadian cartoonist, Jesse Jacobs.

Note: Patching time is at least 30 minutes!
spinch.instHtml:
Download the game from https://store.steampowered.com/app/794240/Spinch/ (also available but not tested from gog and humble).
Copy all the game files to /ports/spinch/assets

splinterzone.title: Splinter Zone
splinterzone.descHtml: Run, jump, and shoot everything that stands in your way. Then die and try again. Maybe a bit wiser about what lies ahead. Maybe with an escape plan. Maybe not.
splinterzone.instHtml: Purchase the game on itch.io or Steam, download and copy the files to the port's gamedata folder.

spooky.title: Spooky Ghosts Dot Com
spooky.descHtml: Spooky Ghosts Dot Com is a small metroidvania about a ghost hunter named Ruby. One Halloween night a ghost hunting job comes in, but it turns out to not be a regular gig!
spooky.instHtml: Copy the file SpookyGhostsDotCom inside the game folder, if you have the steam version rename the file "SpookyGhostsDotCom-Steam".

spookynakki.title: Spookynakki
spookynakki.descHtml: Spookynakki is the bone-chilling continuation of Grabanakki, featuring 3 new worlds, a variety of new and returning mechanics, and a completely new OST. Clear level after level of monsters, using the very blocks you stand on as your only weapon. Can you defeat every foe without falling through the shrinking foundation? Don't wait anymore and go clear the 24 spooky stages of block-throwing combat!

librespot.title: Spotify Connect
librespot.descHtml: Spotify Connect uses Librespot which allows you to stream music to your handheld via Spotify Premium. It even works in the background, allowing you to play music, no matter what your doing on your handheld!
librespot.instHtml: This port is ready to run: - Install "Spotify Connect" port. - Open the port and toggle it on. - Select your handheld in Spotify devices on your Desktop or phone. - Close app if you want to play games. (L1 + R1) - The app dynamically registers if Spotify is running, so if you want to turn it off, just open the port again and use the toggle switch.

springhell.title: Spring Hell
springhell.descHtml: Just Press Spacebar at the right time! It’s very simple arcade game with tiny puzzle and platformer.
springhell.instHtml: This game is available on Steam. Download the game here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2585490/SpringHell/ Once it's downloaded and installed to your library, right click it and select 'Manage' then 'Browse Local Files'. COPY the 'SpringHell.pck' file into the gamedata folder and launch the game!

sprucechat.title: SpruceChat
sprucechat.descHtml: A tiny AI chat app that runs entirely on-device. Qwen2.5-0.5B via llama.cpp, no internet required. The AI has the personality of a spruce tree: patient, unhurried, quietly amazed by everything.
sprucechat.instHtml: Ready to Run. First launch loads the model into RAM (~60s).

squeek.title: Squeek the Meek
squeek.descHtml: A game about a whimpy mouse who cant fight, who has to save his friends from orcs.

starvsthegame.title: Star vs. the Game
