starvsthegame.descHtml: Star vs. the Game is a cross between top-down beat-em up action and 2D platforming. Play as both Star and Marco and fight against a threat from beyond reality! The game features 7 levels with four bosses, as well as some extra content once the game is beaten.
starvsthegame.instHtml: Download game from https://rian-shinozaki.itch.io/star-vs-the-game , copy data.win, audiogroup1.dat and all .ogg files to /ports/starvsthegame/gamedata

jediacademy.title: Star Wars Jedi Knight - Jedi Academy
jediacademy.descHtml: An open source port of Jedi Academy using OpenJK by the JACoders team. Originally developed by Raven Software.
jediacademy.instHtml: You need to add your own full game pak files to the ports/JediAcademy/base folder.

jedioutcast.title: Star Wars Jedi Knight II - Jedi Outcast
jedioutcast.descHtml: An open source port of Jedi Outcast using OpenJK by the JACoders team. Originally developed by Raven Software.
jedioutcast.instHtml: You need to add your own full game pak files to the ports/JediOutcast/base folder.

openjkdf2.title: Star Wars Jedi Knight: Dark Forces II
openjkdf2.descHtml: The 1997 LucasArts FPS that launched Kyle Katarn into the Jedi Knight saga. Native OpenJKDF2 engine port for ARM handhelds (GLES) and x86_64 Linux (RetroDECK / PortMaster PC). Requires original game files from GOG or Steam.
openjkdf2.instHtml: Copy JKDF2 files to openjkdf2/jk1/ from GOG or Steam as-is (Episode/, Resource/, etc.). Optional MOTS to openjkdf2/mots/. Use the MOTS launcher or switch in-game via Expansions & Mods.

theforceengine.title: Star Wars: Dark Forces
theforceengine.descHtml: LucasArts 1995 FPS starring Kyle Katarn. Runs on The Force Engine (native Jedi Engine reimplementation) for ARM handhelds and x86_64 Linux. Requires original game files from GOG or Steam.
theforceengine.instHtml: Copy Dark Forces files to theforceengine/game/ (must include DARK.GOB). GOG and Steam installs work if you copy the game folder contents as-is.

starboy.title: StarBoy
starboy.descHtml: During a journey, StarBoy crashed and got lost on an unknown planet; help him return to its spaceship!
starboy.instHtml:
You can purchase StarBoy at: https://mrkdji.itch.io/starboy

Download and extract it, and place the starboy_linux.pck file in the gamedata directory. This has been tested with starboy_linux.zip, version 1.0.3

starcatcher.title: Starcatcher
starcatcher.descHtml: Starcatcher is a platformer inspired by Kirby, Metroid, Gravitron Experiment. Your goal: Collect stars in outer space.

stardewvalleymainline.title: Stardew Valley
stardewvalleymainline.descHtml: You've inherited your grandfather's old farm plot in Stardew Valley. Armed with hand-me-down tools and a few coins, you set out to begin your new life. Can you learn to live off the land and turn these overgrown fields into a thriving home?
stardewvalleymainline.instHtml: Requires the Windows Steam version of Stardew Valley. Copy all game files into stardewvalleymainline/gamedata. Leave stardewvalleymainline/Mods empty for vanilla play, or add SMAPI mods there to launch through the bundled SMAPI loader automatically.

stardewvalley.title: Stardew Valley Compatibility
stardewvalley.descHtml: Stardew Valley is an open-ended country-life RPG! You’ve inherited your grandfather’s old farm plot in Stardew Valley. Armed with hand-me-down tools and a few coins, you set out to begin your new life.
stardewvalley.instHtml: You must have an updated copy of the compatibility version of Stardew Valley. Both Steam or GOG versions are supported. https://www.stardewvalley.net/compatibility/ Copy the retail game's data into the stardewvalley/gamedata folder.

stargrovescramble.title: Stargrove Scramble
stargrovescramble.descHtml: Your son has been taken! Sling your eggs at foes and platform through three unique worlds in search of his captor. Though tread lightly, his henchmen will try to stop you at every turn.
stargrovescramble.instHtml: This port is ready to run. Thanks Team Bugulon for creating this game and allowing us to distribute it!

static.title: Static
static.descHtml: Static is a fast paced puzzle platformer inspired by games such as 'Super Meat Boy' and 'N++'
static.instHtml: Get the game on the [LoneFoxAndDuck page]https://martin-akehurst.itch.io/staticgame), rename the .exe to .zip, extract and place game files in the ports/static/gamedata/ directory.

steamworlddig.title: Steamworld Dig
steamworlddig.descHtml: SteamWorld Dig is a platform mining adventure with strong Metroidvanian influences. Take the role of Rusty, a lone mining steambot, as he arrives at an old mining town in great need. Dig your way through the old earth, gaining riches while uncovering the ancient threat that lurks below. * A rich world of steam-driven robots, inspired by Steampunk and Western themes. * Explore an underground world full of secrets, treasure, and terrors. * Uncover the remnants of human civilization, a degenerate race of dynamite-wielding troglodytes. * Randomized worlds with emergent gameplay.
steamworlddig.instHtml: Westonpack Runtime is required to run this port! * Take the Linux Installer from GOG and place it within /steamworlddig/installer/ * Run the game via your device (First startup will take longer, wait for 1-2 Minutes)

steamworlddig2.title: Steamworld Dig 2
steamworlddig2.descHtml: SteamWorld Dig 2 takes you on a platform mining adventure forged in Metroidvania flames. When an old trading town is struck by mysterious earthquakes, it’s up to a lone steambot and her unlikely companion to uncover what trembling terrors lie beneath.
steamworlddig2.instHtml: Westonpack Runtime is required to run this port! Install it via Portmaster before running. * Take the Linux Installer from GOG and place it within /steamworlddig/installer/ * Run the game via your device (First startup will take longer, wait for 1-2 Minutes)

steamworldheist.title: Steamworld Heist
steamworldheist.descHtml: In SteamWorld Heist, you command a steam-driven pirate crew in a series of epic tactical shootouts. It’s turn-based strategy with a twist: You manually aim the guns of your robots, allowing for insane skill shots and bullet-bouncing action! As the captain you will board, loot and shoot your way through enemy spaceships. Overcome the challenges of the vast frontier by upgrading your recruits with unique abilities, weapons – and even stylish hats!
steamworldheist.instHtml: Westonpack Runtime is required to run this port! Install it via Portmaster before running. * Take the Linux Installer from GOG and place it within /steamworldheist/installer/ * Run the game via your device (First startup will take longer, wait for 1-2 Minutes)

steelassault.title: Steel Assault
steelassault.descHtml: Punch, whip, and zipline your way through a post-apocalyptic America in this 16-bit retro-style action platformer!
steelassault.instHtml: You must have a copy of Steel Assault for Linux copied to the ports/steelassault/gamedata folder.

stepbystep.title: Step by Step
stepbystep.descHtml: In this game, you must reach the door to complete each level. But be careful! You have a limited number of moves to do so. This game is inspired by Warlock's Tower.

syasokoban.title: Still Yet Another Sokoban
syasokoban.descHtml: Still Yet Another Sokoban, a clone of the popular puzzle game in which the goal is to push the crates onto the designated squares

stingyseating.title: Stingy Seating
stingyseating.descHtml: Transport all of the students to school. You can only carry two at a time, so it might take a few trips.

stop_the_eggspress.title: Stop The Egg Eggspress
stop_the_eggspress.descHtml: A simple remake of Stop the Express mashed up with Chuckie Egg graphics. Yes, it's a game based around a simple pun.
stop_the_eggspress.instHtml:
Button Mappings for the game

D Pad, Left stick and right stick for movement

Start,X, and Y Button to start game

A and B buttons to shoot an egg

strangeadventures.title: Strange Adventures in Infinite Space
strangeadventures.descHtml:
Digital Eel's Strange Adventures in Infinite Space is an incredibly addictive space exploration game that plays like a cross between a board game and Star Control.

The game is best described as the condensed version of Star Control: imagine the same sense of humour you have come to know and love in Accolade's classic, minus the grand plot, mix with more intergalactic business savvy, and you'll have a good idea of what SAIS is all about.

streetsofclaus.title: Streets of Claus
streetsofclaus.descHtml: It was a beautiful Christmas night... Santa Claus was preparing to deliver the last gift of the year, when he was suddenly knocked and fell off his sled. Unfortunately, he fell in a dangerous neighborhood, and now he is going to punch some criminals to make the delivery.

strikeysisters.title: Strikey Sisters
strikeysisters.descHtml: Say hello to a fantasy themed action arcade brick breaker! Featuring cute characters, silly humor, powerful magic, crazy bosses, and even local 2 player co-op mode! -Fast-paced brick breaker action! -Intense boss battles! -Local 2 player co-op mode. -Three difficulty modes. -Travel and conquer the world map in any order you want! -Unique player, ball, and spell power-ups! -Highly replayable! Uncover all the map, collect gems, unlock secret areas and extra levels, and complete the bestiary! -Polished and colorful pixel art visuals. -Catchy synth-fantasy soundtrack. -Cheesy 90's game voice acting!
strikeysisters.instHtml:
Purchase the game either from https://dyagames.itch.io/strikey-sisters OR https://store.steampowered.com/app/643880/Strikey_Sisters/

Itch.io Download Strikey Sisters (Linux Ubuntu 14.04 LTS) [updated on Apr 05, 2018], copy all files from /assets to /ports/strikeysisters/assets

Steam Run steam console via Windows+R: Type: steam://open/console, download the linux version by typing: download_depot 643880 643883 in the console, when the download is complete, it will tell you the location of the folder, copy all files from /assets to /ports/strikeysisters/assets

stuntcarracer.title: Stunt Car Racer
stuntcarracer.descHtml: This is a port to Linux and OpenPandora of Stunt Car Racer Remake, a windows remake of the old Stunt Car Racer from the AtariST/Amiga time.

submachinelegacy.title: Submachine: Legacy
submachinelegacy.descHtml: Submachine is a hand-drawn puzzle adventure game . You will find yourself in a vast network of desolate locations containing puzzles, secrets, notes and items to collect to help you along the way.
submachinelegacy.instHtml:
Purchase the game on Steam.

Download it and copy over all the files from the game [on Windows they should be located in "C:/Program Files (x86)/Steam/steamapps/common/submachine"] into "ports/submachinelegacy/assets/"

sulka.title: Sulka
sulka.descHtml: A simple platformer. Help Sulka find a new home.

sunsetshaped.title: Sunset Shaped
sunsetshaped.descHtml: Sunset Shaped is a tight and responsive platformer with five challenging levels and a calming atmosphere. Featuring interesting and tough level designs, simple and accessible controls - a singular jump and movement keys, flexible movement to nail the most precise of jumps, sweet and peaceful soundtrack and sound design, infinite opportunities for challenge runs and modifications.

sawa.title: Super Amazing Wagon Adventure
sawa.descHtml: Super Amazing Wagon Adventure is a fast-paced 2d shooting game with a random story. You control a group of three migrants traveling west along a wagon trail. The game consists of short scenes that are sequenced together in a semi-random way to tell a crazy adventure story.
sawa.instHtml:
• Install portfiles with PM autoinstaller.
  • Buy and install Super Amazing Wagon Adventure.
  • Copy all files to the "sawa/gamedata" folder.

superbloodhockey.title: Super Blood Hockey
superbloodhockey.descHtml:
Relive the golden age of arcade sports gaming with Super Blood Hockey.

Create and manage your team in a violent, dystopic world of no-rules, fast-paced, arcade-style, ice hockey action. Adjust training regimens, control diets, administer black market pharmaceuticals, and provide healthcare (or not) to a ragtag team of convicts at the mercy of your underhanded tactics.
superbloodhockey.instHtml:
You must provide the Steam data files for Super Blood Hockey. https://store.steampowered.com/app/532190

Supports both Windows and Linux versions. Place all game files into the superbloodhockey/gamedata folder. But do NOT copy the SubparBloopHokeyCon.fig file! (Doing so will boot the game into the wrong resolution).

On first launch, the port auto-detects the device resolution and patches the game's last resolution slot with the device's resolution and zoom values, if necessary. Patcher works with game version 1.5.4 only.

supercakeboy.title: Super Cakeboy
supercakeboy.descHtml: Once again take the role of Cakeboy in this sequel to Khimera: Destroy all Monster Girls' "game-within-a-game". Run, jump, punch and use the variety of pastry-themed weapons at your disposal to blast through 9 action-packed stages. Face off against Cakeboy's eternal rival, the enigmatic Dark Cake and send him packing!

supercratebox.title: Super Crate Box
supercratebox.descHtml: Vlambeer's SUPER CRATE BOX is coming to bring back the glory of the golden arcade age, when all that really mattered was getting on that high score list. Grab your baseball cap and loosen your pants, it's time to fight endless hordes of enemies and collect every weapon crate you can. Prepare for an arcade delight with tight controls, refreshing game mechanics, cracking retro art and a terribly hip chiptune soundtrack.
supercratebox.instHtml: This port is ready to run. Hold START and release on the first startup

superdungeonmuncher.title: Super Dungeon Muncher
superdungeonmuncher.descHtml: Super Dungeon Muncher combines the thrill of puzzle-solving with the intense challenge of rogue-like action—all with a unique twist. As you journey through the world, the relentless Muncher will chase you in real time. Every second counts: act fast and think quickly, or risk being caught by the Muncher*. TATE mode is supported as of game version 1.4.
superdungeonmuncher.instHtml: 1. Download the game and extract it. 2. Move the data.win and options.ini files from the extracted folder to your ports/superdungeonmuncher/gamedata folder.

supergaelicdodgeball.title: Super Gaelic Dodgeball
supergaelicdodgeball.descHtml: Mildly violent Dodgeball game made for Awful Winter Jam 2018
supergaelicdodgeball.instHtml: Get the game on the shoehead itch.io page, and place all game files in the ports/supergaelicdodgeball/gamedata/ directory.

sgsquadronext.title: Super Galaxy Squadron EX Turbo
sgsquadronext.descHtml: Super Galaxy Squadron is a fast-paced vertical shooter designed for human beings as well as SHMUP veterans. Featuring multiple game modes, a challenging but merciful difficulty curve, forgiving health system, and SEVENTEEN playable ships.
sgsquadronext.instHtml: Purchase the game on Steam and copy Super Galaxy Squadron EX.exe or Super Galaxy Squadron.exe into assets folder. For users outside of Windows, use this Steam console command to download the correct version: download_depot 345860 345861 8087376341108724441 Note: this is a 32bit game.

superglitter.title: Super Glitter Rush
superglitter.descHtml:
Super Glitter Rush is a boss-rush style bullet hell shoot-em-up!

30 cute and unique bosses are waiting for you in a colorful world of pixel art. The hail of bullets might look hard. But don't worry. With special bullets that catch your opponent's bullets, you can shoot them all back! The more you catch, the stronger you get!
superglitter.instHtml: Purchase the port on Steam and copy game files into assets folder. The game is also sold on Itch.io and it comes with Steam key as well.

superhelmknight.title: Super HelmKnight
superhelmknight.descHtml: Play as Walt, who must take back Helmland from the evil group of knights. A retro platformer with short, challenging levels.
superhelmknight.instHtml: Purchase from itch.io, download, then extract and copy the game files to the superhelmknight/assets folder

superhexagon.title: Super Hexagon
superhexagon.descHtml: Super Hexagon is a fast-paced, minimalistic arcade game where you control a tiny triangle orbiting a central hexagon, dodging an onslaught of spinning walls. With intense music, rapid movement, and a constantly shifting geometric world, it’s a game of pure reflexes and precision.
superhexagon.instHtml:
This port is compatible with the Linux Itch, GOG and Steam release of the game.

Installing Itch: - Download the Linux version, put the "superhexagon-xxxxx-bin" file into the folder superhexagon/gamefiles/itch/ Installing GOG: - Download the Linux version, put the "gog_super_hexagon_xxxxx.sh" file into the folder superhexagon/gamefiles/gog/ Installing Steam: - Open the Steam console and type in the following command to download the Linux version: download_depot 221640 221643 7186315654381968499 - Put the gamefiles (without any surrounding folders) into superhexagon/gamefiles/steam/

hydorah.title: Super Hydorah
hydorah.descHtml: Super Hydorah is a nonlinear horizontal shoot' em up designed to offer a challenging experience, sublimating the richness of traditional shmup classics.
hydorah.instHtml: Purchase and download the game on steam. Copy the data.win file and the texts and music folders inside gamedata. Then Boot the game from Hydorah.sh

supermazerobo.title: SUPER Maze Robo
supermazerobo.descHtml: A small Mega Man like platformer made for SNES graphics game jam 2. Follow Maze Robo on a quest to save his GREATEST TREASURE after a group called the Shooting Robbers stole it. Travel through giant trees and flying ships to get to their castle to take it back, NO MATTER HOW MANY TIMES IT TAKES.

supermeatboy.title: Super Meat Boy
supermeatboy.descHtml: Get ready for a wild ride with Super Meat Boy! This tough as nails platform game is the brainchild of the dynamic duo, Edmund McMillen and Tommy Refenes, also known as 'Team Meat'. Born from the success of their 2008 Flash game, 'Meat Boy', this game promises thrills, spills, and maybe a few broken controllers. Are you up for the challenge?
supermeatboy.instHtml:
Let's get Super Meat Boy up and running! First, you'll need to copy the Steam version of Super Meat Boy (for Linux) game files to the ports/supermeatboy/gamedata directory. Easy peasy, right?

If you're a Windows user, don't worry, we've got you covered! Open your Steam console, and run this:

download_depot 40800 40802 6556596646716197166 .

Got the Humble version? No problemo! Just place your supermeatboy-linux-11112013-bin file in the ports/supermeatboy/gamedata directory and watch as it extracts the needed files on its first run. Now, let's get gaming!

supermegazero.title: Super Mega Zero
supermegazero.descHtml:
Miss Undefined has been whisked away by the dastardly Kill Screen. Go from Zero to Hero in this fast-paced platformer, chasing time, the high score, and eventually the Kill Screen itself.

Super Mega Zero is a tight precision and puzzle platformer with shoot 'em up elements. Simply touch an upgrade and switch forms to go from classic, straight-forward platforming to the more puzzle-like action number system or Shoot' Em Up gameplay.

Note: Poor readability on small screens and options menu does not work
supermegazero.instHtml: Purchase the game from: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1581880/Super_Mega_Zero/ Run steam console via Windows+R: Type: steam://open/console. Download the 20 April 2022 version by typing: download_depot 1581880 1581881 8562910234793311857 in the console, when the download is complete, it will tell you the location of the folder, copy all the files from the download folder to /ports/supermegazero/gamedata

supermethanebros.title: Super Methane Brothers
supermethanebros.descHtml: A conversion of Super Methane Brothers for the Commodore Amiga. The gameplay is similar to Taito's Bubble Bobble.

supermutantalienassault.title: Super Mutant Alien Assault
supermutantalienassault.descHtml: The Citizen Kane of Super Crate Box clones - dance with death through randomised rooms to clear your space freighter of irradiated aliens in a brutal arcade platformer shooter stuffed to the brim with unlockable weapons, explosives, special abilities and defense moves.
supermutantalienassault.instHtml: Purchase your game from steam. Download the game and place SuperMutantAlienAssault.exe in ports/supermutantalienassault/

superpentagon.title: Super Pentagon
superpentagon.descHtml: This is a fangame based on original game Super Hexagon by Terry Cavanagh, made for Nokia 3310 Jam 3. Be sure to give the original game a spin!.

superraftboatclassic.title: Super Raft Boat Classic
superraftboatclassic.descHtml: The world's been flooded, and all you have is your Super Raft Boat. You keep sailing, hoping to find an island while fighting off the creatures of the sea. From the Clear Skies to the Sea of the Damned, can you reach The Final Island?
superraftboatclassic.instHtml:
Claim the game from https://store.steampowered.com/app/1541250/Super_Raft_Boat_Classic/

Run steam console via Windows+R: Type: steam://open/console, download the linux version by typing: download_depot 1541250 1541251 4671292693324189046 in the console, when the download is complete, it will tell you the location of the folder, copy all files from the download folder to /ports/superraftboatclassic/gamedata

Note: Requires Twin Sticks. Also, when you have unlocked an item, hold L2/R2 and use the D-pad to move the mouse. Let go over Continue and you will be able to get past the unlock screen

superrobotninjagirl.title: Super Robot Ninja Girl
superrobotninjagirl.descHtml: Set out on an epic quest to save Japan from an evil yakuza corporation! Fight your way out of the imperial palace and all the way into the heart of Tokyo's red light district where you will encounter the mafioso himself in an intense danmaku battle!

superskelemania.title: Super Skelemania
superskelemania.descHtml: A single-sitting metroidvania about an acrobatic skeleton. Jump over a pit of thorns, roll your skull like a bowling ball, or headbutt a spider like any good skeleton would!
superskelemania.instHtml: Purchase the game on itch.io or Steam. For itch.io, extract the .exe as if it were a 7-zip archive (which it is) and copy all the games files into the port gamedata folder; for Steam, there's no need to extract the game files, just copy them to the gamedata folder.

superspyraccoon.title: Super Spy Raccoon
superspyraccoon.descHtml: A retro arcade throwback where you hide, sneak, climb, and leap your way to victory! YOU MUST NOT BE SEEN! Do you have the skills to achieve a top score?
superspyraccoon.instHtml: Purchase the game on Steam, download, and copy the .pck file to superspyraccoon/gamedata

superstarpath.title: Super Star Path
superstarpath.descHtml: Classic color match puzzle meets space shoot'em up action! Hop into your spaceship, open a path through huge waves of aliens and other hazards, and face intense boss battles!
superstarpath.instHtml:
Purchase the game either from https://dyagames.itch.io/super-star-path OR https://store.steampowered.com/app/375120/Super_Star_Path/

Itch.io Download Super Star Path (Linux Ubuntu 14.04 LTS) version, copy all files from /assets to /ports/superstarpath/gamedata

Steam Run steam console via Windows+R: Type: steam://open/console, download the linux version by typing: download_depot 375120 375123 in the console, when the download is complete, it will tell you the location of the folder, copy all files from /assets to /ports/superstarpath/gamedata

superstarpunk.title: Super Star Punk
superstarpunk.descHtml: Some evil robots are causing trouble in your city. Go punch em'!
superstarpunk.instHtml: Download the "SuperStarPunk_win_1.2.zip" from https://doctor-succubus.itch.io/super-star-punk. Extract that zip file and put all the files into the assets folder. LAUNCH!

superstartrek.title: Super Star Trek meets 25th Anniversary
superstartrek.descHtml: This free fan game is a remake/conversion of the 1978 strategy game Super Star Trek reimagined with the UI of the Star Trek 25th Anniversary.
superstartrek.instHtml: Download the Windows version on itch and copy all game files into the gamedata folder.

supertransball2.title: Super Transball 2
supertransball2.descHtml: Super Transball 2 is a game which was inspired by ZARA THRUSTA for the Amiga 500. In each level the goal is to find the SPHERE, to capture it and to carry it to the upper part of the level.

mustardman.title: SUPER ULTRA MUSTARD MAN
mustardman.descHtml: Explore Mustard Land. Shoot mustard from your hand.

superdrome.bugs.title: SuperDrome Bugs
superdrome.bugs.descHtml: One day, Simon Pray -- a down-on-his-luck pest exterminator in a strangely pest-free Mexico -- receives a mysterious job offer from a lavish mansion. Something feels off, but Simon doesn't have time for second thoughts. He needs the money.
superdrome.bugs.instHtml:
You can download SuperDome Bugs for free at: https://pistachoduck.itch.io/superdrome-bugs

Download the SuperDromerBugs_Linux64.zip version and extract it, and place the SuperDromerBugs_Linux64.pck file in the gamedata directory.

superhaxagon.title: SuperHaxagon
superhaxagon.descHtml: SuperHaxagon is a cross platform, open source Super Hexagon clone. Avoid the falling walls and survive for as long as possible in this fast-paced arcade game!

supertux.title: SuperTux
supertux.descHtml: SuperTux is a jump'n'run game with strong inspiration from the Super Mario Bros. games for the various Nintendo platforms. !!!Warning!!! This is a 169MB package and will take a while to download and install.

supertuxkart.title: SuperTuxKart
supertuxkart.descHtml: SuperTuxKart is a 3D open-source arcade racer with a variety characters, tracks, and modes to play.
supertuxkart.instHtml: All files are included and game is ready to play. This port uses the low quality mobile assets. See the readme file for instructions on adding the full quality assets.

superxyx.title: SuperXYX
superxyx.descHtml: The year is 3999, humanity has long colonized itself across the galaxy, devouring new worlds for their resources, enjoying the interstellar life of luxury, more or less friendly interactions with other alien races. That was until an ancient threat has awakened from it's slumber..
superxyx.instHtml: Copy the data.win file and the texts and music folders inside gamedata. Then Boot the game. For more detailed instructions checkout the website.

swapwoodquestr.title: Swapwood Quest R
swapwoodquestr.descHtml: Swapwood Quest R is a unique block puzzle game with an RPG twist. Combo your enemies and match enough tiles to protect against opposing blows, but make haste, You only have 10 seconds to prepare before your turn ends!
swapwoodquestr.instHtml: This port is ready to run, thanks to Team Bugulon granting us permission to distribute this game.

switchfin.title: Switchfin
switchfin.descHtml: Switchfin is third-party player for Jellyfin that provides a native user interface to browse and play movies and series.
switchfin.instHtml: Either edit the config.json that is in ports/switchfin/conf/Switchfin/config.json and put your Jellyfin Server IP in there or put your Media into any folder on your device

swordofjade.title: Sword of Jade
swordofjade.descHtml: A lengthy fantasy adventure role playing game based around a day/night cycle, customizing your heroes, and a storyline where every choice has an impact on the story. A retro-inspired RPG built with the OHRRPGCE engine, blending modern mechanics with Super Nintendo-era style.
swordofjade.instHtml: All files included and ready to run. Thanks to FyreWulff Software for giving us permission to share the original game.

swordbounce.title: SwordBounce
swordbounce.descHtml: Platform your way through over 150 ever more challenging rooms with your trusty sword in hand! Use obstacles to your advantage and traverse the treacherous depths.
swordbounce.instHtml: Purchase the game on Steam and copy all game files into the assets folder.

tabletanks.title: Table Tanks
tabletanks.descHtml: Be a tank, shoot other thanks! But beware, ammo is scarce so use it wisely! Battle through 25 boards of increasing difficulty, while outfitting your tank with cool upgrades! 1st Place Winner of HeartGameJam.
tabletanks.instHtml: Install port then download TableTanks.zip free game from here, extract it and copy all files to the tabletanks/gamedata folder.

tailsadventure.title: Tails Adventure Remake
tailsadventure.descHtml: Tails Adventure is a Sonic the Hedgehog spin-off adventure game, released for Sega Game Gear in 1995. Unlike classic Sonic gameplay, Tails Adventure is a slow-paced platformer with focus on solving puzzles, backtracking and collecting items, much like metroidvania games.

tailspin.title: Tailspin!
tailspin.descHtml: Play as a treasure seeking canary and drill through 4 unique worlds of action packed platforming. Can you survive the infested depths below and attain everlasting glory?

talesfromtheotherside.title: Tales From The Other Side
talesfromtheotherside.descHtml: In Tales From The Other Side, you wake up in an old attic in the "FLYPSIDE", a parallel dimension to ours, centuries ahead in the future of an alternate timeline... With no memories of anything beforehand, you have only one thing on your mind. You need to go back. Back to the abyss below you!
talesfromtheotherside.instHtml: Download and extract Tales From The Other Side (DEMO).zip (https://levc-egm.itch.io/theothersidedemo?download) into Assets folder of Port Folder

tamashii.title: Tamashii
tamashii.descHtml: An ancient entity seeking help, a Witch, an unnamed soul and a Twisted Temple. A dark tale about inner discoveries set in a distorted and perverted world.
tamashii.instHtml: Purchase at Steam and copy game.exe into gamedata folder.

tamatool.title: Tamatool
tamatool.instHtml: Tamatool requires a compatible Tamagotchi P1 ROM called rom.bin in its folder.

tamiku.title: Tamiku
tamiku.descHtml: Help Tamiku to break all the balloons in the universe in this action-packed platform.
tamiku.instHtml:
Purchase the game from steamor itch.io

Download the game and place all the gamefiles into ports/tamiku/gamedata

tantibus.title: Tantibus
tantibus.descHtml:
A neon lit world filled with nightmare creatures and bizarre situations exists by the name of Tantibus. Journey from your very normal and totally boring home where nothing weird ever happens of Cobble's Key to whatever exists past the first boss.

Be there man eating clocks?

Be there vomiting gardeners?

Be there depressed lamps?

Be there faceless men?

Yup!
tantibus.instHtml: Download the game for free here: https://benal.itch.io/tantibus

taskforcekampas.title: Task Force Kampas
taskforcekampas.descHtml: Task Force Kampas is inspired by the Golden Age of japanese shmups, and adds new mechanics, randomly generated levels and handcrafted bosses. It is an endless loop: you can finish it, but also find the way to continue past the ending and get the highest score! Space shooters were never that punchy before. Task Force Kampas emphasizes music and game feel to create the perfect game you'd want to spend all your coins into (if that were still a thing, you know.) The story revolves about a team of outcasts fighting for their future, who happened to be at the worst place during the Evil Invasion. Can you contain the breach? Can you save the whole universe before it becomes corrupted? More importantly, can you save your friends?
taskforcekampas.instHtml: Purchase the game from Itch.io. Download the zip and place it in ports/taskforcekampas/assets

techmaniac.title: Techmaniac
techmaniac.descHtml: Techmaniac is a 1-bit style precision platformer made for the thirty-fifth Godot Wild Jam by JohnGabrielUK.

tecnoballz.title: TecnoballZ
tecnoballz.descHtml: This is a Breakout or Arkanoid like game with a lot of bonus stages. You can buy weapons and bonus between stages. Sometimes you have to defeat a guardian.

templeofkashteki.title: Temple of Kashteki
templeofkashteki.descHtml: A short platformer where the player upgrades the environment! Escape the Temple of Kashteki! Made for the Pursuing Pixels James Jam Game Gam
templeofkashteki.instHtml: Download the kashteki_linux.zip from: https://securas.itch.io/temple-of-kashteki. Unzip and place kashteki_linux.x86_64 into ports/templeofkashteki/gamedata.

tempuslocus.title: Tempus Locus
tempuslocus.descHtml: What if you could replay the past? A short puzzle-platformer where you can record and playback snapshots in time.
tempuslocus.instHtml: Game files are included and ready to run.

tenjutsu48h.title: Tenjutsu
tenjutsu48h.descHtml: Your dojo has been attacked by mysterious armed men in black. You have to take it back! Fight enemies, collect DEATH MARKS (ie. skulls) and tag enemies with these marks. Every 10 seconds, marked enemies will die. Some stronger enemies will require more marks to get rid of.

terminus.title: Terminus
terminus.descHtml: Terminus is a short-session coffee break roguelike game with pixel-art graphics and turn-based combat. Ascend into the depths, while fighting through hordes of alien creatures, both in melee and range combat.

terraflame.title: Terra Flame
terraflame.descHtml: Terra Flame is a horizontal shoot ’em up inspired by the 1990s, featuring authentic pixel-art graphics and a chiptune soundtrack created with classic Mega Drive sound sources.”
terraflame.instHtml: Purchase the game on Steam and copy all game files into the assets folder.

theaspect.title: The Aspect
theaspect.descHtml: You are late to a mystic ceremony! Retrieve the items you need to start the event!
theaspect.instHtml: Game is available here: https://backterria.itch.io/the-aspect Download and Place 'The TheAspect.exe' in the gamedata folder.

tboirebirth.title: The Binding Of Isaac: Rebirth
tboirebirth.descHtml: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth is a 2D roguelike action-adventure where a boy named Isaac flees into a monster-filled basement after his mother, convinced by a divine message, attempts to sacrifice him. He fights using his tears while collecting power-ups in procedurally generated dungeons, offering high replayability and dark, absurd humor.
tboirebirth.instHtml:
NOTE: This port is not compatible with the GOG version or any DLCs

  1. Purchase the game on steam.
  2. Open up the steam console by typing 'steam://open/console' into a web browser
  3. enter the following command: 'download_depot 250900 250903 5148620425580684010'
  4. Find the folder 'depot_250903' in your steam library.
  5. Copy the files within the folder to 'tboirebirth/gamefiles/' in your ports directory.
  6. Launch the port and adjust the options. For most devices the default options are recommended. If your firing directions are incorrect, try one of the alternate control schemes from the launcher. If your game is not full screen, select fullscreen from the in-game options.

brainvore.title: The Brainvore
brainvore.descHtml: The year is 2240, you and your crew are currently on the way home from a survey mission to the Proxima Centauri system. Your science officers found some organic material on one of the planets and you are now tasked with returning those samples to Sol. Something seems to have gone wrong. When you wake up your bunk mate is gone. You also can't seem to find anyone else. At least anyone that still breaths.

thecaribbeansail.title: The Caribbean Sail
thecaribbeansail.descHtml: Name your crew, purchase supplies, sail the world, harpoon fish, plunder your enemies, die horribly, unlock a new Captain and do it all over again!
thecaribbeansail.instHtml: Purchase the game at itch.io, grab the Windows version (The Caribbean Sail - V1.7.1.6.zip), extract, and copy the game files into the thecaribbeansail/assets folder. The Steam version works, too.

thecorruptionwithin.title: The Corruption Within
thecorruptionwithin.descHtml: A psychological thriller, first-person point-and-click adventure game set in the Victorian era, with an emphasis on strong narrative, intriguing characters, and puzzle-solving.
thecorruptionwithin.instHtml: Purchase the game at itch.io, grab the Windows version (The Corruption Within Itch version.zip), extract and copy the game files into thecorruptionwithin/gamedata folder.

cosmicwheel.title: The Cosmic Wheel Sisterhood
cosmicwheel.descHtml: Immerse yourself in an enchanting narrative experience as Fortuna, a fortune-teller Witch condemned to exile on her asteroid home. Craft your own Tarot deck, regain your freedom, and shape the fate of the cosmic Witch society.
cosmicwheel.instHtml: Purchase the game on Steam and copy all game files into the assets folder. You can also use the free demo. This game requires at least 2GB RAM.

thecurseofissyos.title: The Curse Of Issyos
thecurseofissyos.descHtml: Download the game from https://locomalito.com/games/the-curse-of-issyos and extract all game files into the assets folder.
thecurseofissyos.instHtml: Download the game from official website and extract all game files into the assets folder.

thedeadprince.title: The Dead Prince
thedeadprince.descHtml: Play the role of a blood magic assassin fulfilling the pact his family made long ago. Use your assortment of magical abilities to sneak through bases, take down guards, and assassinate your target.
thedeadprince.instHtml:
Demo Game is included. But once you see how fun this game is and decide to buy it, get it off STEAM from here Steam

To use the full version:

  1. In the Steam client, right-click on the game in your Library.
  2. Select Manage → Browse Local Files.
  3. Copy the game files into the port's thedeadprince/assets folder.

Note: Launching the full game for the first time may take a moment as it applies a patch, so just be patient.

thedeathofsanta.title: The Death of Santa
thedeathofsanta.descHtml: Santa must gather each gift along his way across and up treacherous platforms. Watch your step! Don't let the fat guy in red become the splat guy in red!

thefinalboss.title: The Final Boss
thefinalboss.descHtml: Play as the Final Boss and crush waves of heroes invading your lair. Features 6 bosses across fantasy, space, and modern scenarios in an '80s-style arcade tribute with unlockable Endless Mode.
thefinalboss.instHtml: Purchase the game at itch.io or Steam. Download, extract, and copy the game files to the thefinalboss/gamedata folder.

theflayedman.title: The Flayed Man
theflayedman.descHtml: You are the Flayed Man. Awaking in a decayed, otherworldly house where your every waking moment is agony, you must uncover the sins of the past, pass judgement, and decide your fate in this unsettling, macabre adventure.
theflayedman.instHtml: Purchase the game on itch.io or Steam. Copy the The Flayed Man.ags file to the theflayedman/gamedata folder.

thefoundersofredacted.title: The founders of [redacted]
thefoundersofredacted.descHtml: The founders of [redacted] is a pixel-art point & click adventure. It's the fourth installment in a series, following Uncle Lee strikes again, Once upon a Möbius strip, and Not enough time. Knowledge of the previous games is not required, as it is a standalone story.

happyhills.title: The Happyhills Homicide
happyhills.descHtml: Welcome to Happyhills, the town where you can indulge your deepest desires, make your wildest dreams come true, and slaughter anyone in your path. In this case, all three of these are the same. Play as a stylish 80's style slasher and kill your way through different levels. The game offers 20 completely varied levels, each with an entirely different playstyle and way of killing. Do you like a challenge? Don't worry. The game will increase in difficulty with every level, not every victim is as easy as the other. From a simple sleeping man in his armchair to fighting off a gang of bikers in a bar. And don't think for a minute you can carry out these heinous acts without an ambitious detective on your back.
happyhills.instHtml: Download the game from Steam https://store.steampowered.com/app/3278760/The_Happyhills_Homicide/ or Game Jolt https://gamejolt.com/games/thehappyhillshomicide/570127 and place the game files into the assets folder.

happyhills2.title: The Happyhills Homicide 2: Out For Blood
happyhills2.descHtml: He is back. Once again take control of mass serial killer John Wade. Six years later, the infamous Pale Grin resurrects from the grave to terrorize the broken town of Happyhills.
happyhills2.instHtml: Place your Steam or GameJolt copy of the game into happyhills2/assets/ on first run.

hordes.title: The Hordes
hordes.descHtml: The Hordes is a shooter in the style of classic arcade titles from the 80s, with enemies that only get harder when you power up. Max out your power up and you'll be firing an arc of ten bullets at at time, at enemies that are worth ten times as much! Developed by Pug Fugly Games.
hordes.instHtml: Download the game from https://pugfuglygames.itch.io/the-hordes and copy data.win into the port folder.

theimpossiblegame.title: The Impossible Game
theimpossiblegame.descHtml: The Impossible Game is a brutally challenging rhythm-based platformer where you control a square navigating a course of obstacles. One wrong move and you start from the very beginning. With pulse-pounding music, pixel-perfect timing, and a built-in level editor, it's simple to learn but nearly impossible to master.
theimpossiblegame.instHtml:
Copy the Linux game files from Steam to the ports/theimpossiblegame/gamedata directory. To get the Linux files from Steam, open the Steam console and run:

download_depot 251630 251632

Then copy the contents of the downloaded depot into ports/theimpossiblegame/gamedata/.

thelastgame.title: The Last Game
thelastgame.descHtml: Traverse the dungeon in this awesome action / bullet-hell roguelite where every choice could make or break your run. Stack over 130 different items and create powerful synergies to become truly overpowered with 13 unique characters!
thelastgame.instHtml: Purchase the game on Steam, open the Steam console and paste the folowing text to download a compatible version: download_depot 2563800 2563801 879463373856549854 and copy TheLastGame.pck into the gamedata folder. You can also use the free demo, add it into your Steam library and use this Steam console command to download a compatible version: download_depot download_depot 2964420 2964421 3185082754256006513. Devices with rk3326 cpu are not recommended because of low performance

spacefighter.title: The Last Space Fighter
spacefighter.descHtml: Originally inspired by the «Defenders of the weeping Quasar» of Ian MacLarty, this game has evolved into its own destiny. For the moment, only two levels are available ... But will you be able to defend the planet Earth until the very end? Remember, you are humanity's last hope! ...
spacefighter.instHtml: Download from itch.io and copy the space_fighter.pyxapp into the spacefighter folder.

thelegendoflumina.title: The Legend Of Lumina
thelegendoflumina.descHtml: Explore an ancient forest, push blocks to solve puzzles, and search for a way to end the curse on your land.
thelegendoflumina.instHtml:
You can download the game for free on itch: https://wizbane.itch.io/the-legend-of-lumina

Grab the linux .pck and install in the gamedata folder.

sdlpal.title: The Legend of Sword and Fairy
sdlpal.descHtml: The Legend of Sword and Fairy (Chinese: 仙劍奇俠傳; pinyin: Xiānjiàn Qíxiá Zhuàn), also known as Sword and Fairy (仙劍) or Chinese Paladin, is a Chinese language fantasy video game series and media franchise centered on a series of nine Chinese mythology/xianxia-themed adventure role-playing computer games created by Yao Zhuangxian. The eponymous first game in the series is released for MS-DOS CLI in 1995 by the 'Crazy Boyz' team (狂徒創作群) of the Taiwanese game developing and publishing company Softstar Entertainment (大宇資訊). It is one of the so-called 'Twin Swords of Softstar' (大宇雙劍) along with the sister Xuan-Yuan Sword series, and has been widely regarded as one of the (if not the) most iconic Chinese RPG series ever made.​
sdlpal.instHtml: Purchase the game from Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1546570/Sword_and_Fairy/ and put all files into the sdlpal/gamedata folder. Add the english translation into the sdlpal/gamedata from: https://www.romhacking.net/translations/2441/. If you want to play in other language, modify the variable 'MessageFileName' at the file sdlpal/sdlpal.cfg with the one you want or empty for original language.

nightshift.title: The Night Shift
nightshift.descHtml: Prevent the walking dead from escaping the graveyard and put them back to rest. Keep the job and save the innocents.
nightshift.instHtml: Download at itch.io and place the NightShift.exe into the gamedata folder.

redstrings.title: The Red Strings Club
redstrings.descHtml: The Red Strings Club is a cyberpunk narrative experience about fate and happiness featuring the extensive use of pottery, bartending and impersonating people on the phone to take down a corporate conspiracy.
redstrings.instHtml: For Steam version, copy all files from the Windows version into the assets folder. For GOG version, download the linux version installer and copy it into the assets folder.

therush.title: The Rush
therush.descHtml: The Rush is a horizontally scrolling shoot 'em up with graphics inspired by classic space shooters of the MSX. Buckle up and see if you have what it takes to master the highly adaptive Chameleon Quartz space fighter and single-handedly obliterate the alien invaders!

thesaloon.title: The Saloon
thesaloon.descHtml: Another reverse-sheepherder game. Rolling rolls your gun; rolling reloads your gun.

thesphinxoftime.title: The Sphinx of Time
thesphinxoftime.descHtml: Time slowed down -- a little at first, and no one noticed. Then the leaves began to stall in the sky. Join the crew of The Bahamut on a desperate voyage to the end of the universe to restart time itself in this sci-fi, time-warping mystery adventure. Features 30–60 minutes of fiendish puzzles, exploration, and point-and-click storytelling.

thestarlitescape.title: The Starlit Escape
thestarlitescape.descHtml: The Starlit Escape! A Game Boy style Metroidvania about exploring a haunted space station and meeting ghosts along the way! Made in the month of October for Halloween

thesunandmoon.title: The Sun and Moon
thesunandmoon.descHtml:
The Sun and Moon, the winner of Ludum Dare 29, is a platformer with a unique mechanic: you can dive into the ground. Momentum is conserved but gravity is reversed, letting you fling yourself high into the air or deep beneath the surface. The goal is always straightforward - collect the three orbs in the level and jump into the wormhole - but spikes, endless drops and impossible heights make this more and more difficult.

Note: This is the paid version from Steam
thesunandmoon.instHtml:
Purchase the game from https://store.steampowered.com/app/321560/The_Sun_and_Moon/

Download and install the game and place The Sun and Moon.exe into ports/thesunandmoon/
On first startup, the game will patch and put the files in the appropriate places.

theswapper.title: The Swapper
theswapper.descHtml: A puzzle-platformer set aboard an abandoned space station, built around creating and swapping between clones.
theswapper.instHtml:
Steam Instructions

  • Open Steam console
  • Copy and paste command: download_depot 231160 231161 5334393392610826601
  • Copy the downloaded files into ports/theswapper/gamedata.

The folder should contain TheSwapper.exe, mainSettings.ini, and the data directory.

swordwitchsapprentice.title: The Sword Witch's Apprentice
swordwitchsapprentice.descHtml: A brief sword-fighting adventure controlled entirely with the directional inputs. It offers about ten minutes of fast, focused action as you live the life of the Sword Witch's apprentice.
swordwitchsapprentice.instHtml: Download the game free at itch.io, extract, and place the game files in theswordwitchsapprentice/gamedata.

treehouse.title: The Treehouse Man
treehouse.descHtml:
A horrible corruption has forced the children of the forest into hiding. They confide in the Treehouse Man, but their prayers remain unanswered. Baptized into the group, you must take the hallowed boat on an odyssey to save your brothers and sisters before the silence kills them.
The Treehouse Man offers a seamless combination of real-time and turn-based combat, requiring equal amounts of execution and strategy to overcome. Configure the hallowed boat to your liking with different weapons, upgrades and travel companions. Explore the winding rivers of the corrupt forest, meeting all of its quirky inhabitants, friends and foes alike.
treehouse.instHtml: Purchase the game on Steam, download the windows version of the game and copy all game files into the assets folder.

tvruhh.title: The Void Rains Upon Her Heart
tvruhh.descHtml: Help her heart battle tough bosses in this Boss Rush, Bullet-hell with rogue-like elements. Fight through several randomly chosen boss battles leading up to a final battle. Each defeated monster will give her random gifts that power up her heart. Don't let her heart break!
tvruhh.instHtml:
• Install portfiles.
  • Download this specific version of the game with the steam console: "download_depot 790060 790061 6364595347882983973"
  • Copy all gamefiles to the assets folder.

walkingveg.title: The Walking Vegetables
walkingveg.descHtml: It’s the 1980’s and an evil alien race has invaded Earth, turning all vegetables into crawling, bawling, mauling abominations. You are about to join Department Radical, the grooviest police force on Earth. Are you a rad enough dude (or dame) to smite these ravenous creatures?
walkingveg.instHtml: Purchase the game on Steam and copy all game files into the assets folder.

thewind.title: The Wind
thewind.descHtml: The story of Lizzy, a tough and resourceful plainswoman, and her struggle against supernatural forces around her isolated home. A short retro-inspired pixel horror game based on The Wind (2018) directed by Emma Tammi.
thewind.instHtml: Download THEWIND_v1-0.zip free on itch.io (https://airdorf.itch.io/thewind), extract it, and copy THEWIND_v1-0.exe to the port's gamedata folder.

wratchsden.title: The Wratch's Den
wratchsden.descHtml:
The Wratch's Den is a turn-based dungeon-keeper roguelite: design rooms, summon and upgrade minions, and defend your den from waves of heroes.

This port uses Machismo to run the native Apple Silicon (arm64) Mac build directly on aarch64 Linux — no CPU emulation needed.
wratchsden.instHtml:
Installation

  1. Buy the game on itch.io or Steam
  2. Download the macOS build
  3. Place the_wratchs_den.app/ in wratchsden/gamedata/
  4. Launch the game

thermomorph.title: Thermomorph
thermomorph.descHtml:
An Alien-inspired survive-the-night horror game, created in Love2D.

Your crew is dead. Unidentified creatures stalk the halls of your mining ship. Armed with a motion sensor and a flamethrower, you must survive until the escape pod is repaired.

thunderpunch.title: Thunder Punch
thunderpunch.descHtml:
Evil alien creatures have invaded! It's up to you to unleash your THUNDER powers and PUNCH them back to the abyss!

AND REMEMBER: more POWER = more PUNCH!
thunderpunch.instHtml: Install port. Then download Thunder Punch.zip file from Itch.io, extract it and place files into the ports/thunderpunch/assets folder.

thwack.title: Thwack
thwack.descHtml: A funky-legged tennis game. Thwack demo/jam files are already included and ready to go. Optionally, you can purchase the full game and play that instead.
thwack.instHtml: The full game is available for purchase at https://jontopielski.itch.io/thwack. To run the full game, down ThwackLinux.zip, extract it, and copy the Thwack.pck file into the gamedata directory. This supports the ThwackLinux.zip, Apr 28 2023 release

thysword.title: Thy Sword
thysword.descHtml: Thy Sword is a hack n' slash platformer with procedural levels and roguelike elements.
thysword.instHtml: Purchase the game from steam OR Itch.io Download the game and place the data.win into ports/thysword/assets

tileworld.title: Tile World
tileworld.descHtml:
Tile World is a source port clone of Chip's Challenge.

Handheld edition based on: https://github.com/senquack/tileworld-for-handhelds Updated to use 640x480: https://github.com/Slayer366/tileworld-for-handhelds
tileworld.instHtml: Everything is included and ready to run. Launch Tile World, select one of the theme mods and desired display scaling and play!

timespinner.title: Timespinner
timespinner.descHtml: Travel back in time to change fate itself, in this beautifully crafted story-driven adventure, inspired by classic 90s action-platformers.
timespinner.instHtml: You must have a copy of Timespinner for Linux copied to the ports/timespinner/gamedata folder.

tinamp.title: TINAMP
tinamp.descHtml: TINAMP - This Is Not A Music player is an audio book player application meant to play DRM free audio books. It remembers listening positions, sorts alpha numerically, supports different play speeds, has a sleep timer and equalizer presets. It features a simplistic 16x4 ASCII character UI that adapts to fill the screen as much as possible. It comes with a free English and German audiobook from LibriVox.
tinamp.instHtml: Install the application and place your audio books inside the existing ports application audiobooks folder. For more folder options see notes section.

tiny-crate.title: Tiny Crate
tiny-crate.descHtml: Tiny Crate is a cute little precision platformer with puzzle elements! Lift and toss crates to traverse over spike pits and reach higher ground! Push yourself and make tight jumps! You got this!

tinyrally.title: Tiny Rally: Turbo Tour
tinyrally.descHtml: Start your engines! It's time to race! Tiny Rally: Turbo Tour is a small arcade rally racing game made for #LOWREZJAM2020.
tinyrally.instHtml: Download the game from Itch.io and extract all game files into the assets folder.

tinytowndefense.title: Tiny Town Defense
tinytowndefense.descHtml:
Follow the command of mayor L.T. and defend your tiny town from the hordes of imps.

Addicting gameplay with meta progression and upgrades will make sure you will have a great time!
tinytowndefense.instHtml: Claim the game for free on Itch: https://zefrost.itch.io/tiny-town-defense Download the linux version of the game and place "Tiny Town Defense.x86_64" in the gamedata folder.

tinyworldracing.title: Tiny World Racing
tinyworldracing.descHtml: Blast your way through a variety of environments in 20 tracks across 5 different tournaments. From crumbling castles to volcanic islands, you'll need to master all kinds of terrain to become the world's best racer.
tinyworldracing.instHtml: Purchase the full game at itch.io. Download and extract the Tiny World Racing - as a compressed ZIP version, and copy the game files to this port's gamedata folder.

tinystg.title: TinySTG
tinystg.descHtml: TinySTG is a vertical scrolling shooting game, reminiscent of titles such as 1942 ﻿and the ﻿Raiden﻿ series. Maneuver enemy bullets, earn powerups, and defeat epic bosses!

titan_tactics.title: Titan Tactics
titan_tactics.descHtml: A follow up to Pocket Tactics, Titan Tactics is inspired by the awesome tactic games of the 90s. Fight with your allies and uncover the mysteries of the kingdoms of Tyrmyr and Skathi!

titanion.title: Titanion
titanion.descHtml:
Strike down super high-velocity swooping insects.

Fixed shooter in the good old days, 'Titanion'.

Avoid incoming bullets and strike down all enemies. At the title screen, you can select a game mode (CLASSIC, BASIC, MODERN).

tmntsr.title: TMNT: Shredder's Revenge
tmntsr.descHtml: Shredder's Revenge is a side-scrolling action brawler with a pixelated artstyle. The player assumes control of Leonardo, Donatello, Michelangelo, Raphael, April O'Neil, Master Splinter, and unlockable character Casey Jones as they combat opponents including the Foot Clan, Krang, Bebop and Rocksteady, and Shredder in locations ranging from New York City sewers to Dimension X.
tmntsr.instHtml: If you have an older version, it is recommended you uninstall it first. Copy the game's data into ports/tmntsr/gamedata/.

to_the_moon.title: To the Moon
to_the_moon.descHtml: A unique & non-combat story-driven experience · Innovative mix between adventure game elements and classic RPG aesthetics. A story-driven experience about two doctors traversing backwards through a dying man's memories to artificially fulfill his last wish.
to_the_moon.instHtml: If using the GOG Version place the to_the_moon_*.sh installer in the root of the to_the_moon folder or extract the contents of the data/noarch/game/ folder into to_the_moon/gamedata/

tomb.raider.1.title: Tomb Raider I
tomb.raider.1.descHtml: An open source port of Tomb Raider 1 using OpenLara engine by xProger.
tomb.raider.1.instHtml: Just add your Steam, Epic Games, or GOG Tomb Raider 1 files to the ports/tombraider1 subfolders: .phd under level, .ogg under audio and .rpl or .fmv under video. Also works with Tomb Raider I-III Remastered files.

tombrobo.title: Tomb Robo
tombrobo.descHtml: A platformer-puzzler. Robo-hop n' roll your way through each tricky stage! But beware, don't waste your jumps!
tombrobo.instHtml: Download at itch.io and copy data.win and options.ini to assets folder.

tomomi.title: TOMOMI
tomomi.descHtml: A new superweapon has been developed by the evil organization Animalia. Enter Tomomi, a hero for hire. Joining her is Riko, the supporter. Their mission...infiltrate the Animalia complex and stop their evil plans! Will Tomomi and Riko be able to find and destroy the new weapon!?
tomomi.instHtml: Purchase the game on Steam and copy all game files into assets folder. This game is recommended primarily for devices with RK3566 cpu or better for performance reasons.

tohoumeijinka.title: Touhou Meijinka ~ Song of Divine Tempest
tohoumeijinka.descHtml: Based on an original screenplay by Emiko Hosokawa, you take control of one of four humanoids to set out and find the source of the concert. Originally based on a fangame album featuring an original score by Chuhou Joutai creator Susumu Takajima, you must traverse six stages of varying terrain to find the concert's mastermind. Whether you're alone or with a friend*, your own danmaku is imperative. This will not be an easy journey - you must dodge your enemies' danmaku and overcome their spell cards.

touhoucirno.title: Touhou: Cirno in Streets of Frog
touhoucirno.descHtml: Yokai Mountain Megacity is under attack by the criminal Frog Syndicate, and it's up to the strongest undercover fairy police officer to stop it! Punch, kick and parry your way through an onslaught of pizza-throwing knights, pop culture references, frogs and breakable crates in this smash hit that'll make your fingers bleed! Battle your way through 10 stages of frogs, fairies and ghost cosplayers in this frantic arcade action game!
touhoucirno.instHtml: Go to the game's page https://yaru.itch.io/touhou-streets-of-frog, download the game and place the zip file into gamedata folder.

towardsthepantheones.title: Towards The Pantheon: Escaping Eternity
towardsthepantheones.descHtml: A prequel mystery game that follows the journey of a soldier before the events of the full-length RPG, Towards The Pantheon. Players must solve puzzles, explore bizarre environments, and make sense of the soldier's situation.
towardsthepantheones.instHtml: Download the game (for free) here: https://connorort.itch.io/towards-the-pantheon-escaping-eternity -- extract and copy the data.win file to the port gamedata folder.

towerbabe.title: Tower Babe
towerbabe.descHtml: The evil wizard, Doodldorf, has taken your hot girlfriend and trapped her at the top of his tower. Run and jump to the top to save her! Developed by Keyslam and poltergasm for the 1-BIT JAM #4.

towerfortress.title: Tower Fortress
towerfortress.descHtml:
A mysterious tower has risen! It emits plumes of noxious green smoke from its summit making people sick. Strange creatures infest the tower but if nobody tries to ascend it we will all be doomed!

Are you that hero?.....
towerfortress.instHtml: Buy the game on Steam. Download the Windows version. Copy all assets to the gamedata folder

towerbag.title: TowerBag
towerbag.descHtml: Play as a little lonely skull, carry your TowerBag and face the evil creatures of the forest. This is a Tower Defense Game, but with only one Tower. Made by Matheus Cunegato and Rodolfo Salazar.

towerfall.title: TowerFall Ascension
towerfall.descHtml: TowerFall Ascension redefines archery combat, delivering adrenaline-pumping versus matches for up to 4 players. With its intense battles and easy-to-grasp mechanics, every moment is filled with heart-pounding action. And now, dive into the solo or duo Quest mode for an electrifying single-player adventure like never before.
towerfall.instHtml: GOG: Drop the .sh file inside the gamedata folder. Itch: Drop the .bin file inside the gamedata folder. For the DLC, put the repective file inside the gamedata folder as well. Steam version does not work due to DRM!

toziuha2.title: Toziuha Night - Order of the Alchemists
toziuha2.descHtml: This is the story of Xandria, an iron alchemist. She seeks revenge regardless of the consequences. To achieve it, Xandria fights with a powerful whip and the power of chemical elements. Find out more about her in this modern metroidvania adventure
toziuha2.instHtml: Purchase the game on Itch.io, GOG or Steam, download and extract the tn_oota.pck into the gamedata folder. You can also use the demo from Itch.io. This game requires a device with 2GB RAM.

toziuha.title: Toziuha Night: Dracula's Revenge
toziuha.descHtml: Toziuha Night Dracula's Revenge is a 2D side-scrolling action platformer with classicvania style. Travel through different linear maps set in a dark fantasy world; such as a gloomy forest and Count Dracula's castle. Play as Xandria, a beautiful and skilled alchemist who, using an iron whip, fights against the most fearsome demons and other alchemists. Find out more about this tragic story of a girl who fights with a whip of iron chains, a cruel reminder of a tragic past.
toziuha.instHtml: Purchase the game on Itch.io https://dannygaray60.itch.io/toziuha-night-draculas-revenge, download the linux version and extract the toziuha.pck into the gamedata folder. Alternatively you can also buy it on Steam, both Windows and Linux version are compatible. Install the game and copy the toziuha_night_dracula's_revenge.pck into the gamedata folder.

trianglerun.title: Triangle Run
trianglerun.descHtml: Run as far as you can, Triangle! Made by Terry Cavanagh for the #stopwaitingforgodot game jam.

trickykeys.title: Tricky Keys
trickykeys.descHtml: Your computer has been infected! Go through level to level platforming and solving puzzles with a Virus looming over your shoulder, restricting your movement and even outright taking control!
trickykeys.instHtml: This port is ready to run, thanks to Team Bugulon granting us permission to distribute this game.

trickykeys2.title: Tricky Keys 2
trickykeys2.descHtml:
Replay and reestablish your connection to the world of Tricky Keys in this old-school puzzle platforming adventure!

Equip your AI assistant with the right combination of instructions and collaborate to solve each level, avoiding the hazards along the way.
trickykeys2.instHtml: This port is ready to run, thanks to Team Bugulon granting us permission to distribute this game.

triggerrally.title: Trigger Rally
triggerrally.descHtml: Trigger is a free 3D rally car racing game. Fun for all the family! Trigger comes with a number of challenges where you have to race several tracks to finish each challenge.
triggerrally.instHtml: Ready to run! Mouse is invisible but can be navigate trough hovering over the menu items.

tripleswaptower.title: Triple Swap Tower
tripleswaptower.descHtml: Triple Swap Tower is a frantic roguelite which puts you in control of three different heroes. Swap fast between them as you fell waves of enemies, then power them up! How will you build your party?
tripleswaptower.instHtml:
Purchase the game from Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3971630/Triple_Swap_Tower
Run Steam console via Windows+R: Type: steam://open/console, download the 4.0 version by typing: download_depot 3971630 3971631 5164187858749778076 in the console.
When the download is complete, it will tell you the location of the folder, copy all the game files to /ports/tripleswaptower/assets

tripletrouble.title: Triple Trouble
tripletrouble.descHtml:
Triple Trouble is a short pixel-art point & click adventure. It's the fifth installment of our running series featuring Ines and her uncle Lee. As usual it can be enjoyed as a standalone game, and this time with 78% more pixels!

You play as aspiring writer Ines, on the day of her 20th birthday. Uncle Lee had the most amazing idea for a birthday present, which can only mean trouble. As if it wasn't enough, he just triplicated himself—it can only mean TRIPLE TROUBLE.

trogdorrb.title: Trogdor Reburninated
trogdorrb.descHtml: Trogdor Reburninated is a fan-made recreation of Trogdor for PC and consoles.

trolley.delayma.title: Trolley Delayma
trolley.delayma.descHtml: A compact puzzle game where you reroute tracks to save victims and stall the inevitable. Combine quick thinking with fast reactions as you try to rescue everyone -- yourself included.
trolley.delayma.instHtml:
You can download Trolley Delayma free at: https://albertnez.itch.io/trolley-delayma

Download the Linux version version and extract it, and place the trolley_delayma.run.pck file in the gamedata directory. This has been tested with the linux_v1_0_1.zip release.

tsunderswap.title: TS Underswap
tsunderswap.descHtml:
TS!Underswap is an unofficial fan-made reimagining of Toby Fox's UNDERTALE, made by Team Switched (TS).

The official DEMO features the first two areas, Ruined Home and Starlight Isles!
tsunderswap.instHtml: Download the Windows version from https://gamejolt.com/games/tsunderswap/160094 and unzip to ports/tsunderswap/gamedata

tube64.title: Tube64
tube64.descHtml: Tube is a little known game from Bullfrog developed for M$ DOS, released in 1994.

tukiyono.title: TUKIYONO
tukiyono.descHtml: This is a fairly high difficulty bullet hell shooter. It is a total of 4 stages + a last boss. Let's go for it...
tukiyono.instHtml: Download free at itch.io and copy the data.win into assets folder.

tumbledown.title: Tumbledown Drive
tumbledown.descHtml: Drive, jump, and honk your way to the top of this exceedingly punishing platformer. Be careful, it's a long, long way down if you fall. Includes controller support, a speedrun timer, regular secrets, and secret secrets.
tumbledown.instHtml: Download from https://managore.itch.io/tumbledown-drive and copy data.win into port folder.

tumikifighters.title: TUMIKI Fighters
tumikifighters.descHtml: Tumiki Fighters brings a different twist to the side-scrolling shooter genre. With simple 3D graphics, the player has to control a ship and shoot down the enemies. The player can swoop in and attach the wreckage to its own hull for bonus points and protection from enemy attacks. .

tutoretta.title: Tutoretta's Easy Quest
tutoretta.descHtml: Short First Person Dungeon Crawler with PixelArt and Paper-like graphics.

tuxfootball.title: Tux Football
tuxfootball.descHtml: Tux Football is a great 2D soccer (sometimes called football) game. It's bringing old style gameplay from DOS times back to your handheld with up to date graphics! It's gameplay is similar to old classics such as Amco's Kick Off and Sensible Software's Sensible Soccer.

tuxpuck.title: TuxPuck
tuxpuck.descHtml: TuxPuck is an air hockey game and clone of the Amiga/Atari ST game Shufflepuck Café. The player moves a bat around a table and tries to knock the puck past the opponent's defense. After either party has reached 15 points, the match is over.

twodie.title: Two Die
twodie.descHtml: Two Die is a turn-based, tactical, roguelike RPG where every action is determined by the roll of two six sided dice and every action requires to spend points. You choose a character out of 3 standard classes (warrior, rogue and mage) and embark on a quest where all encounters will be played through dice rolls. Battle enemies to upgrade your character and discover what hides in your lost memories.
twodie.instHtml: Purchase and download the game https://store.steampowered.com/app/1466260/Two_Die/ and place exe file to the port folder

urguys.title: U R 4 GUYS
urguys.descHtml: You are four guys, but you only have two thumbs. This "single-player co-op" game will test the relationship between your brain and your hands. Each of the four guys is bound to a different input (left stick, right stick, dpad, face buttons), and you control them all simultaneously. Survive waves of foes, climb the leaderboard, and clear the game to unlock a secret.
urguys.instHtml: Ready to run. No external files needed.

ubermoshcollection.title: Ubermosh Collection
ubermoshcollection.descHtml: Collection of all the 8 games of the saga. Omega and Vol7 suggested only with device with 2 gb or more of ram, but works also on lower specs devices, often with very long boot time (up to 3 min for these two for the first boot). Jelos could have weird visualization of some menu sometimes but the interaction works and the gameplay works as espected.
ubermoshcollection.instHtml: Inside the game folders you will find 8 folders each with the name of a Ubermosh game. Place the data.win you have inside in the correct gamedata "ie. Ubermosh black data.win in "BLACK/gamedata"

udlrmodify.title: UDLR_Modify
udlrmodify.descHtml:
Aberration: A temporary change from the typical or usual way of behaving. To reach your goal, you must change yourself.

This game can be difficult, but the difficulty curve dips down every time a new mechanic is introduced. If you get stuck, don't be afraid to skip ahead - there is no penalty for doing so!

udongeinx.title: Udongein X
udongeinx.descHtml: Mega Man X inspired Touhou fan game starring Reisen Udongein Inaba!

nuvie.title: Ultima VI (Nuvie Engine)
nuvie.descHtml: A game engine for running Origin's 'Ultima 6' and 'Ultima Worlds of Adventure' games on modern operating systems.
nuvie.instHtml: Add your Ultima VI Gamedata to the /nuvie/ultima6/ folder

ultimatestunts.title: Ultimate Stunts
ultimatestunts.descHtml: Ultimate Stunts is a remake of the famous DOS-game stunts. Racing in Ultimate Stunts involves some really spectacular stunts, like loopings, corkscrews, bridges to jump over.

ultionus.title: Ultionus
ultionus.descHtml: The galactic heroine Serena S and her best friend Balzac have saved the Universe again! She posts her victory on Spacebook only to be trolled by a misogynistic self proclaimed space prince. Time to make him pay! Ultionus is a love-letter to the home computer and arcade games of the late 80s and early 90s! It's kinda a spiritual successor to Phantis/Game Over II. Huge Thanks goes to Darkfalzx for making this game!
ultionus.instHtml:
[Instructions] 1) Download Legacy Version of Ultionus from itch.io (Download Ultionus_RC3D_Windows_NoSteam) 2) Drop purchased game files into the Game Data folder 3) Enjoy!!!

[How to Play] A = Jump X = Shoot

ultracoredive.title: ULTRA CORE DIVE
ultracoredive.descHtml: SHOOT AND DODGE your way through the underground arenas in this Dark Chaotic Arcade Twinstick Shooter! Don't get consumed by the noise!
ultracoredive.instHtml: Purchase the game on Steam and copy all files into the assets folder.

unciv.title: Unciv
unciv.descHtml: Unciv is a free, open-source remake of Civilization V with a simple, lightweight design. It focuses on strategy, exploration, and building your empire

undergrave.title: Undergrave
undergrave.descHtml: Undergrave is a tactical roguelike in which every try will challenge you with a new adventure, where moving, jumping, managing your stamina, dashing and throwing your sword away strategically is vital for success.
undergrave.instHtml: Purchase the game on Steam https://store.steampowered.com/app/1776930/Undergrave/ and place all game files into the gamedata folder. You can also use the demo version from Itch, download the Undergrave.apk from https://wired-dreams-studio.itch.io/undergrave and place it in the gamedata folder.

undertale.title: Undertale
undertale.descHtml: UNDERTALE! The RPG game where you don't have to destroy anyone.
undertale.instHtml: Copy the contents of your Steam or GOG installation to ports/undertale/assets.

undivine.title: Undivine
undivine.descHtml: A dark metroidvania with RPG elements, Undivine challenges you to explore, battle, and uncover secrets in a desolate, interconnected world. Customize your abilities, wield unique weapons, and delve into deep lore filled with mystery.
undivine.instHtml: Purchase the game on Steam and copy all game files into the assets folder. You can also use the free demo.

unfathomable.title: Unfathomable!
unfathomable.descHtml: Unfathomable! is a first person dungeon crawler featuring 13 randomly generated levels. Delve into ancient and forgotten labyrinths. Explore and collect gear while facing unearthly monsters inspired by Lovecraftian fiction.

ungratefulbirdsngd.title: Ungrateful Birds: No Good Deed
ungratefulbirdsngd.descHtml: Late one night, you walk through a forest and hear the distressed cries of caged birds echoing around you. Someone must set them free, and you're the only one there. But be warned: when freed, these confused and angry birds will turn on you. Journey through five environments, rescuing ten types of birds across dozens of stages.
ungratefulbirdsngd.instHtml: Purchase the game on itch.io, download the Windows version, extract it and copy the game files to the ungratefulbirdsngd/gamedata folder.

unlevel.title: Unlevel
unlevel.descHtml: Unlevel is a small puzzley platformer where you control a cute little penguin. They cannot do much except going left and right, but you can tilt the level to help them reach new heights.
unlevel.instHtml: Download the .love version of the game from https://nicmagnier.itch.io/unlevel, then place it in unlevel/gamedata

unlikely.title: Unlikely
unlikely.descHtml: Unlikely is a dice game with a hungry clown. Roll the dice to score points; reach 10 points to advance. If you exceed 10 points, you get an extra roll. You can also roll the big die for a bonus card, but there’s only a 66.6% chance of success.
unlikely.instHtml: Download the unlikely.rar from the Itch.io Page https://nachogames.itch.io/unlikely and extract it, Copy the Unlikely.pck in the unlikely/gamedata folder

unwin.title: Unwin
unwin.descHtml: Unwin is a one screen Sokoban puzzle game where you use the 'Unwin' button to uncollect stars, independent of Undo. Use the Stars to collect the Stars then make it to the exit.

upaon.title: Upaon: A Snake's Journey
upaon.descHtml: Help this sympathetic Snake on her journey to the hidden treasure, solve puzzles that mix mechanics of the classic game Snake with Sokoban
upaon.instHtml: Purchase the game on Steam and copy all game files into the assets folder.

upo.title: Upo
upo.descHtml: Upo is a procedurally generated music game. Your goal is to avoid collision with flying objects in rhytm to the music.

uqm.title: Ur-Quan Masters
uqm.descHtml:
The Ur-Quan Masters is a 2002 open source fangame modification, based on the action-adventure science fiction game Star Control II.

!!!Warning!!! This is a 369MB package and will take a while to download and install.

valhalla.title: VA-11 Hall-A: Cyberpunk Bartender Action
valhalla.descHtml: VA-11 HALL-A: Cyberpunk Bartender Action is a booze em' up about waifus, technology, and post-dystopia life. In this world, corporations reign supreme, all human life is infected with nanomachines designed to oppress them, and the terrifying White Knights ensure that everyone obeys the laws..
valhalla.instHtml: To boot copy the data.win/game.unx files and all the folder inside the gamedata folder and then boot the game from Valhalla.sh.

vacuoussugarquest.title: Vacuous Sugar Quest
vacuoussugarquest.descHtml: Play as Vac, an adventurer trying to climb Sugar Mountain to prove her sugar gliding abilities!

vampiregarden.title: Vampire Garden
vampiregarden.descHtml: You are a vampire tending to your garden. Be wary of the sun; the light that gives your plants life will take yours away. Grow your garden across 83 levels.

vampiresbestfriend.title: Vampire's Best Friend
vampiresbestfriend.descHtml: Vampire hunters are after a mischievous vampire girl, and it's up to her pet bat to save the day. Flap through peril in this open-ended precision “batformer” with a unique control scheme that re-contextualizes precision platformer trappings and flips them upside-down!
vampiresbestfriend.instHtml: Install port. Purchase the game or download demo on Steam. Copy Vampire's Best Friend.exe or Vampire's Best Friend Demo.exe file from the game folder into the ports/vampiresbestfriend/assets folder.

vanillara.title: VanillaRA
vanillara.descHtml: Vanilla Conquer is a fully portable version Command and Conquer Red Alert.
vanillara.instHtml: The game comes with the demo files, read the README for detailed information on installing the full game.

vanillatd.title: VanillaTD
vanillatd.descHtml: Vanilla Conquer is a fully portable version Command and Conquer Tiberium Dawn.
vanillatd.instHtml: The game comes with the demo files, read the README for detailed information on installing the full game.

vcmi.title: VCMI - Heroes of Might and Magic III
vcmi.descHtml: VCMI is a fully portable version of Heroes of Might and Magic III.
vcmi.instHtml: Copy the GoG installer files to ports/vcmi and it will install the game files as required, see the README for more information.

verminiantrap.title: Verminian Trap
verminiantrap.descHtml: SOS! Your space pod has made an emergency landing on a planet infested with giant insects from Verminest. Fight with your companions and survive while the hope of being evacuated by a rescue unit lasts.

verticaldropheroeshd.title: Vertical Drop Heroes HD
verticaldropheroeshd.descHtml: Vertical Drop Heroes is a procedural platformer RPG hybrid with roguelike elements, where your hero adventures through randomly generated stages. Armed with a variety of skills and traits, you must use your cunning and reflexes to survive the dangers of each stage.
verticaldropheroeshd.instHtml: Place game files on the ports/verticaldropheroeshd/gamedata/ directory.

vikingsofmidgard.title: Vikings of Midgard
vikingsofmidgard.descHtml: After the Aesir Gods defeated the Jotun and reshaped the world, a hidden evil crept in through the cracks of their victory. Now chaos spreads once more -- will you rise to face it? A retro-inspired RPG built with the OHRRPGCE engine, blending modern mechanics with Super Nintendo-era style.
vikingsofmidgard.instHtml: All files included and ready to run. Thanks to Fenrir-Lunaris for releasing this fantastic game to the Public Domain.

viralreload.title: Viral Reload
viralreload.descHtml: An infinite wave-based shoot-em-up with a unique dash mechanic. Blast away at deadly viruses, mechanical hybrids, and two unique bosses. Dash through bullets, lasers, and enemies to stay alive and score!
viralreload.instHtml:
You can purchase Viral Reload at: https://retrocademedia.itch.io/viral-reload

Download the Linux version and extract it, and place the Viral Reload.pck file in the gamedata directory. This has been tested with the Viral Reload Linux.zip, Jan 26 2022 release.

vitasnake.title: vitaSnake
