vitasnake.descHtml: A snake game with smooth rotation made for the PS Vita with LibVita2D. Turn left and right to collect as many apples as you can, but avoid biting your tail, or you will lose the game.

vnds-love.title: VNDS Novel Reader
vnds-love.descHtml: VNDS-LOVE allows you to play such famous games as Tsukihime, Fate \ Stay night, Ever 17, Saya no Uta and many others.
vnds-love.instHtml:
Check VNDS Wiki "https://github.com/BASLQC/vnds/wiki" to find VNDS ready novels. Place your novel folder into ./vnds-love/conf/love/VNDS-LOVE/novels/
More info in README.

vodovod.title: Vodovod
vodovod.descHtml: Vodovod is a game similar to Pipe Mania and Pipe Dream, in which you have to lead the water from the house to the storage tank. You get a limited number of pipes on each level and need to combine them to lead the water from the house at the top of the screen to the storage tank at the bottom.

voidbreach.title: Void Breach
voidbreach.descHtml: A low-res, retro point-and-click adventure where a failed experiment hurls your daughter into a cosmic rift. Embrace the void and follow -- journey through eerie forests, haunted mansions, and sunken ruins to bring her back.
voidbreach.instHtml: Purchase the game at itch.io, grab the Windows version (Void Breach.rar), extract and and copy the game files into voidbreach/gamedata folder.

voidcall.title: Void Call
voidcall.descHtml: They said, "This is your last chance." I didn't care. The prototype R0-Z -- the first working time machine -- fell to MAGNUM CA, a space paramilitary at odds with my employer. My job is to steal it; my mission is my own. I'm done being their pawn. I won't let them keep it, and I won't use it. I'll let the void take it.

voidpyramid.title: Void Pyramid
voidpyramid.descHtml: A post-apocalyptic RPG set in the space-faring Egyptian empire. In this far future, a maniacal Prime Pharaoh rules the wastelands of Earth; any who oppose him are exiled to the Void Pyramid -- an outer space prison populated by criminals, beasts, and mutants.
voidpyramid.instHtml: Download the Windows version of the game (for free) here: https://willyelektrix.itch.io/void-pyramid -- extract it, and copy the voidpyramid.rpg file to the port folder.

voidstranger.title: Void Stranger
voidstranger.descHtml:
Void Stranger is a 2D sokoban-style puzzle game where every step counts. Descend into the forgotten labyrinth teeming with fiendish foes and traps that defy reason. A swift defeat lurks at every corner for those who neither study their surroundings nor think their moves through with care. Trust you wits and slowly, surely, you will conquer the mysteries before you.

You do remember why you are here, right? Or have you lost something? Something very important to you.
voidstranger.instHtml: Purchase the game via Steam or Itch. Currently supporting v1.1.3 off Steam and Itch. Place all .png, .dat, .csv, and .win files in the assets folder. The game will take 20-30 minutes to boot for the first time only.

voidbeat.title: Voidbeat
voidbeat.descHtml: Voidbeat is a game of allegory. A world of greys, a beat that must be followed, and a series of voids that pulse to the rhythm. What you make of it is up to you.

vortexion.title: Vortexion
vortexion.descHtml: Vortexion is a MSX/SG-1000 inspired shoot-em-up written in Python and uses the Pyxel game engine.

vvvvvv.title: VVVVVV
vvvvvv.descHtml: VVVVVV is a 2010 puzzle-platform game created by Terry Cavanagh.
vvvvvv.instHtml: This port is Ready to Run, and includes all retail levels.

vylan.title: Vylan
vylan.descHtml: Help Vylan on his journey to regain lost memories, in this Tile-Based platformer. Take on the 100 levels in this game that takes the platformer genre and flips it on its head.
vylan.instHtml: Purchase the game on Steam or Itch.io, you can also use the free demo. Copy the Vylan.pck (or VylanDemo.pck) into the gamedata folder.

wakingmars.title: Waking Mars
wakingmars.descHtml: Waking Mars is a one-of-a-kind adventure in which you jetpack through subterranean Mars encountering a host of extraordinary alien lifeforms that operate as a living, breathing ecosystem.
wakingmars.instHtml:
Add your Linux (humble) game files to the gamedata folder

File structure: /roms/ports/wakingmars/gamedata/wakingmars_files /roms/ports/wakingmars/gamedata/wakingmars.png

walthrosrenewal.title: Walthros: Renewal
walthrosrenewal.descHtml: A turn-based RPG about a kind-hearted doofus trying to make tough times a little easier. Set in Walthros -- a world of floating fish, chill cats, and long-buried secrets -- Bob's routine excavation job spirals into something much bigger when he uncovers a discovery that could reshape history.
walthrosrenewal.instHtml: Purchase the game from https://store.steampowered.com/app/1317270/Walthros_Renewal and download using the following download_depot/DepotDownload details: -app 1317270 -depot 1317271 -manifest 6884196317892834424. Copy the game files walthrosrenewal.rpg and BurpinBros.rpg to the port directory.

wargus.title: Wargus
wargus.descHtml: Wargus is a Warcraft 2 Mod that allows you to play Warcraft 2 with the Stratagus engine. The game looks and sounds almost exactly like Warcraft 2. The gameplay is very close to Warcraft 2’s gameplay, with slight enhancements towards Starcraft and other more modern RTS games.
wargus.instHtml: Please read until the end to see which versions are not supported. For the GOG version (2019) copy the setup_warcraft_ii_.exe and setup_warcraft_ii_.bin file to /wargus/gamefiles/. For the Warcraft II Battle.net Edition CD (1999) - Copy all the files from the CD into /wargus/gamefiles/ (All files NOT just INSTALL.EXE/MPQ). Then just run the game. This will take longer on first startup to extract the assets (15min to 60min). For the DOS floppy disk version - Copy all the files from the DOS game's data directory into /wargus/gamefiles/ to get the music working download FluidR3_GM.sf2 from https://member.keymusician.com/Member/FluidR3_GM/ and place it in /wargus/data/. The DOS CD version doesn't seem to work fails with 'INVALID TITLE WITH QUOTES' it may expect the original CD to extract audio tracks - there are some similar issues in the wargus github. WarCraft II Remastered (2024) asset extraction is not supported you must have an older copy of the game. Don't mix sources - if you try with another source backup your saves in conf, delete the wargus directory because the data directory may be tainted and start again.

warzone2100.title: Warzone 2100
warzone2100.descHtml: Warzone 2100 is an open source, 3D real-time strategy game with a story-driven single player campaign, online multi-player, offline skirmish, and more. Command the forces of The Project in a battle to rebuild the world after mankind has been nearly destroyed by nuclear missiles.
warzone2100.instHtml: The installer automatically takes care of setting up the game.

watchduckslegacy.title: Watch Ducks Legacy
watchduckslegacy.descHtml: Something new to do between playing your favourite ports -- watch ducks and collect POINTS that build with every session.

watercloset.title: Water Closet
watercloset.descHtml: Escape down the toilet at the end of each stage in this puzzle-platformer, using a time-cloning mechanic to solve each room.
watercloset.instHtml: Ready to run, no additional files needed.

waternet.title: Waternet
waternet.descHtml: Waternet is a puzzle game where you to connect pipes to each other so that water flows through it.

wetspot2.title: Wetspot 2
wetspot2.descHtml: A port of QuickBasic 4.5 game Wetspot 2 by Angelo Mottola.

whichsausagemate.title: Which Sausage, Mate
whichsausagemate.descHtml: Papers Please-style cashier sim in a Polish convenience store. Scan groceries, verify IDs, grill hot dogs, survive 30 days at Żopka. 9 endings, 50+ characters, 127 products, 69 achievements.

widelands.title: Widelands
widelands.descHtml:
A real-time build-up strategy game You are the regent of a small clan. Your task is to build an ever growing settlement. Every member of your clan will do his or her part to produce more resources to further this growth.

Widelands offers a single-player mode with campaigns that tell stories of the tribes and their struggle in the Widelands universe. However, settling really starts when you unite with friends over the Internet or LAN to build up new empires together – or to crush each other in the dusts of war. Widelands also offers an artificial intelligence to challenge you.
widelands.instHtml: All game files included, optional Mods can be installed at will. Main Menu Windows can be dragged if screen is too small.

willyousnail.title: Will You Snail
willyousnail.descHtml: A unique platformer where an evil AI predicts your movement. Dodge AI-spawned traps, solve optional puzzles and uncover the dark secrets of the simulation. A lot of levels in Will You Snail are relatively empty by default. The challenge comes from the interactions with the evil AI. You will jump, run, dodge and die. This game is precise, fast-paced and challenging. (Stay cool, you can change the difficulty at any time.)
willyousnail.instHtml: Purchase the game from Steam. Use download_depot 1115050 1115051 8411373960038250729 with Steam Console to download the game and add the data to willyousnail/assets.

windmills.title: Windmills
windmills.descHtml: Master your combat techniques and explore a magic world in this combat-focused metroidvania. Help the unreliable narrator complete his story which changes depending on the player's actions.
windmills.instHtml: Purchase the game on Steam and copy all files into the assets folder. You can also use the free demo from Steam. Linux and Mac users check the notes for correct download depots.

wizardorb.title: Wizard Orb
wizardorb.descHtml: A challenging little puzzle-platformer game where platforms appear and disappear each time you leap.
wizardorb.instHtml: You can download Wizard Orb for free at: https://slimewitch.itch.io/wizard-orb. Download the windows.zip version and extract it, and place the index.pck file in the gamedata directory.

wizardchase.title: Wizardchase
wizardchase.descHtml:
2D retro pacman like arcade game

Collect all the treasure in the dungeon! Can you make it to the second level? Leave your highest score in the comments. Good luck!

wizardwizard.title: WizardWizard
wizardwizard.descHtml: WizardWizard is a challenging and addicting platformer with tight controls and simple mechanics. The game play is complimented by beautiful pixel graphics and awesome beats by the talented producer _TWC. WizardWizard is easy to pick up and play making for a fun social experience at school or on at a lunch break. WizardWizard is a game with a lot of love and character that will kick your butt and drive you to tears... I hope anyway.
wizardwizard.instHtml: Download wizardwizard.exe from itch.io or gamejolt and place it in ports/wizardwizard

wizball.title: Wizball
wizball.descHtml: A remake of the classic Commodore 64 Wizball game by Sensible Software.

wizorb.title: Wizorb
wizorb.descHtml: The once peaceful Kingdom of Gorudo is threatened by an evil presence. The only hope for salvation is Cyrus, a wizard versed in a secret magic art called Wizorb! Explore many strange places from the derelict monster infested town of Clover to Gorudo Castle atop Cauldron Peak. Danger lurks around every corner so you'll need to keep your wits about you and have quick reflexes in order to survive.
wizorb.instHtml:
Purchase the game from Humble or Steam.
For Humble, download and place the linux installer(wizorb-06232015-bin) in ports/wizorb/gamedata.
For Steam, download the linux game files and place them in ports/wizorb/gamedata.

wizznic.title: Wizznic
wizznic.descHtml: Wizznic! is an open-source, freeware remake of Puzznic, recreating the original arcade levels, the NES ones and including fan-made puzzle packs with new custom levels. The gameplay remains exactly the same, where the player has to move individual tiles, arranging them inside a restricted space to create groups of identical blocks and make all disappear by touching each other. Elevators and other features gradually start to appear on later levels.
wizznic.instHtml: All files are included and game is ready to play

wolf3d.title: Wolfenstein 3D
wolf3d.descHtml:
LZ Wolf and EZ Wolf come to PortMaster! A Love2D launcher makes selecting games and mods easy. See the readme for instructions and details.

Includes shareware demo files.
wolf3d.instHtml: Comes with shareware files for Wolfenstein 3D and Spear of Destiny. Add your full game files to their respective folders to play.

wolfensteinrpg.title: Wolfenstein RPG
wolfensteinrpg.descHtml: A dungeon-crawler RPG spin-off of Wolfenstein, reverse-engineered from the original iOS release.
wolfensteinrpg.instHtml: Requires 'Wolfenstein RPG.ipa' placed in /roms/ports/wolfensteinrpg/. This iOS game is in your own Apple ID purchase history if you bought it in 2009-era.

wordlesdl.title: Wordle SDL
wordlesdl.descHtml:
Wordle SDL is a port of a clone of Wordle made with SDL.

Wordle is a web-based word game created and developed by Welsh software engineer Josh Wardle, and owned and published by The New York Times Company since 2022. Players have six attempts to guess a five-letter word, with feedback given for each guess in the form of colored tiles indicating when letters match or occupy the correct position.

wordswithfreds.title: Words With Freds
wordswithfreds.descHtml: Guess the five letter word within six attempts! Thousands of words to guess! Features 24 different color palettes and 8 background options.
wordswithfreds.instHtml: This game is ready to run. Special thanks to Fred Wood for allowing PortMaster to distribute the game!

wordscoop.title: WORDSCOOP! With Gelato the Otter
wordscoop.descHtml: Your goal is to find words by connecting adjacent, contiguous scoops! When the word is ready, click again on the last scoop to submit.
wordscoop.instHtml: Purchase at itch.io or on Steam and copy the WordScoop.exe to the wordscoop folder.

worldofgoo.title: World of Goo
worldofgoo.descHtml: World of Goo is a multiple award winning physics based puzzle / construction game made entirely by two guys. Drag and drop living, squirming, talking, globs of goo to build structures, bridges, cannonballs, zeppelins, and giant tongues. The millions of Goo Balls that live in the beautiful World of Goo are curious to explore - but they don't know that they are in a game, or that they are extremely delicious.
worldofgoo.instHtml: Copy your GOG World of Goo .sh into the Port folder or copy your Linux Game files (WorldOfGoo.bin.x86_64 renamed to WorldOfGoo.bin and GameFolder) to the worldofgoo gamedata folder.

world.war.ii.gi.title: World War II GI
world.war.ii.gi.descHtml: World War 2 GI using the rednukem build open source port by Alexey Khokholov.
world.war.ii.gi.instHtml: You'll need to add your own full version WW2GI.GRP and WW2DI.RTS and .CON files and optionally CD audio tracks as OGG file in the format trackXX.ogg (where XX is the track number) to the ports/rednukem-WWII/gamedata folder.

worship_vector.title: Worship Vector
worship_vector.descHtml: Worship Vector is a Tower Defense type game. The game is based upon a unique map, which extends automatically.

wrestlejump2.title: Wrestle Jump 2
wrestlejump2.descHtml: Push the button to extend your wrestler's leg, smash your opponent's head to the ground to score, first to five wins!

wuppo.title: Wuppo
wuppo.descHtml: Play as an exiled 'wum' looking for a new home in this bizarre but charming world, filled with strange creatures, puzzles, monsters and political chaos.
wuppo.instHtml:
1. Install portfiles. Buy Wuppo on Steam.
  2. Open the Steam console and enter download_depot 400630 400631 7979843440656313703.
  3. Once the download completes, navigate to the downloaded files.
  4. Copy everything except for the Funpack and Soundtrack folders.
  5. Go to your ROMs SD card, locate the ports/wuppo/assets folder, and paste the files there.

xyze.title: X-YZE
xyze.descHtml: Shutdown sequence interrupted... memories wiped... can't speak... voice in head... ordered to kill... awaking in prison... what's going on? X-YZE (pronounced "excise") is a bump combat action game with a mysterious short story.

xanthiom.title: Xanthiom Zero
xanthiom.descHtml: Take control of Captain Grisham as you investigate the uncharted Planet 4-514. Collect items to help you progress deeper into the planet's depths, and power up your weapons to fight off powerful enemies and bosses! Explore multiple biomes, each with its own hazards to navigate, and uncover the mysteries that lie underneath the surface!
xanthiom.instHtml: Purchase the game on Steam and copy all files into the assets folder.

xargon.title: Xargon
xargon.descHtml: An archaeologist named Malvineous Havershim was studying strange ruins in Madagascar, remnants of buildings constructed during the age of a long-forgotten civilization of the mysterious Blue Builders. One day Malvineous spotted glyphs on one of the structures. As he attempted to translate them, Malvineous was hit by a wave of gas and fainted. In his dream, a talking eagle named Silvertongue tried to warn him of upcoming dangers. The archaeologist awoke in a strange and hostile world, unable to understand anything. With Silvertongue's guidance, Malvineous will have to overcome all dangers and eventually confront Xargon, the tyrannical ruler of that world.
xargon.instHtml: Everything is included and ready to run.

xenofightersr.title: Xeno Fighters R
xenofightersr.descHtml: Xeno Fighters R is an in-development shmup fangame inspired by the Raiden Fighters series by Seibu Kaihatsu. The game has four original fighters: the Amada Vipros, the Phyxius, the Zaiva, and the Xelcor. It also features guest fighters from other shoot 'em up games by Psikyo, Capcom, Konami, and others. There are 20 stages to play in the game with four different game modes to select from.

xenonvalkyrie.title: Xenon Valkyrie
xenonvalkyrie.descHtml: Xenon Valkyrie is a rogue-like with many RPG elements in which you will have to get to the deepest part of a moon and finish the plans of a wicked witch. You will be able to get many weapons randomly as you fight in a world that is created every time you play.
xenonvalkyrie.instHtml: Download the game from https://store.steampowered.com/app/573780/Xenon_Valkyrie/, copy copy data.win, all .ogg and .ini files to /ports/xenonvalkyrie/gamedata

xenosensory.title: Xenosensory
xenosensory.descHtml: Xenosensory is a short incremental casual game with horror themes. Use your cursor to bust Xenos and save convicts, then spend your research points on skill tree upgrades, actions, gadgets, and uncover the true horrifying nature of this space station nightmare.
xenosensory.instHtml: Purchase the game on Steam and copy all game files into the assets folder. Devices with RK3326 cpu are not recommended for performance reasons.

xess.title: Xess
xess.descHtml: Do you like the idea of Chess, but want it to be a bit more and wilder? Like so much it's maybe too much even? XESS features 16 characters/factions to choose from, with unique units and setups. There's online multiplayer, puzzle levels, a short story mode, an endless challenge mode and a mediocre-at-best AI for versus."

xga.title: XGA
xga.descHtml: This is a Metroidvania aiming to continue Metroid Fusion's focus on horror and the SA-X. Explore a huge, interconnected space station, fighting various monsters, upgrades and boss battles. Avoid XGA as getting caught means certain death....

hoverboard.title: xkcd Hoverboard
hoverboard.instHtml: All files are included and game is ready to play.

xmoto.title: Xmoto
xmoto.descHtml:
Xmoto is a challenging 2D motocross platform game, where physics play an all important role in the gameplay. You need to control your bike to its limit, if you want to have a chance finishing the more difficult of the challenges.

First you'll try just to complete the levels, while later you'll compete with yourself and others, racing against the clock.
xmoto.instHtml: Ready to run! When creating a new profile, either accept the default name, or see README.md for how to enter your own name.

xooxenoxafari.title: Xoo: Xeno Xafari
xooxenoxafari.descHtml: It's your summer vacation on Xoo Island -- a beautiful, deserted place filled with a surreal menagerie of alien creatures. Can you find them all in this new-style collecting RPG? While you're at it, scoop up fossils, gems, eggs, merit badges, video games, and anything else not nailed down.
xooxenoxafari.instHtml:
Paid (new/sequel) version

1.Purchase and download from: https://willyelektrix.itch.io/xoo-xeno-xafari 2. Extract, and copy xoo.rpg to the xooxenoxafari port folder

Free (old) version

  1. Download from: https://willyelektrix.itch.io/1999megallennium
  2. Extract, and copy megadata/xeno.rpg to the xooxenoxafari port folder

xroar.title: XRoar
xroar.descHtml: XRoar emulates the Dragon 32/64; Tandy Colour Computers 1, 2 and 3; the Tandy MC-10; and some other similar machines or clones. Put coco bios .rom files in bios folder and rom .cas file in gamedata folder.
xroar.instHtml: The compatible ROM files need to be included in the ports/xroar/bios folder. For example: place the bas13.rom in ports/xroar/bios, then your Color Computer game files in the appropriate ports/xroar/roms subfolder.

xye.title: Xye
xye.descHtml: Xye is a puzzle game in which the objective is to help a character that looks like a green circle to get all the gems in the room. This is, of course, not as easy as it sounds; Xye must solve all sorts of puzzles while at the same time avoiding all sorts of traps and beasts. Xye is similar to other puzzle games like Sokoban or Boulder Dash, yet it also includes some arcade elements. Xye is a derivative of a classic Windows game called Kye, which is the base of the gameplay experience and visual elements. Xye is able to play level files that were made for Kye and Sokoban.

yellowjacket.title: Y E L L O W - J A C K E T
yellowjacket.descHtml: Y E L L O W - J A C K E T (or just yellow jacket) is a vaporwave arcade shoot-em-up about a motorcyclist running from the government in this classic 80s style arcade shmup! Can you get the highest score?
yellowjacket.instHtml: Download the game on itch.io page and retrieve the file data.win from the Y E L L O W - J A C K E T.zip. After, data.win needs to be place on to the folder ports/yellowjacket/gamedata.

yarntown_pm.title: Yarntown
yarntown_pm.descHtml: Yarntown is a charming 16-bit, top-down demake that transforms the gothic world of Bloodborne into a retro, Zelda-style action RPG. Explore the pixel-art streets of Yharnam, dodge-roll through danger, and face iconic bosses in fast-paced, challenging combat.
yarntown_pm.instHtml: Get the .solarus file for this port by downloading Yarntown from https://solarus-games.org/games/yarntown/, then move it into ports/yarntown.

yatka.title: Yatka
yatka.descHtml: YATKA is one of many Tetris implementations available. Motivation behind this one was, on the one hand, to create a game that would conform to modern rules of the game, while, on the other, to make possible running it on resource-limited platforms (e.g. Bittboy or JZ4760-based handheld consoles). Two Classic themes by Tekkenfede included.
yatka.instHtml: All file included, boot the game and play

yknytt.title: YKnytt
yknytt.descHtml: A remake of the atmospheric platformer Knytt Stories, originally developed by Nifflas. With over 1200 community levels!

yolkheroes.title: Yolk Heroes: A Long Tamago
yolkheroes.descHtml: A cute Tamagotchi idle game from 14 Hours Productions.
yolkheroes.instHtml: Purchase game from Steam, rename the main .pck to "yolkheroes.pck" and add to the yolkheroes/gamedata/ directory. See https://portmaster.games/gptokeyb-documentation.html for details about Keyboard Text Entry.

youdiedbanry.title: You Died But a Necromancer Revived You
youdiedbanry.descHtml: You Died ... but a Necromancer revived you! And will keep bringing you back to their crazy tower of death until you reach the top floor and get rid of them, allowing you to finally be free... Can you stop this madness? Or will you give up? Reaching the top is no easy feat!
youdiedbanry.instHtml:
Purchase the game from https://bolhut.itch.io/you-died-but-a-necromancer-revived-you OR https://store.steampowered.com/app/1037100/You_Died_but_a_Necromancer_revived_you/

Steam: Run steam console via Windows+R: Type: steam://open/console, download the linux version by typing: download_depot 1037100 1037102 in the console, when the download is complete, it will tell you the location of the folder, copy the game files from the assets folder to /ports/youdiedbanry/assets

Itch: Download YouDied_BaNRY_linux.zip an copy the game files from the assets folder to /ports/youdiedbanry/assets

youhave10s2023.title: You Have 10 Seconds (2023)
youhave10s2023.descHtml:
A fast paced platformer where you’re spawned into a level and given 10 seconds to work out how to reach the exit without dying. 25 areas with unique level design mechanics to learn.

Note: Motion Blur, Vsync and Details can be disabled/lowered under options to improve game performance!

yomihd.title: YourOnlyMoveIsHustle Demo
yomihd.descHtml: Master your technique, execute flashy combos, and outsmart opponents across the world, frame-by-frame. Slow down the clock to fine-tune your fighting style in this innovative, turn-based combat simulator. Pulverize your friends and choreograph spectacular fight scenes. No training mode required.
yomihd.instHtml: Download and play! Full mod support isn't yet available. Removing the Steam API from the game made some mods incompatible (like char_loader).

yugioh2.title: Yugioh 2
yugioh2.descHtml: Yugioh 2 is a roguelike SRPG based on the Yugioh card game. Before each duel, you spend SOULS to summon monsters to your team, and if you win the match, you either get more monsters or more souls (so you can summon more monsters). Also, more powerful monsters COST more souls to summon, so you need to decide if you want MORE guys or STRONGER guys. The game ends if you win 15 duels (good) or lose 3 duels (bad). Along these duels, you will also face 4 randomly selected bosses from your favorite children's card game.
yugioh2.instHtml: Download YGO2.zip from itch.io and extract the contents to this port's gamedata folder.

z-warp.title: Z-Warp
z-warp.descHtml: Z-Warp is an intense vertical shoot’em up presented in retro pixel art style, featuring frenetic arcade-inspired action where blasters, bombs and KILLER specials are your only allies.
z-warp.instHtml: Purchase from Steam Locate data.win and place it inside the corresponding gamedata folder.

zenodeath.title: Zenodeath
zenodeath.descHtml: Zenodeath is the final entry in the Zeno series, the final evolution, featuring a modern OST by HeavyViper and two gameplay types.
zenodeath.instHtml: Purchase the game on Steam and copy all game files into the assets folder.

zenohell.title: Zenohell
zenohell.descHtml: Zenohell is a 90s inspired shoot-em'up (shmup) that is all about simple gameplay, just dodge, shoot, score, with vibrant pixel visuals and a kicking 28 track soundtrack, with lots of content to boot.
zenohell.instHtml: Buy the game on Steam and copy all game files into assets folder.

zeroptianinvasion.title: Zeroptian Invasion
zeroptianinvasion.descHtml: The Zeroptians have invaded the planetary system of F1. Eliminate the threat and proclaim yourself the defender of the galaxy in this miniature pixelated game featuring chiptune melodies and gameplay inspired by classics such as Space Invaders, Phoenix, Galaxian, and Centipede.
zeroptianinvasion.instHtml: Purchase the game on itch.io or Steam. For itch.io, download the ZeroptianInvasion_itchio.zip version, extract it and copy the game files to the port's gamedata folder. For Steam, there's no need to extract any files, just copy them across.

zeroranger.title: ZeroRanger
zeroranger.descHtml: ZeroRanger is a vertically scrolling 2D shoot'em up with heavy emphasis on shooting, dodging and... mystery?
zeroranger.instHtml: Copy the contents of your Steam or Itch.io install into the assets folder.

zgloom.title: ZGloom
zgloom.descHtml: ZGloom is a re-implementation of Amiga FPS Gloom, including support for Gloom 3, Gloom Deluxe and Zombie Massacre.
zgloom.instHtml: All files are included and game is ready to run.

ziggurat.title: Ziggurat
ziggurat.descHtml: A short adventure game featuring a dreamy atmosphere and strange characters.
ziggurat.instHtml: You can download Ziggurat for free at: https://nethead.itch.io/ziggurat. Download the Ziggurat-Linux.zip version and extract it, and place the Ziggurat.pck file in the gamedata directory.

zimlite.title: Zimlite
zimlite.descHtml: Carry Wikipedia, Wiktionary, Wikibooks and more in your pocket! Zimlite is a fast, lightweight offline ZIM reader with gamepad-friendly browsing, alphabetical article tree, link navigation with history, and instant startup on your handheld — no internet required.

znax.title: Znax
znax.descHtml: Znax is a remake of a game by Nick Kouvaris. It is a sort of puzzle / arcade game where you as the player need to select 4 blocks of the same color and form rectangles as big as you can
znax.instHtml: All files are included and game is ready to play.

zniwadventure.title: Zniw Adventure
zniwadventure.descHtml: Zniw Adventure is a hand-drawn point and click adventure game with a strong 90's vibe and cartoon animations. Play as Zniw - a yellow female dinosaur who is on a mission to find the ultimate gift for her mother's hatchday!
zniwadventure.instHtml:
For the demo

Demo is ready to run.

For the full game

From your purchased copy of Zniw Adventure, copy the data folder into the port's root. The zniw.demo file can be removed after, once confirming it works.

zzt.title: ZZT
zzt.descHtml: ZZT is a 1991 action-adventure puzzle video game and game creation system developed and published by Potomac Computer Systems for MS-DOS

am2r.title: AM2R
am2r.descHtml: Another Metroid 2 Remake. An action-adventure game developed by Argentinian programmer Milton Guasti (also known as DoctorM64).
am2r.instHtml: Copy your own am2r v1.1 zip file into ports/am2r/assets folder.

castlevaniatales.title: Castlevania Tales of Night Moon
castlevaniatales.descHtml: A fan made Castlevania game where you play as Soma.
castlevaniatales.instHtml: Download free at itch.io and copy data.win to assets.

chaoresortisland.title: Chao Resort Island
chaoresortisland.descHtml: Chao Resort Island is a 2.5D Chao raising game originally available for PC and Mac and now on PortMaster! The game takes place on a tropical island which hosts multiple resorts for you to raise your Chao in.

donkeykongredux.title: Donkey Kong Redux
donkeykongredux.descHtml: With this project I am willing to replicate the behaviour of the original Donkey Kong by Nintendo. I tried to simulate the game logic and timing spending multiple hours watching videos of the original game. Game programming is now completed with four brand new levels added on the top of the 4 original ones.
donkeykongredux.instHtml: Go here, https://80s-arcade-games.itch.io/donkey-kong-redux and download the DonkeyKongRedux_200.zip use 7zip or whatever to extract the contents, and copy them all into the assets folder. Launch and Enjoy!

duckdodge.title: Duck Dodge
duckdodge.descHtml: Have you ever wanted to play Duck Hunt, but as the poor defenseless duck? Avoid the hunter's shots and fly away! Be careful, the hunter gets progressively better with each round!
duckdodge.instHtml: Ready to run! Thanks to the Diego Escalante for providing source code and MIT license on his GitHub.

dusklight.title: Dusklight
dusklight.descHtml: Native reimplementation of The Legend of Zelda: Twilight Princess, built on the zeldaret decompilation and rendered through Aurora on OpenGL ES.
dusklight.instHtml: Place your own legally-dumped Twilight Princess GameCube or Wii disc image (.iso or .rvz) in the assets directory.

gizmoduck.title: Gizmoduck
gizmoduck.descHtml: This is a fangame about the adventures of Gizmoduck developed by Gektorne.
gizmoduck.instHtml: Download the Windows version of the game from Itch.io and copy Gizmoduck.exe into gamedata folder.

gta3.title: Grand Theft Auto 3
gta3.descHtml: Welcome to Liberty City. Where it all began. The critically acclaimed blockbuster Grand Theft Auto III brings to life the dark and seedy underworld of Liberty City. With a massive and diverse open world, a wild cast of characters from every walk of life, and the freedom to explore at will, Grand Theft Auto III puts the dark, intriguing, and ruthless world of crime at your fingertips.
gta3.instHtml:
Copy all files from the original game to roms/ports/gta3. The game requires assets from the classic version released in 2001 (not the Definitive Edition, 2021). Versions from Steam and Rockstar Store are confirmed to work fine.

If needed, readjust analog sticks sensitivity by changing LeftStickSens/RightStickSens values in re3.ini.

gtavc.title: Grand Theft Auto Vice City
gtavc.descHtml: Welcome to the 1980s. From the decade of big hair, excess, and pastel suits comes a story of one man's rise to the top of the criminal pile as Grand Theft Auto returns.
gtavc.instHtml:
Copy all files from the original game to roms/ports/gtavc. The game requires assets from the classic version released in 2002 (not the Definitive Edition, 2021). Versions from Steam and Rockstar Store are confirmed to work fine.

If needed, readjust analog sticks sensitivity by changing LeftStickSens/RightStickSens values in reVC.ini.

loderunneronline.title: Lode Runner Online
loderunneronline.descHtml: A fan-made cross-platform clone of Lode Runner Online: The Mad Monks' Revenge.
loderunneronline.instHtml:
You can change controls in the options (cog) menu, but you must plug in a mouse to assign the gamepad inputs.

For the CD soundtrack, download the DLC here: https://mmr.quarkrobot.com/manual/get-started#soundtrack -- place the LR_AUDIO.PRS file in the port's savadata folder.

megamanw.title: Mega Man W
megamanw.descHtml: Mega Man W is a fan made game by Team W which aims to be similar to the original six mega man games. You will face off against a fierce hoard of robots infected by a virus corrupting them and making them go mad!
megamanw.instHtml: Download any version of the game (linux,windows,mac) from https://jumpdashevade.itch.io/mega-man-w and place the .pck file into the MegaManW port folder.

minimario.title: MiniMario
minimario.descHtml: A Mario fan game that was made using the Pyxel engine.
minimario.instHtml: Download at itch.io and place MiniMario.pyxapp into minimario directory

minimetroid.title: MiniMetroid
minimetroid.descHtml: A Metroid fan game that was made using the Pyxel engine.
minimetroid.instHtml: Download at itch.io and place MiniMetroid.pyxapp into minimetroid directory

minizelda.title: MiniZelda
minizelda.descHtml: A ZELDA fan game that was made using the Pyxel engine.
minizelda.instHtml: Download at itch.io and place MiniZelda.pyxapp into minizelda directory

nuclearthronemobile.title: Nuclear Throne Mobile
nuclearthronemobile.descHtml: This is an open source recreation and is based on Nuclear Throne u19, featuring everything from the final release of u9. Nuclear Throne is a post-apocalyptic roguelike-like top-down shooter. Fight your way through the wastelands with powerful weaponry, collecting radiation to mutate some new limbs and abilities. All these things and more you could do if only you were good at this game. Can you reach the Nuclear Throne?

pacmanrom.title: PacMan ROM
pacmanrom.descHtml: Recent reports have talked about strange symptoms when trying this corrupted ROM of the classic Pacman, we can't confirm or deny it, play it at your own risk.
pacmanrom.instHtml: Ready to Run! Thanks to Berick Cook for giving us permissions to distribute game files!

pokemmo.title: PokeMMO
pokemmo.descHtml: Unofficial port of PokeMMO for PortMaster-compatible devices. PokeMMO is a fan-made multiplayer online game that brings together various Pokémon generations in a single MMO experience.
pokemmo.instHtml: Download the portable version of the PokeMMO client from https://pokemmo.com/en/downloads/portable. Extract the ZIP and copy both the PokeMMO.exe file and the data folder into /roms/ports/pokemmo.

reborn.title: Pokemon Reborn
reborn.descHtml:
Reborn is a free 3rd-gen style downloadable game featuring all content through Generation 7. Experience a never-before-seen layer of strategy with the all-original Field Effects, using the terrain to outplay and overwhelm your opponent! Collect, train and battle with all 807 species available in-game and take on Gym Leaders of all 18 types as you fight to restore Reborn to prosperity!

Are you ready?
reborn.instHtml: Download the legacy Windows version of the game here. Install the game and copy all assets within the "Pokemon Reborn" folder to the "reborn" portfolder. The version has to be 19.16 or 19.17, this can be checked with the version file included with the game.

rejuvenation.title: Pokemon Rejuvenation
rejuvenation.descHtml:
Many decades ago, Aevium was once a united and strong blossoming region. However, the calamity known as Storm-9 tore the region apart.

The Aevium Region has lived a time of peace since then. People and the creatures inhabiting the lands band together to create a region worth living in. However, the dark and sinister organization, Team Xen, rises from the shadows to destroy what little peace the region has left.

Explore the Aevium Region while also defending the land from Team Xen. Discover the dark secrets this world has kept hidden under the cracks that separate Aevium and shakes it to its very core.

This world needs you.

Will you lend us your strength?
rejuvenation.instHtml: Download the Windows version of the game here. Install the game and copy all assets within the "Pokemon Rejuvenation" folder to the "rejuvenation" portfolder. Version 13.5.0 is known to work, future updates may be incompatible.

pokewilds.title: Pokéwilds
pokewilds.descHtml: PokéWilds is an open-world Pokémon fan game with survival and exploration elements. Built on Gen 2-style graphics, it features procedurally generated worlds, base-building, and freeform gameplay. Catch, train, and battle Pokémon while exploring diverse biomes, crafting shelters, and uncovering hidden secrets.
pokewilds.instHtml: After installing the port, download the Windows game from https://github.com/SheerSt/pokewilds/releases and extract the mods and app folders, as well as settings.txt, into ports/pokewilds/bin.

render96ex.title: Render96ex
render96ex.descHtml: Super Mario 64 is the first Super Mario game to feature 3D. Discover the precursor to Mario Odyssey in this boosted version with the support of enhanced 3d models, HD textures, HQ musics and sounds, 60 fps.
render96ex.instHtml: Copy your Super Mario 64 USA rom in the render96ex folder and rename it to baserom.us.z64 (md5sum 20b854b239203baf6c961b850a4a51a2)

soh.title: Ship of Harkinian
soh.descHtml: A source port of Ocarina of Time & Master Quest. Ship of Harkinian features extensive and significant enhancements over the original game, such as improved performance, increased frame-rate, native ultra-widescreen support, and extensive mod support (especially compared to emulated versions of the original), among other features.
soh.instHtml: Follow the guide at https://www.shipofharkinian.com/setup-guide for your desired platform to create your oot.o2r and/or oot-mq.o2r files. Once created put in the ports/soh/baseroms folder.

soh2.title: Ship of Harkinian 2
soh2.descHtml: A source port of Majora's Mask. 2Ship2Harkinian (aka SoH2) features extensive and significant enhancements over the original game, such as improved performance, increased frame-rate, native ultra-widescreen support, and extensive mod support (especially compared to emulated versions of the original), among other features.
soh2.instHtml: Follow the guide in the readme to generate your mm.o2r file.

spaghettikart.title: SpaghettiKart
spaghettikart.descHtml:
Mario Kart 64 introduced 3D graphics, 4-player mode, Mirror Mode, Wario and Donkey Kong to the Mario Kart franchise.

SpaghettiKart is the HarbourMasters decompilation and port of the Nintendo 64 classic.
spaghettikart.instHtml: After installing the port, copy your original Mario Kart 64 .z64 file to ports/spaghettikart. The sha1 sum must be 579C48E211AE952530FFC8738709F078D5DD215E; other versions will not work.

starbound.title: Starbound
starbound.descHtml: Starbound is an extraterrestrial sandbox adventure game! You’ve fled your home, only to find yourself lost in space with a damaged ship. Your only option is to beam down to the planet below and gather the resources you need to repair your ship and set off to explore the vast, infinite universe…
starbound.instHtml:
Install

Copy the game assets packed.pak from your normal Starbound install to the starbound/assets directory before playing.

High-End Systems

If you are running on high-end aarch64 systems such as the Retroid Pocket 5 or the Odin 2, you can delete the mods/speedup folder in order to gain extra rendering quality at the expense of cpu.

sm64coopdx.title: Super Mario 64 Co-op DX
sm64coopdx.descHtml: Super Mario 64 Co-op DX is a game based on the Super Mario 64 engine and modified to have multiplayer and mods.
sm64coopdx.instHtml: You will have to copy your own rom legally obtained to ports/sm64coopdx with the name “baserom.us.z64”.

super.mario.war.title: Super Mario War
super.mario.war.descHtml: Super Mario War is a fan-made multiplayer Super Mario Bros. style deathmatch game in which players try to beat one another in a variety of gameplay modes. Great fun even in single player mode.

smworld.title: Super Mario World (and All Stars)
smworld.descHtml: Super Mario World is a 2D side-scrolling platform game in which the player controls Mario or Luigi, the protagonists of the game. The game has similar gameplay to earlier games in the Super Mario series – Super Mario Bros., Super Mario Bros. 2, and Super Mario Bros. 3 – but introduces new elements. As well as dashing and jumping, the player can also fly or float with the aid of the Cape Feather and P-Balloon and can execute the new Spin Jump move.[

sm.title: Super Metroid (Redux Included)
sm.descHtml: Super Metroid (スーパーメトロイド Sūpā Metoroido?), also known as Metroid 3, is a video game developed by Nintendo R&D1 and published by Nintendo for the Super Nintendo Entertainment System. Super Metroid is the third installment in the Metroid series. With its 24-megabit (3 megabyte) cartridge size, it was the largest video game on the Super Nintendo at the time of its release
sm.instHtml: To make it work just copy the Super Metroid US rom renamed as sm.smc in the root folder. For redux same thing, but use the redux Rom

zeldadoi.title: The Legend of Zelda: Dungeons of Infinity
zeldadoi.descHtml: This game is a procedurally-generated rogue-like 'Link to the Past' dungeon crawler. It's not a rom hack, it was created in Gamemaker Studio from scratch using the original assets. Many new features and assets were added to this game, but special care was put in to ensure it still looks, feels, and plays like the original game. The goal of the game is to descend through the many enemy-infested dungeons to defeat Link's nemesis, Aghanim. Along the way you will find many weapons, items, and treasures that will help you along your quest.

zeldafop.title: The Legend of Zelda: Fragments of Power
zeldafop.descHtml: Based on the original Zelda NES game, think of it as a third campaign with a few surprises. Takes place after the second game. Includes a randomizer mode for extra runs, though it is recommended the original game is played first.
zeldafop.instHtml: Download from itch.io then place data.win, options.ini, and both .dat files into the assets folder.

thextech.title: TheXTech
thextech.descHtml: This is a direct continuation of the SMBX 1.3 engine. Add assets, worlds and play Mario-style games with built-in world editor and many other features!
thextech.instHtml: Download assets from https://github.com/TheXTech/TheXTech/releases, file thextech-smbx13-assets-full.7z, unpack it to ./thextech/assets/smbx. Check README for more details!

tunics_pm.title: Tunics!
tunics_pm.descHtml: A roguelike Zelda-style action RPG built with the Solarus engine, where players fight through randomly generated, increasingly difficult dungeons using classic Zelda-inspired items and skills. It features permadeath
tunics_pm.instHtml: Get the .solarus file for this port by downloading Tunics! fromhttps://solarus-games.org/games/tunics/, then move it into ports/tunics_pm folder.

vdrift.title: VDrift
vdrift.descHtml: Drift is a cross-platform, open source driving simulation made with drift racing in mind.

wipeout.title: Wipeout
wipeout.descHtml: Wipeout is a racing game that is set in 2052, where players compete in the F3600 anti-gravity racing league. The game allows the player to pilot one of a selection of craft in races on several different tracks.
wipeout.instHtml: Copy the game data inside the wipeout folder. A prepackaged zip is avaiable on phoboslab site

zelda3.title: Zelda A Link to The Past
zelda3.descHtml: For devices with lower resolution of 640x480 or weird low res aspect ratio you need to modify the zelda3.ini file The game begins with series protagonist Link, the last descendant of the Knights of Hyrule, and his uncle, being awakened by a telepathic message from Zelda, who says that she has been locked in Hyrule Castle's dungeon by Agahnim and requires rescue. Link's uncle goes to rescue her first, and Link follows despite his uncle's orders to remain home. His uncle is slain, though beforehand, Link receives a sword and shield from him. Link infiltrates Hyrule Castle and successfully hides Zelda in the Sanctuary as his uncle's last wish.
zelda3.instHtml: Copy the zelda3_assets.dat file in the root of the zelda folder. The file can be obtained from the snes rom.

zeldansq.title: Zelda Navi's Quest
zeldansq.descHtml:
At the end of the Time of Triumph, Link left Hyrule to take well-deserved holidays far from the kingdom's restlessness. Link set sail to discover distant lands and paradise islands where he gladly spent the many rupees he had borrowed from the princess.

Yet, his holiday took a decisive turn on a small island where he heard interesting rumours.

Those rumours were about a very special island, the most fabulous beach resort, the marvellous Fairy Island. Link was very curious about it, and set sail again to see it by himself.

But what he found there wan't quite what he expected: a quick and painful death killed by a sea monster. His body was washed ashore on a beach...
zeldansq.instHtml: RTR To continue dialogues you need to press accept. Also to go after the boot image

zeldaolb.title: Zelda Oni Link Begins
zeldaolb.descHtml: Brought down by a terrible curse since his recent victory on the Dark Lord, Link is changing, day by day, into a powerful creature with a destructive nature named Oni-Link. Bannished from Hyrule, the young hylian asks the princess Zelda some help. She shows him his last hope: a portal to a secret world.
zeldaolb.instHtml: RTR To continue dialogues you need to press accept. Also to go after the boot image

zelda_roth.title: Zelda Return Of The Hylian
zelda_roth.descHtml: After the events that occured in Termina and the victory of the hero on his evil alter-ego, Zelda and Link knew that, from the bottom of hell, Ganon the immortal drawed his power from his wish to the Triforce, and rounded up his army with a view to invade Hyrule. Until the day when, after months spent watching out for an attack, an event came up and put an end to this endless waiting...
zelda_roth.instHtml: RTR To continue dialogues you need to press accept. Also to go after the boot image

zelda3t.title: Zelda Time to Triumph
zelda3t.descHtml: After the events that occured in Termina and the victory of the hero on his evil alter-ego, Zelda and Link knew that, from the bottom of hell, Ganon the immortal drawed his power from his wish to the Triforce, and rounded up his army with a view to invade Hyrule. Until the day when, after months spent watching out for an attack, an event came up and put an end to this endless waiting...
zelda3t.instHtml:
RTR After the events that occured in Termina and the victory of the hero on his evil alter-ego, Zelda and Link knew that, from the bottom of hell, Ganon the immortal drawed his power from his wish to the Triforce, and rounded up his army with a view to invade Hyrule. Until the day when, after months spent watching out for an attack, an event came up and put an end to this endless waiting...
